(84)be/:rerjes :rdo stuno sheste /)krung da ga pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ sgromi (84)0504 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dum bu dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 3rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 3rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 83rdo rje ye shes kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 92rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po rdo rje las zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 100dum bu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ces bya ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 114'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 1141

khro bo gsang ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 150rdo rje rigs kyi ye shes kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 157rdo rje rigs kyi las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 162rdo rje chen po'i rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 167'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 171rdo rje rigs thams cad kyi rdo rje gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 183rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 187de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 189dum bu gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig las bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 194'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 195chos gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 209ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 218las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 222phyag rgya bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 226dum bu bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 228don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 229rin po che'i phyag rgya'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 242ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 248las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 2532

brtag pa thams cad kyi thabs kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 257rigs thams cad kyi rtog pa gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 283brtag pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 297de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa/ 309rdo rje'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa/ 314pad+ma'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa/ 316nor bu'i rigs kyi nye bar sbyong ba'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 317rigs thams cad kyi thun mong du bzlas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ 319rigs thams cad kyi thun mong ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 320rtog pa thams cad kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud/ 325rtog pa thams cad kyi ye shes skye ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud/ 328rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ 331rgyud thams cad kyi phyi ma'i phyi ma'i rgyud/ 334paṇ+ḍi ta shra ka ra wa dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bar grags/bsdur mchan/(345) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(432)0505 gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ 433shin tu gsang ba stug po'i tshogs kyi las thams cad bsdus pa ste/drug pa las sems dpa' bcu drug gi bshad pa zhes bya ba bshad pa'i dang po/ 433cha dang po'i dkyil 'khor dbus ma/ 464de kho na nyi shu pa zhes bya ba sbyin sreg gi gsang ba/ 4973

dang por sbyor ba zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ go9las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 500rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbus kyi cha zhes bya ba/ 504shar phyogs kyi cha'i dkyil 'khor/ 505rdo rje rigs chen po zhes bya ba/ 507lho phyogs cha'i dkyil 'khor/ 507nor bu'i rigs chen po zhes bya ba/ 509nub kyi cha'i dkyil 'khor/ 510pad+ma'i rigs chen po zhes bya ba/ 513byang gi cha'i dkyil 'khor/ 513dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor thams cad/ 515mtshams rnams kyi dkyil 'khor/ 515'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba zhes bya ba/ 517las kyi rnal 'byor las byung ba/ 518de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma lus pa 519rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ 521rdo rje slob dpon gyi las/ 522slob ma'i cho ga dang ming gi dam tshig 533mchog tu gsang ba/ 535rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba/ 536rdo rje phra mo/ 537gter shes pa/ 542mi snang ba dang / mkha' la 'gro ba dang / chu'i steng du 'gro bar bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i gzugs nyid shes pa/ 5424

rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid/ 543mchog gi dngos grub/ 543de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dgug pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / chad pa gcad pa dang / yongs su bskyab pa'i las 544yon tan gyi dbang du byas pa'i rgyud/ 544de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba/ 545gsang ba'i chos kyi gnas mchog tu gsang ba/ 551rdo rje slob dpon gyi las/ 555ye shes kyi mngon par rtogs pa/ 594de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdo sde'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa le'u dang po/ 605rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba/ 608rdo rje gsang ba'i cho ga 611rtsu rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bsgom pa/ 636bzlas pa gsang ba rnam pa bdun/ 645de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa/ 647khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba rnam par bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa/ 654rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' rgyas pa/ 712dbang po bslab pa rnam par rol pa 718gsang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi cho ga 723rdo rje rigs kyi de kho na nyid shin tu gsang ba'i rnam par bshad pa ste le'u bzhi pa/ 7325

rog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ sasba ②ta thā ga ta tastu saṃ (0gra ha nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad thugs rje chen po gode bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 55)byin gyis brlabs dang / dam tshig gi ye shes rnam pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po (6)dbang bskur ba mnga' brnyes (7)pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnal 'byor chen po'i dbang phyug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad mnyam pa nyid du (8)thugs su chud cing / thams cad kyi 84—3

dgos hu)pa mdzad pa nyid kyis/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing ①lus pa med pa thams cad kyi re ba (guyongs su skong ba'i 'phrin ④las mdzad pa⑤/ thugs rje che ba rnam par snang mdzad dus gsum du rtag par yibazhugs shing / sku dang /gsung dang ⑦/ thugs thams cad rdo rje lta bur gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs shing bsngags bstod pa/ nor bu dang rin po che chen pos spras 6)pa/ kha dog sna tshogs shing ⑨dril bu btags pa/dar dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga ma dang / dra ba dang /dra ba phyed pa yidang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa'i 'og min gyi lha'i rgyal po'i gnas na bzhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / 'jam dpal dang / sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang thabs cig yonyetu bzhugs te/ de yang ⑫'di ltar 'dzam bu'i gling na de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med grangs med pa de dag gi skus kyang til gyi gang bu bzhin du yogegang bar snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re las kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med tshad mimed pa rnams snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na yang chos kyi tshul 'di dag 'chad do'/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po/ nam mkha'i dbyings 84—4

thams cad bzhin du rtag par bzhugs shing / sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje lta bur gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du 'jug pas / rdo rje dbyings thams cad thugs su chud pa'i ye shes sems dpa' nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs las byung ba'i ye shes kyi snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa nyid kyi ①rdo rje chen po'i ye shes rin po che'i ②dbang bskur ba'i rin po che chen po / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du spros pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas ④byang chub par gyur cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑤ngo bo nyid dag pa'i phyir yichos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dag par thugs su chud pa/ nam mkha'i khams ④thams cad du khyab pa'i gzugs thams cad du yang dag par ston pa/ mkhyen pas sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i khams rnams gdul bar (kyispyod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa6)/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' nod cing don yod par mdzad pa nyid kyis tu )thams cad dang mnyam pa med cing bla na med pa'i 'phrin las thams cad 4nyemadzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen por sems /snyebartan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba'i tunyedam yitshig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya ba'i ye shes kyi dbang phyug dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 7legs so zhes bya ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i dbang chen po tshonyabaskur ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyi ma'i 'od kyi tshonadakyil 'khor dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsam pa'i rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal 84—5

po'i 6)rin po che'i dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzhad pa chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dag pa'i ②chos chen po dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab chen po'i ye shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'chad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdon mi za bar thams cad kyi dgongs pa mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi brtson 'grus chen po'i go cha shin tu brtan po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis srung zhing skyob ①pa'i (geganod sbyin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings pa'i ye shes rnams so/ /kun bzang rab tu gdon mi za/ /bdud dang rab dgyes gtso bo dang / /mkha' skyes shin tu gzi chen dang / /rin chen dpal dang 'dzum pa che / /kun tu gzigs lta pa'i dbang chen dang / /'jam dpal dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / /mi gsung ba dang thams cad las/ /brtson 'grus ma rungs dam du gzung 6tsho/ /rdo rje lcags kyu nyamada' gzhu dang / /rin chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'dzum/ /pad+ma (gural gri 'khor lo gsung 6)/ /las dang go cha 'jigs byed bcingasakyi/ /thog ma tha ma med cing zhi(11/ /ma rungs khro bo bzod pa che/ /gnod sbyin srin po dam pa brtan/ /gzi chen tu dpa' bo dbang po (sriche / / u ma'i 'badag po skye dgu'i mgon/ /gtogs 'dod rgyal 'dod thub pa che/ /'jig rten skyong dang mkha' dang sa/ /'jig rten gsum dang khams gsum pas/ /'byung chen sems can don rab mdzad/ /thams cad gu lang tshangs pa dang / /'khor dang mya ngan 'da' dang rtag /yang dag 'tsho dang 84—6

mchod pa che0/ /sangs rgyas dag pa theg pa che/ /srid gsum rtag pa'ang de yin ②rna/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal bde spyod dang / /bde spyod gtso bo charab 'dul mdzad/ /rdo rje gtso dang sa rab mchog /ye shes pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar④/ /⑤de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi spyodayi//sangs rgyas don dang sangs rgyas thugs/ /byang chub kun dang bla na med/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba'i gtsog/ /rang byung gzungs (shedang dran pa dang / /sems dpa' che dang phyag rgya che/ /ting 'dzin sangs rgyas 'phrin las mdzad/ /yang dag sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ / yod pa dzi)rtag don rtogs mdzad pa/ /sdong po chen po nag po kyiche/ / 'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /6)thabs chen dang ni mchog chen mchog /kun gyi mchog dang gnas dbang po/she bcom ldan (3byang chub chen po'i thugs/ /byang chub se mas dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs la gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te byang chub sems dpa' 8chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba byang chub kyi snying por tsobazhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du rdzogs par 7longs spyod pa'i sku bstan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gang gi lha phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de khyenyekho na nyid mngon par ma rtogs par dka' ba spyod pa thams cad la spro ba bskyed cing / ji ltar yi/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par bya snyam/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems 84—7

dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①bskul bas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal (minas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ②de kho na nyid ni ⑦ji lta bu lags/ ji ltar na bsgrub (gepar bgyi bka' stsal par gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ⑥thams cad kyis gsung gcig tu 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rang gi sems la ༅rtog cing mnyam par zhog la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar zlos shing bsgrub ⑧par gyis shig /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be (sidhe ka ro mi/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bdag gi snying ga yin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur gda' ba bdag gis rtogs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sems de (1ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas na de ni ji ltar sbyangs pa de ltar gyur yonyate/ dper na ras dkar (stepo tshon 8gyis bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems shes pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta uṅgā da yā 7mi/ zhes bya ba rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'dis/ yang byang chub sems dpa' 7chen po de'i 7sems bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas yang (9byang chub sems dpa' des17/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi so )bkas byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba gang lags pa de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du mthong ngo / /de bzhin 84—8

gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs me thams cad kyi snying po sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang po khyod kyis mngon sum 6)du gyur gyis②/de legs par sgrubs nishig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang po de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'dis rang gi snying gar ④ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i dbyibs su soms shig /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ⑤badz+ra/ byang chub sems dpas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ⑥rdo rje 'dug par ⑦bdag gis mthong ngo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun tu bzang po'i sems rdo rje des ④sngags 'dis brtan par gyis shig /oṃ badz+ra ād+ma ko3nya6)/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du mnyam par 'jug ⑩pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje dbyings ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin (stobarlabs kyis sems dpa'i rdo rje der zhugs yiso/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa de la/ rdo rje'i dbyings/tunye rdo rje'i dbyings zhes bya ba'i dhiming gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje dbyings kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa 8de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yisku ni bdag legs par mthong ngo ⑪/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po de lta bas na/ sems dpa'i rdo rje de rnam pa'i mchog yonyethams cad (7dang ldan pa'i sa nyesangs rgyas kyi skur bdag nyid rang bzhin 84—9

gyis grub pa'i sngags ci dga' bar 6)zlos la sgoms shig /oṃ ya thā sasba ②ta thā ga ta sta thā ②a haṃ/ de nas de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po ④rdo rje'i dbyings kyis bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa ⑤mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ de nas ⑥de bzhin gshegs pa thams ①cad la phyag byas te 'u)'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag byin gyis rlobs la mngon par rdzogs par 6)byang chub pa 'di khubartan par mdzod cig /de nas de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i yirdo rje dbyings kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje der zhugs 7so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i dbyings kyis skad cig ma de nyid kyi tshe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje ()mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam tshig tu zhugs so/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam tshig tu zhugs so/ /(tshade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs pa rang bzhin gyis dag gotso/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mnyam pa nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing yiye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur to/ /de nas yang tu 7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tunyekyi sems dpa'i rdo rje de 17las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad so)byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bskyed/ nam mkha' 84—10

las byung ba'i 6)nor bu rin po che chen po'i ②dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ro① / /kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i duchos kyi ye shes ⑤bskyed/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las thams cad la yibazhag nas/ ri rab kyi rtse mo gang na ba dang / khang bu brtsegs pa ⑨rtse mo rdo rje (snyenor bu dang 6)rin po che las byas pa gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du byin gyis brlabs nas dbyer med par gyur 7te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi seng ge'i gdan la zhal kun tu bstan te bzhugs (7par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ldan turnyedang / de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i rgyal (3po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du so so nas bdag nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du (gerab tu rtogs tunyepa'i phyir/phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs yinas phyogs bzhir bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 51shenam mkha' las byung ba'i nor bu rin po che chen po'i dbang gis dbang bskur ba/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi yi/dbang po'i chos kyi ye shes dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las thams cad ( )gdon mi za bar ston pa( 1)/ thogs pa med ( 2pa/84—11

lta bu'i 'od zer de dag gi rtse mo las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku byung ste chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab pa thams cad dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ①rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ②mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon par byang chub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa dang /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa sna tshogs pa bsgrub ②pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs mnyes par mdzad pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po chen ④por gshegs pa dang / bdud thams cad 'dul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi byang chub chen por mngon par byang chub pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba phyinas/ ji srid sems can gyi khams ma yilus shing lus pa med pa rnams yongs su skyob cing thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba ⑦mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dang mngon par shes pa dam pa'i dngos grub bsgrub (nyapa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 6)rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul kyirnams kyi bar du bstan nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni kun tu bzang po yin pa dang /shin tu brtan (nyepa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' /gechen po kun tu bzang po'i skur gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas nas/ 'di skad du spre ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o yibadag ni rang byung ba'i/ /kun tu bzang po sems dpa' brtan / /de ni brtan phyir lus min yang / /sems dpa'i lus su gyur pa yin//84—13

de nas byang tshub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang 6)ye shes kyi dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ②la snyoms par zhugs nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang /(7 rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / sems can gyi don bya ba dang /thabs chen po dang 4/ stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / ye shes chen po'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa (5)rnams yongs su bskyab pa dang / thams cad kyi dbang por bya ba dang / thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba myong bar 57bya ba nas/ ji srid (7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang mngon par shes pa (kyebla na med pa dang 99ri/ theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa grub pa'i yimachog thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po de11/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur 12ba nyid du sangs rgyas 1lhathams cad kyi sku rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / cod pan yigyi dbang gis dbang bskur nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi grub pa'i rdo rje de de'i lag par byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/lag na rdo rje lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi kodabang gis dbang bskur ( zhero / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje phyag 84—14

g.yon pa rdo rje bsgyings par bzhugs te①/ phyag g.yas pas ②rdo rje thugs kur gsor zhing 'phen pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing ched du brjod pa ①'di ched du brjod do / /sangs rgyas kun gyi grub pa yi/ /rdo rje bla na med pa 'di/ /bdag ste bdag gi lag tu byin/ /rdo rje la ni rdo rje gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' rgyachen po gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i dam tshig las byung ⑤ba'i sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjordo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs tsonas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (kyispyan drang ba'i po)dam tshig ces bya ba'i ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra rā dza/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lcags kyu chen por gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te gcig tu (nye'adres par gyur nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te / bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu'i dbyibs chen po de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul tu rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po /nayin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sachen po dgadon mi za ba'i lus su gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te/ ched du brjod pa 84—15

'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /lcags kyu nges pa'i rgyal po bdag6) /gang phyir kun tu sangs rgyas khyab/ /grub phyir kun nas spyan 'dren to②/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i sku (7bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ④bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dude bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba'i ⑥dam tshig ⑦gi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba'i (8)dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dgug pa dang / thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba myong bar bya ba nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'du ba'i byin gyis brlabs dam pa'i bar du bsgrub pa'i 99)phyir rdo rje'i lcags kyu de byang chub sems dpa' gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ / de nas ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje dgug pa rdo rje dgug (1pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi (nyedabang gis dbang bskur 12ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ⑫chen po rdo rje dgug 7pa rdo rje lcags kyu des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 7rdo rje yi / /ye shes bla na med pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi don grub phyir/ /kun nas spyan drang nyamedam pa'o/ /de nas (stebacom ldan 'das 6)byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud ces bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba'i sems dpas 8 )byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin 84wa 16

ma'o sangs rgyas rnams kyi nges/ /'phrin las mang po kun bdag yin/ /sangs rgyas don ni lhun grub phyir/ /rdo rje las ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ①'phrin las thams cad ces bya ba'i lus bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs las labyung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig las byung ba'i ①rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje ④zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑤mchod par bya ba la sogs pa gdon mi za ba'i ⑥ tshad med pa dang las kyi cho ga rgyas pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyis las thams cad grub pa dang /thams cad kyi ⑦bde ba dang yid bde ba myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 'phrin las nyid dang ye shes dang mngon par shes pa dam pa rnams 'grub (kyepa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 6)'phrin las thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur bar tu )de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (nyerdo rje'i dbang (nyegis dbang bskur nas de'i lag tu las kyi rdo rje de de bzhin du tu)byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje thams cad 8rdo rje thams cad ces bya ba'i liming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje thams cad 7ces bya bas rdo rje de rang gi snying gar tu bzhag ste/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las la sbyor zhing ched du brjod pa 'di 84—37

ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /las rnams ①thams cad byed pa'i mchog /bdag ste bdag gi lag tu byin/ / sna tshogs la ni sna tshogs gzhag /(0de nas ( rabacom ldan 'das kyis ④byang chub sems dpa' (michen po brtson 'grus thub dka'i 6dam tshig las byung ba las thams cad kyis ( )byin gyis brlabs 87pa'i (97rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsrung 0ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i (7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra rak+ṣa/ 12de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las phyung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ go cha /stebartan par gyur te byung nas / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ rdo rje go cha chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje go cha'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku byung ste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsrung ciba'i go cha kyirgyas pa'i las yil sogs pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas / rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni brtson 'grus dam pa thub dka' ba dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub dka' ba'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o brtson 'grus go cha ni/zhe/ /brtan pa'i bdag nyid rab brtan bdag /de ni brtan phyir lus med kyang 18/ /rdo rje'i lus su byed pa 1784—38

mchog /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 6)chen po brtson 'grus chen po thub dka' ba de'i lus bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur (minas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje brtan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams yongs su bskyang gob dang thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba myong (geb nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sku 'thob pa'i mchog 'grub (6)par bya ba'i bar dung 'e/ de dag gi phyir rdo rje go cha de byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub dka' ba'i lag tu de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje grogs po rdo rje grogs po zhes rdo rje'i (8)ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje grogs pos rdo rje go cha 9des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la go cha bskon ⑩zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byams pa'i go cha dam pa ste/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas bsrung 31)ba che/ /grogs po chen por brjod pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i dam tshig las tsobyung ba/ las (12kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ñdzardo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thabs kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i tshede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 84—39

'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra yak+ṣal/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las phyung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha chen por gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas / rdo rje mche ba'i dbyibs ②su gyur te ①phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje mche ba'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul ④mo mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i ④sku byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bos gdul ⑥ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur ⑦te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas nas (nyached du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni sangs rgyas rnams/ /thugs rje can gyi thabs chen te/ /zhi yang sems can don du ni/ /ma rungs par ni ston par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i lus (9)bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs las byung nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis borab tu khro ba'i 11rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma rungs pa gdul (gyeba'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams 84—40

'jigs pa med par bya ba dang / thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba myong bar bya ba nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thabs chen po dang yo)ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rnams 'thob cing dam pa 'grub ②pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha de byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa de'i lag tu de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ③thams cad kyis rdo rje khro bo rdo rje khro bo zhes rdo rje ming gi dudabang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyechen po rdo rje khro bos durdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha de rang gi thugs ⑨kar bzhag ste④/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsngags ①shing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni kyisangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ma rungs thams cad 'dul ba'i mchog /rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon rno ste/ /thabs tunyedang snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje tu khu tshur zhes bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba las kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i skordo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes bcings pa'i ⑫dam tshig ces bya ba tsode bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra sarnyi/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad bcings par gyur te byung nas / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje bcings pa'i dbyibs su gyur te phyag gnyis su gnas 84—41

so / /de nas rdo rje bcing ba'i (1)dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ②sku byung steri / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang ye shes la sogs pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur shin tu bcings pa dang rab tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres gte byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur zhes bya ba'i skur gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rab tu brtan bcings pa'i/ /dam tshig bdag ste brtan pa'i bdag⑤ /bsam pa thams cad rab grub 6phyir/ /grol ba rnams kyang 'ching bar (me)byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur gyi sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs las byung ste de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyab na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas yang 8bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (9)dam tshig gi 7rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcing ba'i 11dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lha rnams kyis 12dgongs pa brtag 1 pa dang grub pa thams cad dang / thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba myong bar bya ba nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang phyag rgya'i dbang dam pa 'grub pa'i 84—42

bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir rdo rje bcing ba 0)de byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur zhes bya ba'i tshulag tu de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje khu tshur zhes rdo rje bya ba'i (5)ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgyachen po rdo rje khu tshur zhes bya ba des rdo rje bcings pa des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'ching zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya bcing ba gliche zhing brtan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 9myur grub ( nyephyir/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /(kyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i las dang brtson 'grus chen po'i go cha brtan pa dang nyu༄de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thabs chen po dang phyag rgya thams cad bcings pa'i ye shes dang 'di bzhi ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las chen po'i sems dpa'o// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa 7zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes bsgrubs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs 17zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par /gezhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i yi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /satwa brdzuyi/ 7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di phyung ma thag tu / rdo rje'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de 84wa 43

nyid do/ /'od zer de ①las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rnams la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs phyinas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje'i dbyibs chen por gyur te bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan snga na (bzla ba'i dkyil 'khor skyil gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//sems dpa'i rdo rje brtan pa'i ⑤bdag /gang phyir brtan pas lus med kyang / /rdo rje'i lus su gyur pa yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba yide bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab ⑦par bya ba'i phyir rin po che'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba'i nirdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa 597zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje rin po che'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / / rat+na baṣ+ṭha7/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di phyung ma thag tu rin po che'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /rin po che'i 'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rnams (1la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs 7nas yang gcig tu 'dres6)/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje rin po che chen po'i dbyibs 84—44

su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi g.yas phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing ①ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje rin chen bdag yin ⑦grags/ /gang phyir phyag rgya thams cad kyi/ /dbang gi tshul ni dam pa ①yin/ /de nas dubacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi ⑤dbang phyug gi ⑥rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das ⑦rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑧yi shes la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i ①phyir chos kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba/ rdo rje'i byin gyis kyibarlabs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / / dharma brdzu(1/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di phyung ma thag tu pad+ma'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /pad+ma'i 'od zer de dag las ()kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi (sterdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rnams rdzil phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs tsonas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje pad+ma chen po'i dbyibs su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyab kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do / /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi rdo rje gtsang ma bdagatso /gang phyir rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /'dod chags yin yang dri ma med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yinagadon mi za bar grub pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 84—45

bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i 6)phyir las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i (midam tshig las byung ba ①rdo rje byin gyis ④brlabs pa (7zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / / mas brdzu(6)/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung (7)ma thag tu las thams cad kyi 'od zer du gyur te(gu/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do / /las tsa)kyi 'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig kyirten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes rnams la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te 11yang gcig tu 'dres nas 'jig rten gyi khams tu thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi thams cad du rtse mo ltas pa'i las kyi 1sterdo rje chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi ñtsa)zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /las kyi rdo rje mang po bdagatso /gang phyir gcig kyang sems can khams97/ /ma lus par ni las bzang byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dam tshig dang dbang bskur ba chen po dang rdo rje'i chos nyid dang / mchod pa thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 1 pha rol tu phyin pa chen po rnams so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de nas 1 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 84wa 46

par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen mo ①'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra lā 0phye/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di phyung ma thag tu rdo rje'i phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i rtse mo de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ lha mo chen mo rdo rje 'dzin ma'i lus thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' chadang 'dra zhing kha dog dang gzugs dang mtshan ma shedang spyod lam sna tshogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs (5)pa/ de (5)bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad sdud par gyur pa rdo rje sems dpa'i lha mor gyur nas bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su (7)zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang byung (8)rnams kyi ni/ /mchod pa bdag 'dra gzhan med de/ /gang phyir 'dod 59)pa dga' mchod pas/ /mchod pa thams cad byas par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das 7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i phreng ba'i dbang gis /stodam tshig las byung btu / rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen mo zhu 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra mā le/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung yim thag tu rin po che chen po'i phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /rin po che chen po'i (7phyag rgya de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 84—47

skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ lha mo chen mo rdo rje phreng bar de bzhin du gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che ①'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs kyi ⑤zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du ② brjod do/ /e ma'o rin chen mchod pa zhes④/ /bdag dang 'dra bar grags pa med / /gang phyir khams gsum rgyal mchog kyang / /rab tu mchod pa byed par ⑤'gyural/ /de nas yang (7bcom ldan 'das ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu'i (nyamachog gi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje 6)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑩kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen mo 'di (1thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra gī ⑩ti/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di phyung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi phyag rgya de dag tsolas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ lha mo chen mo rdo rje glur 'gyur nas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tsogayon phyogs su 7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni kun gzigs pa'i/ /glu mchog tshul gyis mchod pa yin/ /gang phyir sgra brnyan 7'dra ba yin(she/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mnyes par byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyi 17mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba'i 6gyerdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi 84—48

lha mo chen mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra mṛ ①te/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las labyung zhum thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa de dag thams cad las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te dulha mo chen mo rgurdo rje gar du dugyur nas / ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod dol/ /e ma'o mchod kun don mdzad pa'i/ /mchod pa rgya chen bdag yin te/gang phyir rdo rje gar cho gsani/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rab tu byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i 6)las bla na med pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas ⑩bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tunyerab tu tshim pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yog mo'i gtso mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra dhū pe/tunye de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las phyung ma thag pa 'di tunyebacom ldan 84—49

'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de 6)bdug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin mang po ②rnam pa du mas rdo rje dbyibs (mithams cad du khyab par gyur nas phyung ngo ④/ /bdug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gergya mtsho de dag (5)las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur ⑨gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas rdo rje bdug pa'i lha mo'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su khang bu brtsegs pa'i gartse mo rdo rje dang / nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i grwa na 5nyezla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni mchod pa che/ /rab tu tshim tso ldan dge ba yin1sto/ /gang phyir sems can dbab yo ldan pas/ /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis 4)mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir rin po che'i rgyan gyi mchod pa chadam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsol ka ma 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra pukhye/tshade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di 0phyung ma thag tu 6 7bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid 1nyame tog thams cad kyi mchod pa bkod pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par byed par gyur nas byung ngo / /me tog thams ca da kyi mchod pa 19bkod pa de las 3 tsho'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas (nyayang gcig tu 'dres te rdo rje me tog gi lha mo'i skur gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs kyi khang bu brtsegs pa ( rtartse mo rdo rje rko rtanor bu 3 rin po che las byas 84—50

pa'i grwa ①na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o me tog mchod pa bdag /thams cad kyi ni rgyan byed de/ /gang phyir mchod nas de bzhin gshegs/ /rin chen nyid du myur du 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la snang ba'i mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba'i ②rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pho nya mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra ā lo ke(mi/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di khyibyung (gem thag tu thams cad du snang ba'i mchod pa'i (7bkod pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par byed par gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do / /thams cad du snang ba'i mchod pa'i (bebakod pa de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas/ yang gcig tu 'dres te lha mo rdo rje snang ba zhes bya ba'i skur gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su khang bu brtsegs pa (shertse mo rdo rje (9)nor bu yi )rin po che las byas pa'i grwa na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 5nye'adi ched yi du brjod do/ /e ma'o mchod pa'i mar me ni/ /rgya chen dge ba bdag yin te/ /gang phyir snang bcas myur du yang tshon/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan yang 'thob/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis ñtsa)mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams 84—51

cad kyi dris mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bran mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra garnye/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di 6)byung ②ma thag tu dri thams cad kyi mchod pa bkod pas/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par byed par gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /dri thams cad kyi mchod pa'i bkod pa ①de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas yang gcig tu 'dres te lha mo rdo rje dri zhes bya ba'i skur gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs kyi ④khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje ④nor bu 6)rin po che las byas pa'i grwa na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o lha rdzas mchod pa yi / /yid 'ong dri ni bdag yin te/ /⑦de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi drini/ /lus rnams kun la sbyin6)par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dbab pa dang / byang chub chen po'i yan lag bsags ⑩pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kun du snang ba dang / tshul khrims dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba ston pa'i yonyedri rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin byed pa'o/ /de nas tsobacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ yang 1 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi lcags kyu ④dam tshig las byung ba sems dpa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya mang po 7thams cad kyi 84—52

bdag po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra yaṃ ku ①sha /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las de byung ②ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya nimang po thams cad du gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya mang po ④de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas yang gcig tu 'dres te byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i skur gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje ⑤rnar bu ⑥rin po che las byas pa'i ⑦rdo rje sgo khang ②gi nang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gis spyan 'dren cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag spyan 'dren brtan pa bdag /gang phyir bdag gis spyan drangs pas6)/ /dkyil 'khor kun la bsten ⑩par 'gyur/ /de nas yang ⑩bcom ldan 'das 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig tu ()'jug pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya 'dren pa cigasol ka ba 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra pā sha/ 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las de tsobyung yonam thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'dren ⑫pa'i phyag rgya mang por 6)gyur nas byung ( )ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do(nye/ / de nas sonyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'dren pa'i phyag rgya mang po de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu 84—53

phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas yang gcig tu 'dres te byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje zhags pa zhes bya ba'i skur gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje 0)nor bu (mirin po che las byas pa'i ribasgo khang 54gi nang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dren 5)cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje zhags pa dam po bdag(6) /rdul phran bzhugs pa thams cad kyang / /bdag gis slar yang drang bar bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi lcags sgrog /sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig las byung ba/ sems dpa' ⑦rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsdams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (9pho nya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra spo ṭa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las de byung 9ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsdams pa'i phyag rgya mang por gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de 7nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig (mebasdams pa'i phyag rgya mang po de dag las 'jig rten gyi yonakhams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung nas/yang 3lhagacig tu 'dres te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags sgrog ces bya ba'i skur gyur nas 1 bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje 7nor bu rke rin po che las byas pa'i rdo rje chos kyi sgo khang gi nang gi nye 7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 1nya'aching zhing ched du 84—54

de yang rdo rje 'chang 'drar 'gyur/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'di 6)dag gis/ /bdag cag gis ni bstod pa yin/ /theg ②pa chen po rtogs pa yig/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad par gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos ④de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyigasol ba btab 6)pa'i tshig thos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung ba ⑦rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ⑧zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po (9)'di bshad do/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ / rdo rje ⑩dkyil 'khor yidam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes bgyi bar grags/ /sems dpa' che yi tunyephyag rgya cher / /bsgom ⑩zhing byin gyis rlob bgyid cing / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus nyid du/ /ci rigs par ni mchis nas kyang / /phyag rgya la gnas de bzhin langs / /kun du rnam par bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod nas / /bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bskor/ /sar pa legs par yibakal nas kyang / /tshad dang mthun la tsomadzes pa yi/ /thig gis mkhas pas ci nus kyisayi / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni thig gdab cing / /gru ྅ rmobazhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes bgyis la/ /thig bzhi dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa tshogeyi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni nang (7rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras )par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /de yi rim pa'i ri nyanang zhugs la/ /'khor lo 'dra bar ri rdo 84—59

rje yi/ /thig gis yongs su bskor bar bgyi②/ /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes bgyis la② / /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lngas brgyan la/ /dbus kyi dudakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs gzhag cing / /sangs rgyas kyi ni phyogs kun gyi/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi ④dbus rnams su/ /rim bzhin du ni dam tshig mchog /bzhi po legs par gzhag par bgyidu/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag tu/ /rdo rje'i gom pas song nas ni/ /mi g.yo ba la sogs pa yiyi/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po thams cad gzhag /mi g.yo ba yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs bcas ⑦par gzhag /rin chen 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje snying sogs ④rdzogs par gzhag /tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje spyan sogs ⑨dag par gzhag /gdon mi za grub dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rgya gram la sogs gzhag /'khor lo yi ni grwa rnams su//rdo rje lha mo rnams kyang gzhag /dkyil 'khor phyi rim ⑩gyu rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rnams kyang gzhag /sgo rnams kyi ni yinang du ni/ /sgo srung 8bzhi yang gzhag par bya8/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim phyogs su ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang gzhag /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /cho ga bzhin bcings zhugs tsonas kyang / /ghaṇ+ḍa'i 8phyag rgyas dbab par bgyi/ de la thams cad dbab pa'i snying po ni ⑩'di lags 0so/ /aḥhunye / bdag la byin gyis brlab 67la sogs/ /ji lta bar ni bka' gu nod do/ /de ltar bgyis nas (1bdag ming brjod/ /de nas rdo rjes bsgrub bgyi ba/ /rdo rje slob dpon sems dpa' yi/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bcings nas ni/ /se gol mang po brdab gyis ⑩la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bgyi/ /de tshe sangs 84—60

rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems ①la sogs par ②bcas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad gang ba rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rnams su 'dus par 'gyurag/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yidu/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /cung zad rab tu brjod par bgyi/ /da dunas 'dus pa dgyes pas nadu/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams brtan par 'gyurargya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang grub pa/ /grogs po nyid du nye bar gnas/ /de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la sogs las bgyis nas/ /las chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis/ /dam tshig rnams ni gzhag par bgyi/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /sems dpa' rdo rje la sogs pasal/ /de ltar sems dpa' chen po bsgrub/ / dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ7zhes brjod cing / /de nas sangs rgyas la sogs ⑩pa/ /sems dpa' chen po kun bsdu bar/ /spyan drangs nas ni rab tu bcug /bcings nas de yi dbang du gyur/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po rnams / /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes bgyis la/ /thams cad grub phyir sems can don7/ /thams cad mdzod ces gsol bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du rdo rje slob dpon gyis de bzhin du tshulas bgyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir ni rdo rje slob ma dkyil 'khor du zhugs (stepa la sogs pa mcho ga rgyas par 8mchis so/ /de la dang po tsogazhug pa lags te sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams yongs su bskyab ⑩pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi (nyephan pa dang bde ba'i mchog grub par bgyi ba'i 4)slad du'o/ /gu dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir gzhug ( —)pa la snod du gyur pa dang snod du ma gyur pa brtag mi 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das ru)84wa 61

bcug ma thag tu 'di skad du bsgos ①shig /deng khyod kyis ②de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du 'grub ③pa'ang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos 0te/ de lta bu'i ⑤yi shes bskyed par bya yisadu/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra gshig dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyis (snyesems dpa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya kha nang na khyabastan pa dang / phyir bstan pa bcings la rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste 'di skad du brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin gyis ⑩gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na/ 7klad pa 'gas 8par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid dang mna'i chu'i snying pos bsngags til slob ma de 'thung du gzhug go/ /de la mna'i snying po 'di yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' ④deng khyod kyi / /snying la yang dag gzhug par mdzad8/ /gal te tshul 'di smras tson ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badz+ra da ka 0tha/ de nas slob ma la 'di skad bsgos lho)shig /deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyisayi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par so ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyod dus byas nas ⑥dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re zhes smras la 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sonyabyin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces brjod du gzhug go( )/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis myur du sems dpa'i (sterdo rje'i stephyag rgya bcings la/ 'di skad du smrar 9 lhagazhug go/ /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje'i ye shes bla med ni/ /84—64

de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā ①de sha aḥl/ de nas khro bos ③phyag rgya bcings la/ sems dpa'i rjordo rje'i ①phyag rgya la dumadud cing drangs la theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i tshig ci nus par smrar lagazhug go/ /de nas phab ste ⑧babs ma thag tu lha'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ ye shes des pha rol gyi sems shes par 'gyur ro/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba rnams kyi dgongs ⑨pa thams cad shes par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa thams cad la de yis sems brtan ⑩par 'gyur ro/ / de yis ⑩sdug bsngal thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral nas gnod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /sems dpa' thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad 8'di'i mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /rgyu med par sngon ma byung ba'i dga' ba dang mgu ba dang / rangs par byed pa'i bde ba thams cad de til skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba de dag kha cig gis ni ting nge 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur rol/ /kha cig gis ni gzungs/ kha cig gis ni re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa nas/ kha cig gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'grub pa'i bar du tso'agyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya de bcings la rang gi snying gar bkrol byazhing snying po 'di yang smrar tsogazhug go/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ⑩nyo me bha ba shā shwa rkyo 8me bha ba/skṛ yid ya me/ a dhi ⑩tiṣ+ṭha sarba sidhisme 0pra yats+tsha 'argyu/ ha ha ha ha ho/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba de dkyil 'khor chen por dor zhing snying po 'di yang ched du (nyebarjod du gzhug go/ /pra tīts+tsha tsobadz+ra hoḥ/ de nas gang la bab pa de des ( ge'agrub bo/ /de nas phreng ba de 0blangs te/ ()mgo bor bcings la snying po 'di 84—65

smrar rdzigazhug go/ /o ②ma ti griṇ+ḍa swa ②mi māṃ rgyasatwa ma hā ba la/ de bcings pas sems dpa' chen po des bdag gir byas par gyur pas 'di myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de ltar babs bzhin du dugadong g.yogs pa ⑥bgrol ⑦te / snying po 'di yang smrar dugazhug go/ /o badz+ra satwa sa yaṃ te 6) t+ya tsak+ṣan ⑩ta na tat+pa 7ra ut+ta ṭa8/ ya ti saza 'khyo badz+ra tsak+ṣu a nut+ta 8ro te badz+ra pā bya8/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po rim pa yibazhin du bstan to/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ma thag tu yang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang de'i 7snying ga na gnas so/ / de nas snyide bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑩byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ 'od zer sna tshogs tsho )la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sogs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku cig 0ston par 'gyur ro / /de'i po 2phyin chad don thams cad dang yid kyi dgos pa'i 'dod ( nyapa thams cad dang / dngos grub thams cad nas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i 'og tu rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa'i nang gi dri'i chu dang snying po 'dis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa 69'i(nye/ de nas phyag rgya dang phreng ba gang yang rung ba gcig 65bcings la rang gi mtshan ma lag par bzhag la 'di skad du brjod par bya'o 7/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ( nyerdo rje'i dbang / /de 66ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab 'grub 8)phyir/ /rdo rje de (stoni khyod kyis long rin/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ so a bhi ṣiñtsa 69mi nya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma 84—66

ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas snying po 'dis ①rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ②dbang bskur bya'o①/ /o badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ ④a bhi ṣiñtsa ⑤mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe stika taX/ kye nirdo rje zhes gang gi ming gis 6)gang brjod pa der/ kye zhes brjod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas ci khyod don 'byung ba'i dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i ye shes dang /rig ⑩'dzin gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i ye shes nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi mchog 'grub hu1pa'i ye shes kyi bar du/ gang 'dod ces smras la de nas gang gis gang 'dod pa de de la brjod par bya'o/ /de nas don thams cad kyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab par bya ste/ rdo rje'i dbyings ni gter gnas patso/ /snying gar yongs su bsgom par bya/ /bsgoms (nyenas sa la gnas pa yi/ /gter ni de yis mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i dbyibs cig bris nas kyang / /nam mkha'i ngos la 8bsgom par bya/ /gang du lhung bar tsomathong ba der/ /gter yod par ni shes par bya8/ /blo ldan mi yis rdo rje'i dbyibs/ /lce yi steng du bsgoms na ⑩ni/ /'di na tunyeyod ces bdag nyid kyis/ /bden pa nyid du nyugesmra bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi lus ni thams cad la/ /rdo rje dbyibs su bsgoms nas ni/ /babs par gyur nas gar gnas par( )/ /gter ni de na yod par bshad/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra ni jug ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ rat+na ni ni rnyi( nya/ oṃ dharma (steni rnyi(she/ oṃ gas ( nyani rnyi(me/ de nas rdo rje rdzu 'phrul gyi dngos grub 'grub ( shepa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab par bya ste/ rdo rje'i dbab pa byas nas ni/ /chu la rdo rje'i dbyibs 'dra bar/ /bsgoms nas 27chu yi steng na phar no/ /'gro ba'i dngos grub myur 84—67

bar 'grub①/ /de ltar dbab pa byas nas kyang / /gang gi gzugs su bdag gi lus/ /bsgoms par gyur na bdag nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni skur yang 'gyur / /de ltar bdag la phab nas kyang / /bdag gis bdag nyid ②nam mkhar ni/ /bsgoms par gyur ②na ji srid du/ /'dod pa de srid mi snang 'gyur / /rdo rje babs ④par bdag gyur dunas/ /rdo rje yin par bdag bsgoms na/ /gnas nas ji srid lding 'dod pa/ /de srid mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur / /de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra dz+wa yil/ badz+ra rū ⑦pa/badz+ra ā kā sha /badz+ra ma r+sāni/ de nas rdo rje rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i lho)phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab ⑩par bya ste/ zla ba'i dbyibs cig bris nas ni/ /steng gi mkha' la 'phag bya ste/ /lag 0par rdo rje bsgoms na ⑩ni/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dbyibs steng 8'dug gnas nasatso/ /rdo rje rin chen rab bsgoms na/ /bdag nyid bdag pa 'ji srid 'dod/ /de srid skad cig lding bar 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dbyibs kyi steng 'dug nas/ /rdo rje pad ma la ⑩gnas par/ /bsgoms na 0rdo rje spyan gyis ni/ /rig 'dzin go 'phang sbyin par byed/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas nas/ /las kyi rdo rje bsgoms na poni/ /rdo rje sna tshogs 9/)'dzin pa las/ /rig 'dzin kun tu myur bar 'gyur/ /de dag gi snying po ni (3'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra dha ra/ rat+na ⑥dha ra/ dharma 84dha ra/ gas 0dha ra/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub dam pa 'grub pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab par bya ste/ rdo rje kun gyi 6)ting nge 'dzin/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ( )su bsams na tsodi/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid ji srid 'dod/ /de srid rab 6)tu lding bar 'gyur/ /kun las tso84—68

dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bsgoms na bla med de bzhin du/ /ye shes bsgrub ①pas myur du ni/ /mngon shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar ni/ /nam mkha' thams cad dran byas na/ /bdag nyid dran pa brtan ldan zhing / /rdo rje 'dzin par myur du 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni ②thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su dmigs dunas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin las/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra badz+ra/ shud+dha shud+dha/ satwa satwa/ bud+dha bud+dha/ thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi ye shes 'grub pa rnams so/ /de nas gsang duthub pa yin pas / de la dang por mna'i snying po brjod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ⑤su ya:du/skṛ ⑦da ye sa ma bsta ②ta ni bīr+sā ta tak+ṣa tsā ⑨lnga ād+ma ya ⑩ti bru yad i dam yin yaṃ/de nas 'di skad du khyod kyis mna'i snying po de tsolas 'da' bar ma byed cig /khyod kyis gnod pa ma spangs pas/ dus ma yin par shi ⑩bar gyur ta re/ lus 'di nyid kyis dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab par bya'o/ /rdo rje dbab pa byas na 8ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas rdo rje yiyi/ /thal mo 8ngos kyis dal brdabs na/ /ri bo yang ni dbang du 'gyur/ /rdo rje thal mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i ngos kyis 8ni/ /dal gyis yibardab par sbyor ba yis / /ri bo yang ni kun nas 'gugs/ /de bzhin dbab pa'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje bsdams pa ( )brkyang nas ni/ /sor mo'i rtse mo mnyam brdabs na/ /rigs brgya yud kyis brlag par 'gyur/ /phra mo ( nyedabab pa'i cho ga yis( / /sor mo thams cad mnyam bzhag cing / /rdo rje bsdams mas bgrol du ba ni/ / sdug 84wa 69

bsngal thams cad sel zhi)ba'i mchog / de nas (gyide dag gi gsang ba bsgrub (9pa yin te/ bud med dam cini skyes pa yi/ /bu ga'i nang du gzhug ⑤par bya/ /yid kyis de ltar zhugs nas kyang / /de yi lus kun khyab par bsam/ /de la ⑥ thal mo'i snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra pā sha /badz+ra ā chabe sha /badz+ra ha na / badz+ra ha ra/ de nas zho)rang gi rigs kyi lha'i phyag rgya bzhi'i ye shes bslab par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di skad du bsgo bar bya ste/ khyod kyis phyag rgya mi shes ⑨pa gzhan su yang rung ba dzil/ phyag rgya gang yang rung ba bstan par ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong bar gyur pa'i sems can de dag gis phyag rgya bcing ba byas na(me/ de'i tshe de dag de ltar 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag the tshom ()du gyur te/ gnod pa ma spangs pas myur ba nyid du dus byas nas/ dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa zhes bya bar lhung 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod nyid kyang ngan song du 'gro yibar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa' sgrub 7pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes gang yin pa ste(༅/ sems rtogs pa nas brtsams nas ni/ /rdo rje dbyings shes rjod 1 tshobyed cing / /sangs rgyas skur ni (stebadag bsgyur la/ /rdo rje nyi ma bsgom par bya19/ /grub ma thag tu de 37yis ni/ /ye shes tshe stobs na tshod dang / /kun tu 'gro ba nyid rnams 'thob/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'ang dka' ba min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 9 1byang chub pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub 9 snyepa'i phyag rgya chen po bcing ba yin te/ sku gsung thugs ni 2rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje bsgyings par sems bskyed de / /bsgyings bcas rdo rje gsor byed na/ /rdo rje sems dpar chobadag nyid 84wa 70

'gyur / / des na ①kun du 'gro ba dang / /'dod pa kun bdag bde can (kyidang / /rdzu 'phrul che ③stobs gzugs mchog rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs ni ④rdo rje yis/ /ji ltar ri mo'i rjes mthun ⑤zhing / /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rnams ldan pa(6)/ /sems dpa' chen por ༅bsgrub par bya/ / 'dir ni dum bu thams cad kyi/ /nisgrub pa dang ni dngos grub dang / /grub pa rnams kyi las chen rnams/ /go rims 6)bzhin du bshad par bya / /dang por nyin re'i 7dus bzhin du/ /rang la byin gyis brlab la sogs(nya / /byas nas thams cad bsgrub bya ste/ /de yi 'og tu ci dgar bya/ /de la phyag rgya chen por bsgrub 8pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje dbab pa byas nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po cho ga bzhin/ /bcings nas de yi mdun tsophyogs su/ /sems dpa' chen po de bsgom mo/ /ye shes sems dpa' de mthong nas/ /rang gi lus su bsgom par bya/ /bkug cing bcug la bcing ba skidang / /dbang du byas te bsgrub par bya/ /8de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra satwa aḥyirdo rje dbab pa'i snying po'o/ /badz+ra satwa dṛ sh+ya 8ho/sems dpa' chen po rjes su dran par bya ba'i tsho snying po'o/ / dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ47/sems dpa' chen po spyan drang ba dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang khri )dbang du bya ba rnams kyi snying po'o/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ( :zhes brjod pas/ rgyab tu zla ba grub nas ni/ /der bdag sems dpa' 2 lus su bsgom/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ brjod/ /sems dpa' gang gi phyag rgya gang / /de ni bdag tu bsgoms nas ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pas bsgrub par bya/ /phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub sa pa'o/ /gzhan yang bsgrub ( )pa chen po ni/ / dzaḥtsū baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la/ /legs pa'i cho gas ( zhi84—71

yid kyis ni/ /lus su ①sangs rgyas kun gzhug go/ /de nas bla med rdo rje'i las / /de dag gi ni las bshad de②/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran grub na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du myur du 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje ma grub na/ /phyag rgya kun gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /rin chen rdo rje'i phyag rgya yisal/ /de ni rin chen kun dbang 'gyur/ /chos kyi rdo rje grub na nidhi/ /sangs rgyas chos ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /las kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis⑤/ /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i phyag rgya yibacings pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur//rdo rje 'dren pa'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ⑦spyan 'dren 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dod pa'i phyag rgya ches/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /rdo rje legs pa'i cho ga yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /rin chen phyag rgya'i cho ga yis/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur de bzhin dul/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cho ga yis/ /rdo rje gzi brjid myur du 'grub6)/ /rdo rje dpal 'dzin bsten pas na / /re ba rnams ni yongs su skong (7/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i cho ga yisa'o / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam du bzhadatunye/ /rdo rje chos kyi cho ga yis/ /rdo rje chos ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje rnon po'i cho ga yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi shes rab mchog /rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin bsten pas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsung gi 8cho ga yis/ / sangs rgyas gsung gi grub pa 'thob/ /7rdo rje'i las mchog ⑩bsgrubs pas na/ /rdo rje'i las su tunyemyur du 'grub3 / /rdo rje'i go cha bskon nas ni(1/ /rdo rje'i sku ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bsgrubs pas na nya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin mnyam par 'gyur/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings pas na/ /phyag rgya thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 84—72

'dzin pa bsgrubs ①pas na②/ /rdo rje rol pa chen po ①'thob/ /rdo rje phreng ba bcings pas na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur bya'agyur/ /rdo rje glu yi cho ga yis/ /rdo rje glu ni len par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i gar gyi sbyor khyab yis/ /sangs rgyas kun la des ⑥mchod do/ /rdo rje bdug pa'i cho ga yis/ /'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed/ /rdo rje me tog sbyor byed pas/ /des ni 'gro ba dbang du byed/ /rdo rje snang ba'i phyag rgya ches/ /rab mchog mig ni sbyin par byed / /rdo rje dri yi cho gas ni/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /rdo rje lcags kyus ⑦drangs pas na/ /'dren pa kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i cho gas ⑧ni/ /thams cad rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog sbyor ba yis6)/ /thams cad bcing bar nus par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i cho ga yis/ /thams cad dbab par rab tu 'grub/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes bshad de(spre/thal mo dam du sbyar ba las/ /sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mor bka' stsal te/ /rab tu bsdams phyir rdo rje bsdams/ /dam tshig phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /rdo rje bsdams (nyalas byung bas na/ /de dag bsdams 7pa rdo rje yi() / /bsdams pa bla med bshad par bya/ /rdo rje bsdams pa dam bcas yil/ /gung mo myu gu ltar mnyam bsgreng ski/ /gung mo nang du gshibs tsob ni/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i 4)yin par bshad/ /gung mo rin chen 'dra ba dang / /gung mo pad+ma 'dra bar (nyedagug /sangs rgyas lnga pa'i 4)phyag rgya ni/ /de bzhin mdzub mo bkug ( )pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /rigs kyi dam tshig 'dzin pa yi / /phyag rgya bsdams ri nyedang dngos grub dang / /las rnams yang dag bshad 84—73

par bya/ /zla ba lta bu'i lag gnyis kyi'abye/ /gung mo btang bar gyur pa yi/ /mthe bo mthe ②chung so sor bsgreng ②/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje bsgreng durdo rje/ / mdzub mo (5)lcags kyu mdzub yimo sbyar/ /legs so sbyin pa 'dra ba ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi po yi(7)/ /phyag rgya mang po'i ⑧dngos grub de'o/ /mthe bo gzhibs la mdzub 9riganyis bcag /rtse sprad rin chen rdo rje 7yin/ /de nyid (nyagung mo srin lag dang / /mthe'u chung rnams ni bsnol brkyang ba'o8/ /de las ⑫srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis/ /mnyam par gshibs ④pa rgyal mtshan no/ /de 'di 7las ni bskor nas kyang / /kha 7yi phyogs su bzhag pa'o/ /mthe bo ()gnyis ka mnyam par gshibs/ /mdzub (shemo gnyis ka bkug pa dang / /yigung mo bsgreng ba'i 8)rtse mo bkug /de nyid 0rdo rje ral gri'o/ /de las srin lag mthe'u chung gshibs32/ /'khor lo yin par bshad pa yin( ge/ /bsdams la mthe bo 8steganyis bgrol la lta/ /bkan te kha phyogs bzhag pa'o/ /mthe bo 9 nyamathe'u chung rtse sprad bskyed9 bhe/ /las kyi rdo rje yin par bshad/ /de las mdzub (nyamo gnyis gshibs la rte/ /snying gar brkyang ste bzhag pa'o/ /mdzub 6 )mo rtse mo gnyis bkug stol/ /mthe'u chung gshibs pa mche zhi ba'o/ /mthe'u chung gnyis par mthe bo 82gnyis/ /mdzub 8 〉mo gnyis kyis btsir (stoba'o/ /snying gar mthe bo mnyam nas gi bzhag /rab tu brkyang ba phreng ba'o/ /thal sbyar rtse mo 6 rmekha nas dbyung / /gar las thal sbyar spyi bor gzhag /rdo rje bcings pa thur mnyedu klugs rte / / thal mo sbyar ba )gyen du gtor/ /mthe bo mnyam ste 6lharab tu bsdam ge / /rab tu brkyang nas byug pa'o/ /mdzub 6nyamo gcig pu dgug ṭaṃ )pa dang / /mthe bo lhaganyis ni mdud pa dor/ /mthe bo mdzub mo gdu 69bur 84—74

bcing / /rdo rje bcing ba mdzub 6)mo bsdamal/ /de nas 'di rnams bsgrub ①bshad de/ /rdo rje'i bsgrub ④pa dam pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis / /rang gi phyag rgya snying gar gzhag /de nas 'di rnams las bshad pa/ /rdo rje las ni bla na med/ /rdo rje dbyings lnga'i (dephyag rgya ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams 'dus pa yis6)/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon slob mar bcas/ /de ma thag tu byin gyis rlob/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje bcings pas na⑦/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bcings pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang dgug par byed(she/ /'dod pa'i rdo rje sbyar bas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i yi)sangs rgyas ⑩mnyes par byed/ /rdo rje dga' bas rgyal ba kun/ /legs so bas ni bstod par byed/ /rin chen rdo rje bcings pas na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis de dbang bskur / /rdo rje nyi ma bcings pas na/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni 'od 'drar 'gyur/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'chad tunye'agyur bas/ /re ba kun kyang 4 rdzogs par byed/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang lhan cig bzhad/ /chos kyi rdo rje bcings pas na/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje ral gri thogs pas na/ /nyon mongs thams cad des gcod do/ /rdo rje 'khor lo brtan pas nayin / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbang por 'gyur/ /rdo rje smra ba'i sbyor ba yisayi/ /rdo rje ngag mchog 'grub par 'gyur/ /las kyi rdo rje bcings pas nal/ /rdo rje las dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje go cha brtan byas pas/ /lus ni rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya mchogatso /ma rungs bdud ni des 'joms so/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings pas/ /phyag rgya kun yang tshonadabang du 'gyur / / 'dzum pas tsho nilha yi dga' ba rnams/ /phreng ba yis ni rgyan gyi rnams//84—75
