rū ①pa sho rtses ②gzugs bzang bani/ /sho tra sau byakhya bde ba sbyin/ /sabra pū dza mchod par byed/ / pra lī da ni yid bder ⑤'gyur/ /pha lā gā ⑥mi 'bras bu 'thob / /su te dzā ④gri gzi brjid che/ /su gharnye gi nidri mchog lacan/ /ā ⑩ya ha dziḥ7'gugs par byed/ /ā 8lnga hi 0rgyu 'jug ④par byed/ /he sbo ṭa baṃ 'ching ba che/ / lhastu a aḥtsorab bskyod pa'o⑩/ /de nas de dag gi 0chos kyi phyag rgya bsgrub tu)pa dge ba bshad do/ /lce la rdo rje bsgoms nas kyang ⑪/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ / ༅de nas las kyi phyag rgya dubacing ba bshad de/ rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gnyis su bya / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis bcings te/ /de nas bcing ba rab tu bshad/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje mdzub 0mo ni/ /ma(gegayas pa'i nang du bsgreng bar bya/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog sbyin 0pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba yi cis reg pa/ /durin chen gyi ni mchog ( nyesbyin pa'o/ /tshe dpag med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /gdon mi za ba'i mi 'jigs sbyin/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya rnams/ /mdor bsdus rab tu bshad par bya/ /rdo rje sems sogs ( )sems dpa' rnams/ /rdo rje las rnams byed pa ste/ /bsgyings bcas gsor ba gnyis ka tsoyis/ /lcags kyu 'dzin ltar gnas pa dang / /mda' 'phangs pa so)yi tshul dang (nyani/ /legs so zhes pa snying gar bzhag /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gnyis / /snying gar nyi ma brtan par bya/ /g.yon pa la ni gru mo gzugs/ /de bzhin kha phyogs bskor bar bya/ /g.yas pa yis ni g.yon pa dbye/ /snying gar g.yon pa ral gri mdung / /mgal me 6spre'akhor lo bskor ba dang / /rdo rje gnyi gsogekha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar bskor bgrol ba yi ri / /thal mo 'gram pa spyi bor 84—77

rgyas 'dra bar lamyur bzhad ②'gyur/ /rdo rje me tog bcings pas na②/ / de yis ④rdo rje chos rnams phyimathong / /rdo rje ral gri brtan bcings na/ /de ⑥ni sdug bsngal thams cad gcod/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bcings pas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshig rnams ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni dbang du 'gyur/ /rdo rje go chas lus bcings pas/ /rdo rje snying po thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje mche (7ba bcings pas ni/ /rdo rje nyid kyang bdag gis choms / /rdo rje khu tshur kun 'phrog cing / /phyag rgya grub pa kun kyang nirnyed/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas dga' ba sbyin/ /rdo rje phreng bas gzugs bzang ba/ /rdo rje glu yis glu snyan padzi)/ /rdo rje gar gyis dbang du byed/ /bdug pa yis ni yid dga' kyib/ /me tog gis ni rgyan rnams te/ /mar me yis ni gzi chen po/ /rdo rje dri 1nyani dri rab tu ldan/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhunya'agugs pa ste/ /rdo rje zhags pa dhi'ajug pa'o/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'ching bar byedasko/ /rdo rje dril bu bskyod pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya thams cad kyi spyi'i phyag rgya bcing ba'i mcho ga rgyas pa yonabashad de/ /de la thog ma nyid du rdo rje bcing ba'i sor mo snying gar brdab par bya ste snying po (she'adi brjod do/ /badz+ra brnya tra ṭahurte/ de nas phyag rgya bcings pa kun/ rang gis ( )lus dang ngag dang sems kyi zhu1rdo rje'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la snying po 'di ( stebarjod do/ /sa( ge/ de nas rdo )babs nas grogs po nyid du nye bar gnas par gyur tosan/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi sems dpa' ( ri chen po rjes su dran par bya ste snying po 'di brjod de / /ma hā sa ma ya satwa haṃ / des ni ( /phyag rgya thams cad 'grub ste/ phyag 84—79

rgya thams cad 'grub ①pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas spyi'i bsgrub ②pa'i cho ga rgyas pa bshad do/ /de la thog mar rang gi phyag rgya bcings nas/ rang gi phyag rgya'i sems dpar bdag gi snying po 'dis bsgom mo/ /sa ma yo haṃ/ de nas rang gi ②phyag rgya'i sems dpar bdag bsgoms ④nas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab bo/ /sa ma ya satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa rmārgya/ de nas bsgrub par bya'o/ /bsgrub ⑥pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa bshad de/de la thog mar re zhig nor bsgrub ( )par 'dod na snying po 'di yin no/ /arba sirnyi / des 6)phyag rgya grub na nor chen po skye bar 'dod dokhya/ /de nas rdo rje 'grub ⑩par 'dod na snying po 'di yin no/ /badz+ra sirnyi/ des 4)ci 'dod pa bzhin du rdo rje 'grub 8par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rig 'dzin gyi grub pa 'dod na snying po 'di yin no/ /badz+ra bibyā dha ra sidhi/ des (nyeji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rig 'dzin 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du dam pa 'grub ④par 'dod na rang gi phyag rgya'i snying pos bsgrub bo/ /dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgya thams cad kyi spyi'i rang gi lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rjer bya ba'i spyi'i 7cho ga rgyas pa bshad de/ nam phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs lhod par gyur tam/bdag tshagatong bar 'dod na/ de nas snying po 'dis yonabartan par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho 8me bha ba4)/su to ṣ+yo me bha ba )/ a nu rasto me bha ba( 2/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba( nya/ ( gsasba si smo pra yats+tsha / sarba yismo 'o su tsa me tsisto shri 3 yaḥliku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bā na / sab ta thā ga ta( nya/ badz+ra mā me so)muñtsa brdzu khri 〉bha ba zhunyam hā sa ma ya satwa aḥd / des 2ni mtshams med pa byas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams 84—80

cad bslus pa dang dam pa'i chos la lasmod pa dang / nyes pa thams cad byas pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya sgrub ②pa pos rdo rje sems dpa' brtan par gyur pas/ tshe 'di nyid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad dam / dngos grub mchog gamadu/ rdo rje'i dngos gruba'am④/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos gruba'amaphyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yidangos grub kyi bar du myur du 'grub ⑦bo zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de nas phyag rgya thams cad dgrol ba'i spyi'i cho ga rgyas pa bshad do/ /de la thog mar ⑤phyag rgya thams cad gang dang gang nas byung ba de dang de nyid 6)nas snying po 'dis dgrol lo/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥyi/ de nas snying ga ⑩nas byung 8rin chen rdo rje'i phyag rgya rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas na gnas pas dbang bskur te/ mdzub ()mo gnyis kyis phreng bar ④bskor zhing bcings nas / de bzhin du go cha yang snying po 'dis bcing ngo / /o badz+ra rat+na ⑩a bhi ṣiñtsa tsosasba mu dru me pyatri dhī tunyeku ru ba ra ()ka ba tse so )na baṃ/ de nas yang go cha'i mthar phreng ba bcings pa btad 41la thal mo mnyam par brdabs te snying po 'dis ()mnyes par bya'o/ /badz+ra tu gyi hoḥ( ste/ cho ga des 'phyag rgya rnams dgrol ba dang / bcing ba (snyedang mnyes par byas na sgyu —9rdo rje lta bur 'gyur ro/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpas 6)kyang bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lan cig bzlas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bdag bde bar/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa bzhin/ /zhes ( )bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos gsungs soso / /rdo rje sems sogs so )sems dpa' rnams/ /bsgrub (spepa dang ni las kun la/ /'dir ni ci dgar bzlas na ni/ /rtog pa kun las dngos grub 84—81

thob / /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rtog pa las bshad rang ①byas pa'am/ /bsgrub pa 'dir ni thams cad do/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ②brjod cing rdo rje bstod pa'i 6)glu blangs te gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhi bya'o/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glur (na)blangs pas/ /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /de nas dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje bstod pa'i glu ⑤nyid kyis/ /rdo rje'i gar lag pa (tshigashibs pas bsang ba bya'o⑦/ /bdug pa la sogs pa'i (nyamachod pa bya ste/ de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje po)bdug pa la sogs pas mchod pa byas la khrimachod pa de dag rang rang gi gnas su gzhag go/ /de nas thams cad ‘/7ci nus pas 7mchod cig ces bsgo nas/ 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol te boji ltar 'dod pa bzhin snyibadug pa la sogs pas mchod pa byed du bcug la/ ji ltar zhugs 7pa rnams ci 'byor pa'i ro dang kha zas la sogs pa thams cad dang dkyil 'khor chen por phul ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis mgu bar byas teyi tsho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rdo rje'i /brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de(ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang 47/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa spyo dhā 2 ra yā 21mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ deng 6rtenas thams cad ( gesu la yang ma smra ( — )shig ces bsgo zhing 2pa/ mna'i snying po yang bstan to/ /de nas ( 9ji ltar zhugs pa'i rnams slar bkye ste de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba ni 9 shesems dpa' rdo rje'i 29phyag rgya bcings la / kha gyen du bstan te/ snying po 'di 84—82

bzlas shing bkrol ①nas/ o khyed ②kyis sems can don kun byas / /rjes su mthun par skyidangos grub stsal(snye/ /sangs rgyas yul du bzhud par mdzad⑥/ / de nas ⑦slar yang gshegs par dugasol/ /badz+ra satwa muḥ6)/ de ltar dkyil 'khor thams cad la yang ⑩bya'o/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya rnams kyang dgrol bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i 7rgyal po las/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto(ste// //bam po gsum pa8/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chagazungs dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu yang 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid yirdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa kun du 'bar ba'i snying po rdo rje gzungs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i lha mo rnams su gyur nas byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (zhekyi rdo rje'i gzungs yo kyi ye shes bsgrubs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i gzungs zhanasu gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la bkod ( )de ched du brjod pa (27ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o gang phyir byang chub sems/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis dpa' bo gang / /bud med gzugs su ri namadzad par gyurazhun/ /84—83

de nas bcom ldan 'das ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig rdo rje dbyings kyi byin gyis ②brlabs ①zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te④/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa⑤/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tī yishwa ri hūṃ badz+re ṇiphu/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (nyadam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi 6)byin gyis lhanabarlabs pa 3)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra badzi ṇi kyirgyu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che'i dam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyis 6)byin gyis tsobarlabs pa tsozhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ rat+na 7badzi ṇi 0rgyu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe tshad med pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i chos kyi dam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi (1nyabyin gyis brlabs pa 6)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ dharma badzi ṇi ( )hūṃ / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i las kyi zhimedam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi 22byin gyis brlabs pa zhi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ kum badzi ṇi zho byurgyu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzungs chen po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bzhi po bshad do/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa gu h+ya sa ma ye hūṃ ⑤/oṃ sagu h+ya rat+na e ku ne shi hūṃ/ oṃ 2 gu h+ya rā ( megi rā gā )ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya 84—84

badz+ra sā tī ①sha ri hūṃ/ kun du bzang mo dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lcags kyu mo ②dang / dga' ba ②chags ma dang legs ldan ma ste rdo rje gzungs chen mo rnams so/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya rat+na ④sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya pra bhe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa (9dza a gra gu h+ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra hā yis badz+re hūṃ/ rin po che'i gtso mo dang /rin po che'i sgron ma dang / rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i ⑦dpung rgyan ma dang / bzhad ⑧pa dang ldan ma ste rdo rje 6)rin po che'i gzungs rnams so/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma ⑩ga h+ya sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ko ṣa 7gu h+ya sa ma ya 8rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya maṇ+ḍa le hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya wa tsa tsos ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje pad+ma dang / kun 'dzin ma dang / kun du 8'khor lo 8dang steng du zlos ma ste chos kyi gzungs ⑩rnams so/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya kum tsos ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya ka pa tse hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya /ṭī tsodha ra tī hūṃ / oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya muṣ+ṭi hūṃ/ dngos grub kyi yigatso mo dang / thams cad srung dum dang / mdangs slar 'phrog ma dang gzungs kyi phyag rgya 0ste thams cad kyi gzungs rnams so/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' chen pos/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bzhi po tsobashad do/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya satwa badz+re ṇi duḥ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya rat+na badz+re ṇi rdziḥ/oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dharma badzi ṇi 2)rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya kusma badzi ṇi ( nyergyu/ rdo rje pha rol tu phyin pa de dag nyid la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig gi gzungs sdud pa'i dam tshig gi khri)phyag rgya rnams te/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ( shedakyil 'khor chen por 'bar ba dang bcas par 66zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dug par gzhag go/ /de nas lu )phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nunyagasang ba'i mchod pa ru dam tshig gi phyag rgya bzhi 84—85

po bshad do/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya ra ti pū dzā 6)sa ma ye sarba pū dzā lapra bsto nā ya ②rgyu/oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣe ka pū dzā ri nyes ma ye sab pu dzā (snyem brta nā ya 6)rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya gī ti pū dzā (pes ma ye sarba pū dzā (shepra bsto nā ponyeya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya mṛ t+ya pū dzā sa ma ye sasba pū dzā pra brta nā ya rgyu7/ rdo rje 'dzin ma la sogs pa de 7nyid de 'bar ba dang bcas par nyugerang gi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rnams 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwa rnams su dgod do/ /de nas yang 'phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba khurdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di bshad do/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /rdo rje gsang ba zhes bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /mchod rten khri la legs 'dug pa/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad/ /khri yi steng du rdo rje brtsegs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 8zhes bshad pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen khri yi steng ⑩/ /rang gi dbang ni bskur bar bshad / /rdo rje pad+ma khri yi steng / /mtshon cha zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /las kyi rdo rje khri yi steng / /rdo rje kun zhes bya bar bshad/ /pad+ma'i steng du bri ba 9/ 7ni/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rten 918pa'o/ /khri yi steng du rdo rje bri/ /lcags kyu bsgreng (6ba gnyis de bzhin/ /rdo rje rdo rje la snyes par/ /legs par sbyin pa gnyis de bzhin / /rin chen 'od zer 'bar bar 9 7bya/ /nyi ma'i phyag rgya'ang de bzhin no / /rgyal 2lhamatshan rtse mo'ang 'bar bar ( rtebacas/ /rdo rje gnyis par so yi phreng / /rdo rje'i dbus su pad+ma bri/ /ral gri 'bar bcas de bzhin no/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rdo rje rtsibs/ /'bar ba 2 'od zer can gyi rtse / /rdo rje kun du rtse mo 84—86

dang / / go cha rdo rje 1)yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje mche ba de bzhin (gyibri/ /lag gnyis khu tshur phyag rgyar ( bya/ /sems dpa'i 'a)rdo rje la sogs bri(5)/ /dbyings 6)kyi dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya bri ba ⑦ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs zhu)dkyil 'khor du/ /phyi rol du yang ci rigs par6)/ /rang gi mtshan ma rnams kyang bri/ /byams pa la sogs rang gi mtshan/ /ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du bri/ /de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug pa la sogs 7pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ste (nyade la thog mar rdo rje slob dpon gyis(nye/ sems dpa'i (1sterdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rang gis ④bcings te 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas lan ④cig bskor te phyag rgya de bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phul nas rang gi snying gar tshul bzhin du bgrol 9te sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas/ ji lta ba bzhin du 4)las rnams byas nas phyir 'byung /she'o / /phyir byung nas kyang rdo rje slob ma rnams rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gzud pa'i tshul gyis (gegazud do/ /de nas btsud nas dngos grub kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i mtshan ma chang zhu )pas g.yogs la byin te/ rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab bo/ /de la dang por (sterdo rje gsang ba'i lus kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab bo/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rkang lag thal mo sbyar nas kha/ /glal zhing ( 2rdo rje bsgom rdusnyebyas na/ /rdo rje ma yang chags par byed/ /dpung pa bskum pa'i lcags kyu dang / /mgo la rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /lag pa yis ni 'byed byed cing / /lcags kyu ma yang 'gugs par byed/ /mda' 'phen pa yi tshul gyis ni/ /glal zhing snying gar 'phangs na ni/ /nyid kyis rdo rje dga' ma yang / /bdud kyi tshul gyis mnyes par byed/ /bdag gi gelus kyi snying gar ni tsi/ /rdo rje go cha'i 84—87

tshul gyis ni/ /dpung pa bsnol bar bcings na ①ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang srung ②bar byed/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /badz+ra rā chag ma ho/ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥdu/ badz+ra mā ra ya mā ra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra brnya rak+ṣa haṃ/de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i blta ⑤ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes la yibaslab bo/ /rdo rje blta ba'i ⑦chags pas ni/ /dga' bas mig ni durab tu bgrad/ /de yis bud med bltas pas stin/ /rtag tu dbang du 'gyur ba yin/ /rab tu myur bar mig bskul ⑩zhing / /mig gi rdzi mas ⑩'gugs byed pa/ /lta ba gzi can yin par bshad / /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs byed pa'o/ /khro gnyer gnyer ma rab bsdus pa/ /khro bo'i mig ni btsum 8pa ste/ /khro bo'i blta ba byas na 7ni/ /khams gsum yang ni 'jigs chapar byed/ /ri rab ri yi brag 'dra b.rabya/ /brtan par 'dzums pa med pa'i mig /byams pa'i blta ⑩ba yin par bshad/ /nad dang gdon dang dug sel to/ /de nas de ⑩rnams kyi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi maṭa dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi e ku sha dzaḥhunye/ kro dha dṛṣ+ṭi hrīḥ/ dṛ nye tiṣ+ṭha ()phaṭa / de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i dag ( )gi phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab (nyebo/ /ho ho ho ho zhes smras na/ /sgra dang bral bas de ma thag /sems can kun ni mgu bar byed / /de ni rdo rje'i tshig stsal 9 nyapa'o/ / dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza 6)zhes brjod na/ khro bo'i tshig ni gsal ba ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dra ba yi( ste/ /skye bo kun kyang 'gugs ( nyepar byed/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod na/ /tshig tu brjod pa gsal ba yi / /ri rab dang ni 'dra ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi ( )bdud byed do/ /haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ zhes smras na/ /phra ba'i tshig ni gsal 9 sheb ste/ /'jig rten pa ni zho )srung byed pa/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid rgyal ba'ang sung / /de la snying po 'di rnams yin no/ /badz+ra 84—88

hoḥlabadz+ra dzaḥkhyabadz+ra hūṃ/ badz+ra haṃ/ de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i sems kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes la ①bslab bo/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje khyod nyid duX/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms byas na⑤/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang du byed/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'iX/ /rdo rje snying po bdag nyid dul/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms byas na/ /phyag na rdo rje 'gugs par byed/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i/ / chos kyi spyan gyi ⑧bdag nyid dusti/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms ⑩byas na/ /chos rnams thams cad des sdud tunyebyed/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje thams cad bdag nyid du8/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms tsobyas na/ /rdo rje thams cad des bsrung ④ngo / /de la snying po ni 'di rnams yin no7/ /badz+ra pā 0ṇi sasba sha mā ⑩na ya sasba bud+dha ho/ badz+ra gar+bha 8badz+ra pā ṇi shī phroṃ ā man+ta ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ badz+ra ⑪ne tra sasba dharma 0mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra bi shwa pu nyarak+ṣa sa: lunyen hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes la chabaslab bo/ /bdag gi lus kyi ④snying gar ni/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje bcings ( nyebyas la/ /rdo rje mig gis (nyabaltas na ni/ /'gro ba thams cad dbab khri)par byed/ / rang gi lus kyi yisnying gar ni/ /rin chen rdo rje bcings (7byas la/ /'bar ba'i mig gis sum̐ )bltas na ni/ /thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /bdag gi lus kyi (stesnying gar ni/ /chos kyi rdo rje bcings byas na ste/ /khro bo'i mig gis dunabaltas na ni/ /'gro ba thams cad des sdud (nyebyed/ /bdag gi lus kyi zhigesnying gar ni/ /las kyi rdo rje bcings 69byas la/ /byams pa'i mig gis so bltas na ni/ /'gro ba thams cad srung (3bar byed / /de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya de dag gi snying po nu 'di dag 84wa 89

go1ni / /badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya hoḥ(mi/ badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya dzaḥ(/)/ badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya hūṃ / badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya rta5gi)/ de nas rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rgya chen po bcing ba la 5)bslab bo/ /rdo rje thal mo las byung ba/ /gsang ba chen po yin par (zhebashad / /phyag rgya chen po mdor bsdus pa/ /de dag gi ni bcing ba bshad/ /mthe bo 7)gnyis ni bsnol byas la/ / mdzub mo gnyis ni (8)bkug pas ni/ /gung mo bsnyams te (95tshigs su sbyar/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad/ /de nyid gung mo rdo rjer bya/ /gung mo gnyis ni nor bur bya7/ /pad+ma srin lag mthe'u 11chung gung / /lag pa'i sor mo rab tu brkyang / /mdzub tsomo rdo rje mdzub 1steganyis rtse/ /de nyid mthe bo skiganyis kyis sprasa'i/ /legs pa sbyin dang mdzub tsharin chen/ /mdzub 7mo rin chen de 'bar bya(nya/ /srin lag gshibs la (17mthe'u 9 7rin chen/ /de nyid kyang ni bskor ba'o/ /kun gyi rtse mor (merab tu dbye mi / /mthe bo mthe'u chung rab tu gzhug /sor mo rab tu 'khor lo brkyang ( ge//de nyid kyang ni kha nas dbyung 5) / /mthe bo brkyang 69ste rdo rje dgabs5/ /mdzub ( rmomo mnyam snyenas nang du gzhug /mthe'u 87gnyis dbye ba de nyid las/ /de nas nang du rdo rjer bya/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i las 8 )rnams ni/ /rdo rje bcings las byung stob yin/ /chos kyi gsang ba 8nyamatshan rnams kyis sto/ /thal mo nang du bkug nas ri so/ /las kyi gsang ba nang gnas pa'i/ /mtshan mas 8gelas su bstan pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa69/ /chos kyi phyag rgya mdor bshad da pa/ /a dza ri ho sa/ oṃ i ṭ+wāṃ ha/ hrīḥdhe )mi raṃ/ kai haṃ hūṃ baṃ/gsang ba'i phyag rgya gnyis byas nas/ /las kyi phyag rgya rnams su bya/ /dam tshig mchog ni ji snyed pa/ /gnyis su phral nas de bzhin 6 )no/ /de nas de 81rnams 84wa 90

kyi bsgrub ①pa bshad dephyi/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes smra (kyezhing / /bdag gis bcings pas ④'grub pa ni/ /'dod la chags pa bde ba'i bdag /'di rnams lhag par gcig kyang ni/ /dus kun tu ni bcing mi bya/ /gsang ba 'am (snyeni don chen la/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyar bar bya/ /de 0rnams kun gyi ⑦bdag nyid gnas / /rang byung rnams kyi lha mo brtan/ /bsgrub (kyepa rnams la rang ⑨chags pas / /rtag pa'i bdag 7po btang nga (1re/ /de nas phyag rgya de ()rnams thams cad (nyebacing 0ba la sogs pa'i las rnams yin no/ /bdag gam 'on te gzhan la'ang tsorung / /rdo rje dbab pa byas na yini/ /snying po bya ba 'di yin no( māṃ/ /bcing ngam 'ching du bcug tu)kyang rung / /badz+ra hūṃ bad+dha/ de nas dgrol ba yin no / /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /snying po 5)bya ba 'di nyid kyis/ /gang dang gang nas byung ba yi/ /de dang de nas dgrol bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ/ /de nas brtan par bya ba yin te/ rin chen rdo rje brtan byas te/ /snying ga nas ni spyi bor dgrol/ /mdzub ( )mo yis ni go cha bcing / /snying por bya ba 'di nyid do / /o dṛ sgye ( stebadz+ra ka ba tsa/ dṛ nye(rte/ de nas bcing ba'i dam tshig yin no / /ji ltar gnas pa rnams su dgrol/ /go cha yis ni brtan par byas/ /thal mo brdabs pas kun sbyar ba/ /snying por bya ba 'di nyid do/ /oṃ gu h+ya sa ma ya tra(nya/ rdo rje sems dpa' ci dgar bzlas/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni las kun la/ /dus de rdo )nyid du sbyar bar bya/ /thams cad grub 5gepar byed pa'i mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ theg pa chen po ( lhamangon par rtogs pa'i rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa ( snardzogs stos // //84wa 91

de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje phra mo'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis ①brlabs ②zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa / oṃ sum chabadz+ra dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes phra mo'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa ④zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra dusatwa sum rtsibadz+ra dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che ⑦ye shes phra mo'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa (nyazhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te yonyerang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ rat+na srug 7badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe tshad med pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi ye shes phra mo'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa (nyezhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/oṃ dharma sum 7badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje las kyi ye shes phra mo'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis 1 brlabs pa lizhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ kurma srug 7badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 7ye shes phra mo'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i 84—92

ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nyid kyi tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes phra mo'i 'od zer de rnams byung nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/ sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ①rdo rje'i ye shes phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin du mnyam ②par zhugs pa brtan par bya stesri/yang gcig tu gyur nas ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes kyi rdo rje'i skur dmigs te④/gcig tu 'dus nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi thugs su zhugs nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes phra mo (snyedam tshig chen po'i rdo rje 'di smras pa/ sum ⑥badz+ra/ de nas de smras ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes phra mo'i rdo rje'i dbyibs su bdag (7)byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shangs kyi rtse mo'i phyogs su gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du 57brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje phra mo 6)bdag ste che/ /gang phyir phra yang che ba'i phyir/ /khams gsum yang ni rgyas par mdzadakyi/ /de nas de skad ces smras pa dang /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shangs kyi rtse mo'i phyogs nas tshoterab tu phra ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan ma rgyas par bya ba'i tshul gyis yo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku la khyab par byas nas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par bya ba'i tshul gyis nam mkha'i 84—93

dbyings thams cad 0hrīrdo rje phra mo'i ②ye shes kyi mtshan ma rnams kyis ③khyab par byas so/ /nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje'i dbyibs su bdag ④byin gyis brlabs (gete 'dug go/ /de nas de nyid kyi tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje'i dbus su rdo rje chos nyid du dmigs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ye shes phra mo'i byin gyis (nyabarlabs pa 7)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs (gyiso/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 6)rdo rje de las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes kyi snying po 'di byung 7ngo / /badz+ra nā 0bī ta thā ga ta hūṃ/ de nas de byung tsom thag tu bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje ye shes phra mo 7'jug pa'i tshul gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur zhugs nas snying po 8rdo rje'i dbyibs su gyur te gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (7rdo rje de las ye shes chen po'i snying yipo 'di bzhi byung ngo / /badz+ra ād+ma ka dz+rar+gha 1 tshobadz+ra e ku sha tiṣ+ṭha rā ga badz+ra pra be rka/nyesha skṛ 67da yaṃ/ a ho badz+ra duṣ+ṭi/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba'i byin gyis brlabs )kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang /dga' ba chen po ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin chen po rnams so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po phyag na rdo rjes ye shes phra mo 31'jug pa'i tshul gyis rang gi thugs su zhugs te/snying po 22rdo rje'i dbyibs su bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs te bzhugs so/ /de 84wa 94

nas rdo rje dbyibs ①de las snying po 'di bzhi byung ②ngo / /badz+ra rat+na ād+ma ①ka /skṛ ④da ya badz+ra srur+ya/ tiṣ+ṭha ⑤badz+ra dh+wa dzā gra bo(nya/ hro ⑦da ya badz+ra hā las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang /'od chen po'i stidakyil 'khor gyi ⑩rgyan ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi re ba (merdzogs par byed pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba'i shugs 'byung ba'i 4)ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes ye shes phra mo (nya'ajug pa'i tshul gyis rang gi snying gar rdo rje snying por zhugs nas/ rdo rje'i dbyibs su bdag byin gyis brlabs nas bzhugs so/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbyibs de las snying po 'di bzhi byung ngo / /badz+ra pad+ma ād+ma lika /skṛ tsod ya badz+ra ko ṣa/ tiṣ+ṭha tshabadz+ra tsakra ṣ+ṭṛ ()da yaṃ pra be sha /badz+ra dzi hā yi gra ṣ+ṭṛ 6)da ya/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhu noshes rab kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang /'khor lo chen por 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshig ri stespros pa med pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ( geste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes rang gi snying po rdo rje ru thugs ma'i rdo rje las byung nas( gha/ ye shes phra mor 'jug pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje thugs der zhugs nas ru rdo rje shin tu phra mo'i dbyibs su bdag byin gyis brlabs te bzhugs 26so/ /de nas rdo rje phra mo'i dbyibs de las snying po 'di bzhi byung 3 ngo / /sasba badz+ra ād+ma na ka skṛ khrind ya khri )badz+ra ka (speb tsa/tiṣ+ṭha sa badz+ra rak+ṣa skṛ ne da ya/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi skṛ ci rid ya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 84—95

cad kyi las kyi 0)ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / thub dka'i ②brtson 'grus kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / bdud thams cad kyi dkyil ②'khor 'joms pa'i ༷ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑤'ching ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de duyang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes ye shes phra mo'i ⑦mtshan mas khyab pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' (kyiphyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ de nas yang rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' (97/rnams kyi skur gyur te/ rang rang tigi phyag tunyamatshan 8nyid kyi thugs kur bzhag nas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po dgod 8pa'i tshul gyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas rang rang ④gi snying po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste bzhugs so/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang li/ ye shes dang tsomangon par shes pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rdo rje phra mo'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'di bshad do / /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /rdo rje phra mo zhes bshad do/ / de nas dkyil 'khor tunyetshul du ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang gzhag /rdo rje'i dbus su sangs rgyas bri/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rnams su yang / /sems dpa' chen po rnams bri zhing / /de bzhin thugs kur nyid phyag rgya/ /ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs pa dang / /phyag gnyis rdo rje bcing ba khri bcings/ /de nas rdo rje phra mo'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir dgug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa yin te/dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du zhugs 17pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas par byas nas/84—96

ye shes kyi phyag rgya ①lag tu byin nas rang gi sems las su rung bar bya ba'i ②phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes bslab bo/ /lce ni rkan la gzhar byas te②/ /sna yi rtse mor bsam bya ba/ /rdo rje phra mo'i ④bde reg pas/ /sems ni mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur/ /rdo rje phra mo'i ⑤bde reg pa'i/ /mtshan ma gal te byung ba dang ①//mtshan ma de ni khyab bya ba/ /sems ni ⑦kun tu khyab par bya/ /ji tsam 'dod par (kyesems khyab nas/ /khams gsum du yang khyab par 'gyur/ /de nas de yang bsdu ba ni/ /sna yi rtse mo'i bar du yang ⑨/ /de dag ⑩shin tu mnyam par bzhag /gang yang rung ste bsgom tunyebya ba/ /de dag thams cad brtan par 'gyur / /ting 8'dzin shes rab brtags tu pa'o/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ni tso'adi yin no/ /sum 8badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa tsobadz+ra/ badz+ra skṛ ⑩da tiṣ+ṭha(nye / /sems dpa' gang gis 4)byams pa ni/ /mnyam 'gyur brtan pa chen po yis/ /sems kyis khyab pa'i ( — )tshul gyis ni/ /sems can kun la des khyab bo(nyal/ /byams pas khyab pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /snying rje can ni gang yin pa/ /sems can kun don ldan pa yis(ste/ /bsgrub (nyepa yis ni khyab par bya/ /kun kyang rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa ( stenam mkha' bzhin( nye/ /chos sam yang na chos ma yin/ /bsam pas khyab cing dga' bar 'gyur/ /gdul dka' ba dang mtshungs 'dra ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub snod ma yin/ /de dag rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /btang snyoms chen po bsgom ( nyepar bya/ / de la du snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /ma hā mi tri s+pha ra ṇa ma hā ka ru ṇa ru spa ra ṇa/sarba bud dho ( )pra mo da pu )spa ra ṇa/ sarba saḥ saṃ bo dha (nyaya/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad so rjes su dran pa'i ye shes la sa bslab bo/ /nam mkha' 84—97

'am 0nyeni phyogs gzhan du/ /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul gyis ni/ /'greng ngam yang na 'dug kyang rung / /rdo rje'i dbyibs ni goms par bya/ /de bzhin ②du yang gnas kun tu/ /rdo rje phra mo'i sbyor (kyeb yis/ /mnyam par bzhag pas snying gar ni/ /④byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje (5)bsgom/ /de ⑥lta ba 9)yi rim bzhin du / /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul gyis ni/ /phyag na rdo rje dbyibs chen po/ /gnas rnams kun du bsgom na par bya/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i5)/ /sangs rgyas sku ni 7dus kun du/ /ci 47lta ba yi go rims tu)bzhin/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya/ /de la snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /badz+ra mu khi bha ba/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ā 1stobe sha /badz+ra pā ṇi yir+sār+sha ya swa rū paṃ tsobud+dha a nu smṛ ti ā tshabe sha /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul gyis ni/ /goms par bya ba bdag nyid kyis/ /zla ba'i dbus 7su bdag nyid ni1nya/ /byang chub sems kyi 4)bsgom pa'o/ /zla ba'i tshodakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /bdag nyid rdo rje dbyibs gyur par/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgom bya ba/ /sems dpa' ( stordo rje bsgom pa'o/ /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul sbyar la/ /bdag nyid snying gar rdo rje sems/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgom bya ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ( 2bsgom pa'o/ /rnam pa kun du (nyamachog ldan pa'i / /sangs rgyas gzugs su bdag nyid ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgom bya ba / /sangs rgyas byang chub bsgom pa'o/ /de la snying po ni 'di rnams yin no no//sa man+ta bha dra ā 0be sha /badz+ra satwa badz+ra ā ( mede sha /badz+ra satwa sa mā dhi dzñā k+ṣ-i ston ā ( 8be sha ta thā ga to rgyu / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi gsang ni1ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes la 2bslab bo/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs dang mnyam/ /rdo rje'i tshig tu lan cig brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar snye/ /84—98

sems can thams cad chags par byed/ /bdag ni rdo rje chen por mnyam/ /rdo rje tshig tu lan cig brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam par sbyar0)/ /gdon mi za bar 'jig rten 'gugs/ /bdag nyid (kyerdo rje chos dang mnyam/ /rdo rje tshig tu lan cig brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /de yis 'jig rten thams cad 'jig /bdag ni ma lus rdo rjer ⑧mnyam/ /rdo rje tshig tu lan cig brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /las rnams thams cad des bsgrub bo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa ④zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'i ye shes zhi)bslab bo/ /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje'i dbus su bsgom bya ba/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku nyid du/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub/ ja/de nas rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i (ne༄ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'i ye shes la ( nobaslab bo/ /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul sbyar la/ /snying gar (8)rdo rje la sogs 'khodakyiste/ /bsgoms nas bordo rje la sogs pas/ /rang gi dngos grub sbyin par byed/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes la (stobaslab bo/ /rdo rje bcings pa las yi byung bar/ /bcu drug rnams su bshad pa ste/ /ting nge 'dzin ni 1 dam tshig mchog /de rnams kyi muni bcings pa bshad/ / skyil mo krung tshe'adug gan rkyal du/ /g.yas bcu 7de bzhin slar bcug nyu pa/ /snying gar gnas pa bzhi pa ste/ /rdo rje sems sogs (shedakyil 'khor ro/smu/ /dpral bar bzhag )dang ltag pa dang / /phrag rdo lha pa dang ni dgod par sbyar/ /khar gzhag snying gar ral gri dang / /snying gar rgyas dang kha nas dbyung / /spyi bo mthong kha ( gekhar gzhag pa/ /mdzub ( gemo gnyis bkug 84wa 99

mdun de bzhin/ /de nas gzhan yang chos kyi phyag rgya la ①bslab par bya'o/ /ṭak+ki ②ga gra/ ma ṭa/ a gra/ ṭ+wāṃ t+t+waṃ/ e e / baṃ baṃ/ ti ⑦ṭa/ hrīḥṭa④ / skṛ yiṭa/ kra shal /ha ha/ ba ba/ baṃ baṃ/ phaṭa/ gra sa/ de nas chos kyi las kyi ye shes phra mo rnams kyi mchog bshad do(nya/ /ye shes khu tshur dam tshig las/ /gnyis su byas nas sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa 6)chen po'i rgyal po'i 0rdo rje ye shes kyi chos kyi ⑩dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto.e// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa 8bla na med pa'i 7cho ga rgyas pas khyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi ye shes kyi (9byin gyis brlabs pa ()zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhā tu a nut+ta (nyer pū dzā gasmo yo)spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 8)rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod pa bla na med pa'i cho ga rgyas pas khyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi 81rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa ⑥zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa / oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a nut+ta (nyer pū dzā kum 6 )spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che 9 nya'abyung bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tsho nirdo rje rin po che'i mchod pa bla na med pa'i cho ga rgyas par zho nyekhyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa sostezhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ sasba ta thā 84wa 100

ga ta badz+ra rat+na dhi.a nut+ta ②ra pū dzā /smra ②spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe tshad med pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje chos kyi mchod pa bla na med pa'i cho ga rgyas pas dhikhyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi ⑤byin gyis brlabs pa ⑥zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ sabra ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma a nut+ta ⑦ra pū dzā /smra ⑧spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje las kyi mchod pa bla na med pa'i cho ga rgyas pas khyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa ⑨zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rang gi rig pa'i mchog 'di smras pa/ oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kum a nut+ta bor pū dzā kum ⑩smra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du khyab pa'i las kyi dam tshig gi 8rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid deyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pas snyichos kyi dbyings thams cad du khyab pa'i tshunam mkha'i dbyings kun du rgyas pa rnam pa tu sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad kyi rgyan gyi cho ga rgyas pa'i ()sprin gyi rgya mtsho'i lha mo rnams su gyur te byung nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam gyi sprin gyi tsho rgya mtsho rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 84—101

thams cad kyi rigs mnyes par bya ba dang / kun du bzang po'i spyod pa bsgrub 17pa dang / byang chub chen po'i snying por nye bar 'gro ba dang / bdud thams cad 'dul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen por (kyebaskyed pa dang / khams gsum thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor (geb dang /sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi don du ④bya ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul thams cad bstan nas bzhugs so/ /mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho'i lha mo de dag kyang rang (7gi phyag rgya lag pa gnyis kyis 'dzin cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la cho ga bzhin du (6)mchod de rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas mchod pa bdag /mchod pa kun ni byed pa yin / /gang phyir sangs rgyas byin can (8)du/ /sangs rgyas kun ni 9grub par mdzad/ /de nas yi )phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 1lhamachod pa la sogs pa'i 3nyalas kyi cho ga rgyas pa rdo rje tsho zhes bya ba'i las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di 1 bshad do/ /oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta sasba āt+na na nir+sā ta (7na pū dzā saspa ra ṇa gasgro badz+re ṇi lho rgyu ā/ oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta sab āt+na na nir+sā 6)ta na pū dzā s+pha 19ra ṇa /smra gri dzaḥ / oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta sasba āḥ na nir+sā 1ta na a nu rā ga pū dzā s+pha ra ṇa kum pā ṇi na zhu ho/ o sasba ta thā ga 2 (ta sasba āḥ na nir+sā gta na sā dhu kā ra na pū dzā :spa ra ṇa kum tuṣ+ṭi aḥ // de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rab tu dga' ba'i bde ma 29dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams 84wa 102

po phyag na rdo rjes sems can thams cad kyi ①khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams yongs su bskyab pa dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub dam pa 'grub par bya ba'i bar du/ theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di bshad do/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bshad/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzhag par bya/ /de nas dgug pa dang gzhug pa la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob pa'i ri ye shes ①bskyed par bya'o/ /de la li'adi skad du khyod kyis dam tshig ma mthong ba dang /khong du ma chud pa su la yang gsang ba 'di ma smra shig /khyod ngan song thams cad du ltung ba'am/ mi bde ba ma spangs pas dus ma yin par shi bar gyur ta re zhes bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub dam pa bsgrub pa'i ye shes 3bslab par bya'odzi/ /zla ba rgyas la 'dug nas kyang ⑦/ /phyag rgya chen po gzung byas nas / /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig gi ye shes 9bslab par bya'onya 7/ /'dod chags bral ba'i sdig lta bu/ /khams gsum na ni 3stogazhan med de/ /de bas 'dod pa'i 7chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis kyang ni nyanam byed cig /ma hā sa ma ya ha na phaṭa/ de nas ñtsa)mna'i snying po 'di 7sbyin no/ /de nas 7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 84—112

cho ga rgyas pa rnams su dam tshig gi sdom pa sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa bzhi bcing ba bslab par bya'o/ /dngos grub kyang de bzhin no/ /ri mo la sogs pa dang / lugs ma'i sku gzugs thams cad la yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i cho ga bzhin du byas nas①/ dngos grub thams cad kyang ②de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas par byas pa ci ④lta ba bzhin du yang bya'o/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ④gcig tu 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo/ byang chub kyi sems rgyachen po rdo rje sems dpa'i kyiphyag na rdo rje chen po la rdo rje dgyes pa'i snying po 'dis legs pa dzodagasol to/ /oṃ 2rdo rje sems dpa' khyod legs so/ /legs so rin chen rdo rje khyodakyi)la/ /rdo rje chos ni 7khyod legs so/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs soyi/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon tunyebasdus pa'i8/ / mdo sde 'di ni legs par bshad/ /dhirdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan nyid 8kyang / /dngos grub kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /dag par byas pas tsobasgrubs na ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang bde bar 'thob⑩/ /rdo rje chos kyi sbyor ba8ni/ /'dod pa kun gyi 4)bde bas bde/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis 'grub pas na/ /bde ba mi zad med sum̐ stemi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba ( /rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po dum bu dang po ( gerdzogs sto(ge// //84—113

bam po bzhi pa/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang 6)gcig tu 'dus ②te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor lo chen po bskor ba la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dis gsol ba btab bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje che/ /rdo rje mgon po rab sgrub ①mdzad / /rdo rje dbang bskur rdo rje 'od/ /rdo rje dpal khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bzhad pa chos chen po/ /rdo rje ral gri mchog chen poX/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi (5)rgyal po mchog /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje las dang srung ba che/ /gnod sbyin gtum pa gdon chen po/ /rdo rje khu tshur phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dang byang chub che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che/ /theg chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don kun gyi ni de nyid don/ /sems can don chen kun rig pa/ /kun mkhyen kun byas thams cad de(6)/ /kun gzigs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bdag rab rdo rje mchog /rdo rje brtson rab rdo rje 'chang / /dam tshig chen po de nyid don/ /sems chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dod pa che/ /rab tu dga' ba 'od chen po/ /rdo rje 'od dang 'od gsal 7ba/ /sangs rgyas 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal mchog rdo rje drag /rigs namachog mchog dang mi yi mchog /rdo rje dam pa mchog chen mchog /rigs 9mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dbyings dang gsang ba che rdo rje gsang ba rab gsang 'chang / /rdo rje phra 7ba bsam gtan che/ /rdo rje dgos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mchog sangs rdo rje mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub mkhas pa che/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sangs rgyas che/ /sangs rgyas sangs 84—114

rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa mchod pa che/ /sems dpa' mchod pa rab mchod pa/ /thabs chen dang ni dngos grub che/ /rdo rje grub ①khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dbyangs te/ /de bzhin gshegs ④pa'i sems chen po/ /rdo rje rdo rje khyod ①phyag 'tshal④/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo rgyal ⑤bka' nyan/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo bshes gnyen yiskyes/ /rnam par snang mdzad che dang khyab/ /ston zhing 4)khro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid che/ /yang dag mtha' ste ②che khro'i tshul/ /pha rol phyin pa kun mkhyen pa/ /don dam khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du bzang dang spyod 6)pa mchog /bdud dang bdud ni rab 'dul ba/ /kun ni ⑩mchog dang mnyam nyid mkhyen/ /kun du 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas hūṃ zhes hūṃ zhes pa/ /rdo rje hūṃ zhes 'dul ba po/ /rdo rje thams cad rdo rje mchog /phyag na rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag byas yimachod cing brjod pa dang / /rim gror de bzhin gshegs pas byas rnye/ /gang phyir rdo rje sems brtan pas / /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya khyod(snye/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub khyod rag ④lus / /kun gzigs yab ni khyod yin te/ /byung ba dang ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod kyis bsgrubs/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di 7yis ni/ /rab tu mos pas stod yibyed cing / /glu blangs gang zhig stod 4 byed pa/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin 'drar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sems can kun don mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi rigs ni skyed par mdzad/she/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo phyag na rdo rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba'i tshig thos nas/84wa 115

rdo rje bdag hu)nyid kyi thugs ②kar bzhag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad bos nas 'di skad ces chagasungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ④ma 'tshal lo2/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci'i phyir/ rdo rje 'dzin pas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i sems can dag kyang mchis te/de bzhin gshegs pa 96)thams cad kyis kyang zhi bas 'dul (7bar mi spyod pa de dag la bdag gis 8)ji ltar bsgrub 6)par bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi ⑩brlabs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thabs chen po'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/sto/ snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu tunyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyi rdul shin du phra mo dang mnyam par 'phros nas1nya/ ri rab ri'i rtse mo ni 8rtse mo rdo rje dang / nor bu dang —/ rin po che las byas pa'i khang bu brtsegs par yang gcig tu 'dus te/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mnyam 7nyid du dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang snyimadzad kyi thugs kyi dpal be'ur 7zhugs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs su bdag byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje mnyam pa nyid kyis ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams yongs su bskyab pa dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i dam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul 6steba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ye 84—116

shes la dmigs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i thabs khro bo chen po'i ①dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te② / snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ces bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di byung ④ngo / /hūm̐/ de nas de byung ⑤ma thag tu phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ma'i rdo rje las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ kun du 'bar ba'i snying po khro gnyer can smin ma bcum zhing dpral bar gnyer ⑥ba/ mche ba lhag tshiger byung zhing so gcigs pa/ rdo rje dang ( lcags kyu dang (she/ ral gri dang / zhags pa la sogs pa rdo rje me lce 'bar ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs pa/ rnam pa du ma'i kha dog dang rgyan rnams ⑨ kyi cha lugs can phyag na rdo rje'i sku byung nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du shin du ma rungs pa thams cad gdul bar yibyas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyogs kun du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dug ste (nyached du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do//e ma'o 7thabs kyis 'dul ba yi/ /thabs chen ldan pa bdag yin te/ /gang phyir sems can 'dul thabs phyir/ /dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur(nye/ de nas ⑫de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spros pa med pa'i chos nyid la dmigs linas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo chen po rdo rje'i dam tshig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa ⑩zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba yonade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rig pa'i mchog 'di smras 84—117

pa / o sum+bha ni sum+bha 0)rgyu/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa (snyes/ griṇ+ḍa ①pa ya gro: ④pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya hoḥ45nobha ga bī yibadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las (7)byung ma thag pa (3bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjer gyur te byung nas 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ri9)rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ngobyin gyis brlabs te/ spyan drangs nas rdo rje'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste/ dam tshig gis bcings nas yang gcig tu 'dus (nyete rdo rje khro bo'i skalus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kur 'dug ste/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o byang chub sems 'di ni/ /kun du bzang zhing sdig med de/ /gang phyir sems can 'dul don du/ /khro bo yang ni yid 'ong 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje khro bo'i yinasku de bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas babs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas te yang bka' 7nod cing bzhugs so / /de nas sa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gis 'gugs pa'i 1 rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs ka nas byung yi ngo / /hūṃ ṭak+ki dzaḥ18 / de nas de byung nya6ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ( )sprin rgya mtsho'i sprin 1thams cad na/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dbang po dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'jig rten thams cad na gnas pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa 84—118

thams cad kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje'i lcags kyus bkug nas/ ri rab ri'i 4)rtse mo rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / rin po che las byas pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang /nor bu dang / rin po che las byas pa thams cad du bskor nas 'khod par gyur to / /de nas phyag na rdo rje rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje de blangs te/ gsor zhing (gyikhams gsum pa ①ji snyed pa thams cad kyi 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo la bltas te 'di skad ces bka' stsal gi)to/ /grogs po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa la zhugs la nga'i bka' la (5yang nyon cig /de nas de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la / /skyabs su 'gro bar (5)bsgrub par byos/ /kun mkhyen (3)ye shes thob bya'i (shephyir / /grogs po rnams kyis bsgrub (9)par gyis1 / de nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi /lhabadag po lha chen po 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa yi dregs te cher khros par ston cing 'di skad ces tunyesmras so/ /kye gnod sbyin nga ni 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi gtso bo dbang phyug chen po yibyed pa po 'jig nyu5pa po 'byung po thams cad kyi dbang po lha'i yang 7lha chen po yin na/ gnod sbyin khyod kyi ngag nga ci 6 phyir nyan / de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje gsor zhing bka' stsal pa/ kye nyushesems can ma rungs pa dkyil 'khor du myur du zhugs la nga'i dam tshig la yang dag par 6steganas par gyis shig /de nas lha'i yang lha chen pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i sems can 84—119

dbang phyug la 'di hunyeskad ces ②bka' stsal ①pa 'di su zhig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum gyi tshogs thams cad la bos nas ④'di skad ces ⑤gsungs so/ /grogs po rnams dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsgrub par gyis shig /phyag na rdo rje 'di skad yiganod sbyin khro bo ma rungs ⑦pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po ste/ rdo rje 'bar bas dukhams gsum po 'di 6)dag thams cad brlag par byas ta kyire/ de nas dbang phyug chen po 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi dbang por gyur pa dang / rang gi shes pa'i dbang gis 'khor mang po dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje tunye'ajigs par bstan pa'i phyir/ khro bo tsogatum pa chen por tsorab tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'bar ba chen po gtong zhing / ma rungs pa chen pos rta skad du dgod yipa rnams bstan nas 'di skad ces 7smras so/ /kye ying ni 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi bdag po yin na⑩/ khyod kyis nga la ci'i phyir bka' stsal pa(ste/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje de bsnyems 67pa dang bcas par rdo rje so )gsor zhing 'dzum ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye 81lus srul po'i (nyami'i sha za ba zas su ro bsregs pa'i thal ba za zhing kha zas dang mal dang / gos kyang de las byed pa nga'i bka' bzhin 2 byos shig /de nas lha chen po dbang phyug chen pos 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag dang nam mkha'i khams rdo 1rnams khro ba khro ba so chen pos non par byin gyis brlabs te 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kyang de'i 67bka' nyon la dam tshig kyang long 3shig /de nas phyag na rdo rje khro bo chen po'i rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol 8to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha chen po zhes bgyi ( 784wa 120

ba'i lha 'di ni/ rang gi ①'tshal ba'i stobs kyis dregs pa dang dbang phyug chen po'i dbang gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa la 'dud du ③mi btub na 'di dul ji ltar bgyi ba'i rigs/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ༷thugs ka nas byung ⑤ba'i rdo rje chen po'i dam tshig dran par byas so/ /oṃ ni 6)sum+bha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i snying po 'di brjod do/ /rgyu/ de nas de brjod ma thag tu khams ⑦gsum pa (nyethams cad nas 'dus pa'i lha chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum po'i dbang po thams cad kha bub tu 'gyel te/ nyam thag pa'i tshig 'byin cing / bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la skyabs su dong ngo / /lha chen po zhes bya ba'i lha de ni sa la 'gyel te dran pa med par gyur nas ⑨ shi'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di kyiskad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag na rdo rje 'jig rten gsum po'i 'khor lo 'di thams cad la skyabs sbyin pa byos te ma bsad cig /de nas phyag na rdo rje khro bo chen po'i rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa thos nas / lha thams cad bos nas /nya'adi skad ces gsungs so/ /gal te khyod rang gi srog 'dod na/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su deng kyil nga'i bka' yang nyon cig /de nas de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o / /khyod kyis bstan yo pa'i bka' ni bdag cag gis ma 'tshal lo/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang ñtsa)mdzad de bzhin gshegs pas de dag la bos nas 7'di skad yibaka' stsal to/ /kye yi lha rnams 'di ni nged 4shedang tu/de 84—121

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po'o①/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ②bka' bzhin ②byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po ste/ sems can thams cad gdul ba'i don byas pa'i ④phyir/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen por dbang bskur to⑤/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyed kyi nang na yang lha chen po la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i sems can yod de/ de rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang zhi bar mdzad pas/ sdig pa las bzlog 4)par mi spyod pa'i sdig pa'i sems can de dag ⑦rnams tshar gcad (shepa'i phyir byin gyis brlabs so/ /de bas na khyed rnams 'di'i dam tshig la gnas par byos shig par bka' stsal to/ /de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi 6)srog yal ba las bskyab tu gsol/ bdag cag kyang bka' stsal pa 7bgyid/ cing mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye (nyagrogs po rnams 'di nyid (nyal skyabs su dong ⑫dang 'di thunyid kyis kun du skyob stesnyigazhan gyis ni ma yin no/ /de tsonas khams gsum kun nas 'dus pa srid pa gsum gyi bdag po de rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa 7ga la ba de logs su bltas nas/ nyam thag pa chen po'i sgra mgrin gcig tu phyung 1stenas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las kun du bskyab par gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa kun du bskyab par gsolakyi / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po phyag na rdo rjes lha la sogs pa de rnams la 8nyabos te 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye 'a ma rungs pa rnams nga'i bstan pa la zhugs shig /rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis gcig tu 84—122

'bar bar byas nas ①thams cad kyang thal bar byas ta re/ 'di ②skad ces gsol to/ /khyod ni bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs chabaskyed pa zhi ba dul ba sems can thams cad la phan par bzhed pa/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa 465 ba lags na/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag bsregs ④par 'gyur/ de nas phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye ⑤grogs po dag gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dubaka' bzhin ⑦byed pa de'i phyir nga (kyeni kun du bzang po ste/ khyed lta bu'i sems can ma rungs pa'i ngang tshul can sdig pa'i sems rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir6)/ gal te nga'i dam tshig la mi gnas na chud gsan ⑩par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos dbang phyug chen po ma gtogs pa'i lha de dag gzhan dbugs dbyung zhing bslang ba'i (nyuphyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rdo rje'i bslang ba zhes bya ba 'di smras so/ /oṃ badzotiṣ+ṭhatso/de nas de skad smras ma thag tu dbang phyug chen po ma gtogs par khams gsum pa 'dus pa srid pa gsum gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad kun brgyal ba las sems dbugs tunyephyung ste/ lha'i bde ba myong zhing 'jigs shing bag tsha ba dang 0spu langs pa med par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la lta zhing langs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po lha'i bdag tsopo lha chen po 'di ma bslang na 'di srog de chud gsan par byas yite ci rung / gsos na 'di yang ⑩skyes bu dam par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin du bya'o snyam 84—123

nas shi ba gso ba'i snying po 'di smras so/ / badz+ra ā yuḥl/ de nas de ②smras ma thag tu lha chen po lha'i bdag po shi ba las gsos ①te ldang 'dod na yang ldang dum nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci bdag cag ⑤'di lta bus 'dul lam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod skyes bu chen po 'di ⑥bka' nyan par mi 'jug na/ khyod la 'dul ba 'di nyid yin gyi nga ma yin no⑦/ /dbang phyug chen pos gsol pa/ci bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis ma rungs pa'i sems can de ⑧las skyabs mdzad par lho)mi spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas 'di las skyabs ⑩mi nus so/ /gsol pa/ ci'i slad du/ bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lhonyekyis bka' stsal pa'i don bdag gis ma 'tshal to7/ / ci'i slad du ⑩zhe na / khams gsum gyi bdag po'/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las gzhan pa'i bdag po mchis par ma 'tshal na/ 'di su lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 8chen po phyag na rdo rjes yang lha chen po la ⑩bos te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /kye ⑩ma rungs pa'i sems can nga'i bka' mi nyan tam/de nas lha chen pos rdo rje sems dpa'i tshig thos nas 'khrugs shing khros par gyur tem/ de ltar bsgyel 1nyabazhin du yang 'jigs pa chen po'i gzugs bstan te/'di skad ces smras so/ /nga shi bar bzod kyi/ khyod kyi ngag nga 67mi nyan no()/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 57phyag na rdo rje rab tu khros par ston cing rang gi rkang pa'i mthil nas tshon rjes su spyod pa 'di byung sa ngo / /oṃ pa ta ka ri ṣa ṇa (stebadz+ra hūm̐/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 32mthil nas kun du 'bar ba'i rdo 84—124

rje'i ①snying po khro gnyer byas nas②/ mche ba lhag ①ger byung ④ba gdong chen po rdo rje'i rjes su spyod pa byung nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga na bka' nod ⑤cing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes dbang phyug chen po sbyang ba'i yiphyir 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /o ⑦pa ta ka ri ṣa ṇa badz+ra hūm̐/o pa ta ka ri (nyesha /sarba badz+ra dha 6)ra a nu tsa ra ka ⑩ta badz+ra hūṃ dzaḥ7/ de nas (gyede skad smras tu pa dang / lha chen po dang lha mo u mar bcas te rkang pa gyen kur bstan nas gcer bur phyung ste skye bo thams cad kyis gad mos btab cing rkang pas 'gugs pa'i ④rjes su spyod pas de 8bkug ste/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar 8zhabs kyi drung du bzhag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ⑩chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can ma rungs pa rjes 'brang 4)dang bcas pa 'di ji ltar bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badz+ra kra ma ho/ de nas de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' (7chen po phyag na rdo rjes lha chen po zhabs g.yon pas mnan zhabs g.yas pas lha mo ( )u ma'i steng du mnan nas( spe/rang gi snying po 'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra ā be 4)sha ha na pa rta traṭa(rnye/ de nas de smras ma thag tu lha chen (stebabs nas rang gi lag (2stong gis rang gi gdong stong la 'tshog go/ /de nas rdo rje'i nor bu rin po che'i rtse mo'i ( nyerdo rje dang / nor bu dang / rin po che las byas (rtepa'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i phyi rol na srid pa gsum pa thams cad kyis nged kyi ( nyedabang po 'di zhu bdag nyid chen po des btul lo zhes sgra chen po byung mu )ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha chen po la thugs rje chen po bskyed pa'i (stesangs rgyas thams cad kyi byams sa pa'i snying po 'di 84—125

gsungs so/ /oṃ bud+dha mi ༷tri badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ de nas de skad ces smras ②ma thag tu / lha chen po la ④babs pa'i sdug bsngal de ①kun zhi bar gyur toX/ /de nas ⑥yang phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs kyi mthil gyis reg ⑦pas/ ⑧bla na med pa'i grub ⑨pa'i dbang dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa dang / gzungs dang ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rnams ⑩thob pa yinas/ de nas 8de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'grub pa'i bar du gyur to/ /de nas lha chen po bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs mthil gyis reg pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang rnam par thar pa'i bde ba myong ste lha chen po'i lus phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la phul nasatso/ 'og gi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i 0klung sum cu 8rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten tsokhams kyi rdul phra rab snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na/ thal bas khebs pa ⑩zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi ()khams der thal ba'i dbang po'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par skyes so/ /de nas lha chen po'i lus de las ched du brjod pa 'di byung ngo / /e ma'o (kyesangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /yi ge'i tshogs kyis ( nyamanan nas su/ /mya ngan las ni 'das par gzhag /de nas byang chub sems dpa' (7chen po phyag na rdo rjes/ de las gzhan pa mthu bo che 6nyal sogs pa 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to( nya/ /grogs po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs shig /zhugs nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig srungs shig /de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bka' ji skad stsal pa ( stebazhin du bgyi'o/ /de nas byang 84—126

chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes srid pa gsum 'dus pa de rnams bos te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /grogs po rnams yang gsum la skyabs su 'gro ①ba dang bslab pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa zung ②la nga'i dudam tshig la yang gnas par gyis shig /de dag gis gsol pa/ de bzhin du 'tshal na bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang byadam tshig glo bar ma chud do/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi dam tshig 'di byin no/ /byang chub sems ni rim dubazhin du/ /bskyed nas de yi 'og tu ni/ /byang chub chen por ci nus par/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag 'bad par ⑥bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyaphyag na rdo rjes/ lha la sogs pa de ⑧rnams 'jug pa'i dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya bcing ba la sogs pa ⑨byas nas/ dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya tsosnying po 'dis 'ching du gzhug ⑩go//oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya griṇ+ḍa s+t+waṃ tibarnya sa ma ya/ badz+ra satwa sa ma yati/ ma nu sma ra/sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ 8sto me bha ba/ sbi ro me bha btso/ ā hā 'byo me bha ba/ a pra ti hā 0rlo me bha ba/ sarba kurma 8su tsa me tsisto ⑩the ① yaḥ/ ku ru r+ghaṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ de nas de dusmras ma thag tu khams gsum gyi srid pa gsum gyi skye bo 'dus pa thams cad rdo rje khro bo ti rirnyi ri'i ( )phyag rgya lag tu babs nas dam du bcings par dugyur to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes tshul bzhin du btsud nas dkyil 'khor chen po thams cad go rims ⑥bzhin du bstan te rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur bas dudabang bskur nas/ rdo rje'i mtshan ma'ang lag tu byin te ⑩/rdo rje ming gis dudabang bskur bas dbang bskur nas de nas (nyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sgo)sems can gyi don la bkod do/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum po'i bdag po ( )rnams yin te/ 'di lta ste/ dbang phyug chen po ni ()khro 84—127

bo'i rdo rje'o/ /mthu bo che ni sgyu ma'i rdo rje'o/ /kurnyika ①sgra gzhon nu ni rdo rje dril bu'o/ /tshangs pa ni thub pa'i rdo rje'o/ /dbang po ni rdo rje'i mtshon cha ste/ de la sogs pa ni ②rig pa'i rgyal po rnams su zhes bya bar skyidabang bskur to0/ /de nas bar (9snang la spyod pa'i lha'i dbang po thams cad ⑥la rjes su byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ nyi ma ⑦ni rdo rje 'khyil ba'o/ /zla ba ni rdo rje'i 'od do/ /dbyug ⑧pa chen po'i gtso bo ni rdo rje ⑨dbyig pa'o/ /ser smug ni rdo rje ser smug ste/de la sogs pa ni 7rdo rje khro bo zhes bya bar dbang bskur toyi/ /de nas nam mkha' la spyod pa'i lha'i dbang po thams cad la byin pa 'di lta ste/ sbrang rtsis myos pa ni rdo rje'i glang po'i sna'o/ /sbrang rtsi yibyed pa ni rdo rje'i phreng ba'o/ /rgyal po ⑩ni rdo rje'i dbang ngo ⑫/ /rgyal bar byed pa 7ni rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje ste/de la sogs pa ni tshogs kyi gtso bo zhes bya bar yidabang bskur to0/ /de nas sa bla'i dbang po 32thams cad la byin pa 'di lta ste/ mdzod skyong ni rdo rje tho ba'o/ /me ni rdo rje'i me'o/ /rlung ni rdo rje'i rlung ngo / /ku ber ni rdo rje 'jigs pa'o/ /de la sogs pa ni rdo rje pho nya zhes bya bar 6)dbang bskur tokhunya/ /de nas sa'i ⑥'og gi dbang po lha thams cad la byin pa 'di lta ste/ phag ni rdo rje lcags kyu'o/ /gshin rje ni rdo rje dus so/ /gtsug phud sa ni zhusterdo rje bgegs kyi gtso bo'os/ /ba ru ṇa ri ni klu 82rdo rje ste/ de dag 8nyal sogs pa ni rdo rje 9 )bran zhes bya bar (3dbang bskur totsho 6/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po'i lha mo thams cad rdo rje rin po che'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur te/ rang gi mtshan ma ( )rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur cing ri7/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems can gyi don la rab tu 84—128

bkod pa la ①'di lta ste/ u ma ni khro bo rdo rje ma'o/ / gser ldan ma ②ni rdo rje gser ro/ / drug ldan ma nini rdo rje gzhon nu ma'o/ /tshangs ma ni rdo rje zhi ma'odul/ /dbang mo ni rdo rje khu tshur ma stephyi/ de la sogs pa ni rdo rje'i rgyal mor dbang bskur to/ /de nas nam mkha' ⑥la spyod pa'i bud med thams cad la ⑦byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ mi 'chi ba ⑧ni rdo rje mi 'chi ma'o⑨/ /ro hi na ni rdo rje mdangs ma'o / /dbyug ⑩'dzin ma ni rdo rje dbyug yimachog ma'o/ /skye ba 'phrog ma ni rdo rje'i rked chings ma ste'/ de la sogs pa ni khro tsomo zhes bya bar dbang bskur to④/ /de nas bar snang la spyod 8pa'i bud med thams cad la byin pa ni ⑩'di lta ste/ gsod ⑩ma ni rdo rje 'ju ma'o/ /za ba (nyeni rdo rje za ba ma'o/ /bgo 'o)ba ni rdo rje bgo ba ma'o(nya/ /dga' ba ni rdo rje dga' ba ma'o0/ /de la sogs pa ni tshogs kyi gtso mor dbang bskur to6)/ /de nas sa la spyod pa'i bud med thams cad la byin pa ni 'di lta ste/ zhi ba ma ni rdo rje pho nya mo'odu/ /rlung ni mgyogs ma (sterdo rje ma'o( snye/ /me ni rdo rje 'bar (nyema'o/ /ku be ra ma ni rdo rje'i 'khor sgo)ma ste/ de la sogs pa ni rdo rje'i pho nya mor dbang bskur to( she/ /de nas sa'i( )'og na gnas pa'i bud med thams cad la byin pa ni 'di lta ste/phag mo ni rdo rje kha'o/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi ( )ni rdo rje dus ma'o(nye/ / snang chen po (nyeni rdo rje rul pa ma'o()/ /ba ru ṇa ma dunani rdo rje chu srin ma ste/ de la sogs pa ni (nyerdo rje bran mor dbang bskur to(lha/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes zhugs pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnams bskyed (nyenas phyag rgya bcing zhu)ba thams cad ()bslabs te/ rdo rje'i dam tshig ( )mna'i snying po 'di byin no/ /rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis 84—129

'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ci hunyenas kyang sems can thams cad ji ltar dga' ba (snyebazhin chabagyis kyang dngos grub thams cad thob par ④bgyi ba'i slad du'o / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po la byin gyis brlab (gepa'i phyir 'di skad ⑥bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod legs so//rdo rje rin chen khyod legs sog/ /rdo rje chos ni khyod kyang legasal/ /rdo rje las khyod rab tu legs/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs par bshadapo)/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med / /de bzhin gshegs kun gsang ba ste/ /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rtog pa 0chen po las rdo rje chen po'i rtog pa'i 6)cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stodhi// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te mkhyen bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' nyon la dbang phyug chen po'i lus 'di khyod kyang 8rkang pa'i 'og nas btang bar byos/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyis ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i khro bor dbang bskur nas de bdag gis bskum lags nayi/ ji ltar de bdag gis btang bar bgyi/ de nas 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi ⑩bdag po dbang phyug chen po'i lus kyi srog gso ba'i phyir shi ba'i rnam par shes pa dgug 84—171

pa'i snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra satwa rtsu dza/ de nas de'i phyag rgya bcing ba bshad do/ /gsang ba'i lcags kyu bsdam ①bya ste/ /tha ma mnyam du brkyang nas kyang / /shi ba'i mgo bor bzhag na ni/ /srog ni phyir yang thob par 'gyur/ /de nas de thob ②ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang po'i dbyangs de①/ thal bas khebs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de nas slar phyin te dbang phyug gi lus der zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /gang ④phyir shi ba'i lus 'di yang / /'tsho ba'i khams su gyur pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rkang pa 'degs 57pa zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di (6)gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ.a/de nas de'i phyag rgya bcing ba bshad do/ /rdo rje khro bo mdzub (nyalegs par/ /zur sprad bsdams te bzhag pa ni/ /rdo rje de dag bsgyur byas shing / /'og nas de dag 'byin par byed/ /de nas de dag gsungs ma thag tu rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhabs kyi 'og nas lha chen po thar bar (9)rang gis shes par gyur to/ /de nas dbang phyug chen po'i lus de/ de bzhin gshegs pa des sos par byin gyis brlabs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don dang /ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu bcug kyigo/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs kyi mthil de nas zla ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi phyag rgya byung ngo / /oṃ tsajo dhā 6nyare sa man+ta bha dra ki ra ṇi 12ma hā badz+re ṇi /ste:/ de nas de'i phyag rgya bcing ba bshad do/ /rdo rje bcing ba dam byas te/ / mthe bosnyimathe'u chung snyimanyam par 84—172

ni / /mnyam ①nas legs par brkyang na ni/ /rdo rje ri mo zhes kyang grags/ /de nas de byung ma thag tu zhabs kyi mthil de las zla ba'i bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa de byung nas dbang phyug chen po de'i mgo bo ②la phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mnan pa'i rjes su zla ba phyed pa zhuganas par gyur te g.yon logs na 'dug go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag na rdo rje'i grogs su lag tu ④rdo rje'i mdung (9rtse byin nas rdo rje'i rig pa dam pa rdo rje'i rig pa dam pa zhes rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur nas yidabang bskur ro/ /de nas rdo rje'i rig pa dam pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje mdung rtse des mgal ⑦me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor zhing gar gyi mchod pas mchod pa byas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /zhabs mchog gis ni gar reg pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid du grub ⑧pa thob/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑨phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag gi sug par rdo rje stsal te/ phyag na rdo rje nyid du dbang bskur bas lha la sogs te phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i rigs de rnams 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la gnas pa'i rim pa bgyis nas gang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las sems can de rnams phyir mi ldog par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa usnri ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de 84—173

nas 'di bshad ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnams las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de 6)kha dog du ma'i 'od zer du gyur te /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang bar byas nas yang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i gtsug gi mtshams su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gyi tshul du 'phungs snyunas 'khod do/ /de nas gzi brjid kyi phung po de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor 'di byung ④ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tosmi ṣa a na a wa ⑤mo ki te myur dha ni te phyidzo rā shi/ oṃ hūṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka ⑦dha ka /da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ sbyin da sbyin da/ snyin da ⑧nyin da⑨/hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ni sum bha badzā ⑩ phaṭa/de nas (mephyag na rdo rje de nyid kyi thugs las snying po 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ ṭak+ki dzaḥ7 / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ()chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ut+ta ma dzā chal ya rtsu phaṭa/de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud ṅgāḥ/ badz+ra pad+ma sho dha ya sarbe bi byot+ta 8ma hūm̐ phaṭa / de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma ut+ta ma badz+ra dha ra sa ma ya ma nu sma ra sum bha ni sum bha ā kur+sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ā tsobe sha ya/ bhan dha (rteya/ sa ma yo(nya / gra ha ya sarba kurmā ṇi mi 6)ku ru ma hā satwa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rig pa'i dam pas rang gi snying po bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir phul ba/ oṃ sum bha ni 84—174

sum bha ①badz+ra bi byot+ta ②ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje khro bo'i rig pa'i rgyal pos ①bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra shu la/ de nas rdo rje sgyu ma'i rig pa'i rgyal pos rang gi rig pa'i snying po dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dha ri ṣa ④ya sarbe hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje dril bu'i rig pa ⑧rgyal pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa ra ṇa ༅rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje thub pas rang gi snying po phul ba/ o badz+ra mo na ma hā pradzñā dus phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje mtshon chas rang gi snying po ⑤phul ba/ oṃ badzā spru ⑨snya dā ⑩ma ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ rig pa'i rgyal po rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje 'khyil pa rdo rje khro bos bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la rang gi snying po 'di zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa ⑩li ma hā badz+ra gro dha grihā 8ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa bi dh+wan tsos ya badz+re ṇa 8myu da rna pa la ya ti skṛ 7ta sa skṛ yid ya badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje 'od rdo rje khro bos rang gi snying po 'di phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra pra bha 0mā ra ya sro ma ()gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje dbyug pa rdo rje khro bos rang gi snying po 'di phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ya sar+pā duṣ+ṭi tunyem hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje khro bo rdo rje ser pos rang gi snying po 'di phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra piṅga la bi sha ya sarba du/ nu )bi ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bo rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje glang sna tshogs kyi bdag pos bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la snying po 'di phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra sho dha ma hā ga ṇa pa ti rak+ṣa sarba duṣ+ṭi bh+yo/ badz+ra dha soger ā dzñā cenapa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas gro rdo rje phreng bas rang gi snying po 'di phul lo/ /oṃ mā la ga ṇa pa zhugeti mā la ya ā kuṇ+ḍa ya/pra be sha ya ba shaṃ ( sheku ru (nyamā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭas / de nas rdo rje dbang gis rang gi 84—175
