snying po phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra ba shi ①ma hā ga ṇa pa ti ba shaṃ ②ku ru rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje tshogs kyi bdag pos rang gi snying po ②phul bsti/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya bi dza ya ma hā ga ṇa pa ti hūṃ phaṭa/ tshogs kyi bdag po rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje tho ba rdo rje pho nyas rang gi snying po 'di phyag na rdo rje la phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra mu sa la ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭi (snye phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje rlung gi pho nyas rang gi snying po du )phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra nī la ma 9)tā be ga ga (7ṇa pa ti sarba duṣ+ṭa 6)rgyu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje me'i pho nyas rang gi snying po ⑩phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā duṣ+ṭa dzā ⑩la ya sarba bhasmi 7ku ru sarba du/ ()rgyu phaṭa/ rdo rje 'jigs pa'i pho nya chen pos rang gi snying po saphul ba/ oṃ badz+ra hai ra ba badz+re tsos da ba sha la sarba tsoduṣ+ṭan ma hā yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ pho nya rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu rdo rje bran gyis rang gi snying po 'di bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra e yiku sha ā (stemar+sha ya/ sarbe 17ma hā tsista 8)rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje dus kyis rang gi snying po phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra kā la ma hā mṛ kyu muṅgā ( med hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje ngan chakhrid kyis rang gi snying po phul ba/ oṃ badz+ra bi nā so)ya ka su bisnan 6 )ku ru rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje klu'i rdo rjes rang gi snying po 'di phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas phul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ga badz+ra ā mnyan ya sarba da na da ne tir+ya dugarna ne muk+ta ( )a laṅgā ra bi ni rinasarbo pa rmo (kā ra ṇa ( 7ni badz+ra dha ra zhinas ma ya ma nu smar ka ta/nyin da sgyin da ri ha ra ha ra mā ṭ+wāṃ nyam hā ts+tsha da zhu )rtsu phaṭa/ bran rnams so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rigs thams cad 'gugs 5pa'i dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha 8)ā kur+sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas de gzhug pa'i dam tshig 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra pā shā 84wa 176

mchu ①rgyu/ de nas thams cad bcing ba gsungs pa/ hūm̐ badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃ/ de nas las kyi snying po gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra kurma sa ma ya kri tal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di bshad do / /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra bar ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus ④bre/ /de la 'di ni srad bu bre ba'i snying po yin no/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra sru traṃ ④mā ⑤kar+ṣa ya sarba maṇ+ḍa la rtsu / dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus su yang / /seng ldeng phur bu btab nas ni/ /de nas srad bu nyis rim du/ /byas nas de yis srad bu ④bre/ /de la 'di ni phur bu'i snying po yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra tī la ya tī la ya stisarba bisne ⑧ban dha hūṃ phaṭa/srad bu bzhi dang ldan pa dang / /dkyil 'khor zlum po srad bu bre/ /de yi phyi rol byung nas ni/ /nyis 6)'gyur du ni de bzhin no/ /de yi rim pa gsum du ni / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor srad bu 'bre/ /phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i rtsibs tshul du/ /grwa (nyeyi ri mo srad bu 'bre/ /srad bu bre ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas srad bu bres pa der/ /dag pa'i tshon gyis dgang bar bya/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis / /cho ga bzhin du gzung (nyebar bya/ /dang po bris nas phyis ci bde8/ /de la 'di ni tshon gyi snying po'o8/ /oṃ badz+ra raṅga sa tsom ya hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon yang / /mnyam par bzhag la dbus 'dug nas/ /rdo rje yi ni sgo bzhi rnams/ /yid kyis kyang ni dbye bar bya/ /de la sgo dbye ba'i snying po ni 'di'o / /oṃ badz+ra ud gha ṭa yi thos ma ya pra be sha ya shī r+ghaṃ yonyesma ra badz+ra sa ma ya rtsu phaṭa / gser ram yang na dngul yang rung / /sa la bar zhu)du bris pa'am/ / pha gu so)gru bzhi'i steng du ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs gzhag (spepar bya/ /de la 84—177

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po ni 'di'o/ /oṃ sarba bid/ sangs rgyas kyi ①ni phyogs kun du/ /sems dpa' ②chen po bzhi bzhag go/ /mdun du phyag na rdo rje ni/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal zhes bya/ /de la sems dpa' chen po'i snying po ①ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi ④rgyu/gro: ⑤pa ya gro: ⑥pa ya hūṃ/ ā ⑦na ya ho bha ga ṭ+wāṃ ⑧badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra : ⑨ku ṭī kro dha ā tshun ya sarbe rat+na (1hrīḥrdu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi kro dha dṛṣ+ṭa ④mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi shwa kro dha ku ru sarba bi tishwa rū pa ta ya sid dha ye 84 phaṭa/'jug gam 8phyir ni byung ba na/ /srad bu'i 'og 'dzul yid ⑩bsams nas/ /rdo rje shugs su brjod pa ste/ /de yis ri mo brgal bar bya/ /de la rdo rje shugs kyi snying po ni 'di'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e gā kra ma rtsu/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal ⑩nas ni / /dkyil 'khor dang por de bzhin du/ /ltag tso'og go rims yiji bzhin du//rdo rje sgyu ma la sogs bri/ /de la dam tshig gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa 6 )rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ka sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā sgo1yu dha hūṃ/rdo rje shugs kyis brgal 9 stenas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa de bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'khyil pa la sogs pa/ /rdo rje khro bo gzhag par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ pra dz+wa ( nyeli ta dīp+ta ( )badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sau me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi kṛ ( mita hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /sgo ni bzhi po rnams su yang / /rdo rje glang sna la sogs pa/ /thams cad rim pa bzhin du bri/ /de dag gi dam tshig gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra dha ma rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra mā la 8)rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra arba rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra a si hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal 3 tshonas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsum par bri ba ni/ /ltag ( ste'og 84—178

rim pa ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje tho ba la sogs pa'o/ /de dag gi snying po ①ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra mu sa la hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā ta rtsu/ o badz+ra dzā ②la hūm̐/oṃ badz+ra gra ha hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal dunas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi par bri ba ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs bran/ /ltag ④'og rim pa bzhin du'o/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /o ⑤badz+ra deḥ yis/ oṃ badz+ra mā ⑦ra ṇa (kyergyu/ oṃ badz+ra be 6)ga tsū/ oṃ badz+ra ⑩ha ra ṇa yi:/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal ⑫nas ni/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor gzhag pa ni/ /ltag tso'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /ma mo thams cad bri bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje sgo bzhir yang / /sgo ba rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas rab tu bshad pa yini/ /cho ga rgyas pa ji bzhin pa'o/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum po'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir dgug (nyapa la sogs pa'i las kun byas te/ rdo rje slob dpon nyid rdo rje khro bo ti rirnyi ri'i ⑩phyag rgya bcings te 'di skad bsgo zhing ⑫/ ngas khyod la rdo rje dam tshig gi ye shes bskyed par bya ste(nya/ de khyod kyis su la yang ma smra shig /mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyod dus byas te dmyal bar lhung nga re zhes bsgo ste mna'i snying po 'di sbyin no / /rdo rje khro bo ti rirnyi ri'i (7phyag rgya yang ston cig /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /rdo rje khro bo chen po yi( )/ /dam tshig khyod kyi rigs sreg ( nyapas/ /klad (nyapa nas ni brtsams nas kyang / /lus rnams ma rungs par yang byed/ /dam tshig bcing ba'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang ba'i las kyi phyag rgya sa snying po 'dis bcing ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhā ra/ grihā ( ༄ban dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ de nas 'di so phyag rgya bcing ba bshad do/ /lag gnyis bla 'og gnyis su (9btang / /mthe bo mthe'u chung sbrel ba dang / /las kyi phyag rgya dam tshig 'di/ /rdo rje 84—179

bcing ba zhes kyang bshad/ /de nas rdo rje'i chus dbang bskur te/ snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe yo)ka a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra dhā ra ta ②sa ma gra gro/ de nas g.yogs pas gdong g.yogs te/ snying po 'di ②gzhug go/ /oṃ badz+ra pra be ༅sha ya/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a dhi tiṣ+ṭha (gebadz+ra hūm̐/ de nas bcug nas snying po 'dis me tog gtor ro/ /oṃ pra tīts+tsha a dhi yitiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥphya/ de nas de dag gar dulhung ba de ⑨'dis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gdong g.yogs pa bkrol tshunas dkyil 'khor go rims (1bzhin du bstan te/ lha gang yin pa de ni de la mi bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can log par lta ba dag yod de / gang dag ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ⑩rnams kyi ye shes gdon mi za ba ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rigs su phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur ba de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dam zhes dad par mi 'gyur ro zhes pa ni dam tshig go/ /gzhan du na lha gang dag 1nyal dad pa de dag la mna'i snying po 'di byin nas bstan par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i rin po che'i mtshan ma'i phreng bas dbang bskur nas las kyi rdo rje lag pa gnyis su byin la/ rdo rje ming btags te ji ltar rdo rje dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 7chen po bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcing ba tsobaslab bo/ /rdo rje bcing ba dam byas te/ /mthe bong nang du sbyar nas ni/ /mdzub 7mo bkug nas gnyi gas bkab/ /sems dpa'i (nyagatsug tor zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba byas nas ni/ /mthe bo gung mo mthe'u chung bsgreng tunye/ /gzi brjid phung po zhes bya ste/ /gzi brjid chen po'i btsun pa'o/ /rdo rje phyag rgya gnyis bcings te/ /mthe bo mthe'u chung sbrel ba ni/ /dam du lcags kyu bcings pa ste/ /rig pa chen po dam pa'i 'o/ /rig pa chen po dam pa yi9)/ /84—180

phyag rgya bcings nas rab bcing ①ba/ /snying gar mthe bo'i ngos kyis so/ /sems dpa' yi ni snying por bshad/ /de nyid las gung mo srin lag /sor mo rab tu bsdams nas ni/ /rdo rje rin chen tshul du ni/ /bsgyur nas gdong du gzhag par bya/ /de nyid bskyed de bzhag nas ni/ /snying gar yang ni bsgyur bar bya/ /me tog bzhi pa zhes bya ste/ /pad+ma'i rig pa dam pa'o/ /de nyid spyi bo nas brtsams te/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor bskor bar bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'di/ /rdo rje las ni rab bsgrub ②pa'o/ /sems ma'i rdo rje dam byas ⑧te / /mthe'u chung rdo rje bsgreng ④ba ni/ /thams cad rig pa'i snying po 'di/ /phyag rgya 'di ni thams cad sgrub/ / mthe bo mthe ⑤chung bcings nas yini/ /g.yon pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum/ /rtse gsum pa ni dbus ma'i rtse/ /rdo rje phyag rgya gzung ⑦ba ste/ /rdo rje rig pa dam pa 'di(mi/ /rdo rje mdung zhes bya ba'o//de nas rab tu bshad pa ni/ /sgyu ma rdo rje la sogs brtags6)/ /rdo rje bcing ba dam byas te/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur zhes bshad de/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni kun gyi 'di'o⑩/ /rdo rje de ni gnyis byas te/ /mtshan ma kun kyang des bzhag go/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya rnams kyang 'byung ba ste/ /sor brkyang steng du gzhag pa dang / /mdzub (7mos mthe 8bstan sbyar ba dang / /oṃ zhes bya ba spyir bzhag nas/ /rdo rje steng du bzhag pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs rnams so/ /rab tu brkyang nas lag gnas pa/ /lag pa'i rgyab tu de bzhin te/ /khu tshur bcangs yonyebazhag lag ngar bskum / /kha yi phyogs su bskor skibar bya/ /rdo rje khro bo'i 8phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bo yisteng du bzhag /phreng ba'i bcing ba'i thabs su sbyar/ /84—181

nor sbyin par ni g.yas pa ste/ /ral gri'i phyag rgya khu tshur mchog /'dus pa'i dbang po'i phyag rgya chen po 'dus pa'o/ /g.yas pa mdun du gtun ①rings 'dzin / /lag pa brkyang ba'ang de bzhin te/ /g.yas pas phyi'od ni 'bar bar bstan / /rdo rje khu tshur bskyod par bya/ /pho nya'i phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs so/ /bsgyings bcas mdzub ④mo'i khar mche ④ba/ /dbyug pa bsnun ⑤cing gnas pa dang / /dpung ba bskum zhing dbyung ⑥ba dang / /g.yas pa g.yon gyis 'dren pa'o / /bran gyi phyag rgya'i tshogs chen po'o⑦/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bstan pa (nyani / /g.yon pas rdo rje gzur ⑨nas so/ /de nas rab tu bshad pa ni/ /sgrub pa dang ni las nyid do/ /sems dpa' gang gi phyag rgya gang / /de ni bdag nyid nyid 7kyis kyang / /bdag nyid goms par gyur na ni/ /phyag rgya dam par 'grub par 'gyur/ /gtsug tor chen po bsrung (1ba che/ /gzi brjid phung po rab grub ster/ /rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya kun byed/ /snying gar gzhag pa thams cad 'gugs7 / /sangs rgyas kyi phyag rgya rnams so/ /thams cad rig pa thams cad 'grub / /rdo rje rig pa dam pa'o/ /rdo rje mdung tunyeni phyag rgya che/ /grub pa chen po sbyin par byed/ /sgyu ma'i rdo rje rab 'grub ster④/ /dril bu yis ni yang dag 'bebs / /dbyug pa'i shing gis mya ngan 'da'/ /rdo rje'i rdo rje gsod par byed / /rig pa'i rgyal po tshernams so/ /'bar ba'i mchog ni ma rungs ⑩'dul/ /zhi ba'i mchog ni thams cad gsod/ /dbyug pa'i mchog ni gsod pa ste/ /'jigs 7pa'i mig ni skrag par byed/ /rdo rje khro bo'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /myos pas rab tu myos par byed/ /phreng ba kun ni byed par bshad/ /'dod byed dga' bar byed pa ste/ /gsod pa thams cad gsod pa'o/ /tshogs kyi phyag rgya 84—182

rnams so/ /tho ba gdug pa 'joms pa ste/ /ras kyi rgyu ras de bzhin te/ /'bar ba'i mchog ni gdug pa sreg /gnod sbyin ma ①ni gdon 'bod ②do/ /pho nya'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /rdo rje'i mche ba za ba ste/ /gsod pa thams cad gsod pa'o①/ /bgegs byed ma ni rab tu bgegs/ /'phrog ma yang ni thams cad 'phrog /bran gyi phyag rgya rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ༷kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po las 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto(ge // //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gzungs kyi dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs ⑥zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra ba si tre swā hā/ de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na ⑦rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o badz+ra dha (nyari hūm̐/ 6)badz+ra bi kra 0me hūm̐ phaṭa / yang byang chub sems dpa' 7chen po rdo rje tsosnying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na go tre 4༄swā hā/ de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ne+e 9tre swā hā/ de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma ka tsore swā hā/ de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' tsochen po rdo rje rig pa dam pas rang gi rig pa dam pa ⑩'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra shu lā tu gre swā hā/ de nas rdo rje sgyu ma 4)rig pa'i rgyal pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsa kre ( )rtsu/ rdo 84—183

rje dril bus smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa 6)ke hūm̐/ thub pa'i rdo rjes smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra dan+ta /sbre ②rgyu/ rdo rje mtshon chas smras pa/ oṃ badz+re hūṃ/ rig pa'i rgyal po'i dam tshig gi phyag ①rgya rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje 'khyil pa rdo rje khro bos rang gi snying po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra dzā ④le hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje 'od kyis smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra sau me phyis/ de nas rdo rje dbyig pas smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍi (6)rtsu/ rdo rje ser smug gis smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra bi ṣā ṇi ⑦ / rdo rje khro bo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje glang snas rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra me (kyede hūm̐/ rdo rje phreng bas smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra mā le rtsu/rdo rje dbang gis smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra a 6)gi ṣe hūṃ/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rjes smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra a pa kyi'o dzi ⑩ta rtsu/ tshogs kyi 8bdag po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje gtun rings kyis tsorang gi dam tshig gi 8phyag rgya rnams smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra mu sa la gra he hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje rlung gis 7smras pa/oṃ badz+ra bā 7te hūṃ/ rdo rje mes smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra dzā (sprele hūm̐/ rdo rje 'jigs pas smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra gra he hūm̐/ rdo rje pho nya'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyus smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra rdas tunyertsu/ rdo rje dus kyis smras pa/oṃ badz+ra /lha ba she hūm̐/ rdo rje ngan 9 nyakhrid kyis smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra bisnan 0rtsu/ rdo rje klus smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra ha ra ṇi 6)rtsu/ rdo rje bran gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams so / /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes 9 sterdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /gru 86bzhi pa la byang phyogs sgo/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor srad bus bre//de yi nang du der yang ni/ /de bzhin sgo ni shar phyogs gdod( snye/ /de yi dbus 84—184

su ci rigs par/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni gzhag par bya/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal ①sogs pa/ /bzhi po de yi phyogs kun bzhag /dkyil 'khor de bzhin gtso bor yang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de yi ③phyogs rnarmes thams cad du/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /rdo rje glang sna la sogs pa/ / bzhi po de yi phyogs kun bzhag /dkyil 'khor de bzhin gtso bor yang rdo rje phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /rdo rje glang sna la sogs pa/ /tshubazhi po rnams ni sgo srungs so/ /'jigs ④ma dpal dang sgra dbang dang / /dur ga g.yon pa'i grwa rnams nas/ /phyi yi grwa rnams phyag rgya ni/ /de rnams nyid ni bri bar bya/ / phyi yi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /lha mo rnams ni bri bar bya/ /⑤de nas cho ga rgyas pa'i rnams/ /ji bzhin par ni bshad par bya/ /de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du byas te rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas dam tshig gi las byas nas rdo rje 'chang ba'i 6)cho ga bzhin du bcings la khyod ⑦kyis dam tshig ma ⑧mthong ba su'i mdun du yang dam tshig gi phyag rgya de rnams ma smra shig /gsang ba 'phel bar ma byed cig ces bsgo shig /de nas las kyi rdo rje de rdo rje 'chang ba'i phyag rgya'i steng du bzhag ste cho ga bzhin du chug po)cig /zhugs nas rdo rje de de bzhin du 'or ⑩cig /gang la bab pa de de'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i dbang du 'gyur te/ des las thams cad byed do/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol ⑪nas dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bstan te/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya gsang ba smros shig /dam tshig 7phyag rgya 'di khyod kyi/ /rtag tu las kun byed pa ste/ /ma dang sring mo rnams dang ni/ /chung ma bu mo 'dra 4 ba'o/ /de la de'i snying po ni 84—185

'di dag yin no/ /oṃ sarba ga ma ni sarba bān+t+ra sā stidha ya gu h+ya badzi ༷ṇi rtsu phaṭa/'di lan cig bzlas pas bud med thams cad dbang du byas te spyad na chos ma yin par mi 'gyur ro/ /ci dga' bar thams cad spyad nas bsgrub par bya ste/de nas sems can thams cad dag par phyag rgya ④thams cad ༷yid kyis shes nas las dam pa thams cad kyang byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang bas gsungs so/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bslab par bya'o/ /dam tshig khro bo mdzub gtsug (snyedang / /snying gar yang ni bsdam par bya/ /ngos kyi mdzod spu kha nas drang / /spyi bor bzhag nas gnyis su bya/ /g.yon pa'i ⑥rdo rje mdzub ⑦mo yis / /mdung rtse rtse gsum mnan (kyepar bya'o/ /'di bcings pas ①ni yang dag par/ /rig pa dam pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur⑩/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni thams cad kyi/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje gtso bor 'dus/ /dam tshig cho ga ji bzhin par/ /phyag rgya bcing ba bshad par bya/ /thams cad 'khor lo mdzub rtse bcum7/ /dril bu phyag rgya'ang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin oṃ gyi ⑩phyag rgya dang / /seng ge'i rna bar bya ba ste/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /'bar ba kun du 'dzin pa dang / /'od ni yang dag 'dus pa nyid/ /dbyug pa'i khu tshur 'dzin pa dang / /kha 'gram phyag rgya bskor ba'o/ /khro bo'i dam tshig rnams so/ / btung ba'i nyi phyag rgya phreng ba dang / /rdo rje mnan nas mdud pa yin/ /spyi bor bzhag pa tshogs kyi ste/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bsrung to)ba'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi ni 8dam tshig go/ /lag pa bskum pa khar gzhag ste/ /rgyab tu yang ni bskor bar bya /'bar ba me stag gtong ba ste/ /phye nas khar yang gnas par bya/ /pho nya mo'i yidam tshig rnams so/ /mtha' ma gnyis ni khar bcug dang / /btsir cing rab tu 84—186

gnon pa'o/ /dpung pas bsnol ①bas bsnol ba dang / /myur du 'phrogs ②pa'ang de bzhin no/ /bran mo rnams kyi dam tshig go/ / rdo rje ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ④dam tshig gi rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las rdo rje rigs thams cad kyi rdo rje gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stokhya// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje dbyings kyi byin gyis brlabs (7zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rang gi rig pa dam pa 9)'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra (9bid/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes rang gi chos kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so / /oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas yang rdo rje ①snying pos rang gi chos kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas yang rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi chos kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ra ma ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas yang rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi chos kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas tshurdo rje rig pa dam pas rang gi chos kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje sgyu mas smras pa/ oṃ hrīn+da sbyin hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ ā bi sha ā bi sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khyur bu ba swaḥ(7rgyu phaṭa/ o bhin dha gin dha 8rgyu phaṭa/ rig pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ da ma da (nyam hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ yimā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ghā ata ya ghā 7ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bha ya bha ya hūm̐ phaṭa / khro bo rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ da ma da 4 ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban dha ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ ba shī tunyerta ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ya dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ tshogs rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ bh+yo bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ghu ghu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzā la dzā 47la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khā da khā da hūm̐ phaṭa/84—187

pho nya rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ kha na kha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ra ma ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ a groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi 6)rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pi bha pi bha hūṃ phaṭa/ bran mo rnams kyi'o/ /de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor te(ge / /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin la sogs/ /thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'ol/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor tshul lta bu/ /snying gar mtshan ma yang dag bzhag /de nas 'di'i chos kyi chadam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'dir cho ga bzhin du las byas nas rdo rje 'chang ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu bcings ④pa bcings te 'di skad smos shig /khyod kyis dam tshig ma mthong ba dang / lha'i rigs ma mthong ba su la yang ma smra shig ces bsgo ba (5)la dril bu dkrol du chug cig /'di skad bsgos ⑥nas kyang mna'i snying po byin la/ ji ltar dril bu 'di dgrol ba'i/ /de yi sgra des ji lta ba'abye/ /de bzhin las kyi rdo rje khyod/ / de bzhin nges par ma rungs (nyabyed / /rdo rje slob dpon bsti (93stang med/ /rdo rje grogs 7dang mi mdza' dang / /gdug la byams dang skyo bar ni/ /gal te khyod kyis byas na'o/ /de nas gdong g.yogs pa bkrol 37la dkyil 'khor bstan te/ chos kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes slobs 7shig /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin la sogs/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor ji bzhin no/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid bsam pa/ /rdo rje rig pa dam pa skye32/ /'gro ba 'di dag sgyu ma bzhin/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal dril bu 'dra/ /sdug bsngal thams cad mya ngan 'da'/ /rdo rje 'joms skipa bla na med/ /rig pa'i rgyal po ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /sems can gdul phyir khro bo'i tsomachog /84—188

zhi ba yis ni nges par gsod/ /dbyug pa 'dra la 'tshog par byed①/ /log par lta ba 'jigs par byed/ /khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /ra ro 'dra bar dpa' ba med/ /phreng ba 'dra bar 'ching ba med/ /bud med 'dod pas 'gro dbang byed②/ /brten pa tsam gyis gzhan pham mo/ /tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /'tshog pa'i chad pa'i mchog yin te / /reg pa rnams ni rlung gi'o/ /gzi brjid can ni byin za mchog /zas rnams kyi nang khrag dam pa / /pho nya'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /mche ba dag par zhugs pa ste/ /'chi bdag thams cad gnas na 'dug /'jigs las lhag pa'i bgegs gzhan med / /chu las lhag pa'i ro gzhan med/ /bran gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje dam tshig gi rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po las rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stokhyi// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig las 'byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlab bo ⑤zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma pra brta ni sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra bi lā (6)se pū dzā (7)ya hūm̐/de nas rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ a bhi ṣe ke a bhi ṣiñtsa (mi / de nas rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra gī te gā 5)gyi hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sna tshogs kyis ⑩84—189

rang gi las kyi rig pa 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+ra t+ya mṛ t+ya ①rgyu/ de nas rdo rje rig pa dam pas rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra bi byot+ta ma ne ②dra bi kur ba bi kur ba gartsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje khro bo rdo rje me'i lha mos rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha badz+ra asne dzā rgyal tri shu latri na skṛ (snyed ya badz+re ༅ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje gser lha ⑦mos rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra he ma nits+tshan+da tsakre ṇa badzi 0ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje gzhon nu mas rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra ku mā ri shī r+ghaṃ ā be ()sha ya ghasto shasdi (men badz+ra bā ṇi ()sri ye badz+ra sa ma ye ma nu smar ṇa 0rtsu phaṭa/de nas lha mo chen mo rdo rje zhi bas rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra shārnyi 'dza pa dza pa a gha mā la ya sablon ma ra ya shān+ta tri h+ya 8rgyu phaṭa/ de nas lha mo chen po 8rdo rje khu tshur gyis rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi 3)ha na ha na badz+ra bhin dha nyin dha pi ḍa ya pi tu)ḍa ya sarba duṣ+ṭa skṛ da yā yini oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ rka pho phaṭa/ rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams kyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje mi 'ching (nyab khro bos rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te sa( duṣ+ṭa groṇ+ḍa 8gebarnya ( steha na sarba bi t+t+waṃ sa tson/ bi nā (nyesha ya sbyisdo ba bi ku ru mut+ta 0ni/ta ya badz+re ṇa ye ke tsitra 8)ma mu ka ra bi na yā ka tan+ta ma dīp+ta kro ( )snya badzi hūm̐ phaṭa/de nas rdo rje mdangs can gyis rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra kurnyi mā ra ya sau me ru 87pe pra ti ba ta rā 6 )shen shī r+ghaṃ sbo ṭa ya badz+ra dha (nyer h+ye na ma hā byo zhi sna kā 'ger le shi ta rasmi 8 3badz+re ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje dbyug pa'i mchog mas rang gi las kyi snying po 'di smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa gri ghā ta (nyeya hūṃ phaṭa/de nas rdo rje tsong tsong khro bo chen mos rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ 84wa 190

badz+ra mā le me kha le kha na kha na sha ①pa ba de ②ni ba shigaku ru traṃ /ṭī mā dur ya bi sha ne hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i rig pa rnams so/ /de nas rdo rje 'jums durang gi las kyi dam tshig smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra ba dul ye me gats+tshan+da si na bhin+da nibadz+re ṇi mā ra ya u ma da ya pi ba pi ba las tshuphaṭa/ de nas rdo rje zas kyis rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra a sha ne ba krā ⑩ya sarba duṣ+ṭa tsobadz+ra da sha ne sha ga ti dha ra ṇi tsom nu sha ma 8na se ā ⑩ha re ṇa ⑩ra ru ti sa shud ⑩ci pri 8ya ma dza ba sā yinu dule ba na bi le ba ta gra 0te/ a na ya sarba dan+ta n+ya ya dunyi ra rgya su bar+ṇa ā di ni 'gra 0ma ya de ⑤bar k+ṣa ṇi tso phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje bgo bas rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras pal/ oṃ badz+ra bā dus ne ā dun ya sarba sra an+da ba ṇa 'di rgyu dub ka ra ṇa ⑥ni shī s+t+waṃ ba shi ku ru dī pa de 9me pra yats+tsha ā bi dusha sa traṃ ④ka ta ya badz+ra ko ṣa dha tsor tsā tsos phaṭa / de nas rdo rje dbang gis rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra ba shi ()ā na (nyeya ba shaṃ 6)ku ru sarba pri ya sarba pu ( )ru ṣa nad si ku ru kru ji pra se da ya sarba (tebh+yaḥb ha re bh+yo ha (nyer ya bi tsa ra ya ka ri badz+ra pa ta ka d+mar tī 4)rtsu phaṭa/rdo rje tshogs kyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje pho nya mos rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra duṣ+ṭi ā skyin ya sarba maṇ+ḍa lo pra be sha ya ā (shebe sha ya brnya ⑩ya sarba kurma ṇa me 4)ku ru shī traṃ shī r+ghaṃ (nyal gu la gu ()tra sa ya ( )mā ra ya/ da bya ba re bho dha dur ya bi dza yaṃ ka ri badz+ra pa ta ka dh+ra 6gyer tī ru rgyu phaṭa/ de nas ④rdo rje shugs kyis rang gi (nyedam tshig smras pa/ oṃ be gha zhunyabadz+re ṇa 6)lhu ghu ghu ghu sha ba de mā ra ya bi ghi ra bi t+t+waṃ sa 4)ya badz+ra pā sha dhā 6)ra tsā hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje 'bar bas rdzo )rang gi las kyi dam tshig (nyasmras pa(nye/ oṃ badz+ra dzā la dzā (nyel ya sarba badz+ra dzā la ya dzā ④la ya da ha da ha ba smi tsoku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje 'jigs pas tsorang gi las kyi 84—191

dam tshig smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra bi ga te pra be ka rda'i ①ka rā li ka rā la bi ②sha na bā ka gatre shī r+ghaṃ shrī r+ghaṃ ā ④ba sha ya bhak+ṣa 0ya ru dhi raṃ pi 0pa ma ༷hā yak+ṣi ṇi badz+ra pā ⑧sha dhā ⑨ra tsā ⑩ phaṭa/ rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i bzhin rdo rje bran mos ⑩rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi ā tson ya badz+ra disnri ⑫ba ya ni ke ba tā tsol ni bsi ni kha na kha 8na khā hi khā nyi sarba mu khe pra tsobe sha ya sbo ṭa ya mā ra mā ra ṇi tsosarba duṣ+ṭa ṭ+wāṃ badz+re tso'i shi ta si dhā yiri tī hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje dus tsoms rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra kā li ma hā pre ta rū pi ṇi ma nu ṣa māṃ sa ru dhi ra pri ye i h+ye hi groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi/ bhak+ṣa ya badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra thi kha le sarba de ba ga ṇa mā tri bhū te ha ra ha ra pā shā/⑥ a mu ⑤ka su ka pā dul mā lā ④lo kṛ ( steta sarba ka ye kiñtsi rā ⑩ya si badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑥ga dhā ri tī pre ta ma nug sha rī 0re shī s+t+waṃ ā 'be sha ya pra be sha ya brta ya ba shi ku ru 0mā ra ya badz+ra rak+ṣa si rtsu hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa / de nas rdo rje rul (1mas rang gi las kyi dam tshig 'di smras so/ /oṃ badz+ra pū 8)ta me ma nu ṣa ya man sa sarba ru dhi dur mu tra byas rī ṣa sha le smra shī (nyergyu na re tsoka to ga hi ra ṣ+yo yā tī 6 〉shī s+t+waṃ i dam mu ka su du)ku ru badz+ra sho dha ni ka dhā ra ⑥tī ‘ sarba kurma ṇi 81me ku ru swā hā/ hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje ma ka ras rang gi las kyi dam tshig smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra ma ka re 6 gra sa gra sa shī r+ghaṃ ( pra be sha ya bla tā lo bhak+ṣa ④ya badz+ra ma ka ra dhā ra tī hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje bran mo rnams kyi'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes yang rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus bre/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas dbus na bzhugs par bya/ /de dag 84—192

phyogs su rim par yang / /sems dpa' chen po rnams bzhag go/ /de yi dbus su chung mar bcas/ /rdo rje rig pa dam pa nyid/ /rdo rje lā gye ①la sogs gsang ②/ /gar gyi mchod la sogs pas mchod/ /de la lha mo'i go rims ⑧bzhin / /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin du/ /rang gi phyag rgya phyag rgya 'dra / /gang byed par yang bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can mchod phyir/ /rdo rje gar gyi gotshul gyis so/ /grwa ⑤dang sgo yi phyogs rnams su/ /bdug pa la sogs rim pa bzhin/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir dgug pa la sogs pa'i las byas nas rdo rje 'chang 6)ba'i las kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya ji lta ba bzhin bcings te 'di skad spros shig /khyod kyis lha'i rim pa ma mthong ba dang las mi shes pa su la yang gsang ba'i las 'di ma smra shig /khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re zhes smros shig /rdo rje slob dpon rang gi las kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te khro bo'i lta bas blta zhing 'di skad brjod do/ /oṃ badz+ra ( petar+ya ā gabe sha ya pra be 6)sha ya mṛ 7te ba ya sarba kurma sid+dhi me 0pra yats+tsha hūm̐ āḥ8rgyu a la la la la badzi/ de nas yang bdag la babs nas bdag nyid kyis 'jug ste phyag rgya dang 'dra ba'i phyag rgya rnams kyi gar gyi mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /⑫phyin chad lus dang / ngag dang / lta ba dang / yid dang / rdo rje'i phyag rgya rnams kyis cilas thams cad 'dod pa bzhin byed pa'o/ /de nas gdong g.yogs pa bkrol 7te/ gar gyi mchod pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes slobs shig /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyi/ /dam tshig mchog ni gnyis byas te/ /rdo rje rig pa dam pa la/ /rdo rje lā sre gel sogs mchod/ /rig pa 'di rnams thams cad kyang ske/ /ltag 7'og go rims (nyeji bzhin du/ /gar gyi mchod pa'i phyag rgya 84—193

yis / /las kyi dkyil 'khor mchod par bya/ /rdo rje gar gyi tshul gyis ni/ /phyag rgya chen po mdor bsdus so/ /dam tshig mchog ni gnyis byas nas/ /las kyi phyag rgya bkrol ①bar bya/ /gar gyi mchod pa 'di yis ni/ /gtso bo thams cad mchod na ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa che sogs kyi/ /las grub par yang nges par 'gyur / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ②rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi ①dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stobya// //de nas snyibacom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje'i rigs de dag thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du bskos 6)nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la rab tu bzhag ste mkhyen bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag gsang ba thams cad 'dzin par dbang bskur na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba de gang lags/bka' stsol cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /sems can rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /ji lta (7ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta (9de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags la sogs gtsang bas bya(9)/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rdo rje gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad phan phyir dang //sangs rgyas rnams kyi 7bstan pa'i phyir/ /sems can thams cad bsad kyang ni//sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos rang gi nor bu gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad phan phyir dang / /sangs rgyas don du sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol nor rnams phrogs kyang ni/ /84—194

sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi pad+ma'i gsang ba ①'di gsungs so/ /'dod chags 'dra ba'i bde ba med / /rgyal ba la ni de phul la②/ /gzhan gyi chung ma sems can phyir/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i ①rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi las kyi gsang ba 'di gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad phan phyir dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa'i phyiral/ /las rnams thams cad byas pa yis/ /bsod nams shin tu mang po rnyed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'chang ba la legs so zhes bstod (5)pa/ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste / /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /mdo 'di (gelegs par smras pa ste/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po rdzogs sto(7)// //bam po drug pa/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po la mtshan brgya (8)rtsa brgyad pa 'dis gsol ba btab pa / pad+mo'i sems dpa' pad+mo che/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang phyug che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan pa'i mchog /rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /84—195

chos kyi rgyal po dag pa che/ /sems kyi ①rgyal po blo gros che/ /pad+ma'i bdag nyid pad+ma che/ /pad+ma'i mgon khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma las byung pad bzang ②'od / /pad+mo dag par rab dag ①byed/ /rdo rje pad+ma pad mchog lus/ /pad+ma pad+ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs chen po snang ba che/ /dogs ④pa chen po che dang mtshungs/ /brtan pa chen po dpa' ba che/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can bsam pa theg pa che/ /rnal 'byor chen po mes po che/ /bde za bde byed dag pa'i don/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /chos de nyid don dam pa'i chos/ /dag pa'i chos ni chos rab 'dzin/ /chos chen po dang chos bzang mchog(5) /chos kyi 'khor lo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas sems dpa' sems bzang mchogazhi) /chos kyi sems dpa' chos mchog 'dzin/ /sems dpa' dam pa sems mchog 'dzin/ /sems dpa' sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po ⑦mchog /mgon po chen po rnam (nyagazigs pa/ /'jig rten snang ba 'jig rten don/ /'jig rten mgon po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'jig rten yi ge yi ①ge che/ /yi ge mchog ni yi ge 'dra/ /yi ge yi ge thams cad gzigs/ /'khor lo'i yi ge khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag na pad+ma phyag ngachen po/ /dbugs 'byin pa ni sbyin pa po/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sangs rgyas che/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni gzugs chen po/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni gzugs bzang 'chang yo ste/ /chos kyi snang ba gzi brjid mchog /'jig rten snang khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma'i dpal ni mgon po mchog7 /chos dpal mgon po mgon ldan pa/ /tshangs pa'i mgon po tshangs chen po/ /tshangs sras khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /84—196

snang ba'i ①snang mchog snang ba'i gtso/ /snang gsal shin tu snang ba po②/ /snang ba'i mgon po snang ba ②che/ /sangs rgyas snang khyod phyag 'tshal lo sangs rgyas dbang bskur ④sangs rgyas mchog /sangs rgyas sras po mkhas chen po/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur gtsug gi mchog / sangs rgyas phyisangs rgyas khyod duphyag 'tshalacha/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni spyan chen po/ /chos spyan gzigs pa chen po yig / /ting 'dzin ye shes thams cad pa/ /rdo rje spyan khyod phyag 'tshal lo /bdag nyid kun gyi yon tan 'di/ /khyod ni mtshan brgya 0rtsa brgyad rnams/ /bstod nas goms par byed pa na⑩/ /'jig rten dbang po thob par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo khyod la gsol btab ⑩pa/ /rang gi rigs rnams bskyed nas kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /thub pa chen pos 8bshad par gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (stegasol ba btab pa'i tshig thos nas/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der mngon du phyogs te 'dug nas rdo rje pad+ma de rang gi thugs kur bzhag ste ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o/ /rab tu dag pa 8bdag gi rdo rje pad+ma 'di/ /pha yin snyi'adi ni bdag gi bu/ /rigs 'di byin gyis brlab ⑩par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyi brlabs tunyepad+mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs tunyete/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po li'adi rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /trīḥ/ de nas de byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa 84—197

thams cad kyi thugs ka nas pad+ma lta bu'i 'od zer ①kha dog dang gzugs dang rtags dang / spyod lam dang / 'od rnam pa du ma byung ste 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pa dang / chos nyid kyi ye shes yang dag par sbyangs nas yang slar log ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i thugs kur zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya bas tshurang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+mot+ta ④ma hrīḥ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhu)phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra bit+yā ⑥hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rabasta ma spyiX/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o badz+ra bi byot+ta (nyam hrīḥ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 99)rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra bibyot+ta ma aḥkhu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 11spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gzugs thams cad ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'gro ba 7thams cad 'dul ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ hrīḥho(ste/ /de nas de smras ma thag tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i thugs las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang po'i gzugs 'dzin pa pad+ma la zhugs te/ phyag rgya'i mtshan ma pad+mo 'dzin pa'i kha dog dang / gzugs dang / cha lugs dang / rgyan sna tshogs pa de bzhin 84—198

gshegs pa la sogs pa sems dpa' thams cad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i ①lus su gyur nas byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can thams cad ②ji ltar 'dul bar so so'i gzugs su bstan nas ma lus pa ①lus pa ④med pa'i sems can gyi khams gdul bar byas te / yang slar log phyinas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i phyogs thams cad kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la ⑥'khod nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thabs ni snying rje bdag nyid de/ /gang du thabs kyis 'dul ⑦mdzad na/ /lha (kyernams su yang 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'byedabang pos rang gi rigs tibaskyed nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / don dang / grub pa (skyedam pa dang / rdo rje chos nyid kyi yiye shes dang / mngon par shes pa'i 'bras bu'i ()rgyu rnyed pa'i phyir phul nas 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di bshad do/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba / /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bas na/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ste/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni brgyan skipa dang / /srad bu bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ /dar dang phreng bas brgyan ⑫pa dang / /dkyil 'khor grwa ni thams cad dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan par/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor srad bu bre//de yi nang du srad bu ni/ /gru bzhi par ni bri tsobar bya/ /gnyis pa'i grwa (rteni sgo 84wa 199

gdod 6)cing / /pad+ma 'dra bar bya ba yin/ /ka ba brgyad kyi tshul du ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ /de yi ge sar dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sku gzugs bzhag /de ②la sangs rgyas gzhag pa'i snying po ni 'di yin no/ /budha /ske/ sangs rgyas phyogs kun bri ba ni/ /pad+ma'i dbus su gnas pa yi③/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma'ang de bzhin no/ /de la de rnams kyi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ hūṃ trīḥkrodhi/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /der ni spyan ras gzigs dbang bri/ /gzugs rnams thams cad 'byin pa ste/ /de yi ③phyogs ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje 'gying la sogs tshul du/ /sangs rgyas la sogs sems dpa' che/ /mtshan ma pad+ma 'chang ba bri/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di dag yin no/ /āḥyi.o ta thā ga ta dharma hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma e phyaku sha ko (nyaṣa dhā ra ⑨badz+ra satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya ⑩pad+ma ku su ma ā ḍo/teyu dha dha char a mo gha sha ra ()ho/ oṃ pad+ma sam+bha pad+ma hasta sā bidhu hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa de bzhin te/ /de yi dbus su bri ba ni/ /thor tshugs dbus na'ang de bzhin gshegs / /de yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /khro gnyer la sogs tshul du ni/ /mtshan mar pad+ma 'chang bri ba/ /ltag 7'og go rims yiji bzhin bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma skṛ 7ku ṭī (nyaṭi ṭi tra/ oṃ pad+ma srur+ya dzā 67la hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ma ṇi ke tu dha ( )ra/ tsan+d+ra pra ha da la a ba lo ki (nyate shwa ra de hi 9 rteme sarba arta ( nyan shī r+ghaṃ sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma aṣ+ṭa hā so 7sa e ka dar+sha tsho nyamu ka ha ha ha ha hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'ang de bzhin te/ /sems dpa' chen po snyoms zhugs par/ /pad+ma'i 84—200

steng du bzhugs par bri/ /de yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /ltag tshi'og go rims ②ji bzhin bya/ /pad+ma la sogs ②tshul du ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang bzhag /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ hrīḥbya/oṃ tā rā pad+ma a ba lo ka ya mā ma sa ma ya satwa (gyes/ o pad+ma ku mā ra pad+ma shasti dha dur kha ḍa ge na ts+tshan+da tshin+da ④rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma nī la kuṇ+ḍa (nyasha 6)ra ka 0tsakra ga ta pad+ma pā ṇi byā gh+ra tsam ni ba sa ni kṛt+ta sarba kṛ ta ya dzño pa bā ti a dzi nam ba tsa tsastota/dha (7ri ya nā rā ya ṇa rū pa dha re tro ni mu kha astob tihā sa na pra be sha ya sa ma ya na/de hi me sidhi ()a ba lo ki ④te shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ brah+ma 7pad+ma saṃ bha tsob dza pa dza pa pad+ma p+ta sha hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'ang de bzhin te/ /der ni pad+ma zhal bzhi pa/ /pad+ma mdung rtse thogs par bri/ /de yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje gar la sogs tshul du/ /mtshan ma pad+ma 'dzin bri ba/ /sems dpa' chen po'i yicho ga bzhin/ /de rnams kyi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ hrīḥ(she/ oṃ pad+ma narte (6sha ra nā ( )tha pu dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta 0badz+ra /rma sa ma ya ā ༷r+sha ya pra be sha ya brnya ( 2ya ā ( )be sha ya sarba kurma sirnyi me ( stepra yats+tsha a ba lo ki 0te shwa ra rtsu/ oṃ ba ya na dha ta da a ba lo ki 0te shwa ra ru)rak+ṣa brnya ya ka ba tse sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā pra tsarnye bi ru shwa zhu7rlu pa tsi ka /pad+ma deju ā ka rā 6 )la bi shwa na badz+ra skṛ da ya sarba sa pad+ma yak+ṣa khā da khā da dhi rtsi bhi bhi ke(nye/oṃ pad+ma muṣ+ṭi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ brnya ( rtsu phaṭa/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /grwa rnams kun du bri ba ni/ /rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs tshul/ /pad+ma sgeg mo la sogs lha / /de dag gi ni phyag rgya 'di rnams so/ /oṃ pad+ma lā gye (sterā ga ya ma hā de bi (nyerā ga ma hā pu dza (lhas ma ya rtsu/ oṃ pad+ma mā le a bhi ṣiñtsa/ a bhi ṣe ka pū dzā ()sa 84wa 201

ma ya hunyertsu/ oṃ pad+ma gī te gī ②te pū dzā dus ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma dṛ h+ye dz+ra h+ye byasarba pū dza pra brtan (gyes ma ye (6)rtsu/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal stinas ni/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor grwa 6)rnams su/ /pad+ma'i mchod pa la sogs bzhi/ /mchod pa'i lha mo 9rnams bri'o/ /de la de dag gi mchod pa'i ⑩phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ pad+ma dhū pe zhu)pu dza tshunas ma ye pra h+la 6)da ya pad+ma ku la de ④yi te ma hā ga ṇi pad+ma ra ti tsū/ oṃ pad+ma saspre rmug dzā tsos ma ya ⑩pad+ma bā ༷si ni yim hā shri ye 0pad+ma ku la pra ti ha ra busarba arba sā dha (rteya t+t+waṃ/ oṃ pad+ma dī pa pū dzā phyis ma ye pad+ma ku la sun+da ri tsom hā du t+ya ā ( nyelo ka badz+ra ba tsi na ya pad+ma sa ra swa ti ༷rgyu/ oṃ pad+ma garnya pū dzā 6)sa ma ye ma hā pad+ma ku la tsi te ( nyeku ru sarba ⑥ kurmā ṇi 6)me pad+ma sirnyi byas/de nas pad+ma'i sgo bzhi po/ /kun du tshogs sogs ji bzhin du/ /ji lta ba bzhin legs bri ba/ /de dag snying po du)don gyis bris/ /oṃ ha (9ya spyi ba ma hā pad+ma e ku sha ya do ā kur+sha ya shī traṃ (5sarba pad+ma ku la sa ma yaṃ pad+ma e ku sha dhā ra hūṃ dzaḥ(me/oṃ a mo gha pā sha kro dha ā kur+sha ya pra be sha ya ma hā ba shu (shepa ti ya ma ba ru ṇa ⑥ku be ra brah+ma be zhe sha dhā ra pad+ma ku la sa ma yī (1rtsu hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma sbo ṭa sbo ṭa brnya sarba pad+ma ku la sa ma māṃ 8 shī traṃ hūṃ baṃ/ oṃ ṣi mu kha sa nasku mā 6nyer be sha dha (nyer (nyepad+ma gharnye ā 85de sha ya sarba pad+ma ku la sa ma māṃ (rtesarba mu ṭ+wāṃ 88brnya ya sarba sidhi m+me 4)pra yats+tsha pad+ma ā 8 9be sha aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥsko1/ de nas 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa bshad do/ /de la dang po kho nar (gepad+ma'i slob dpon nyid rdo rje pad+ma dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la ji lta ba bzhin du zhugs te/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du snying po 'dis 5nyalas rnams bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā pad+ma sbo ṭa 8gyes dhi tiṣ+ṭha a/ de nas de bzhin du 84—202

bka' mnos nas dam tshig gi phyag rgyas 0)bdag nyid dbang bskur te/ pad+ma'i dbyibs bslabs ②nas rang gi pad+ma'i ming brjod la pad+ma lcags kyu la sogs pas las rnams bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya de dag nyid kyis ①sems dpa' chen po rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas pad+ma'i slob ma rnams gzhug (gepar bya ste/ de las (snyedang por pad+ma'i slob ma rnams mna'i snying po byin la 'di skad du bsgo (6)bar bya'o/ /deng ni khyod kyi ④snying ga na/ /pad+ma sems dpa' nyid bzhugs te/ /ji ste tshul 'di smras na ni / /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /de nas yang 'di skad du (nyabasgo bar byas te5) / gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa 'di su la yang ma smra shig /khyod kyis mi bde ba ma spangs pas dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ de nas snying po 'dis dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /o badz+ra pad+ma sa ma ya sdokyi / de nas gos dkar po bgos la dar dkar pos gdong g.yogs nas gzhug (1par bya ste/ snying po ni sna 'di yin snye/ o pad+ma sa ma ya (8/ de nas las rnams 7ji lta ba tsobazhin du byas nas pad+ma'i dbyibs lag tu sbyin no/ /oṃ pad+ma hasta badz+ra ༷ dharma ha na pa la ya he ni/she/ des kyang tsho/'di skad du pad+ma'i chos nyid ji lta bu lags zhes dri bar bya'o/ /de la yang 'di skad du brjod par bya'o / /ji ltar pad+mo dmar ripo 'di/ /'dod pa'i nyes pas mi chags ri 1 bzhin/ /thams cad dag par bsgoms na ni/ /de bzhin sdig pas chags mi 'gyur/ /de la chos nyid ni 'di yin no/ /de nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi ( gephyag rgya'i ye shes sa bslab par bya ste/ snying la pad+ma bris nas kyang / /pad+ma bsgoms na snying ga yi/ /pad+ma dpal yang dbang 'gyur na/ /bud med phal la smos ci dgos/ /dpral 84—203

bar sangs rgyas dbyibs bris te/ /rtag tu bsgom ①pa byas na ni/ /bsgom pa des ni myur du yang / /dbang bskur ba yang thob par 'gyur/ /kha yi nang du lce steng du/ /sangs rgyas dbyibs ni rab bsgoms na/ /sgra dbang lha mo bdag nyid kyi②/ /rtag tu kha na ①gnas par 'gyur/ /gtsug tor dbus su pad+ma ni/ /snyoms par zhugs te bzhag nas kyang / /gtsug tor pad+ma bsgoms na duni/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'ang de dbang 'gyur/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no//oṃ pad+ma she yaṃ bhā (snyeg ya ho/ /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka 0pra yats+tsha baṃ/ ⑦pad+ma sa ra sbri bi sho dha ya hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma u dha gro ba shi 9nyaku ru dzaḥ6)/ rtsig pa'am yang yinam mkha' la'ang rung / /pad+ma dam pa bsgoms na ni/ /'di ni sems can thams cad kyang / /dbang du byed pa dam pa'o/ / kha 'am yiyang na phyogs gzhan tsodu/ /pad+ma dam pa bsgoms nas kyang / /gang tshe mthong ba de tshe blangs/ /ci dga' bar ni mi snang 'gyur/ /rtsig pa'am yang na nam mkha' la/ /pad+ma rgya gram bris nas tu ni/ /gang tshe mthong nas blangs pa yi/ /de tshe sna tshogs gzugs de 'gyur / /mkha' 7'am yang na phyogs gzhan du/ /rdo rje pad+ma bsgoms nas kyang / /de blangs skad cig nyid kyis ni/ /pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra dza gad 8ba shi 81 na pad+ma ā tsobe sha ya(/rnya/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma tiṣ+ṭha a sha na ba ku ru baṃ/ oṃ sa mā dhi bi shwa pad+ma tiṣ+ṭha rū paṃ ne dhā ra sha ya bha 17ga ṭ+wāṃ baṃ/ oṃ sa mā dhi mnyabadz+ra padroṣ+ṭha a dhi 6)tiṣ+ṭha shī traṃ hri(nye/dkyil 'khor la sogs thams cad du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bris nas ni/ /de yi mdun du rta mgrin gyi/ /phyag rgya mchog gis 'dren par bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs thams cad du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bri bar bya/ /nges 84—204

pa'i zhags pa phyag rgya yis/ /'gro ba thams cad des dbang byed/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs thams cad du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bri bar bya/ /de yi mdun du pad+ma yi/ /lcags sgrog mchog gi phyag rgya bcings/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs thams cad du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bri de yil/ /mdun du pad+ma dril bu yis/ /thams cad 'bebs pa'i dam pa'o/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no②/ /oṃ pad+mo ā kur+sha ya sarba ma hā sa hūṃ dzaḥphyi/ oṃ a mo gha pā sha gro budha hūm̐ ho hi/ oṃ pad+ma sbo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ghaṇ+ḍa ā tsobe sha ya sarba aḥyi/bdag nyid kyis ni bdag nyid nyid/ /pad+ma zhal bzhi sems dpar yang / /bsgoms te de nas grub nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzugs ma 'gyur/ /de ltar bdag nyid bdag nyid kyis/ /rdo rje chos kyi ting 'dzin gnas/ /pad+ma pad+ma bsgoms na ni/ /zad mi shes pa'i go 'phang 'thob/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gtsug tor dbus/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas gzugs su ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms gyur na/ /tshe dpag med pa'ang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis gting 'dzin gnas/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi ting 'dzin du/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms na (gyini/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mnyam par 'gyur / /de la de dag gi 6)snying po rnams ni 'di yin no/ /pad+ma bi shwa/ dharma kā ya pad+ma/ bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka a ba lo ki te yishwa ra/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab 4)bo/ /de la re zhig dang por ni phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes yin te/ ji ltar ri mo'i tshul du ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing / /pad+ma la gnas sems dpar ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bdag nyid bsgom/ /de nas de dag gi las ni 'di dag yin no/ /sangs rgyas — 84—205

phyag rgya che bcings na3)/ /tshe dpag med dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma bcings na ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dbang gis bcings na ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas de dbang bskur/ /pad+ma pad+ma'i ting 'dzin 'thob/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sna tshogs mchog /sna tshogs gzugs kyis 'dul ba dang / /sangs rgyas rin chen dbang bskur 'gyur/ /pad+ma sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /pad+ma khro bo dbang phyug dpal/ /rdo rje 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /pad+ma 'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog /sangs rgyas dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid/ /rdo rje pad+ma grub mchog sbyin/ /'dod pa'i pad+ma rab 'dod ldan/ /dga' ba yis ni legs pa sbyin/ /khro gnyer gyis ni khro zhir 'gyur / /pad+ma'i nyi ma gzi brjid mchog /pad+ma zla bas mdzes pa che/ /bzhad pas rab bzhad grub pa 'thob/ /grol bas dngos grub mchog 'thob bo/ /pad+ma ral gris longs spyod 'thob/ /mgrin sngon gyis ni 'gugs pa che/ /gos dkar gyis ni dngos grub 'thob/ /pad+ma gar dbang gis 'grub ste/ /mi 'jigs rtag tu 'jigs pa med/ /rab gtum gyis ni ma lus (5)'dul/ /pad+ma khu tshur rab tu sgrub/ /sgeg mo dga' zhing phreng ba (51nor/ /grur blangs gar bde bdug pas tshim/ /me tog mdzes shing me mar (4lta/ /dris ni mchog gi (5)drir yang 'gyur/ /rta mgrin gyis ni yang dag 'gugs/ /gdon mi za bar dbang du byed/ /pad+ma lcags sgrog bcing ba che/ /dril bus kun nas 'bebs byed do/ /de nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes (6)yin te/ rdo rje bsdams 7pa bcings nas ni/ /mthe bo mthe'u chung mnyam par bsgreng (8)/ /phyag rgya 'di ni chos dam tshig /sangs rgyas chos ni rab thob byed/ /rdo rje 84wa 206

bsdams ①pa bcings nas ni/ /mdzub mo gung mo srin lag mnyam/ /sangs rgyas rigs mchog phyag rgya de/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par byed/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcings nas ni/ /gung mo rdo rje rab mnyam pa/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs ②dam pa'i①/ /phyag rgya yin te rdo rje 'grubargya/ /de las gung mo rin chen 'dra / /rdo rje rin chen rab 'grub byed/ /gung mo pad+ma'i tshul du byas/ /pad+ma'i dngos grub thob par byed/ /rdo rje thal mo bsdams nas ni/ /rdo rje'i las ni byed par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rdo rje bcings na ni/ /skad cig gis ni dam tshig 'grub/ /rdo rje bsdams las mdzub mnyam ⑤pas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par byed/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /sems dpa'i phyag rgya khyad par du/ /rdo rje thal mo bsdams nas kyang / /gung mo mnyam par bsdams nas ni / /mthe bo (5)mthe'u chung phye ba ni/ /sna tshogs pad+mar bshad pa yin/ /de las mthe bo phyaganyis bsnol te/ /mdzub (8)gnyis rtse mo sprad la dgugasnyo nye /dbus kyi rdo rje spyi gtsug phud/ /gtsug phud sangs rgyas yin par bshad/ /rdo rje bsdams pa dam byas la/ /mthe bo mnyam ste 7btud nas ni/ /mdzub (nyamo gnyis ni rtse sprad dgug /bkan yi nas ting nge 'dzin du bcug /thal mo pad+mo mnyam sbyar la/ /mdzub (3mo rdo rjer mnyam na muni/ /mthe bo yingos la sbyar ba tso 'di / /nges pa'i dbang phyug phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdam yo)pa bsdams nas ni/ /legs par bkan te bcings nas kyang / /mthe bo /sheganyis ni pad+mar bsgreng (6/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma yin par bshad/ /mthe bo gnyis ni rdo rjer mnyam/ /mdzub khri nomo lcags kyu ral grir ( mebya/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni so sor dbye/ /gung mo srin lag pad+mor bya/ /pad+ma mnyam par rab sbyar la/ / mdzub mos mdzub mo 84—207

gzung nas su/ /'dren par byed pa pad+ma'i mda'/ /6)thal mo mnyam par sbyar nas ②bkan/ /legs pa'i niphyag rgya bcings na ④ni/ /legs so zhes bya sbyin par byed/ /pad+ma'i legs pa yin par grags/ /thal mo mnyam par rab sbyar la / /mdzub ⑤mo rtse mo mnyam ste ⑥dgug /mthe'u chung phye nas mdzod spur ⑦bzhag /pad+ma khro gnyer zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams (kyepa dam byas la/ /sor mo thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /snying gar rab tu brkyang khyab ni/ /pad+ma'i nyi ma yin par bshad/ /thal mo rab tu dam sbyar la/ /mdzub ⑩gnyis rin chen 'dra bar bya/ /dpung pa'i spyi bor rab brgyan (spepa/ /pad+ma rin chen rgyal mtshan rtse'o⑩ / /rdo rje bsdams pa spyi bor bzhag /kha dang bcas par rab brkyang nas//nyid kyi kha nas rgod (3pa dang / /kha ni bcu gcig nyid du 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin pad+mar bcings nas ni/ /mthe bo chaganyis ni so sor 'byedakyi/ /pad+ma sgrol ba'i phyag rgya las/ /mdzub yiganyis pad+ma'i tshul du dgug /pad+ma sgrol ba'i phyag rgya 'di / /dngos grub thams cad grub par byed/ /ral gri'i ()tshul du byas pa 'di/rtel/ /pad+ma'i ral gri'i phyag rgya yin/ /mthe'u chung pad+ma chen por bya/ / mtheb gnyis de bzhin 8 1dbyug ltar bsgreng (ste/ /mdzub 3stemo rtse mo dung chen bya/ /gung mo srin lag 'khor lor ( —stebya/ /rdo rje thal mo snye )dam byas la/ /g.yas pa oṃ du nang du gzhug /g.yon pa'i mdzub mtheb bzlas par (nyabya/ /ser kun chu ⑩skyes kha bye 3 7'dra/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar la/ /g.yon dang g.yas nas de bzhin du/ /'gying bcas gar byed bskor nas ni/ /spyi bor bzhag pa pad+ma can / /rdo rje thal mo dam byas la/ /rtse mo thams cad kha phye ba/ /bskor te pad+ma'i snying gar ni/ /bzhag nas bstan 8nyapar byed pa po/ /rdo rje thal mo dam 84—208

byas la/ /gsang ba'i gnod sbyin tshul du ni/ /thal mo brkyang ste bskums nas ni / /khar bzhag pad+ma'i gnod sbyin ma/ /rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas kyang / /gung mo gnyis ni phyir bkug ste/ /rang gi mthe bo ①rgyab mnan pa/ /pad+ma'i khu tshur zhes kyang bshad/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje thal mo las byung ba / /mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig mchog rnams bcing ba'o/ /rdo rje bsdams ②pa dam byas la/ /mdzub ④mo gnyis ni mnyam sbyar nas/ / bkug nas rtse mo sbyar ba ni/ /༷rta mgrin gyi ni yin par bshad/ /pad+ma'i thal mo mnyam sbyar la/ /mdzub ⑤gnyis mdud par mdud ⑥pa na⑦/ /nges par zhags pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /mtheb mdzub nilcags sgrog 'dra bar bya/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /pad+ma'i thal mo mnyam sbyar la/ /srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis bar du/ /mthe bo ⑨gnyis bcug dam du btsir⑩/ /de nas pad+ma rigs kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ hrīḥgro kṛ hi/ sh+lau shi dhi hi/kṛ ti kṛ 0bi khi miṣ+ṭi kyis/ pad+ma khu tshur gnyis byas la/ /las kyi phyag rgya bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (stechos kyi dam tshig gi rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po las 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i 8cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stotshi// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi gzungs kyi dam tshig 'byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs (9zhes bya ba'i ting nge 5nye'adzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma sa ma ye 6)rtsu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 4)phyag 84—209

na rdo rjes rang gi rigs ①'byung ba'i rig ②pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' ①chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na lis ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pad+ma sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o kurma sa ma ye rtsu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das (5)byang chub sems dpa' (7chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos rang gi rigs kyi dzo phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas (b.rab tu bshad bya ba / /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba la/ /pad+ma'i gsang ba zhes bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus bre/ /de dbus pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mo 'bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /dam tshig mchog rnams snga 7ma bzhin/ /rang gi rig pa rnam 6nyaldan par/ /chos kyi rdo rje la sogs bri/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta dharme shwa ri (9hūṃ / oṃ dharma sa ma 12ye badz+ra pad+ma ni hūm̐/ oṃ bud dha a bhi yi'i ka rat+na sa ma ye hūm̐/oṃ tā rā sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa mu khe 7rgyu/ sna tshogs gzugs mchog dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal minas ni/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma yis/ /bskor ba'i pad+ma bri bar bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya gnyis gnas pa/ /pad+ma'i mtshan ma bri bar bya/ /bde gshegs nyid kyi nyid phyag rgya/ /de la de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin no/ /hrīḥ/ oṃ pad+ma ta thā ga tonya tsho/ oṃ pad+ma 1snyes man+ta bha bre17/ pad+ma badz+ra e ku sho ri tshos ṣa dhā ri tsā hūm̐/ oṃ 84—210

pad+ma ra ti/ o pad+ma dusbyi/ de hu)bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis par yang / /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal ②nas ni/ /gtsug phud chu skyes che gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur bri bar bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag zhu'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /pad+ma'i mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /dam tshig mchog rnams gzhag par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /shrīḥ/ o ṣ+ṭṛ ku ṭī be tā ḍi ④pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ pad+me dzā lel/ oṃ sau me ni pad+me ni yis/ oṃ pad+ma ⑦hā si ni duye ka da po)sha ba dhika tre di ri di ri i ar+bhe/ bar+bhe tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su ma dha nga/nyare i le pra be sha sidhi me pra tsoyats+tsha ju/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum par yang / /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal tsonas kyang / /de yi dbus su pad+ma mdzes//pad+ma'i phyag rgya gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag ④'og go rims 7ji bzhin par/ /pad+ma'i mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma la ni gnas par bri'/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ / bhi dhīḥdhi8/oṃ tā ()re tut+ta 'o)re rtsu/ oṃ dhi ( )rtsu/ oṃ pad+ma tsakra shaṃ kha ( 0hadha ra khri( nye/ nī la kuṇ+ḍa dunasid dha sid dh+ya hūm̐/ o paṇ+ḍa (ster pā se na ( depad+ma saṃ bha be ba dha ba dha hūm̐/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bzhi par ni/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal tsonas kyang / /pad+ma'i dbus su pad+ma ni( —)/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor 'od bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag ( na'og go rims ( nyeji bzhin par/ /pad+ma'i dbus na gnas pa yi/ /pad+ma'i mtshan ma ldan par bri/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /snyizhi ri/ oṃ pad+ma mṛ h+ye (1shwa ri pū dza ya sarba ta thā ga tā ru māṃ so na ta na ta hūm̐/ oṃ ā du be sha ya sa pad+ma ka ba tsa ban dha ra kra ma na hūm̐/ ham/oṃ ma hā pra tsaṇ+ḍi 69pad+ma yak+ṣi ṇi mu bi shwa rū pa dhā ra tī bi sa shwa pa ya sarba duṣ+ṭa khā da khā 84—211

da rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma musbyi a mu/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal ①nas ni/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rnams bri ba/ /pad+ma lcags kyu la sogs rgyal/ /mdor na pad+ma'i mtshan ma can/ /de nas de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ pad+ma ra ti pū dze 8ho/ o pad+ma a bhi ④te ke pū dze ra tidu/ o pad+ma gī te pu dze gi/ oṃ pad+ma mṛ h+ye 9pu dze ho sta/ oṃ dhū nipo pad+ma ni hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma put+pa 0rtsu/ oṃ pad+ma ku la sun da yiri/ dharma ā 7lo ke pū dzā tsoya rtsu/ o pad+ma gan dhe r+ghaṃ/ mchod pa rnams so/ /o pad+ma e tsoku sha ā 8kar+ṣa ya ma hā pad+ma ku la na/ ha ya spyi ba sa ma ye hūṃ dzaḥ'i/ oṃ a mo gha pā sha kro dha sa ma ye pra be sha ya sarba satwa tsos ma yaṃ hūm̐/oṃ pad+ma shī ka le baṃ/ oṃ pad+ma gan dha dhā rmyari shrī s+t+waṃ ā tsobe sha ya/ sa ma yaṃ sha na mu ki a/ de nas phyag rgya'i 6)dkyil 'khor 'dir dgug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas par byas nas pad+ma'i slob ma rnams ji lta ba bzhin btsud de du / 'di skad du khyod kyis gsang ba 'di su la 0yang ma smra shig /khyod sems can dmyal bar lhung nga re/ tshe gcig tu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur 'ata re/ de nas phab nas 'di skad du khyod kyi (2nyamig lam du ci zhig snang zhes dris nas/ des ji skad du smras pa de bzhin du dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /des gal te nam mkha' dudakar bar tsomathong na ni de'i tshe de'i dngos grub dam pa'i ye shes bslab cipar bya'o/ /yang na ser po mthong na ni de nor 'grub 8 pa'i ye shes bslab bo/ /ci ste dmar po mthong na ni rjes su dga' bar kho )'gyur ba'i ye shes bslab bo/ /ci ste nag po mthong na ni mngon spyod kyi ye shes bslab 9 rtebo/ /ji ste sna tshogs mthong na ni dngos grub thams cad kyi ye shes bslab pa go 69bar shes nas ji lta ba (7bzhin du gdong g.yogs pa bkrol ni nas snod ji lta ba bzhin du ye shes bskyed de(gye/ phyag 84—212

rgya'i ye shes bslab ①par bya'o/ /de ltar rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du yang snod ji lta ba bzhin du phyag rgya'i ye shes bslab ②pa ni 'di bzhin du brtag par bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sems dpa' che/ /sna tshogs gzugs su bdag nyid kyis/ /bsgoms na phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dbang gis dam tshig ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas brtan byas te/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms na ①ni/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /pad+ma pad+ma sems dpa' che/ /bdag nyid mnyam par bzhag pas bsgoms/ /bdag nyid kyis ni dam pa yi/ /dngos grub thob pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rang byung gdon ④mi za ba yi/ /dbang phyug las kyi phyag rgya ni//cho ga bzhin bsgrubs myur bar yang / /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ pad+ma satwa haṃ sid dh+ya ()ho/oṃ bud dha a bhi ṣe ka kro dho 6)lha/ sid rgya ho/ oṃ dharma sa mā snyi ra haṃ sid dha ༷ho/oṃ a mo ghi shwa ro haṃ/ sid rgya mā(8)/ de nas nor sgrub pa'i ye shes ni 'di yin te / kha yi nang du dbyig bcug 5)ste/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /bdag nyid nyid kyis bsgoms na ni/ /gcig tu gyur las stong du 'gyur/ /gser srang brgyad 0cha blangs nas ni/ /dam tshig mchog ni rab brtan par/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms na (nyuni/ /gcig tu gyur las stong du 'gyur/ /mu tig 'brum dhibu khar bcug la/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug tu/ /bdag nyid kyis ni ()bsgoms na ni/ /gcig tu gyur las stong du 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya lag gnyis kyis/ /rin chen thams cad blangs na ni/ /bdag nyid 84—213

kyis ni bsgoms (pen yang / /gcig tu gyur (gyelas stong du 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni (gyi'adi rnams yin no/ /oṃ pad+ma ma hā rat+na pra dha t+t+waṃ ⑤dza/ oṃ pad+ma su baṇ+ḍi pra dha hūm̐ dza/ o pad+ma mu ku ṭa ⑤pu dha hūm̐ dza/ o pad+ma sarba rat+na pra dha hūm̐ dza/ de nas rjes su dga' ba'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ sna tshogs dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms na ni/ /pad+ma blangs te mdun gnas pa/ /gang yin des ni de mgur (ponyebyed/ /dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya yis / /pad+mo dmar por dam bzung ste/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsgoms na ni/ /bud med thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid nyid kyis bsgoms nas kyang / /pad+ma blangs te ji lta ba/ /rdo rje lta bas de ltar bltas/ /'jig rten thams cad des mgur 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i tshul gyis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du pad+ma gzung / /lag pa gnyis kyis bskor (7)na ni/ /bud med thams cad des 987mgur 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ bi dzi)she shwa ra ma hā pad+ma ho/ oṃ pad+ma sa ma ya pad+ma ho/ oṃ yo ga pad+mo ho/ oṃ pad+ma kurma ho / sna tshogs ye shes dbang phyug che/ /bdag nyid mdun du pad+ma gtsang / /phyag rgya pad+ma de nyid kyis/ /de yi 'chi ba skad cig go/ /pad+ma bzung yinas brtan bya ba/ /cho ga legs pa ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig dam pa de nyid kyis/ /nan tan kho nar gzhig 11par byanya / /gang gis ming smos 'jig pa ni/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya sbyar nas su/ /ji ltar de ltar pad+ma thogs/ /las de nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang gi nyanagazhig par khros na ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya sbyar nas su/ /bskor zhing brdab par byas na 71ni/ /de yi 'tsho 7ba rdol bar 'gyur / / de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /7o ma hā pad+ma ts+tsha da mā ra 84—214

ya ho phaṭa/ o sa ma ya pad+ma sbo ṭa nā sha ya ra ta 6)phaṭa/ o dharma (snyepad+ma ts+tsha da bi nā sha ya pra ti ya phaṭa/ o kurma pad+ma sbo ṭa ya dzī ( bi ta ma su kṛ lita phaṭa/ de nas chos kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i (sheye shes ni 'di yin no/ / pad+ma la ni bud med (6)bsam/ /de steng bdag nyid rdo rjer bsgyur/ /pad+ma pad mchog rtse byed cing / /mnyam par bzhag na dngos grub 'thob/ / pad+ma la ni bud med (7)bsam / /de steng bdag nyid sangs rgyas bsgyur/ /rtse zhing dbu rgyan (8)sangs rgyas ni/ /bsgoms na des ni des 'grub bo/ / pad+ma la ni bud med 59)bsam/ /de steng pad+mar bdag bsgyur te/ /rtse zhing pad+ma pad+ma mchog /dag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ / pad+ma la ni bud med 4 7bsam/ /de steng sna tshogs bdag bsgyur te/ /rtse zhing sna tshogs pad+ma mchog /sna tshogs dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /o badz+ra pad+ma saṃ yo ga sā dha ya hriḥ(nya/ oṃ bud dha ma ku ṭa saṃ yo ga sā dha ya shrīḥhu / oṃ pad+ma pad+ma saṃ yo ga sā dha ya 45)/ oṃ bi shwa pad+ma saṃ yo ga sā dha ya snying/ de nas pad+ma rigs kyi gsang ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ji lta ba bzhin du bslab bo/ /sor mo rtse sprad pad+mar bya / /rdo rje khro bo'i mdzub 'oganyis sprad/ /rtse gnyis nor bu'i pad+ma ltar/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'ang de bzhin te/ /rdo rje tshabacing ba bsdams nas kyang / /gung mo gnyis ni myu gur bsgreng 1 / /mdzub /shemo srin lag gnyis bkug pa'i/ /phyag rgya shākya thub pa'i brtan49/ /chos kyi rdo rje snying gar gzhag /bsgyur te dpral ribar bzhag pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin tshul pang du gzhag /bsgyur nas spyi bor gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang bcings la/ /mchod rten pad+ma'i tshul du ni/ /gung mo lhaganyis ni bcings 2gyur na/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma yin par 84—215

bshad / /de las mthe bo rdo rje dang / /mdzub gnyis ral gri lcags kyur bya/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin pa de①/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /de las mthe bo ②bsnol nas kyang / /mdzub ①mos mdzub mo rab gzung dul/ /drangs na rab dga' yin par bshad/ /legs so zhes pa'ang de bzhin te/ /rdo rje bsdams ⑧pa dam byas las/ /mthe bo duganyis bsnyams ⑦bcug nas kyang / /mdzub ⑧gnyis rtse bkug rtse mo ni/ /dpral 6)bzhag gung mo pad+mar bya/ /de nyid las ni snying gar yang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ston pa dang / /de nyid las ni rgyal mtshan bcing ⑩/ /ltag par rab tu brkyang bar bya/ /rdo rje bsdams tunyepa dam byas la/ /mdzub tsoganyis rtse mo pad+mar dgug /de bzhin pad+ma ral gri ste/ /mdzub 8mo pad+mar byas pas sbyar/ /rdo rje bsdams ④pa dam byas la/ /mthe bo tsogayon pa nang du gzhugatso /dung ste mthe bo tho bar bsgreng ⑩/ /sor mo bskum brkyang pad (nyamathe'u chung / /de las tu)thams cad bcum ( tshonas kyang / /mthe'u chung pad+ma lta bur bya/ /mthe bo phyagayas la sbyar ba yi / /mdzub 8)mor nor bu bgrang bar bya/ /rdo rje bsdams dupa dam byas la/ /mthe'u chung pad+ma lta bur bya/ /mdzub 9 7mo bsgreng ⑤ste gar byed pa/ /pad+ma spyan gyi tsoyin par bshad/ /rdo rje bsdams 9 rtepa dam yibyas la/ /mthe'u chung pad+ma lta bur bya / /dam du mdzub 7mo gnyis bkug ste/ /mthe bo sogeganyis ni go char bya/ /de las mtheb gnyis mche bar bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du gzhug par bya/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig mchog ni bla med de/ /rdo rje nang du bsdams nas kyang / /mdzub 8nyaganyis pad+ma 'dra byas la/ /mthe bo ru phan tshun bsnol ba ni/ /gsang ba'i sna tshogs dbang du bshad/ /de bzhin rdo rje 84—216

bsdams pa las/ /mthe'u chung gung mo mnyam bsgreng ①la/ /mtheb mos rdo rje sbyar ba ni/ /gtsug phud dbus na de bzhin gshegs/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mthe bo pad+ma ②'drar byas la/ /kha nas dbyung ltar byas nas kyang / /pang ①du ting nge 'dzin ltar gzhag /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams dupa lasal/ /sor mo kun gyi ngos rnams ni/ /mnyam par dam du bsdams nas kyang // mdzub gnyis durdo rjer mnyam pa'o/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mdzub ⑥gnyis pad+ma 'drar byas la/ /mthe bo duganyis kyang bsnol nas ni/ /gung mo gnyis ni rtse sbyar bkug /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las mtheb ⑧gnyis rdo rjer rab sbyar la/ /mdzub khyamo ral gri lcags gyur ⑩bya/ /mthe'u chung pad+ma 'drar ⑩byas la/ /de bzhin du ni bsgyur nas kyang / /mdzub 8mo g.yon pa bsgreng tsob la/ /mdzub tsomo mthe bo 8rtse sbyar ba/ /dam du bzung ste dgug ltar bya/ /de la mdzub tsomo gnyis bkug la/ /mthe bo chaganyis kyis mnan 8pa ni / /pad+ma dgyes pa bdag nyid che/ /legs so zhes bya sbyin byed kyi/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /sor mo kun gyi ngos sbyar la/ /mthe bo yiganyis kyis mnan dunas ni/ /mdzub (nyamo mnyam par sbyar ba'o/ /de nyid snying gar nyi mar bya/ /spyi bor pad+ma rgyal mtshan bya/ /phab ste kha yi 'gram bzhag pa/ /pad+ma cher dgod dgod pa yin/ /rdo rje nang du bsdams sogebyas la/ /chos kyi rdo rje tshul gyis ni/ /mthe'u chung mthe bo (nyerab bsnyams ⑥pa/ /'di ni sgrol ma'i dam tshig yin/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mdzub (nyegung pad+ma ral grir bya/ /de bzhin nang du 'khor lor bya/ /zlos pa sbyin pa de bzhin no/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mtheb mdzub ( )sprad de gnyis su bya/ /de nas snying gar ⑦84—217

sbyar ba ni/ /gsang ba'i bsrung 1)ba yin par bshad/ /de bzhin rdo rje bsdams pa las/ /mthe'u chung pad+ma 'drar byas la/ /mdzub ②gnyis shin du bkug nas kyang / /mtheb gnyis phyir bskyed ( dmache ba can/ /de las khu tshur tshul gyis ni/ /mtheb gnyis ngos kyis btsir ba yi/ /pad+ma gsang ba'i khu tshur che/ /dam tshig mchog tu rab brtag ri pa'o/ /pad+ma lā gye la sogs pa/ /de dag gzhan rnams kun gyi ni/ /rdo rje nang du bsdams byas la/ /de 'dra bar ni bcing bar bya /de nas pad+ma gsang ba'i chos kyi phyag rgya (5)'di yin te/ hāḥgāḥmāḥhāḥ/ shāḥsāḥdhaḥhāḥ / gāḥdhaḥkrāḥbāḥ/ dāḥrāḥhāḥsāḥ(6)/ las kyi phyag rgya mdor bsdu na khu tshur gnyis su bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ⑦dam tshig rtog 8pa'i rgyal po chen po las chos gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto9 // //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ye shes kyi tshadam tshig 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs 9/7pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 12'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa 1nya'adi gsungs so / /o dharma sa mā dhi dzñā na ta thā ga ta hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' yichen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rigs kyi chos 'byung ba'i rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma tsū/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ rat+na dharma hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 7spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dharma dharma rtsu/ de nas byang chub 84wa 218

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o kurma dharma hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos nyid kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra bar ni/ /chos kyi ye shes zhes brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus bre/ /de yi dbus su bri ba ni/ /ye shes rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /sems dpa' che rnams cho ga bzhin/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs bri/ /de la de dag gi snying po 'di 6)rnams so/ /oṃ dzñā na bud+dha hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na bi shwe shwa re hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na bud+dha mu ku ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na dharme dzubasha re hūm̐/ o dzñā na a mo ghi shwa re rgyuji ste/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma bud+dha (4)rtsu/ o dzñā na pad+ma badz+ra dhā (5)ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma mā ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma duṣ+ṭi (6)rtsu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma ṣ+ṭṛ (7)ku ṭī 3)rtsu/ o dzñā na pad+ma srur+ya 5)rgyu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma tsan+d+ra yis/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma hā nyu1sa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma tā rā rtsu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma ku mā ra ()rtsu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma nā rā ya (nyertsu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma hā sa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma mṛ h+ye (steshā ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma rak+ṣa sartsu/ o dzñā na pad+ma yak+ṣa hūm̐/ o dzñā na pad+ma muṣ+ṭi hūm̐/ o dzñā na pad+ma lā phye 9rtsu/ o dzñā na pad+ma mā le nyu hūm̐/ o dzñā na pad+ma gī h+ye 4shes/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma n-i h+ye /zhes/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma dhū ( nope hūm̐/ o dzñā na pad+ma pulpe hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma dī pe (27rgyu/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma gan dhe ges/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma e ku sha hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma a mo gha pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma sbo ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma ā be so sha hūm̐/ de nas chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir dgug 2 pa la sogs 84—219

pa'i 0)cho ga rgyas par byas nas ji lta ba bzhin du bcug nas 'di skad du khyod kyis gzhan su la yang ma brjod cig /khyod ②sems can dmyal bar lhung nas sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re/ de nas de'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ 'jig rten dbang phyug snyoms zhugs la/ /snying gar pad+ma bsgoms nas kyang / /pad+ma'i ting (7'dzin thob na ni/ /de ma thag tu myur bar lding / /'jig rten dbang por snyoms zhugs la/ /dpral bar pad+ma bsgoms ④byas te/ /goms nas shin du brtan 5༄gyur na/ /de ma thag tu mkha' la lding (6)/ /'jig rten dbang gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /lce la pad+ma bsgoms nas kyang / /grub par gyur na myur bar ⑦yang —/ /nam mkha' la ni de 'gro'o/ /'jig rten dbang gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /gtsug tu pad+ma bsgoms nas kyang / /grub par gyur na myur du ni/ /skad cig gis ni steng du lding / /de dag gi snying po ni (8)'di rnams so/ / oṃ pad+ma dzñā na skṛ da ya ā be sha3) /oṃ pad+ma dzñā na ⑩a (7gi ṣe ka ā tsobe sha /oṃ pad+ma dzñā na bi ⑫byot+ta ma ā 'be sha /oṃ pad+ma dzñā na u: dhiṣa ā 9be sha /nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs shig bsgoms nas kyang / /cho ga 'di ni 'grub 7'gyur na/ /skad cig gis ni mi snang 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs shig bsgoms (nyanas kyang / /de yi steng du bdag 'dug par/ /bsgoms par 67gyur na mi snang 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs 6 )shig bsgoms byas la/ /gang tshe mthong ba de tshe blangs/ /mi snang bar ni myur du 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs ni bsgoms byas la/ /mthong ba'i pad+ma de zos na/ /de ma thag tu mi snang 'gyur/ de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ oṃ 84—220

pad+ma ā kur+sha6)/ oṃ pad+ma ra tha/ oṃ pad+ma dzñā na gra hā (snyen/ oṃ pad+ma ra sa ya na hūm̐ phaṭa / phyag rgya che bcings pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dbyibs rnams sna tshogs pa'i/ /dbyibs de lag pas bzung na nini/ /gzugs rnams thams cad 'chang bar 'gyur / /pad+ma'i kha dog dbyibs rnams ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbyibs bris la / /de nyid bsgoms ④pa byas na ni/ /gzugs phyimang 'chang bar de 'gyur ro//nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /pad+ma'i kha dog dbyibs rnams ni/ /sna tshogs dbyibs su bsgoms na yang / /sgra yi gzugs su de 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i kha dog dbyibs rnams ni/ /sna tshogs dbyibs su byas nas kyang ⑥/ /de la zhon nas mkha' 'gro zhing / /ci dga'i ⑦gzugs su nges par 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ pad+ma dha ri nibi shwa ༷r+sha pa pra brta ya ā be ⑩sha /oṃ bi shwa pad+ma pra brta ya rmā0/ o sa mā dhi bi shwa pad+ma ā be yonyesha /oṃ bi shwa pad+ma ma no'i tunyepa ā kā sha bi shwa rū paṃ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha yimāli/ gang yang rung ba'i phyag rgya che/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis legs bcings la/ /pad+ma blangs te rab byin na/ /gdon mi za bar dbang du 'gyur/ /gang yang rung ba'i dam tshig gi/ /phyag rgya zhes bya bcings na ni/ /des ⑩ni pad+ma blangs nas kyang / /byin par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin skyes dge ba yi/ /phyag rgya gang yang rung bcings la/ /ye shes pad+ma gang byin pa/ /de ni de yis myur bar tu)'gyur/ /gang yang rung ba'i dam tshig ldan/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /pad+ma byin pa gang yin pa/ /de ma thag tu de dbang 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ma hā dzñā na pad+ma ho/ oṃ sa ma ya pad+ma ho/ oṃ dzñā na pad+ma ho/ oṃ kurma pad+ma ho/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya chen 84—221

po'i ye shes bslab hu)bo/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor tshul du ni/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig mchog ni bsgrub bya ste / /chos kyi dkyil 'khor tshul du ni/ /pad+ma'i pad+ma gzhag par bya/ /chos kyi khu tshur brtan byas la/ /las kyi phyag rgya gnyis su bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig rtog 9mipa'i rgyal po chen po las ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto(gu// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi las kyi (gedam tshig 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kurma kṛ 95)rgyu/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rigs kyi las 'byung ba rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o hūm̐ dhi/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ rat+na kurma sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje spyan (5)gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pad+ma kurmi (pe// de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa gu'adi gsungs so/ /oṃ bi shwa narme kyi)rtsu/de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos nyid kyi las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di bshad do/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba ni/ /pad+ma'i las zhes bya ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus 1 rmebre/ /sangs rgyas phyogs kun pad+ma yi/ /mtshan ma 'dzin par thams cad 84—222
