pa thams cad bshags na ni/ /mtshams med lnga las 'byang bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang phyug ting 'dzin du/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag bsgoms la/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags na ni/ /sdig pa kun yang rab tu 'joms/ /mdor na gang yang rung ba yi/ /las kyi phyag rgya legs bcings la las rnams thams cad bshags na ni/ /las rnams kun las rnam par 'dag /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /o sarba pā paṃ saṃ ①she dha na ma hā pad+ma / oṃ sarba ā nan+ta t+ya sho budha na sa ma ya pad+ma/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ mā ṇa ①sha ṇa dharma pad+ma/ oṃ sarba pad+ma ā lib ra ṇa (9bi sho dha ka kurma pad+ma/ de nas sgrib pa thams cad yongs su zad par 'gyur ba'i ye shes skyobaslab bo/ /'jig rten dbang gi phyag rgya cher/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag bsgoms gabyas la/ /shud rgya shud rgya zhes brjod na/ /las rnams kun las dag par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi dam tshig bcings na ni/ /bud rgya bud d+ku zhes brjod na/ /las rnams kun las dag par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang por snyoms zhugs la/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar bsgoms nas ni/ /dhi dhi dhi dhi zhes brjod na / /las rnams kun las dag par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang po'i ②ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas kyang / /tī tī tī tī zhes brjod na/ /las rnams kun las dag par 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so / /oṃ pā paṃ lta k+ṣa ya pad+ma/ oṃ ā 7ba ra ṇa (hak+ṣa ya pad+ma/ o kurma k+ṣa ya pad+ma/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i ye shes yi bslab bo/ /'jig rten dbang gi phyag rgya cher/ /rab tu mnyam par gzhag bcings la/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes brjod na/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu byed/ /'jig rten 84—224

dbang po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas kyang / / bhu bhu bhu bhu ①zhes brjod na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad des ②mchod 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang pos snyoms zhugs la/ /chos kyi pad+ma bsgoms nas kyang / /te he he he zhes brjod na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad des mchod 'gyur/ /pad+ma'i las kyi phyag rgya ni/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag bcings la/ /dhe dhe dhe dhe zhes brjod na / /sangs rgyas thams cad des mchod 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ kā nir pad+ma/ oṃ bhū ④tā ra pad+ma/ oṃ te kā phyir pad+ma/ oṃ dhe kā ra pad+ma/ oṃ ni ba ra ṇa k+ṣa ya pad+mayi/ de nas dngos grub kyi ye shes ⑦bslab bo/ /'jig rten dbang po phyag rgya cher/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bcings nas nidu/ / trī trī trī trī 6)zhes brjod na/ /'jig rten dbang por grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig ces bya bcings nas kyang / /shrī shrī shrī shrī zhes brjod na/ /dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur / /'jig rten dbang po'i mnyam gzhag par/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgoms nas kyang / /dhig dhig dhig dhig zhes brjod na/ /pad+ma khro bor 'grub par 'gyur/ /pad+ma chen po dge ba yi/ /las kyi phyag rgya tshubacings nas kyang / /smi smi smi smi/ zhes brjod na/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ / de la 47de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ hrīḥsidharmu/ oṃ shrī sidh+ya/nye/ oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ ka chasid rgya/ oṃ si sid rgya'/ de nas las gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ 'jig rten dbang po tsosnyoms zhugs la/ /bud med kun dang rtse byed cing / /a tu ho su kha tunyezhes brjod na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad des mchod 'gyur / /'jig rten dbang por snyoms zhugs la/ /bud med kun dang rtse byed 84—225

cing / /pri ya pri 6)ya zhes brjod na/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dgyes so/ /'jig rten dbang por snyoms zhugs la/ /bud med kun dang rtse byed cing / /a ho ra ti zhes brjod na/ /de ni rtag tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang por snyoms zhugs la/ /bud med kun dang rtse byed cing / /su kha su kha zhes brjod na/ /de yi bde ba nyams mi 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dza pra brta na pad+ma/ o t+pā ②ti kā ③ra pad+ma/oṃ ra ti pra k+ṣ-i brta na pad+ma/ o ma hā su kha pad+ma dṛ nye (ge / de nas las kyi phyag rgya ji 6lta ba bzhin du bslab par bya ste/ de nas pad+ma thal sbyar te/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rdo rje dgongs/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni/ /gnas rnams kun du gzhag par bya/ /de nas pad+ma rigs kyi chos kyi phyag rgya ni dra ⑦zhes bya ba brjod par bya/ las kyi phyag rgya gnyis byas la/ /98)las kyi phyag rgya des bsgrub bo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi (9)dam tshig rtog 7pa'i rgyal po chen po las las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto17// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs 12pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge yi 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas phyag rgya'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+re mi/dharma pad+ma hūm̐/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rnyi/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭi skihūm̐ / de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje spyan gyis lngarang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ dharma pad+ma dhi/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sna tshogs 84—226

kyis rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /o sarba mu khe hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos phyag rgya bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya bzhi mchog dkyil 'khor te6)/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba dang / /dkyil 'khor chen por 'dra bar bya/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni gzhag par bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje pad+ma la sogs bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'dir dgug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas par byas nas/ ji lta ba bzhin du bcug ste/ 'di skad du 'di khyod kyis su la yang ma brjod cig /khyod rtag tu nasdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba dang /mi bde ba ma spangs pas dus byas nas (kyesems can dmyal bar lhung nga re zhes bsgo zhig /de nas de'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ lag pas pad+ma bzung nas kyang / /bsgrims (gte legs par bsdam (5)par bya/ /dri de sangs rgyas rnams mchod na/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /mnyam par bzhag pas (5)gtsug phud (7)dbus/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rab bzhag la/ /'gro zhing rdo rje 'gying bstan na/ /'jig rten thams cad dbang du byed/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po'i gzugs / /ting nge 'dzin 'dug ji lta bzhin/ /yid kyis su ni de bsad do/ /gang du phog pa (kyede rgyas pa'i/ /sa sogs pa yi las byed do/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po'i gzugs/ /pad+ma rgya gram 5)nyid du ni/ /byas te lag pas bzung nas kyang / /bskor nas dbab la sogs de byed/ /de nas de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so / / o badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā sha pa ri pū ra ṇa ma hā rat+na hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ tra/tsha o gan dha sna pu dzā 12gri nyu sā dha chosaya hrīḥ/ oṃ pad+ma mu maku ṭa ta thā 84—227

ga ta ①ba shaṃ ②ku ru sar+pā na lo ke shwa ra a rnyi ṣe ka sa ma ya ②sto/ oṃ pad+ma pad+ma mā ra ya sarba dra dur+ya'i ka na sa mā phyadhi dzñā na lhakaX /o bi shwa pad+ma sarba kurma kā ro bhā ba la li lu la la li hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas phyag rgya gsang ba'i ye shes ⑦bslab bo/ /chags nas ⑧dgos pa thams cad ni/ /bsgrub par bya ste dam tshig 'di/ /bsgrub par dka' ba'i phyag rgya yang / /rnal 'byor gyis ni myur du 'grub/ /de la 'di'i dam tshig gi snying po ni 'di ⑨yin no/ /oṃ sā dha ⑩ya pad+ma rā ga sa ma ya a / de nas phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po thams cad bslab par bya'o / /phyag rgya bzhi'i 'oskyedakyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stodhi// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba 'dza gaspyi nā ④ya ma hā satwa a/ ā 8gats+tsha shī s+t+waṃ bi shwa rū tsopaṃ san dhā rā ⑩ya ma me tsa sarba sid+dhā ()ya pra yats+tsha ⑥hrīḥ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 8rtespyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du pad+ma yang / /de bzhin du ni bri bar bya / /der ni 'dab ma kun khyab pa'i/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni bri bar bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'dir cho ga rgyas pa ji lta ba bzhin du btsud nas/ de bzhin du bsgo ste 21'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba'i ye shes so bslab bo/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bris nas kyang / /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms na ni/ /sna tshogs 'chang dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'gro ba 84—228

'dul ba'i gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes ①bslab bo/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi ting 'dzin du/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgoms nas kyang / /dbang po gnyis ni sbyar bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de ni de grub bo/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa phyag rgya bcing ba rnams bslab par bya'o/ /dngos grub rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin du ras la sogs pa la yang bya'o phyag rgya gzhan rnams kyang phyag rgya gcig pa'i (gyidakyil 'khor gyi ②tshul du phyag rgya la sogs pa yang ④'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po la legs so zhes bya ba byin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi (migasang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa / /rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs bshad pa/ / legs so ⑥rdo rje sems dpa' khyodag/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /nirdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig las rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po dum bu gsum pa 6)rdzogs sgo7// //bam po bdun pa/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba'i rin po che rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la ming brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dis (1gsol ba btab bo/ /nam mkha'i snying po sems can don/ /sems dpa' chen po gzi chen po/ /rin chen che ba'i rin chen mchog /rdo rje rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dbang bskur sbyin pa rin chen 84—229

khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen phung po rin chen 'byung 0ci/ /nor bu rdo rje nor yon tan②/ /rin chen 'byung ba sku rab 'bar/ /rin chen sku ste khyod phyag 'tshal / /che nyid shing ste rin chen dbang / /re ba thams cad skong srimadzad pa/ /bsam pa thams cad legs par mnyes/ /rin chen phung po khyod phyag 'tshal/ / 'od mchog khyab pa'i libadag nyid kun/ /mchog rab po)sbyin zhing mchog che ba/ /phun sum thams cad 'byor pa'o/ /rdo rje snying po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ming 4)brgya rtsa brgyad zhi ba 'di/ /su yang rung bas ⑦'chang byed na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ba/ /skad cig tu ni sdig med 'thob/ /rin chen khyod la gsol ba ni/ /nor 'dus pa ni bshad par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang gi mchog /nges pa'i rigs ni bskyed par mdzod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i lasnying pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' 'di thos nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang gi dam tshig ces bya ba rang gi snying po 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nor bu'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā (9༄sha pa ri pū ra ṇa ⑩ma hā rat+na hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rigs 'byung ba'i rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ traX ri/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so / /oṃ ma ṇi hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rigs 'byung ba'i rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pad+ma hriḥ12/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di 84—231

gsungs so/ /oṃ bi shwa stirat+na hūṃ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang gi rin po che zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje nor bu rin po che lta bu 'od zer rnams byung nas de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang gis dbang chabaskur nas yang gcig tu gyur te bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po ①nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs kur zhugs so/ /de nas nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid kun nas 'od zer 'bar ba'i snying po rdo rje dang / nor bu dang /rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbang bskur (gel sogs pa'i ⑤bkod pa dang / rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku rdo rje'i nor bu'i rin po che'i phyag rgya'i stimatshan ma phyag na bsnams pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i sku rnams su gyur te byung nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rin po che chen po'i char 'bab pa la sogs pa nor bskyang ba rmo rnams kyis sems can rnams (sumagu bar byas nas yang slar byon nas/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyogs thams cad du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o (9)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rin chen thams cad bsdus pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen rigs nyid du/ /'gro ba'i don du 'di gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 7chen po nam mkha'i snying pos rang gi rigs bskyed nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsam pa 84—232

thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di phul te don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba la/ /thams cad grub pa zhes bshad pa/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo ①bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni brgyan ②pa ste//srad bu bzhi dang ldan pa la/ /dar dang phreng ba lda ldis brgyan①/ /dkyil 'khor chen po grwa ༷rnams dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor srad bus bre/ /de yi nang du rdo rje yi/ /rin chen las byung gnas bya zhing / /ka ba brgyad (7kyi tshul du ni/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'od 'bar ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor lngar ni brgyan 0gyur par/ /der ni srad bu bre ⑦bar bya/ /rang gi phyag rgyas bskor (kyeb yi/ /der ni sangs rgyas gzhag par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ budha rat+na rgyu/oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na dzi) e ku ru yirgyu/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ⑩pad+ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na par+ṣa 8rgyu/ re ba kun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal (nyenas kyang / /rdo rje snying po der gnas shing ④/ /rin chen mchog ni sbyin par bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag tso'og go rims ⑩ji bzhin du/ /rin chen phyag rgyar ldan pa yi/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams bri'o/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ sarba arba sidhi ()pra da hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi tsin+dha (nyaha na ā kā spre)sha gar+bha ( habha ga bān sid rgya sid dh+ya hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na khri)e ( muku sha ā dukar+ṣa ya sarba aṅgā na ( stes ( gem ya shī r+ghaṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa ma nu sma ra hūm̐ / oṃ ti rā ga ba shi 9 lhaku ru sarba nak+ṣa sha gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ( meduji hūm̐/ rin chen phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal ( nyanas ni/ /rin chen 84—233

phreng ba 'dzin pa'i mchog /nges pa'i dbus su legs par bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag 0)'og go rims ②ji bzhin par/ /nor bu'i mtshan rnams lag thogs shu pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams bri'o/ /de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /o rat+na tiṣ+ṭha lita/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe 75ka rat+na mā le tsho rtsu/ o rat+na ma ṇi subye 6)rtsu/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ma ṇi dh+wa ⑤dza sar+pā shā 6)pa ri pū ra ā kā sha gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ rat+nas yihā sa hā sa hūm̐/ rin chen pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal (hanas ni/ /rin chen pad+ma 'dzin khyab pa/ /de dbus gnas par bri bar bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag tso'og go rims 3)ji bzhin par/ /nor bu mtshan ma 'chang ba yi/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams bri'o/ / de layide dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na pad+ma hūm̐/ oṃ he ga sa mā dhi dzñā na 8gar+bha rtsu/ oṃ rat+na ko yig gra hūṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi tsakra pra bablo lho ya hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ba shī 68rgyu/ rin chen char 'bebs dkyil 'khor du / /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nyitshenas ni/ /rin chen char ni rab 'bebs pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po der yang bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /mdor na tsho lag na phyag rgya yang / /rin chen mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /sems dpa' che 2lharnams cho ga bzhin/ / de la gi de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na bṛṣ+ṭi bar+ṣa 2ya sarba brta sam+bha dha zhi bha ga ( gubān po 9ma ṇi hasta tsho 7rtsu/ oṃ ma ṇi pū dza sa ma ya hūṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi ban dha ka ba tsa hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rdas ka rā 8)la ma hā yak+ṣa ha ra ha ra saṅgāṅgān ti sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi mnyarat+na ban dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal tsho 2nas ni/ /grwa yi phyogs ni nathams cad du/ /ltag 8 )'og go rims 5ji bzhin par/ /rin chen lā mye ne la sogs bri/ /de la de dag gi 84—234

snying po ni 6)'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na ra ti tsū/ oṃ rat+na gimā le ①rgyu/ oṃ rat+na gī ti ④rgyu/ o rat+na mṛ h+ye ⑤rgyu/ phyi yi dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal phyinas ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor grwa rnams su/ /bdug pa'i mchod pa la sogs bri/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na dhū 〈pe rasne/oṃ pulpe ma ṇi/ o rat+na ā (nyalo ke/ oṃ ma ṇi gan dhe/ sgo rnams bzhi yi dbus su ni/ /sgo ba rnams ni gzhag par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so / /oṃ sarba rat+na kyi)ā kur+sha a 7ru ṇa (nyam hā satwa bha ga bān two ā kā sha gar+bha tso dā ya ā mar+sha ya shī s+t+waṃ ho 4)dza(ste/ o sarba rat+na pra be sha ya/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya sa ma ya ma yihā ma ṇi lirā dzā ku lo rat+na pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi ban dha hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ā 0be sha 4)a/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir nor bu rin po che'i slob dpon nyid ji lta ba bzhin zhugs te cho ga rgyas pa bdag nyid kyis byas la/de nas rin po ches byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa /shegang ba'i chus (kyenor bu'i slob ma dbang bskur tezhu bye/ rdo rje nor bu'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ( nyabacings la ( g+nesnying po 'di brjod do/ /oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi rat+na 5 shes ma ya baṃ/ de nas kha dog ji lta bu rnyed pa'i ( stebla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te de dang 'dra bas mig g.yogs la snying po 'di brjod du bcug ste 5 nyagazhug par bya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ ( nyam ṇi rā dza zhunaku lo/de nas da ( sheltar bcug nas 'di skad du khyod kyis 'di su la yang ma brjod cig( smu/khyod tshe rabs thams cad nu )dbul por gyur ta re/ sdug bsngal las mi thar bar gyur ta re/ sems can dmyal bar yun ring por gnas par gyur ta re zhes bsgo la dam tshig gnyis su bya'o/ /theg pa chen po mngon par 'dus pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bsam sa17pa dang gter chen po gang na yod/ ji ltar 84wa 235

thob par 'gyur zhes rdo rje'i tshig gis dri bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos thams cad smrar 465 cig ces smras ma thag tu gdong g.yogs pa bkrol ①te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang gi dam tshig kyang bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la thug gi bar du dkyil 'khor chen po bstan par bya'o/ /de nas ci 'byor pas mchod pa byas nas dgos ②pa thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje snying po'i phyag rgya che/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bcings / /gter brkos nas ni gang dag na/ /gter yod pa ni de mthong 'gyur/ /dam tshig gi ④ni mchog bcings la/ /gang na gter rnams yod gyur pa/ /der ni phyag rgya btsir na ni/ /de tshe bdag nyid 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying po'i ting 'dzin du/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag bsgoms na ni/ /gang na gter rnams yod pa yang / /yid kyis shes pa nyid du 'gyur(nya//rdo rje'i snying po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gang du phyag rgya babs gyur na/ /de na gter yod shes par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ma hā ma ṇi rat+na ā bi sha hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi piṇ+ḍa (6)pa ri sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na 97sa mā dhi byu (8nyi/ oṃ rat+na ā bi 99)sha dar+sha ya hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen por bsgoms na ni/ /gang du lus ni khor gyur pa/ /de na dzirin chen gter yod par/ /dam tshig nyid kyis shes par bya/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas kyang / /gang du babs nas gnyis gyur pa/ /de ni 11rin chen chen po yi/ /gter yod par ni shes par bya/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gang la babs pa bdag nyid kyis/ /rin chen chen po bdag nyid kyis/ /gter ni 84—236

gang na yod par smra/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas kyang / /gang tshe lag gnyis phan tshun du/ /babs nas dam tshig bcings ①gyur pa/ / de ni chagater ni yod par bshad/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ma hā rat+na kā ya dar+sha ya rat+na/ oṃ ā kā sha gar+bha ma ṇi rat+na/ oṃ sbo ṭa spro ṭa ya tra ni nidhi/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na litsā na swa yaṃ byu ⑤nyi/ oṃ pu na sa ma ya ban dha dar+sha ya swā hā/ phyag rgya chen po bsgoms nas ni/ /de bzhin gang du dogs 0gyur pa/ /de ni 0rin chen 'byung ba yi/ /gter yod ye shes shes par bya/ /gang du dogs duyod der yang ni/ /dam tshig mchog ni mchog bcings la/ /gang tshe nyid ni grol gyur pa//de na gter ni yod par bshad/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gang du nges par dogs ⑨gyur pa/ /de na nges par gter yod par/ /ye shes bskyed de shes par bya/ /gang na yang dang yang dogs ⑩payi/ /las kyi phyag rgya cho ga bzhin/ /der bcings de ni gnyis gyur pa/ /gter yod par ni shes par bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ni dhi dzñā tson ā bi sha /oṃ rat+na tsos ma ya muñtsa ni dhi ba 8/ oṃ dharma rat+na bru hi ni dhi ⑩rna/ oṃ sarba kurma ni tsotho ṭa ya dar+sha ya ni bid+dhāḥtsoban dho yirā k+ṣi pa/ phyag rgya chen por bsgoms nas ni / /gter rnams kun du btsal nas kyang / /gang na gnas pa der babs na//de na gter ni yod par ( )bshad/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas kyang / /gter rnams kun du btsal nas ni/ /gang na gnas pa brtag gyur pa/ /de na gter ni yod par bshad/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gter rnams kun du btsal nas kyang / /gang na yod par rtag tu shes/ /de na gter ni yod par bshad/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gter rnams kun du 84—237

btsal nas kyang / /gang na yod par las phyag rgya/ /bskor ba de na yod par bshad / /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ / oṃ rat+na pa rak+ṣi ā be sha6) /oṃ rat+na sa ma ya skṛ (gyid dar+sha ya/ /o rat+na pa rak+ṣi dzñā na ā be gsha /oṃ ma ṇi kurma braṅgā ④ya/ de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes (5)bslab par bya'o⑨/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar (pel/ /gter rnams kun du tshol byed cing / /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms na ni/ /babs par gyur na (nyagater rnyed do/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas kyang / /bud med dang ni rtse sgro)byed cing / /gang du phyag rgya dam gyur pa7/ /de na gter ni yod par bshad/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar na/ /gter rnams kun du tshol byed cing / /ye shes phyag rgya bsgoms nas ni/ /gter gyi ye shes 'jug par 'gyur/ /dbang po gnyis kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /gang du phyag rgya gnyis gyur pa/ /de na 17gter ni yod par bshad/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ma hā ma ṇi saṃ yo gā be tsho sha /o sa ma ya tshomise yo ga / dṛ ḍho 8me bha ba/ oṃ di skani dzñā na ā be (7sha saṃ yo ga /o sarba kurma saṃ spo ṭa saṃ 41yo ga /de nas nor bu'i rigs chen po'i phyag rgya'i ye shes thams cad yo bslab bo/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po 'di yin te/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ji lta ba yi ri mo 19bzhin/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms na ni/ /don gyi mchog kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po rnams kyi las ni 'di rnams yin no/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya sangs rgyas nyid/ /rdo rje snying pos gnyis rab 'grub / /rin chen lcags kyus kun spyan 'dren/ /nor bu dga' bas rjes dgar 2 byed/ /nor bu mgu bas dgyes par byed/ /nor bu lta bas nor thob 84—238

bo / /nor bu phreng bas dbang bskur zhing / /nor bu nyi mas gzi brjid mchog /yid bzhin nor bus ji dgar sbyin/ /rin chen bzhad pas nor thob 'gyur/ /rin chen chos kyis chos kyang thob/ /gtong ba'i dpal gyis dam pa rnyed/ /rin chen ral gris mtshon chen po/ /rin chen 'khor los dbang por 'gyur/ /smra bas btsal 6)ba'i dngos grub 'thob/ /rin chen char gyis (minor chen po/ /nor bu'i mchod pas rab mchod nyid/ /rin chen chos kyis brtan par byed/ /rin chen mche bas nor thob bo/ /khu tshur nor bus dngos grub 'thob/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin no/ / rdo rje rin chen phyag rgyas ni/ /chasangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur 'thob/ /rdo rje nor bu che bcings nas/ /rdo rje rin chen grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gnyis las nor bur byas/ /rdo rje 'dzin las nor 'thob bo/ /de nyid mthe bo rdo rje yis / /nor bu sbyar te snying gar gzhag /mdzub rigeganyis pad+ma'i nor bur bcings / /'jig rten dbang gis 45)nor byin (kha'agyur/ /rdo rje las nor sna tshogs kyi/ /nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan sbyin/ /rdo rje dbyings mdzub spyinor bu yis / /sangs rgyas rin chen nyid 'thob bo/ /mdzub (kyemo bsnyams te ponyephyir bkug la/ /mthe bo rdo rjer bcings pa yi/ /rdo rje snying po'i phyag las byung / /'di ni rdo rje'i nor bur gsungs/ /'di ni bcings ma thag tu yang / /rdo rje'i nor bu chen po 'thob/ /mdzub tsoganyis rin chen 'drar bcings la/ /gung mo myu gur bsgreng 3gleb ste/ /'di ni bcings ma thag tu yang / /rang gi dbang bskur thob par 'gyur/ /de nas gung mo srin lag dang / /mthe'u chung rnams ni pad+mar bya/ /'dis ni kun du spyan ras gzigs/ /mtshan 'dzin pas ni 84—239

nor sbyin 'gyur/ /mdzub ①mo mthe bo mthe'u chung rnams/ /rdo rje rin chen tshul du bya/ /gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo sbyar/ /srin lag myu gu 'dra bar bsgreng ②/ /rdo rje bsdam pa dam byas la/ /mdzub ①gnyis nor bur byas nas kyang / /mtheb gnyis brkyang ba'i ngos snying gi④/ /don kun grub pa sbyin par byed/ /rdo rje bsdam pa bsdams nas kyang / /gung mo gnyis ni nor bur ⑤bya/ /nor bu mtshan gyi phyag rgya 'di/ /nor bu chen po rab sbyin no/ /de nyid las ni mdzub dumo gnyis/ /lcags kyu'i tshul du byas pa ni/ /don kun dgug khu)pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /nor bu rin chen lcags gyur bshad/ /de nyid las ni bsgyur nas kyang / /mdzub (8)mos mdzub (9)mo bzung yinas ni/ /mda' 'phang ba (nyayi tshul byas la/ /drangs tsonas 'gro ba dga' bar byed/ /de nyid las ni mdzub tsomatheb gnyis/ /sbyar ba legs so zhes bya ba'o⑩/ /de nas mtheb gnyis sbyar ba yis/ /mdzub ⑫gnyis rtse mo sbyar ba dang / /mthe bo gnyis ni dbus sbyar la/ /mdzub yiganyis ngos dang sbyar ba ni7/ /nor bu lta bar bshad pa ste/ /lta ba'i don rnams 'phrog byed pa'o/ /don kun grub pa'i phreng ba ni/ /rang gi dbang ni rab sbyin 'gyur / /de nyid snying gar mthe bo gnyis/ /bsgreng (steste ngos kyis sbyar ba ni/ /nor bu nyi ma'i snying gar gzhag /gzi brjid chen po rab sbyin 'gyur/ /srin lag bsnyams te bsgreng 47nas ni/ /phye ste spyi bor gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje nor bu chen po gtso/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs byed sgo )pa'o/ /de nyid las ni 'gying byed cing / /kha 'gram rgod ( nyapar bskor ba ste/ /rin chen char rgod ( stezhes bya ba / /bzhad pas don rnams thams cad 'grub/ /ting nge 'dzin du sor mo bsgom / /nor bu pad+ma nor 'chang ba'i/ /de nas mtha' nas grol ba ni/ /84—240

sbyin pa chen po rab sbyin byed/ /mthe bo gnyis ni nang du dgug /mdzub ①gnyis nor bur byas pa ni/ /nor bu ral gri yin te mthus/ /'gro ba rnams kyi nor 'phrog pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams las 'khor lor bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bcug nas kyang / /mdzub (miganyis nor bu ③'drar byas pa/ /'khor los sgyur zhorab thob par byed/ /de nyid thal mo'i tshul du byas/ /kha nas 'dren par byas pa ni / /de bcings nas ni ngag gis kyang / /rang gi bkas ni nor 'phrog 'gyur//rdo rje nor bu che bcings la/ /rin chen char ni rab 'bebs te/ /sor mo thams cad bsgreng (5)ba ni/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni nor char 'bebs/ /rdo rje nor bu che bcings la/ /gar byas gtsug phud dbus bzhag nas/ /kun la cho ga bzhin mchod na/ /rin chen kun gyis de mchod 'gyur/ /don kun grub pa'i phyag rgyas ni/ /mgrin pa'i phyogs su 'khyud par bya/ /nor bu bcings pa zhes bya ste/ /bsrung (5)ba yi ni cho gar grags/ /don kun grub pa de nyid las/ /gnod sbyin tshul du khar bzhag pa/ /nor bu mche ba zhes bya ste/ / 'jig byed ⑦don kun 'phrog byed pa'i(kyi/ /rdo rje bsdam (9)pa dam byas la/ /mdzub tshubakug mthe bo gnyis kyis ni/ /legs par mnan te btsir zhunyab ni/ /nor bu'i khu tshur dngos grub 'thob/ /dam tshig rnams kyi mchod mchog rnams/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi tshul du ni/ /ji bzhin nor bu ldan pa la/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog tu brtags(gye/ /gung mo nor bu'i tshul du bya/ /de dag nyid la rnam par brtags(ge / /lcags kyu gcig sogs tshul gyis skoni/ /las rnams thams cad rab 'grub byed/ /de nas nor bu chen po'i rigs kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin no/ / hraḥgraḥtriḥhrīḥshrīḥ.iḥriḥdh+riḥdiḥdhīḥgriḥbiḥriḥḍaḥyaḥ.aḥyi/ rin 84—241

chen phyag rgya gnyis byas la/ /las kyi phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig gi 0)rtog pa'i rgyal po las don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stol// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba'i gzungs shekyi dam tshig 'byung ba'i rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs ④zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so / /o badz+ra rat+na dhū (gepe hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ⑥chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rigs 'byung ba'i phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /o badz+ra a bhi ṣe 0ka mā le 98)a bhi phyohak+ṣañtsa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ rat+na ⑩a bhi ṣe ka hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra 1〉dharma a bhi ṣe ka hūṃ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka pū dza yoshes ma ye hūm̐/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khya byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying pos rang gi rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste//rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba la/ /rin chen gsang ba zhes bshad de/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bus breli/ /de yi dbus su tshul bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya bri bya 7ste/ /khri la gnas pa'i 84—242

nor bu'i gtso/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi mdun du ni/ /nor bu'i phreng ba pad+ma'i nor / /nor bus bskor ba'i nor bu'i rnams/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ tral/ oṃ ma ṇi sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na dzo a gi ṣe ka mā le ②hūm̐ / o ma ṇi rat+na ④pad+ma hūm̐/ o ma ṇi rat+na bṛ ti (5)sa ma ye hūm̐/ thams cad grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal (snyanas ni/ /rdo rje rin chen dbus su ni/ /rdo rje nor bu chen po bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams (7)thams cad du / /ltag la'og go rims po)ji bzhin par/ /rang gi phyag rgya nor bur ldan/ /rin chen slob dpon nyid kyis bri/ /de la de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ sarba arba sid+dhi pra be sha tshim hā badz+re rat+na (lhas ma ye ma ṇi sarba aṅgā yoshen me sā dha ya dhā (gyer tsā r+ghaṃ/ o ma ṇi rat+na ā rdzikar+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na sa ma ye e ku sha ma ṇi ku lañdza'/ oṃ ma ṇi rā ga skyes ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi sā dhu hūm̐/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis par yang / /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nyunyenas ni/ /spyan gnyis dang ni ldan pa yin/ /nor bu de yi dbus su bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag yina'og go rims 67ji bzhin par/ /nor bu'i mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /rang gi phyag rgya rnams bri'o/ /de la de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di dag go / /oṃ badz+ra ( )ma ṇi rat+na ne tra ā ( nan ya ba shi sne ku ru sarba arba sam+bha ba sa dā na shī s+t+waṃ tiṣ+ṭha ( ste.i ku shi hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na rat+na ( na mā le ( lhas bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ( nasubye ( )dzā so/la ya sarba ma hā rā 6 )dzi ni hūm̐/ o ma ṇi tsan+d+ra ni〉ṅgā dzā khrinagri hūm̐/ o ma ṇi hā se hā sa hūm̐/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal sa nas ni/ /nor bu pad+ma bri bar bya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ltag rdo chi'og go rims sa ji bzhin bya/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni dga'adi rnams so/ /o ma ṇi sa mā dhi pad+me ni so hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi 84—243

rat+na 1)bya gra sa ma ya ri rtsu/ oṃ ma ṇi sa ma ya ko ṣe hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi sa ma ya tsakra hūm̐/oṃ ma ṇi bhā ṣā du )gri hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor bzhi pa dam par ni/ /rdo rje shugs kyis brgal 94)nas kyang / /rdo rje rin chen ldan pa yi/ /rin chen char 'bebs der gnas shing / /las kyi 957phyag rgya ji bzhin pas/ /yongs su bskor bar bri bar bya56 / /nor bu'i mtshan mar ldan pa rnams/ /ltag tso)'og go rims (nyaji bzhin bya / /de nas de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na bṛṣ+ṭi po)sā dha ya ma hā ma ṇi hūm̐/ o ma hā pū dzā kyis ma ye ne tra tshona.ā/ oṃ ma hā pū dzā yinas ma na sa ma 6)ye rak+ṣa / oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi rat+na rdas lokā rā 8le ha ra ha ra hūm̐/ o ma ṇi sa ma ya muṣ+ṭi hūm̐/ de nas nor bu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir las rnams ji lta ba bzhin du byas nas rang gi slob ma rnams btsud de 'di skad du bsgo bar bya'o/ /khyod kyis tshul 'di su la yang ma smra shig /khyod rab tu dbul ba dang dus byas yo bhenas sems can dmyal bar lhung ta spyi re zhes bsgo la rang gi nor bu'i dam tshig gi ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rdo rje rin chen ting 'dzin gyis/ /mkha' la rdo rje rin chen bri/ /bdag nyid kyi ni dpral bar yang / /bzhag na rgyal por nges par 'gyur/ /rin chen rdo rje bcings nas ni/ /rdo rje rin chen mkha' la bri/ /dbang gi gnas su bzhag na ni/ /nges par rgyal po nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje rin chen ting 'dzin gyis16/ /rdo rje rin chen mkha' la bri/ /ye shes rdo rje de bzhag na / /nyid kyis grub pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /mkha' la rdo rje rin chen bris / /rang gi gnas su de bzhag na/ /nyid kyis 5 lhagrub pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /ma hā badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ snye/ sa ma ya rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa rmātsho nya/ dharma rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa 84—244
