gsol btab la/ / tsi li (1)rat+na ( zhes brjod 'thob/ /nam mkha'i snying po las kyi mchog /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings nas ni/ /rin chen thams cad gsol btab la/ /ki li rat+na ②zhes brjod 'thob/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ i li/ o mi li/ oṃ tsi ④yi/ oṃ ki li/ de nas nor bu ye shes gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes 95)bslab bo/ /nam mkha'i phyogs sam phyogs gzhan du/ /rdo rje snying po bsgoms nas (6)ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sprad na/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /gzhi la ri mo bris pa bzhin//rdo rje snying po bsgoms nas ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar la/ /dbang bskur ba yang thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying po bsgoms nas 97)ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar la/ /sdug pa de 98)dang gar rtses (97pa/ /'jig rten kun gyis de dgar byed/ /nam mkha' kun gyi rdul dbyibs kyis/ /rdo rje snying po bsgoms nas ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar ( )la/ /thams cad 'grub par nges par 'gyur/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /ā kā sha gu (gleh+ya dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ bi tsi tra 12gu h+ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sri yā nu smṛ 1 ti dzñā na gu h+ya sarba lo ke sarā ga ya hūm̐/ sarba gu h+ya dzñā na sarba sid zhismi 12sra yats+tsha tsū/de nas phyag rgya chen po 'di ji lta ba bzhin bcing bar bya'o/ /dngos grub kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas chos kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes tshabaslab bo/ /rdo rje nor bu ni rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya ni 'di yin no/ /sā bā rā sā 1 ra te ka hā 1 rda ti he bā 17kan ka ra ya ma / de nas mdor na las kyi phyag rgya ni gnas ci bzhin par gzhag par bya'o 1 / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi 2dam tshig gi rtog ‘ gepa'i 84—252

rgyal po chen po las ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto1)// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis (0de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i las kyi dam tshig 'byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ( nyeting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa (4)'di gsungs so//sarba ta thā ga ta kurma a bhi (ge'i ka hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi las 'byung ba'i rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so / /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ kā (phyir a bhi ṣe 97)ka /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta a bhi ṣe ka hūm̐/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sarba dharma a bhi ṣe ka rat+nan)/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi rig ri9)pa dam pa kha'adi gsungs so/ /o bi shwa a bhi ṣe ka yinas/nya / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i 12snying pos rang gi rigs kyi dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba(1 no/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyings dang 'dra ba la / /rin chen dgos pa zhes bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul du ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad srad bu 51 bre/ /de yi dbus su tshul bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs gzhag par bya/ /sems dpa' chen po tshul gyis ni/ /rin chen mchod pa rnams bri'o/ /de la de dag gi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na pū dzā tshag/ oṃ sarba arba sid+dha 1 badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣe ka hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma ṇi 84—253

dharma sa ma ye 0)ju/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ā kusgo kurma sa ma ye rtsu/ o ma ṇi rat+na (snyen ga ra ti kurma pū dze pra brta(5)/ o ma ṇi rasne chasā dhu kā ra (5)pu dza (nenas ma ⑦ye hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ma ṇi rat+na dṛṣ+ṭa ā gar+sha(she/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na mā la pū dzi(9na/ o ma ṇi rat+na srur+sā yilo ka pū dzeXste/ o ma ṇi rat+na dh+wa 'dza pā ta (nyeka 8phu dze/ o ma ṇi rat+na astos 87 sa pū dze/ o pad+ma ma ṇi sa mā dhi sa mā 7ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba t+yā gā nu smṛ tu snati sa mā ()dhi /smo 6)ka ri hūm̐/ o ma ṇi rat+na ( 3khrig zhumes ma 6)ye ts+tshan+da hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ( nyatsakra sa ma 3)ye hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na bhā zhesa'i bha da bha da hūm̐/ o ma ṇi rat+na bar+sha ni hūm̐/(lha.oṃ ma ṇi rat+na garmi ṇi 2 7rtsu/ o ma ṇi rat+na zhu)ka ba tse 6)rak+ṣa rmākhri )/ o ma ṇi rat+na rdas sastokhya da khā da hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na gas ()muṣ+ṭi hūm̐/ o ma ṇi rat+na lā sre 6)pu dza (steya ho/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na mā rigale 87a bhi ṣe ka pu dzā pu moya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na gī bye (shes dzā ya rte / oṃ ma ṇi rat+na mṛ h+ye sna'i dzā 81ya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na dhū pe pū dzā ( ya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na phusne pū dzā 2ya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ā lo ke pu dzā ( )ya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na gasne pū dzā lhaya/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na e ku sha ā kusgo ya dzaḥ6lha/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na pā 6 7she hūṃ/ o ma ṇi rat+na sbo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ā 8be sha aḥ 'o/ de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par byas nas 5 7bcug ste 'di skad du bsgo bar bya'o/ /'di khyod kyis su la yang ma smra shig /khyod las kyi sgrib pas non nas shi bar gyur ta re zhes bsgo 6nyal/ las kyi ye shes ne bslab par bya'o/ /rdo rje snying po phyag rgya che/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms nas kyang / /mchod pa kun gyis mchod na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi 52dam tshig mchog /phyag rgya gang yang rung bcings la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod na ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni des 'thob bo/ /rdo rje snying po'i 5 84—254

ting 'dzin du/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams 6)cad rab mchod na/ /'gro ba'i dam pa 'dul bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod gyur na/ /skad cig tu ni don kun 'thob/ /de la de dag gi snying po ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ rat+na pū dza narab shi ri ku ru/ (ga.o rat+na pū dza (5)sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa / oṃ rat+na pu dzā ri nyeya dharma nā sha ya bā di/ oṃ rat+na pū dzī /karma sarba aṅgā na me sā 58)snya/ de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje snying po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod na ni/ /'jig rten thams cad des mgur 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyis dngos grub dam pa 'grub par 'gyur(9)/ de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes 7bslab par bya'o/ /rdo rje rin chen bcings nas ni / /gnas rnams kun du gzhag par bya/ /rdo rje dgos pa'i tshul du ni/ /ltag 117'og go rims 12ji bzhin bya/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes ni 'di yin te/ twa dza ga dha/ t+na dza tu sa/ smo kyā tu ṣa/ smra k+ṣa k+ṣa dhiyoshe/ rdo rje rin chen gnyis byas la/ /las kyi phyag rgya de bsgrub bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skithams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig gi rtog gepa'i rgyal po chen po yolas las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stotsho // //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rin po che'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na sna tsā/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra mā 84—255

le(1) / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi rasne(5)/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje spyan gyis rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma rat+na / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' (༄chen po rdo rje sna tshogs kyis rang gi phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ bi shwa dṛṣ+ṭi par/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos rang gi nor bu'i rigs kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi pa'i tshul du ni / /dkyil 'khor yongs su brtag par bya/ /de nas ji lta ba bzhin du bcug nas bslab par bya ste/ khyod kyis 'di 6su la yang ma smra shig ces bsgo bar bya'o//de nas ye shes bskyed bya 57ste/ /rdo rje rin chen ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje rin chen bcings nas ni/ /dpral bar rab tu gzhag na ni/ /dngos grub thams cad 'thob par 'gyur/ /de nas de dag gi snying po ni 'di gsungs so(7 o badz+ra rat+na sarba a bhi ṣe ka sarba sirnyi me pra yats+tsha ra la ra la 9rtsu tra/ de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya bslab par bya ste/ khyo 'am 1 yang na sdug pa 'am/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa'ang rung / /dpral ba gnyis ni sprad nas kyang / /gtugs na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de la de bsgrub 11pa'i snying po ni 'di yin te/ o badz+ra rat+na sa khi bit+yā dhā 12ra sto12/ pra yats+tsha shī r+ghaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa ya hi ha ha ha twa/ de nas phyag rgya bzhi 7bslab bo/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /o badz+ra ma ṇi dhā ra sarba arba 84—256

sirnyim 6)pra yats+tsha ho(mi/ bha ga bān badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'di yin te / de nas rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /dngos grub kyi ni dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji bzhin par ni bri bar bya/ /de nas 'dir ye shes gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes (shebaslab par bya'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i (sku)rnams/ /chags par gyur pa'i bde ba ni/ /sangs rgyas la yang phul gyur na/ /las kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya bzhi'i 6)ye shes (6)bslab par bya'o/ /ras la sogs pa la yang sems dpa' 'am phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bris te bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la dzoralegs so zhes bya ba byin pa 'dis bstod do/ /legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg 58)pa chen po mngon 'dus pa/ / rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /59nomado sde 'di ni legs par bshad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa 7las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi 41)dam tshig ces bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po dum bu bzhi pa yi rdzogs 1ste(1ge / / //bam po brgyad pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi de kho na nyid kyi skocho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la re zhig dang por ni phyag rgya chen po dam 84—257

pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad dezhino/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyag rgya che/ /bcings nas mkha' dbyings thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs byin brlabs 55skul/ /rang gi snying du bcug nas ni/ /ci ste 'dod na tshe 'di la/ /zhi ba dam pa mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'thob nges 'di bsgrubal/ /ci ste mi 'dod dngos grub bzhin/ /phyag rgya chen po bcings nas kyang / /de nyid chen po tshig re rer/ /brjod nas kun dang ldan par yang / /thams cad bdag ni yin bsgoms na/ /ci ste 'dod na bdag nyid des/ /de bya gzi can dge ba yi/ /go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la 'thob/ /mi 'dod dngos grub gong ma bzhin / /de nas dam tshig phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin 'grub pa/ /de ltar bdag ces bsgoms na ni/ /sangs rgyas dang ni gzi chen 'thob/ /mi 'dod dngos grub gong ma bzhin/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis/ /dag ces brjod na nges par yang / /sangs rgyas dang ni gzi can 'gyur/ /mi 'dod dngos grub gong ma bzhin/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ thams cad kyi ni kun dag par/ /las rnams thams cad sbyangs na 4ni/ /sangs rgyas gzi can thob ci ste/ /mi 'dod dngos grub gong 5ma bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dam pa'i dngos grub rnams so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa dam pa'i dngos grub kun gyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /dngos grub kun sbyor sangs rgyas kyi/ /bkas neni sems can kun don du/ /phyag rgya chen por bsgrub na ni/ /tshe 'di (7 nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi 84—258

rgyud bshad do/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du ni/ /ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin grub pa/ /de bzhin bdag ces bsgoms na ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi chen 'thob/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de0)/ yi ge med pa'i chos rnams la/ /rab tu spros pa yod min te/ /chos mchog 'di ni rjod (mibyed cing / /bsgoms na gzi can nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /gang gi 6)las rnams byas pa ni/ /rgyal ba rnams la phul byas na/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes pad+ma'i rigs dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la dang por ni phyag rgya (༄chen po'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ 'dod chags ngo bo nyid kyis dag /mu stegs can gyis mi 55)gyur la/ /de la chags pa'i chos 'di ni/ /theg pa che la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub ni 'di yin te/ ting (6)'dzin brtan ri dpa'i tshul gyis ni/ /byams pa chen po bsgoms nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin ldan khyab byas na/ /skad cig gcig gis (shegazi can 'thob/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/'dod chags ngo bo nyid dag ces/ /smra bar gyur pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin rnyed de/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'thob/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 9)bshad de/ bdag gi lta dang reg pa dang / /mnyan 7pa dang ni dran pa'ang 11rung / /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi mthar phyin 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes nor bu'i rigs kyi dam pa'i dngos 84—259

grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la phyag rgya chen po dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di yin te/ rdo rje snying po ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas kun dbang bdag gyur ces / /bsgom 1)par bya ba rnams ('ubasgoms nas/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'thob / /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/nam mkha'i snying po 'dra bar ni / /sems can kun gyi re ba kun/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed gyur cigaci /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'thob/ /de nas chos kyi phyag rgya dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ bdag nyid kyang ni spangs nas su5tsho/ /nor byin rab tu dga' byed cing / /chos byung (6)phyag rgya smra na ni/ /gzi can tshe 'di nyid la 'thob/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya (7)dam pa'i da/ngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ dbul po rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /nor bsgrub (7pa la brtson ldan na/ /gzi can 'gyur ro ci ste yang / /mi 'dod dngos grub gong ma bzhin / /rigs thams cad kyi phyag rgya rnams kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi dngos grub thob pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi (91dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di yin te/gang gis 'dod la snyoms zhugs pa/ /de la 'dod pas spyod par 7byed/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya chen po yi/ /ye shes dam tshig yin par bshad/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad de/ 'dod pa rnams la chags bral min/ /dam tshig mdzes pa chen po 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dag pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni 'da' mi mdzad/ /de nas rdo 84—260

rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin te/ sems can don du khro min yang / /khro bo chen por rab tu ston/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni chen po yi/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'da' dka'o17/ /de la pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin te/ rang bzhin dag par shes nas kyang / /de yi dgos pa de byed de/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni chen po yi/ /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /de nas nor bu'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin te(gyi/ nyung ngam yang na mang yang rung / /ci tsam nus pa nyid du ni/ /sbyin pas nyi ma stongs ( par ni/ /bya min dam tshig 'di yin no/ /rigs thams cad kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi (4)cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin te(snye/sangs rgyas chos zhes grags so zhes/ /brjod na chos nyid yi ge ni/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi phyag rgya che/ /ye shes mchog gi tshul yin no/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi chos kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /'dod chags las ni dag pa'i chos/ /bde ba thams cad rab sbyin byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ni/ /dngos grub byed pa'i mchog 'di'o/ /de la rdo rje'i rigs kyi chos kyi nedangos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /sangs rgyas bka' ni sbyang ba (smanodang / /sems can drang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de la khro bar ma gyur yang / /ma rungs bdud byas dngos grub 'thob/ /de la pad+ma'i rigs kyi chos kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /pad+ma chu yis mi 58chags pa/ /de bzhin 84—261

'dod pas mi chags zhes/ /smra zhing dgos min byed kyang ni/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la nor bu'i(1)rigs kyi chos kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /sbyin dang mnyam pa'i chos med de(gyi/ /sgrub par byed cing smra ba ni/ /nor bu'i rigs ni chen po'i chos/ /mi 'dod dngos grub gong ma bzhin/ /rigs thams cad kyi chos kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin te/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' nyid rnams su/ /ji bzhin du ni btul nas su/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i mchog 'grub sbyin/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /dus bzhi yi ni tshul dag tu/ /mchod pa rnam pa bzhi yis ni/ /rtag tu ldan pa rnam bzhir yang / /byas nas las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /de la rdo rje'i rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /ma rungs sems can gnod bya'i phyir/ /dgos pa gang dang gang de byed / /las kyi rdo rje rigs kyis 'dis / /dngos grub thams cad rab sbyin byed/ /de la pad+ma'i rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /'jigs pas gzir la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /ji bzhin par ni 'dul de bzhin/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi las/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub sbyin pa'o/ /de la nor bu'i 5rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur de bzhin du/ /lus can rnams la sbyin pa dang / /re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /las kyi don du bsgrub pa'o/ /84—262

rigs thams cad kyi las kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi 6)ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid dgongs/ /'di ni sangs rgyas sangs rgyas nyid/ /gzhan la ②sangs rgyas 'gyur ba med/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi chos nyid kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud ni 'di ①yin te/ phyag rgya chen po ④bsgoms na (nyani/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /chos nyid dngos grub dam pa 'thob/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi chos nyid kyi (6༄ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de(pe/ phyag rgya chen po'i tshul gyis (8)ni/ /dam tshig mchog ni bcings nas kyang / /las rnams thams cad bsgrubs na ni/ /rdo rjes dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi chos nyid kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ chos kyi phyag rgya'i kyisatshul gyis yini/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rjod nyu1byed cing / /rdo rje chos ni chos rnams kyi/ /chos nyid du ni 'dis bsgrubs pa'o/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi chos nyid kyi yi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do1ge/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i tshul gyis ni/ /las kyi rdo rje snying gar gzhag /chos nyid 'di dag bsgoms na ni / /las kyi chos nyid thob par 'gyur/ /rigs thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi ye shes kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi 51 niye shes kyi 84—263

phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 6)kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /zla ba'i rdo rje tshul gyis ni/ /ji ltar de gnyis kha dog shes/ /de ltar 'jig rten de (5)shes te/ /dag 90la dag dang dkar 'od gsal/ /chags la dmar dang dmar ser 'phro(4)/ /shes nas kha dog ji bzhin pa'i/ /de yi bdag nyid nyid du 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od bcas pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po bcings nas ni/ /rang gi lus la ji ltar shes/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i yid ⑤shes so / /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /'phros 96)par gyur nas dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji lta bur yang mthong 'gyur bci / /de lta bur ni yid 8shes so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ nam mkha' 'am sa phyogs phra mo'am/ /yi ge phreng ba mthong gyur 97na/ /mdor na kha dog ci 'dra bar/ /shes pa de 'drar des misems shes/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi ye shes kyi (1medangos grub kyi rgyud de12/ 'jig rten kun la bltas nas kyang / /ji lta bur ni snang gyur nyi cing / /mthong bar gyur na de 'dra 'bar/ /'gro ba'i sems ni shes par bya/ /de gnyis snyoms par zhugs nas ni/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba dang / /byed pa dang ni 'chags tshapa'ang rung / /ji ltar mthong ba de ltar rtogs/ /snyoms par zhugs nas bsams na ni/ /sems can gang dang gang yin pa'i/ /de dang de ni de bzhin du/ /sems can thams cad rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi ye shes 84wa 264

kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi ①cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ / de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi rgyud de/(snye sems dpa' byin gyis brlabs ②tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su bdag bsgoca/sa na/ /ye shes kyi ni tshul de yis/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi ④rgyud de(5)/ nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du / /dkyil 'khor 'di ni ser skya mthong / /sems dpa' nyid ni phyag rgya nyid//mngon sum du ni mthong 'gyur na'o/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i (7rigs kyi dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi rgyud do(pe/ /de lta bu'i dbyibs gyur pa yi/ /dbus na sngo bsangs (misnang na ni/ /rdo rje rigs mchog dngos grub 'thob/ /po)de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi 7ye shes kyi rgyud de(spre/ de nyid la ni mkha' 'dra ba'i / /pad+ma sngon po lta bur mthong / /pad+ma chen po'i (1rterigs rig tu pa'i/ /dngos grub de ni legs par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i yirigs kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /de nyid mkha' bzhin dri med las/ /'od zer dkyil 'khor 'phro bar ni/ /mthong na dngos grub myur du 'thob/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa'i 7rnams/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od bcas par/ /dngos grub dus su rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid kyi ni ⑩mdun mthong na'o/ /rigs thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi mngon par 84—265

shes pa'i dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mngon par shes pa'i dngos grub kyi ye shes kyi rgyud de / rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /lus kun de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsgoms la/ /de bzhin lus las byung mthong na'o/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 6)mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud dor / /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings na ni/ /sgrub pas cho ga 'di yis ni/ /mngon shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni 'phrul gyi spyan gyi (7ye shes kyi dngos grub yin no/ /phyag rgya chen por zhugs nas ni/ /mig gi rnam (gshes bskyed nas kyang / /gang yang rung ba des bsams na/ /shin tu ring ba'ang mthong 'gyur zhes/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas (5)gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen por zhugs nas ni/ /rna ba'i rnam shes bskyed nas kyang / /de cani dgos pa gang bsams kyang / /shin tu ring na gnas thob ( zhes/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen por zhugs nas ni/ /yid kyi rnam shes bskyed nas kyang / /sems can gang la des brtags na/ /de yi sems ni des shes 'gyur / /phyag rgya chen por zhugs nas ni/ /bdag gam sems can gang yang rung / /yid kyis bltas nas gar skyes pa/ /gzugs ni de yis shes par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho ga shes pa'i dngos grub ni 'di yin no/ /phyag rgya chen po bcings nas kyang / /rdzu 'phrul gang dang gang 'dod pa/ /de nas gang yang rung bar ni / /ting 'dzin gyis ni mthong bar 8'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das byang 84—266

chub kyi sems chen pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do0)/ /khams gsum ②rnam rgyal mchog tu ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag ①pas bcings nas kyang / /cho ga 'dis ni sgrub pa pos/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'thob bo/ /khros nas dgos pa thams cad ni/ /ltag ④'og rim pa ji bzhin bya/ /rdzu 'phrul mig la sogs tshul gyis/ /mngon shes kun bdag nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so / /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do(snye / /'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyag rgya'i mchog /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings na ni/ /cho ga 'dis ni sgrub pa pos/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'thob bo/ /ltag (6nye'og go rims ⑦ji bzhin du/ /cho ga bzhin du 'dod pas chags/ /'phrul gyi mig la sogs tshul gyis/ /mngon shes thams cad thob 'gyur zhes/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang pos gsungs/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (kyerigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do59na/ /don kun grub pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings na ni/ /cho ga 'dis ni sgrub pa pos/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'thob bo/ /ltag pa'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /'phrul gyi mig la /stosogs tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod byas la/ /mngon shes lnga ni des 'thob bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi bden pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bden pa'i dngos grub 84—267

kyi rgyud ni 'di yin no/ /bden pa'i rjes su 'jug pa yi0)/ /tshig gis mna' ni 'dor byed cing / /bden pa chen po bsrungs ②na ni/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob bo/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bden pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do①/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'byung ba'i/ /dam tshig la ni mna' bor la /rdo rje'i bden pa bsrungs na ni/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi bden pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do4)/ /ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na / /shin tu 'di las 'da' bar dka'/ /rdo rje 'dzin la mna' 'dor (5)cing ske/ /bden pa 'di la bsrung bar bya/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin gyis gsungs so/ /de la (6)'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi bden pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud dodzon/ /ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /pad+ma chen po'i (nyarigs mchog gi/ /pad+ma chos la mna' 'dor zhing / /bden pa'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi bden pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud rdo9/ /'di las shin tu 'da' dka' bar/ /sangs rgyas chos la mna' 'dor 7zhing / /bden pa mchog 'di gsungs na ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas mchod pas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi mna'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 61de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa 84—268

thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do①/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod nas/ /de yi 'og tu ma bsgrubs pas/ /rigs kun gyi ni phyag rgya rnams / /nyid kyis bcings nas dam tshig (ge'agyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po de kho na nyid kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi zhi)de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do④/ /su ra ta ⑤s+t+waṃ zhes brjod na/ /de nyid bskul (beba'i bdag nyid che/ /ma bsgrubs par yang phyag rgya kun/ /nyid kyis bcings na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud donas/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba gcig tsam gyis / /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /bdag gam yang na gzhan yang rung //nyid bcings 'ching du bcug kyang rung / /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do(8༄/ /sarba shud dhā 6)zhes brjod na/ /bdag gam yang na gzhan dag gis/ /bud med chags la sogs ldan na/ /thams cad du ni grol mi 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs ⑩kyi dam tshig gi zhi de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ge/ /o zhes bya bas mdor bsdu na/ /phyag rgya thams cad 'grub 'gyur te/mi/ /'jig rten kun gyi mchog nyid kyi/ /rang 'byung nyid la mchod par 'gyur/ /rigs thams cad kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub kyi 'cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud tsha'adi yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dran byed cing / /84—269

sangs rgyas phyag rgya bcings nas 6)ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub brtan par yang / /bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do②/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /bcings nas de yi mdun du yang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms na ni/ /shin tu myur bar dngos grub 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do①//rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dam tshig gi ni mchog bcings na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms na ni/ /nyi ④rim du ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /'jig rten dbang po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /chos kyi phyag rgya bcings nas kyang / /'jig rten mgon po bsgoms na ni/ /nyi rim du ni dngos grub thob/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ( snyerigs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do phyi/ /rdo rje snying po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /rdo rje snying po bsgoms na ni/ /nyi rim du ni dngos grub thob/ /rigs thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dodzo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub (8)sgrub pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i rgyud do(97/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcings nas ni/ /bdag nyid dang ni mdun du yang / /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /de nas de ma thag tu 'grub / /ces sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub 7)pa'i rgyud do11/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'dod pa bdag ces bsgoms nas 84—270

kyang / /phyag rgya thams cad bsgrubs na 6)ni/ /grub pa'i mchog ni kun bsgrubs pa'o(mi / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i rgyud do / /bdag nyid nyid kyis rdo rje dbyibs/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas sgom byed cing / /phyag rgya thams cad bcings na ni/ /de ma thag tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de4)/ ye shes kun 'byung dngos grub kyi/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs la gnas/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bdag nyid nyid / /pad+ma'i dbyibs su bsgom par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i 6)rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub pa'i rgyud do6)/ /nor bu rin chen 'od zer 'bar / /bdag nyid nyid kyis bsgoms na ni/ /nor bu chen po'i rigs mchod na(7 / /kun las 'byung ba'i dngos grub 'thob/ /ces bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i (kyisnying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi (9)dngos grub dam pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis 7brlabs kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs 41kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do12/ /rdo rje dbyings dbang phyag rgya ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings nas kyang / /snying ga mdzod spu mgrin spyi bor/ /bzhag na 1 sangs rgyas byin rlob bo/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi byin gyis brlabs dza84—271

kyi rgyud yin te0)/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje dam byas la/ /snying ga mdzod spu mgrin ②pa dang / /spyi bor bzhag na byin gyis rlob / /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi byin gyis brlab ①pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do(4)/ /rdo rje hūm̐ gi phyag rgya ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bcings nas kyang / /snying ga mdzod spu zhi)mgrin spyi bor/ /bzhag na nyid du byin gyis rlob(6)/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtso bos gsungs so ni/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi byin gyis brlab (gupa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de5)/ 'jig rten dbang po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma dam byas la/ /snying ga mdzod spu mgrin bespyi bor/ /byin gyis brlab zhunyaphyir gzhag par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs (/nyedabang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i yo rigs kyi byin gyis brlabs (mi①kyi rgyud do/ /rdo rje snying po'i boting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje nor bu che bcings la/ /snying ga mdzod spu tshamagrin spyi bor/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gzhag par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab thi trepa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nya chen po phyag na rdo rjes / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do19/ /rin chen rdo rje bcings nas ni/ /dpral bar (2 ’rab tu gzhag byas na/ /rgyal ba rdo rje rin chen gyis/ /dbang bskur bar ni de 'gyur ro/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 21kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dbang bskur ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de mi/84—272

rdo rje dbyings dbang la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya mdun nas ni/ /brtsam pa byas nas ngos bzhir yang / /phreng ba nyid kyis dbang bskur 6)'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang bskur ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do②/ /rdo rje dbang gi phreng ba ni/ /bcings nas dpral bar bzhag na yang / /phreng ba'i dbang ni de yin te / /rdo rje rnams ni de dbang 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dbang bskur ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud deg/ chos kyi rdo rje bcings nas kyang / /mgo bor bzhag ste (5nide dbang bskur/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni 'jig rten gyi / /dbang phyug gis (nyuni dbang bskur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (7rigs kyi dbang bskur ba'i rgyud de/ rdo rje rin chen myu gu bcings/ /dpral bar bzhag ste des dbang bskur/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni mchod pa yi/ /dbang phyug tu ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do(kye/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 95phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs tshethams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud denyunye/ rgyal ba kun gyi rnam par ni/ /phyag rgya mnyam par bzhag par bcings / /zlos shing kyi sngags kyi rig pa ni/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi /geting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud deyin/sems dpa'i byin brlabs mtshul gyis ni/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje chos kyis kyang / /84—273

snying po phyag rgya sngags rig 0)rnams/ /zlos ②pas myur du 'grub ①par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do④/ /'dod chags las ni khyod phyung ste/ /bdag ni khro bo yin bsgoms nas/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig (5)rnams/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi ting nge 67'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de(pe/ 'jig rten dbang po (8)rig zlos pas/ /byams pas 'gengs (9)pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /snying po la sogs bsgrubs na yang / /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de / nam mkha' kun gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag par bsgoms na yang / /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig 67rnams/ /bsgrubs na kun du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yo chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud demi/ rab mnyam bzhag pas dang por ni/ /bdug pa la sogs mchod byas la/ /de nas dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /bsgrubs na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de mi/84—274

gsang ba'i mchod pa rnam (1)bzhi yis/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rjod ②byed cing / /bdag dbul ba la sogs pa yi/ /mchod pa byas na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de / khro bo rdo rje mchod chen po/ /khro bo gsang ba rjod 'byed cing / /khro bo'i khu tshur rab sbyar na/ /myur du bdag gi ⑤rigs 'grub bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de(ye/ mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /tshul rnams legs par brjod nas kyang / /yid dang ngag gis phul na ⑦ni/ /dngos grub myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (kyerigs kyi nasamachod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud dol/ /gdugs dang 'phan ⑫dang rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rgyal po'i mchod pas mchod byed cing / /sbyin pa thams cad byin na ni/ /nor bu'i rigs ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos 1gegasungs so/ /nyid la byin gyis brlabs sogs ldan / /rdo rje sems dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi yis ni/ /rdo rje sna tshogs ting 'dzin gyisanyuge/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab kha)pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /mchod pa rnams kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de 84—275

bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud yin no/ /lus la sangs rgyas ting 'dzin nihu)/ /'di ni bde gshegs nyid mngon shes/ /de ni rab tu rtogs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas pa yi dngos grub 'thob/ / ces sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /②de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do(5)/ /'phrul gyi mig sogs mngon shes ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms nas kyang / /mngon shes lnga ni bdag gyur na/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud deli/ khro bo mngon shes bskyed nas ni/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms na yang / /mngon shes lnga ni bdag gyur nas/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de(5)/ 'dod chags mngon shes bskyed nas kyang / /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms na ni/ /mngon shes lnga ni bdag 'gyur 67nas/ /dag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje spyan gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (7rigs kyi mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud den3/ mchod pa'i mngon shes bskyed nas kyang / /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms na ni/ /mngon shes lnga yang bdag gyur nas/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog tu gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi ri9)mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dobe/ /de nas byang chub 84—276

sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa ①thams cad kyi rigs kyi byang chub kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi byang chub kyi ye shes kyi (7dngos grub kyi rgyud de /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas dran byed cing / /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do④/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /phyag rgya chen por sgom (5)byed cing / /byang chub chen po'i ye shes 'di/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ / lazhes bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de(5)/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /lag pas dam tshig mchog bcings la/ /byang chub chen po'i ye shes 'di/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de57)/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ting 'dzin gnas/ /de bzhin chos kyi phyag rgya 58)bzlas/ /byang chub chen po'i ye shes 'di/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i 99rigs kyi byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do1 ri/ /rdo rje snying po'i ting 11'dzin gnas/ /las kyi phyag rgya las legs byed/ /byang chub chen po'i ye shes 'di/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom 84—277

ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi byang chub chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do0)/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (0phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ( mnyes par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do(ga/ /nyid kyi sangs rgyas byang chub phyir/ /sems can don rnams rab byed (nyecing / /sangs rgyas rjes su dran gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chags pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mnyes par bya ba gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de(6)/ ji ltar yul (7dang ldan 'gyur (87nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed ces/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgom byed cing / /de nyid bskul na myur bar ni/ /mnyes par 'gyur ba des 'grub bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi mnyes par byed pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de99/ sangs rgyas bka' ni bsrung ⑩ba dang / /sems can don ni spyad pa'i phyir/ /rngam pas mngon spyod byas na ni/ /rdo rje rnams ni mnyes par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs yonyamanyes par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud dobo/ /chags pa 1nyakun du blta 7ba dang / /byams dang snying rjes chos smra dang / /mi 'jigs kun sbyin byed pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mnyes par byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje spyan gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs mnyes par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud des/ dbang bskur ba ni 84—278

rab sbyin dang / /nor bsags rab tu sbyin byed cing / /de yang sangs rgyas don du sbyor/ /'di ni sangs rgyas mnyes par byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi ①mnyes par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do②/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dbang du ①bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud del/ de ltar rnam dag bde sbyin pa/ /'dod chags la ni brnyas (gemi bya/ /sems can kun gyi don du brtson / /'di ni sangs rgyas dbang du byed/ /ces sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de6)/ /'dod sten (7)bde ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /su ra ta s+t+waṃ zhes smra zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrubs na ni/ /de nyid bskul na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do(gyi/ /sangs rgyas bka' ni sems can rnams/ /dag bya lus can skyabs sbyin dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung 59)ba'i phyir/ /bsad na yang ni dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de / pad+ma 'dab ma kha 'byed cing / /'dod chags dag la kun rtog la/ /gdul ba'i phyir ni chags byed cing / /'dod par byed pa dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa kun du 61)spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor 84—279

bu'i 6)rigs kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de②/ sangs rgyas thams cad dbang bskur phyir/ /rdo rje rin chen nyin re rer/ /spyi bor bzhag ste ①dbang bskur na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi dbang du bya ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dong)/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsad pa'i (5)dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so96ste/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑦ gsad pa'i (7dngos grub kyi rgyud de6)/ sems can kun don ma mthong zhing / /sangs rgyas de nyid ma sbyangs 〉la/ /yid dang ngag dang lus kyis ni/ /bsad na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsad pa'i 11dngos grub kyi rgyud de12/ dngos grub thams cad ma thob la/ /rigs rnams kyang ni mi brtson zhing / /rdo rje kun du brtags bsnyenas ni/ /bsad na dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje 7rigs kyi gsad 7pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de7 / ma rungs mi brtul khro med cing / /de bzhin sems can mi 'dul la/ /bdag nyid sdug bsngal 'thob byed na/ /hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsad 7par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsad 18pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de19/ snying rje med cing byams med la/ /sems can ma rungs mi sbyong 2 zhing / /bdag nyid kyis k+ṣ-i 15ni bslus na yang / /bsad na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa kun 84—280

du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ①rigs kyi gsad pa'i sridangos grub kyi rgyud deni/ mi gtong bdag la nor med cing ske/ /nor stor ba dang gnod byed la/ /dbul por gyur ④la sems can rnams / /bsad na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das re ba thams cad rgyaskong bas gsungs so/ /kha cig gis ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnal 'byor ma thob gsod bcug na/ /de dag drang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa kun du bzang pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi gsad ⑥pa'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rdo9)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das (shebyang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsrung dzitaba'i phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsrung ⑩ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de(ste/ sems can thams cad mi gtong zhing / /rtag tu sangs rgyas mchod 7bdag nyid/ /rtag par sangs rgyas yid la byed/ /'di ni bsrung (nyeb rmad kyi mchog /ces sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bsrung (1geba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de(she/rdo rje sems dpa'i yimatshan tsam zhig /lan cig tsam yang brjod gyur na/ /'di ni bsrung ba rtag tshomachen po/ /skad cig dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi bsrung kyi ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de dz+wa/ rigs dang rgyud kyis 6 )chog mi shes / /'jig rten gsum rgyal bdag nyid kyi/ rte/ /rdo rje hūm̐ la mos byed pa/ /'di ni bdag dang gzhan la bsrung da / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya 84—281

bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi bsrung 6)ba'i dngos grub kyi ②rgyud de / 'dod chags dag cing byams pa che/ /thams cad la ni mi 'jigs sbyin / /'jig rten dbang gi mtshan zlos pa/ /bsrung ④ba 'di ni rmad du che/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das (gerdo rje chos kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ⑥rigs kyi bsrung (7)ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de(8)/ sangs rgyas sems can gtong byed par1ri/ /ci nus par ni sbyor byed cing / /nyi ma stong 7par mi bya bar/ / bsrung ba 'di (1ni rmad kyi mchog /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bsrung 7bas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi bsrung (steba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dethu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi rgyud 'di 8bzhes par gsol/ gang gis sems can thams cad brtag pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug tu gyur nas rtogs par bgyi ste/myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i 7slad du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ phyag na rdo rje la yi legs par bshad pas nged kyis blangs shing byin gyis brlabs kyis legs so legs sokyishe/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs bshad pa/ / legs so yi rdo rje sems dpa' khyod / /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos ni khyod legs 84—282

te① / /rdo rje ②las ni khyod legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las brtag ( dpa thams cad kyi thabs kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rdzogs stodu// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la dang po 'dir (snyeni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub dam 6)pa'i gsang ba'i ⑦rgyud del/ sangs rgyas byang chub ting nge 'dzin/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas bsgoms na ni/ /byang chub bde bas thob par 'gyur/ /bsams nas de ni rtogs par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dam pa'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de5)/ sems dpa' rdo rje snying gar bcings /nga yi chung ma khyod sdug pa/ /brtan par gyur cig ces smras nas/ /phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub bya ste/ /cho ga 'di yi tshul gyis ni/ /rang gi 7las rnams ma grub kyang / /gsang ba'i chung ma zhes smras na/ /shin tu dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dam pa'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de0ste/ ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs na yang / /dngos grub thob par ma gyur na/ /hūṃ gi yi phyag rgyas bsad /gen ni/ /skrag ste dngos grub sbyin par byed/ /ces bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsungs so/ /de la 8'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub dam pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud de(ge/ ting 'dzin phyag rgya 84—283

bcings nas kyang / /rdo rje blta bas bltas nas kyang / /bdag gi 6)chung ma'am gzhan chung ma/ /sdug pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i 'dod pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ②rigs dam pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de(kye/ dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar la/ /bde ba'i mchog ces smra ⑤byed cing / /sangs rgyas kun la nyid dbang po/ /phul na myur du dngos grub 'gyur/ /ces bcom ldan 'das nor bu bzhed pas gsungs so/ /rigs dam pa thams cad kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud de(snye/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi yigasang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod cing / /bud med kun la chags byas la/ /sems can don gyis mi skyo na/ /nges par sangs rgyas des mnyes so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs sog/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de3)/ 'dod chags la ni brnyas mi bya/ /bud med kun dang rtse (9)byed pa/ /rdo rje rnams kyi gsang dam tshig /'di ni bsrung yin 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de1lha/ gsod pa 'jig rten thams cad gsod/ /lus dang ngag la dam dgyes pa/ /'jig rten rnam par sbyangs nas ni/ /dam pa'i dngos grub sbyin pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i 84—284

ldan 'das rdo rje dam tshig gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud dezhiswā/ chos kyi las kyi phyag rgya ni/ /bcings nas pad+ma'i ting 9ge'adzin gyis/ /bu gar bcug na bud med rnams/ /thams cad kyang ni bsrung bar (kye'agyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das ④rdo rje pad+mas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (5)rigs kyi las kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de(6)/ rdo rje rin chen ting 'dzin gyis/ /las kyi rdo rje nor bur bcings/ /bu gar bcug na bud med rnams/ /nyid du phab (7)nas gar byed 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rin po ches gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi las kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud de98)/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo dag pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud deyin/ chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra bar ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bya zhing / /phyag rgya bud med rnams kyis yibaskor/ /des 17ni sangs rgyas gzhag par bya/ /gsang ba der (geni zhugs nas kyang / /sangs rgyas la ni nyid du smra/ / 'di khyab pa yi btsun mo ste/ /kun gtong bas ni bdag sogs zhes/ /5nyerigs rnams kun gyi phyag rgya ni/ /tshul rnams la yang de skad brjod/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyam med pa'i/ /gsang ba'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 1 /'khor thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi tshe gsang ba'i sargyud de/ / rdo rje /shedabyings dang 'dra bar ni/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bar bya/ /de bzhin 84wa 287

gshegs pa'i rigs rnams ni/ /thams cad kyi ni mchog 'tshal 6)te/ /dkyil 'khor du ni zhugs nas kyang / /dngos grub 'dod pas myur bar ni/ /su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tshanasaho/ badz+ra satwa ār+ya (gyisid rgya rmā9cas/ zhes brjod snying po 'di bzlas te/ /bsgrubs na thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid bskul (geba'i tshul gyis ni/ /mgu nas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de6)/ khams gsum rnam rgyal 'dra bar ni/ /rdo rje rigs kun rnams kyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'jug par yang / /mkhas pas legs par bri bar bya/ /der zhugs nas ni myur bar (peyang —/ /dngos grub gsol ba 'debs byed cing / /'dod chags las ni khyod 'byung zhes/ /zhes smras 5)kun du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje ju gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de6)/ pad+ma'i rigs ni thams cad kyi'o/ /'gro ba 11'dul ba'i tshul du ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /der zhugs nas ni brjod bya ba/ / 'dod chags chos te pad+ma che/ /khyab pas bdag ni myur dngos grub/ /7de skad smras tu nas dkyil 'khor ni/ /kun gyi des ni dngos grub thobs/ /ces bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i 7rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud des/ nor bu chen po'i rigs rnams ni/ /don kun 'grub pa'i tshul du yang / /dkyil 'khor legs par bris na (1 tshoni/ /zhugs nas 'di skad smra bar bya/ / bsam pa kun gyi dngos grub las/ /'dod chags bsam pa dngos 84—288

grub mchog /grub shig grub shig sems dpa' che/ /bcom ldan thams cad grub pa po/ /6)de skad smras nas dkyil 'khor kun/ /zhugs nas mchod gsang bla med pa'i/ /dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur/ /phyin chad dngos grub bdag nyid kyis/ /bsgrubs na dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang tshe myur du mi 'grub na/ /de nyid bskul na (gyi'agrub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud de / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad kyi (gegasang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya gsang ba'i rgyud (5)dngos grub kyi rgyud deyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha mo che/ /sdug cing bde ba kun sbyin pa/ /⑦bden las byung ba'i tshig bden pas/ /bsgrubs kyang de ni ma grub na'o/ / zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /((de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i gsang ba'i (9)dngos grub kyi rgyud de7/ ltag (spre'og go rims yi ji bzhin du/ /phyag rgya chen po bcings nas ni/ /'di ni de nyid gsang ba yi/ /rdo rje tshul gyis 'di smros shig / bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid / /khyod nga'i chung ma snying la gnas/ /lus kun la ni 'khyud nas kyang / /rdo rje 'gying bas 'gying bar mdzod/ /tsho rdo rje 'gying ba'i lha mo che/ /de nyid bskul bas chags 'gyur bas/ /lus kun la ni brtan 'gyur nas/ /ji bzhin myur du dngos grub 'gyur8/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'gying ba'i bdag pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos 84—289

grub kyi rgyud denyuste/ dngos grub dam tshig grub pa ni/ /khyod dgyes dam tshig bdag yin no/ /(mizhes bskul myur du chags gyur na/ /rab tu yang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das ①rdo rje dam tshig gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi chos kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/rtogs pa sems dpa' rtogs chen khyod/ /bdag gi chung ma shin dgyes mdzod/ /④zhes ni bskul na myur bar (5)yang / /rjes su chags nas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ⑥rigs kyi las kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ las kun byed pa'i chung ma khyod/ /bdag la 'grub mdzod rdo rje mtshi/ /rdo rje can gyis bskul myur bar / /rjes su chags nas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ / rig pa 90thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i 99)rgyud dokyi/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de9/nya/ mu stegs can rnams phan gdags phyir/ /ri mo'i phyag rgya'i tshul du ni/ /sangs rgyas btsun mo rab sba bar / /shes na rab tu grub 7par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de6nya/ sems can kun gyi 7yid la khyab/ /sems can kun la bde sbyin zhing / /sems can kun gyi yab nyid ni/ /dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa'i mchog /ces bcom ldan 84—290

'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i mchog ste rmad che b.ratshi/ /dad ldan shes nas dad byas nas/ /bsgrub (snyedaka' ba yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de / chags pa yidag pa'i chags bral gyi/ / sems can don gyi yid byung nas/ /(5dmu stegs lta bar byas pa ste/ /lta ba ngan pa'i gcong rong ltung / /theg pa che la dgod (phyirapa'i phyir/ /gsod pa'i tha tshig stimachog yin te/ /de ltar shes na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das (kyerdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ mu stegs can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /'byung ba che las thams cad 'byung / /mi gtsang zhes ni ci phyir brjod/ /nges par dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 59)rdo rje spyan ( )gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i /1rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ bud med chags phyir rin chen rnams/ /rtag tu legs par bsag par bya/ /bud med bla med rin chen zhes/ /bsams nas de ni grub (gyepar 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi tsho bka' bzhin du mdzad pas gsungs so / /rigs thams cad kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' tsochen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ bud med chags rnams yongs bskor la/ /kun nas 84—291

gtses 6)pa'i bde ba ni/ /sangs rgyas mchod phyir phul na yang / /mchod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs sol/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de52)/ rab (5)dgas ngal te skyo ba na/ /rab dga' skyilas byung bde ba de/ /phyag bzhi 45)pos ni mchod pa'i phyir/ /phul na myur du grub par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ hūṃ gi (6)dam tshig bcings nas ni/ /skye bo bud med 'khyud nas ni/ /'khyud par 'gyur ba'i skye bo ⑦de/ /phul na de ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de sna/ 'jig rten dbang por bdag bsgoms la/ /sdug pa'i gdong 'byedu bltas nas ni/ /bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de/ /phul na de ni ⑩'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das (stopad+ma'i spyan gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i 7rigs kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ las kyi phyag rgya bcings 'gyur 1 la/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan nas kyang / /bud med 'khyud pa'i longs spyod ni/ /mchod phyir phul na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das skardo rje rin chen gyis gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi mchod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang yinaba'i mchod pa'i tshadangos grub kyi 1 rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 7/shesangs 84—292

rgyas su ni 1)bdag bsgoms la/ /ci nas sus kyang mi tshor bar/ /gzhan gyi bud med rtse (mibyed na/ /mchod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ①gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rgyud de/ rdo rje 'jo ma byas nas kyang / /rdo rje phreng ba 'ching byed cing / /de nas rdo rje glu blangs la/ /rdo rje gar gyis mchod byas la/ /'dod pa'i dga' bas dbang bskur mchog /glu dang gar gyi ci)bde ba las/ /bde ba gzhan gyis (5)myong min te/ /de phyir gsang mchog 'di bla med/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal bsgomaridzin/ /cho ga ji bzhin tshul du yang / /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod na ni/ /mchod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsang bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchod pa'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyag rgyar gnas / /gsang ba'i tshul ni ci bzhin par/ /las kyi phyag rgyas rab mchod na/ /mchod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa kun du 7spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (kyerigs kyi gsang ba'i mchod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de5ra/ don kun grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang ba'i tshul ni ji bzhin par/ /las kyi phyag rgyas rab mchod na/ /mchod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dotsha/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsho chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs bskyed pa'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 4gye84—293

'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i de kho na nyid bskyed pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ mdor na ting 'dzin ye shes las/ /sems can rnams la chags tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub 'gyur na/ /myur du bla med thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi de kho na nyid chen po bskyed pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de0)/ sems can thog ma (7tha ma med/ /nam mkha' la'abyung ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /'dod pa'i ca'agro ba kun bdag po/ /sems can kun gyi sems gang ni/ /bstan 5phyir sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje mnyam par mnyam gzhag na/ /nges par ne rdo rje nyid gyur pa/ /sems dpa'i byin brlabs (7)tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du gyur(8)/ /bcom ldan sems dpa' de nyid de/ /rdo rje bzhad 99pa de bzhin gshegs/ /nyid sems rab tu rtogs la kyisogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub cho ga bzhin/ /de nyid bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad kyi ni rigs su 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems dpas gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs nyid de/ /de nyid rdo rje'i rigs chen po/ /de nyid pad+ma'i rigs dag pa/ /de nyid nor bu'i rigs kyi mchog /ces bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor los gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad bskyed pa'i gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do11/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 1 chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi phyag rgya mngon par brjod pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 84wa 294

rigs kyi mtshan ma mngon par brjod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/bcom ldan sems dpa' de nyid ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thugs la gnas/ /mnyam par bzhag las ting 'dzin te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu bsgrubatu)/ /ces sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mtshan ma'i mngon par brjod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de(mi/ rab tu rtogs phyir rdo rje ste/ /gzung ba'i tshul gyis lcags kyu yin/ /phra mo rtogs phyir mda' yin la/ /mgu bar gyur phyir legs zhes bya/ /spras pa'i phyir yang rin chen gsungs/ /gzi brjid tshul gyis nyi ma ste/ /rgyal mtshan legs par sgreng bar gsungs/ /'dzum (miphyir bzhad par grags pa la/ /'dod chags dag phyir pad+ma yin/ /ral gris nyon mongs dgra gcod yin/ /dkyil 'khor tshul du 'khor lo ste/ /tshig gis brjod pas smra zhes bya/ /rgya gram tshul du kun rdo rje/ /mi tshugs tshul gyis go cha yin/ /'jigs byed litshul gyis mche ba ste/ /phyag rgya'i tshul gyis bsdams pa'o/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sems rtag pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' kun 'gro ba/ /de bzhin rdo rje mtshan la (5)sogs/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan mas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi mtshan ma mngon par brjod pa'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud do(6ni/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi (7niphyag rgya bcing sku ba skye ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi (9)phyag rgya bcing ba skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de'i/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo 84—295

rje skyil mo krung 6)bcings la/ /lag gnyis rdo rjer bsdams pa las/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ ji ltar rgyal po nyid phyag rgya/ /rgyal po khrims la 'debs pa ltar/ /bdag nyid chen po skye bo rnams/ /sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni tshul du yang / /nyid kyi phyag rgya btab pa ni/ /bdag nyid che ba'i phyag rgya cher/ /shes na (gudangos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ ji ltar dam tshig dam pa ni/ /skye bo 'gas ni bcing gyur (2)na/ /shin tu 'da' bar mi bya ba/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcings pa yis/ /rdo rje bcing ba'i mchog bcings na/ /ma shi bar du mi 'da' bar/ /shes nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dam tshig gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni chos kyi rigs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ mdor na rgyal bas rdo rje bka'acho/ /'da' bar bya ba ma yin te/ /'di ni bcings par shes nas kyang —/ /des ni chos kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje las kyi rigs kyi phyag rgya (5) bcing ba (6)skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub gsang ba'i rgyud de/ rdo rje bka' dang las mang rnams / /'da' bar bya ba ma yin zhing / /bka' nyan pa yi las de ni/ /shes na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas 84—296

gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcing ba skye bar 'gyur ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa gsang ba'i rgyud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di yang bdag gis yongs su gzung zhing byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 6)'dus pa'i/ /mdo 'di ②legs par bshad pas na/ / legs so ①rdo rje sems dpa' khyod④/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos 0khyod legs pa stekhya/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las rigs thams cad kyi rtog ⑦pa gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rdzogs stoni// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi chos dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/sangs rgyas rjes su dran tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi ting 'dzin ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgoms na yang / /bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi chos dam pa'i (9)dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ chags pas rjes su dran tshul gyis/ /sems dpa' thams cad ting 'dzin gnas/ /84—297
