pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i ①rigs kyi las kyi chadam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ sems can kun la don chen sbyin/ /kun bzang rgyal po bdag yin te/ /don kun 'grub ①pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /mchod na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das don thams cad grub pas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud dor bye/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi las kyi (gechos dam pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i las kyi chos nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rang gi ting nger 96)'dzin pa yis/ /g.yas pa'i mdzub 7༄mos mdud nas ni/ /go char bcings te spyi bor bzhag /shin tu yang ni bsrungs par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i las kyi rigs kyi las kyi (8)chos nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rtsig 9)pa la ni ldan 'dra ba/ /ri mor bris nas mtshan bsgreng yi ste / /mnyes na bud med gang bsams pa/ /de ni 'di yi dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi las kyi 11chos nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de'agye/ sa la gnod sbyin gdong bris tenyan/ /de yi mig gi phyogs su ni/ /mdzub yimo'i sen mo btsugs na yang / /bud med mchog ni 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 7rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi las kyi chos nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ lag pa gnyis su pad+ma blangs/ /'dod chags dag pa lta byed cing / /rdo rje lta bas bud med de/ /bltas na yang ni dga' bar 84—306

'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das hunyepad+ma 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni ②nor bu'i (kyerigs kyi las kyi chos nyid kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rdo rje ④rin chen ting 'dzin gnas/ /lag pa gnyis kyis (5)nor bu bzung (ye/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /bud med kun la 'dud byed do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ gis gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi las kyi phyadangos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do(kye/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi ponargyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ mchod pa'i las kyi cho gar sbyar/ /gang dang gang gi dgos bsams pa/ /de dang de ni gsol btab ste/ /mkhas pas phyag rgya bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das bordo rje dbyings kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de / rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i zhunyacho gar sbyar / /dgos pa gang zhig smras pa de/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ khro bo'i ting 51 'dzin zhugs nas kyang / /rigs kyi gsang ba'i mchod chen byas/ /mkhas pas cung zad gang bsams pa/ /de ni myur du dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khro bos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'jig rten dbang po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /yid kyis hu mchod pa byas nas kyang / /mkhas pas dgos pa gang bsams pa/ /de yi dngos grub 84—307

thams cad thob/ /ces bcom ldan 'das pad+ma 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (1)rigs kyi las kyi ②dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rdo rje snying po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bdug ①pa la sogs mchod byas la/ /mkhas pas dgos pa gang bsams ④pa/ /de kun skad cig nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi las kyi dgos pa'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do(5)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya sgom pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs (6)kyi rnal 'byor gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de(7)/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ting 'dzin gyis / /rdo rje phra mo'i tshul gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya rab bsgrubs pas/ /dngos grub dam 8pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs (97kyi 7rnal 'byor gyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de / kun gyi bdag nyid sems dpa' ni/ /bdag gi lus la gnas pa ste/ /sems dpa' bdag ces byin brlabs tshonyal/ /bdag ces bya ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /bsgoms na 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par 'dus pa'i rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so / /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi rdo rje'i byin gyis (1 brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de12/ sems dpa' ji bzhin phyag rgya bzhin/ /phyag rgya ji bzhin bdag de bzhin/ /cho ga 'di yi latshul gyis ni/ /phyag rgya thams cad bsgrub 7par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i 84—308

rigs kyi chos kyis hu)byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de/ chos kyi phyag rgya'i tshul gyis ni/ /rdo rje phra mo bsgoms byas la/ /ngag gi phyag rgyas de dag kun / /sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /ces bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i (7rigs kyi las kyis 55)byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de/sangs rgyas kun la dbang bskur dang / /mchod dang dam tshig dngos grub rnams / /bcom ldan 'das zhes bsgoms nas kyang / /rdo rje'i las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje las kyis gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi phyag rgya sgom pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur (4ba phyag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba (5)byin no/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo 'di legs par bshad pas na/ / legs so 4)rdo rje sems dpa' khyod(pe/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos (shekhyod legs pa ste(9) / /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa las brtag pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto // //(lhabam po dgu pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' /nyachen po phyag na rdo rjes tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /lta ba ngan cing chags bral 84—309

la / /gsang ba 'di ni mi rigs te/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /de bzhin cho ga bshad par bya/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' 6)phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi yo (0byad dang cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi yo 50byad dang cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud de/ de la 'di ni snying po'i yo ④byad dang cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud yin te/ dkyil 'khor chen po mthong nas bdug pa dang /mar me dang / me tog dang / dri'i phyag rgya rnams kyis mchod pa byas te/ de nas rdo rje tshig gis bzlas pa brtsam par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni bzlas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud 5de/ zla ba bzhir (6)gnas ji bzhin par 'dug ste( —na/ dus bzhir 87bdug pa la sogs pas 99)cho ga bzhin du tshamachod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i mtshan brgya (1rtsa brgyad pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod yo de/ phyag rgya bzhis phyag bya ba'i tshul gyis phyag byas la sngags 'di bzhis bdag gi (1 lus dbul zhing mchod pa bya'o / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pa'i nā 7ya āt+pa 7rna nir yā ta yā 7mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satā 3 7tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā snye/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā (/6a bhi ṣe kā ༷ 7ya āt+na rna 2lhanir yā ta yā 22mi/ sarba ta thā sa ga ta badz+ra rat+na ( /a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta nā ( g.ya āḥ ( 1rna nir yā ta yā 8nyami/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra 2 dharma pra brta ya rmā / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā 61karma ne na āt+na nu rna 6 )nir yā ta yā 5mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kurma ku ru rmā tsho/ de nas 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la chags pa dang ma bral la kha zas kun dang 'dod pa kun la nye bar spyod cing / bdag nyid snying po'i don du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan 84wa 310

mdun du 6)tshig tsam gyis kyang bsgoms la ci dga' bar byed cing rdo rje tshig ②gis lan brgya rtsa ①bzlas na myur bar dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /ci ste bla na med pa'i dngos grub 'dod na de ni ras la ④bcom ldan 'das ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa ni dbus na bzhugs/de'i sems dpa' chen po bzhi dkyi'/ 'khor gyi tshul du kha dog dang rgyan rnams ci dga' bar bya steyi/ bri zhing sems dpa' chen po rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs la rigs kyi lha mo rnams grwa rnams su bri'o/ /de nas ri mo'i sku gzugs la mchod pa rgya cher byas la 'dzab 7bya ba'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du zla ba bzhi'i bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mthar mchod pa rgya cher byas la mtshan thog thag bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs (kyepa dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /yang na phyag rgya bsgrub par 'dod na ni des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa' rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings la ri mo'i sku gzugs kyi phyag rgya'i spyan sngar ci dga' ba bzhin du ji lta ba bzhin bcings shing bgrol (1)te rdo rje'i tshig 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mthar mtshan thog thag ngal mi bso 7bar cung zad tsam zhig phyag rgya bgrol te / ji lta ba bzhin bcings nas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya 'bar 41zhing 'bab la 'phar zhing nyung bar yi smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings bzhin du nam mkha' la lding bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs ci dga' ba dang / mi snang ba dang las thams cad kyang byed pa ra 'gyur ro/ /bcings ma thag tu phyag rgya thams cad kyis kyang las thams cad ji lta ba bzhin byed par 84—311

'gyur ro/ /6)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /yang na ting nge 'dzin bsgrub ②par 'dod na ni/ des rdo rje phra mo nas brtsams te/ ting nge 'dzin de zhugang la dga' ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du zla ba bzhi'i bar du bsgoms la/ de nas mthar mtshan thog thag skyil mo krung (0mi zhig par snyoms par zhugs (7te 'dug par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs (6)pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /de nas ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu thob par 'gyur zhu)ro zhes bcom ldan 'das ②rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /ci ste las bsgrub 5)par 'dod na yang de bzhin du bzlas zhing 7zla ba gcig gi bar du bsgrubs 0stol/ de nas mthar mtshan gcig ⑫thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas 1gelas thams cad kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste las shig bya bar 'dod na yang lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis bdag dang gzhan dang /grong dang grong khyer rnams go cha bcing ba mil sogs pas bsrungs par 'gyur ro/ /dbab pa yang bya ste tsan+dan dri zhim pos gdon gyis zin pa dang / gdon gyis ⑫ma zin pa rnams rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' dang /7 lag pa dang ske/ 7rin po che dang / nyi ma dang / rgyal mtshan dang / so'i phreng ba dang ske/ pad+ma dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / lce dang / rdo rje rgya gram dang / go cha dang / mche ba dang / khu tshur gyi khri phyag rgya la sogs pa dngos po thams cad la 19lan cig brjod pas 'bebs par byed do/ /sgyu ma'i las kyang byed de/ rma bya'i mjug sgro'i nang du rdo rje bcug ste bcings la de nas rma bya'i mjug sgro de sems dpa' rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas mnan la/ de 84—312

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa' rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya babs kyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas rma bya'i mjug sgro las gzugs sna tshogs pa la sogs par snang bar 'gyur te/ de phyin cad stirma bya'i mjug sgro phyirang gi lus la cho ga bzhin du gzugs thams cad kyang ston te/ mjug sgro de nyid ①lan cig bzlas te / bskor bas kyang bdag nyid las gzugs thams cad snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mjug sgro de nyid kyis 'jig rten pa'i sgyu ma'i las ④rnams kyang ston⑤/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzugs brnyan yang ston/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdud sde dang bcas pa rnams 'dul ba la sogs pa rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rol pa la sogs pa mdzad pa rnams kyang ston pa nas/ bdag nyid las rnam ⑥pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyang ston pa'i bar du'o/ /ci ste dbang du byed par 'dod na yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems ma'i ⑦rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings la phyag rgya de 'bar bar gyur (8)gyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas de phyin chad phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed cing dbang du byed na sems dpa' gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ci ste 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub 5)par 'dod na yang des dang po kho nar de bzhin du/ zlos shing 7zla ba gcig tu brgyad stong bzlas la 11de nas mthar phyag rgya bcings te de bzhin du mtshan thog thag phyag rgya 'bar gyi bar du khobazlas par bya'o/ /de phyin cad ri phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi dngos grub migang yang rung ba gcig tu 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 84—313

'das 6)rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto(mi// //de nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ de la dang por ni sngar bsnyen pa bya ste/ de ltar ci 'dod pa bzhin du yi ge 'bru 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /de'i mthar mtshan thog thag tu bzlas pa byas la de phyin chad sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa dang / chad pas gcad (7par nus par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /'on te bsgrub 47par 'dod na yang / des ji lta ba bzhin du ri mo'i sku gzugs bris la/des de bzhin du mchod pa byas nas zla ba gcig tu 'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing ci dga' ba bzhin du byas nas brgya stong du bzlas par dus bzhir rdo rje'i tshig gis zlos shing 5zla ba'i mthar phyin pa dang / ri mo'i gzugs la mchod pa rgya cher byas nas rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya bcings (7)la phyag rgya bcings pa de las hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgra byung gi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs pa dang lha rnams kyi dbang po (77dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mdun du gnas nas bka' nod par 'gyur ro(rnyi/ /de nas rig (9)'dzin gyis 'di skad du bsgo bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe ngas khyod tshur shog 'di byos shig /ces bsgo ba de'i tshe na khyod 'dir 'ongs la nga'i bka' bzhin byos shig /de phyin cad nga'ajig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi bdag por 'gyur te/ yud tsam gyis kyang sa gsum pa thams cad la ci dgar bka' stsol cing bskor te/ slar 'ongs nas kyang phan gdags pa dang / chad pas gcad 11pa rnams byed cing lha 84wa 314

rdzas kyi 'jig rten gsum tu)longs spyod ②la nye bar spyad nas ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du byed cing lha thams cad kyi dbang po'i bud med la sogs pa bud med thams cad mgu bar byas nas/ nye bar spyad ①kyang de la su gang gis ④byas kyang gnod par byed nus pa med de hūṃ zhes bya bas lha la sogs pa ma rungs pa thams cad gnon cing de nas bskal pa chung ngu'i stong gi bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste phyag rgya bsgrub par 'dod pa rgyan yang ji lta ba bzhin du bzlas pa ⑥byas la bzlas pa'i ⑦mthar rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la/ mtshan thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o / /de nas nam langs pa dang phyag rgya 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang ldan par ji lta ba'i (8)cho ga bzhin du/ phyag rgya bcings na nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / gzugs sna tshogs (9)ston pa dang / mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / sgyu ma rnams ston pa dang / thams cad la dbab pa dang /dgug pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / thams cad kyi dga' ba bskyed yipar bya ba dang / rin po che thams cad 'phrog pa tsho1)dang / 'od zer 'bar ba chen po bstan pa dang / rin po che'i char 'bebs par bstan pa dang / gad tunyemo cher bgad (1nyepa dang / sems can thams cad sbyang ba dang / gcad skepa dang /dbye ba dang / dus kyi tso'akhor los sgyur 57ba dang / ji lta ba tsho bzhin pa'i de kho na nyid brjod pa dang / las thams cad la 'jug pa dang / bsrung ba dang / rmongs pa dang / gnon pa dang / bsdigs 51 pa dang / bsad pa dang / sems can thams cad phyag rgya nyugegadab pa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba la 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ri rib dang / dngos po thams cad glu len du 84—315

gzhug 6)pa dang / gar byed du gzhug pa dang / dgug ②pa dang / gzhug pa dang ske/ bcing ba dang / dbab ①pa la sogs pa las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste rdo rje phra mo bsgrub 6)par 'dod na yang des rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin du bsgom zhing de bzhin du bzla sa pa'i tshul gyis zla ba gcig tu bsgrub par bya ste de nas mthar ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyis mtshan gcig 8thog thag bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs 6)pa dang mngon par shes pa lngar gyur nas sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa dang / tshar gcad ⑦pa nus par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste las bsgrub ⑧par 'dod na de bzhin du zlos zhing zla ba gcig tu bsgrub la 99)de nas mthar mtshan gcig thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de nas las rnams byed par 'dod na yang lan cig brjod de/ yid kyis bsam pas bsrung 7ba la sogs pa las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro1sto/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto12// //de nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ de la dang por 'bum bzlas pa byas na bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bsgrub par bya ste ras la bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba la sogs pa bris la1 / de'i phyogs thams cad du dkyil 'khor bzhi'i tshul du sems dpa' chen po 'bazhi bris la grwa rnams su lha mo rnams bri'o/ /de nas bzlas pa'i cho ga de 84—316

bzhin du rgyas par byas la zla ba'i mthar mtshan gcig thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba thams cad 'dul bar byon te/ dus ji bzhin par dam pa'i skabs 'byed par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste phyag rgya bsgrub 6)par 'dod na yang des ②de bzhin du pad+ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings la stong phrag brgyad tshang bar brjod pa'i bar du dus bzhir bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mthar mtshan gcig thog thag tu phyag rgya bcings te bzlas pa byas la nam langs pa dang dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings pas ji lta ba bzhin (ge'agro ba thams cad 'dul bar byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /ci ste ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du (thubasgrub par 'dod na yang de bzhin du zla ba'i mthar mtshan gcig thog thag tu ji ltar dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bzlas par (5)bya'o/ /de nas nam langs pa dang ting nge 'dzin thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas (6)gsungs so/ /ci ste las bsgrub (7)par 'dod na yang de bzhin du bzlas la zla ba'i mthar mtshan (shethog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto9// //de nas nor bu'i nyu rigs kyi nye bar spyod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/de la dang po kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag nyu1 rnam bzhi byas la 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du ras la bcom ldan 'das don 84—317

thams cad grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i tshul du bris la/ de nas 6)de bzhin du bsgrub 92la zla ba'i mthar mtshan gcig thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs pa dang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sridabang bskur ba'i rin po che/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po byon nas dbang bskur ba sbyin pa mdzad do/ /dbang bskur ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams der rig 'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur ④bar 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste phyag rgya bsgrub ⑤par 'dod na yang de bzhin du chos kyi rdo rje ma'i tshul rdo rje rin po che'i myu gu'i ⑥phyag rgya/ ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs 97)na bsam pa thams cad kyi las byed par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /ci ste nor bu ye shes bsgrub 87par 'dod na yang de bzhin du rdo rje (9)rin po che 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin / ji lta ba'i 7rim pa bzhin du bsgom pa (nyabyas te dngos po med pa'i nam mkha' las rin chen nyi ji ltar 'byung ba rin po che las byang chub sems dpa'i sku ji ltar 'byung 1 zhes bya ba'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin 'di dus bzhir bsgoms la ji ltar gong du smos pa bzhin du bzlas par skabya'o/ /de nas zla ba'i mthar ting nge sa'adzin de nyid kyis mtshan gcig thog thag tu bzlas par 1 bya'o/ /de nas nam langs pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byon nas/ ci dga' ba bzhin du dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro 1nyazhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /de nas las bsgrub 19pa bshad de/ de bzhin du bzlas la ( )zla ba'i mthar mtshan gcig thog thag 2lhabazlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam langs pa dang bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur 84—318

ro / /de nas las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /nor bu'i 1)rigs kyi nye bar sbyong ba'i ②cho ga rgyas pa cardogs sto(gu// //de nas rigs thams cad kyi thun mong du bsgrub ④pa'i yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ de la dang por snying po thams cad kyi yo byad dang cho ga rgyas par (5)bshad do/ /snying po bsgrub (6)par 'dod na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi grub par gyur cig ces brjod la snying po ci dga' bar bzlas shing bsgrub (7)pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i yo byad dang cho ga ste/ phyag rgya thams cad bdag la dga' bar gyur cig ces smras la dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te ci dga' bar ci nus kyis bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas ci lta ba bzhin du darngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di ni sngags thams cad kyi (8)yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa ste/spros pa med pa'i tshig grub par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin bdag la skye bar gyur cig ces smras la sngags ci dga' bar bzlas pa byas te (9)'di ni dngos grub bo/ /de la 'di ni rig pa'i yo byad dang cho ga rgyas pa ste/ kye tsosems can 'di dag thams cad ni ma rig pas ldongs par 'gyur(1 / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni rig pa rtogs shing sdom par gyur to zhes smras la/ rig pa ci dga' bar /2bzlas shing bsgrub par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de nas snying po dang /sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / rig 1 pa thams cad ji dzaltar bsgom skipa nyid du rdo rje bzlas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ sems pa (7gang gi snying po dang /84wa 319

phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig pa rnams bzlas pa'i don du bsgrub par bya ba de ni bdag gam sems dpa' bsgoms na bsgrub par bya ba 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad nya kyi thun mong midu bzlas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs sto(kyi// //de nas rigs thams cad kyi thun mong du bsgrub ( dpa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di lta ste / de la dang po kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs kyi dngos grub ni 'di lta ste/ nor 'grub 57pa'i dngos grub dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi dngos grub dang /rig po 'dzin nyid du 'grub pa dang / dngos grub chen po rnams so/ /de la nor 'grub pa ni 'di yin te/ gang na gter yod par dogs ( pa der phyag rgya bcings la rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyis gter gyi gnas der/ (8)rdo rje blta (9)bas blta tshab na/ ci ste rdo rje lta bu yar bar mthong na/ de na gter yod par shes par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje lcags sgrog 17gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te sa brkos tshal ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du blangs na rtsod pa med par thob par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi dngos grub 'grub pa yin te/ phyag rgya gang sgrub par byed na badz+ra sid+dhi zhes brjod par bya'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi dngos grub ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ de ni 'di ltar chu'i steng nas par 'gro zhing 'dug pa la sogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi gzugs ston pa dang / ji srid du dga' ba de srid du 12mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / dpag tshad stong gi steng du lding ba dang / 'og tu 'gro zhing 'ong ba dang / phyogs 84—320

thams cad du dpag tshad stong du ci dga' bar song la bskor te yo)slar 'ong ba dang / dpag tshad stong kho ra (mikhor yug gi sems can thams cad kyi bsam ⑧pa shes pa dang / dngos po thams cad mig gis mthong zhing rna bas thos pa dang /phyogs thams cad du dpag tshad stong khor yug na gnas pa'i bud med thams cad ci dga' bar 'phang lidu blangs te 'dug pa dang / gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig (gel sogs pa'i dbyig thams cad dang / nor thams cad phrogs (6)nas kyang sus kyang (7)cung zad kyang brgal ri mi nus te/ bdag gi rdo rjes kyang mi thub par 'gyur na/ gzhan gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ skyes bu stong phrag bcu bsdams kyi)pa'i stobs dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu nad med pa dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu 'dod pa thams cad 7longs spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / rtag tu dar la bab cing lha'i gzugs dang ldan pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong zhing rdo rje'i dngos grub bla na med pas mchod pa byed cing lo /7stong phrag bcu bzhi'i bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje tsodangos grub kyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje rig 'dzin gyi 51 dngos grub 'grub pa yin te/ phyag rgya sgrub r+shapa na rdo rje rig (ge'adzin ces brjod la 'grub pa dang /rdo rje rig 'dzin gyis 'khor los sgyur 'bar 'gyur te/ 'dod pa thams cad la longs spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skad cig gis bskor te/ slar 'ong zhing bde ba thams cad la yongs su spyod skopa dang /lo brtswa dzi brgyad pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa dang / skra 'khyil ba dang ldan pa dang /rdo rje chen po'i rig 'dzin du gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /84—321

rdo rje sems dpa' thams cad mthong zhing bskal pa chen po'i bar du gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig 6)'dzin gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni dngos grub chen po 'grub pa yin te/ bdag nyid phyag rgya'i snying po don du bdag nyid kyis phyag rgya bsgrubs na sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur nas skad cig gcig gis kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gzugs sna tshogs kyis bya ba sna tshogs byed pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpar bcas pa thams cad mthong nas rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pas yang dag par mchod nas sems can ma lus shing 9gelus pa med pa rnams kyi don byas nas slar 'ongs te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad (5)rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'dod pa thams cad dang / bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad la spyod cing rdo rje sems dpa' (cadang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' (5)chen por gyur nas tshe'i tshad ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i bskal pa chen po'i tshad du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs kyi dngos grub chen pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi cadangos grub ste/ de yang 'di ltar 7gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub dang / dbang thams cad kyi dngos grub dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad kyi dngos grub dang / dngos grub dam pa rnams so/ /de la 'di ni 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub yin te/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcings la dbang phyug chen po 8rkang pa 9g.yon pas mnan te bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas gzugs de skad 'byin pa dang hūm̐ zhes bya bar skabarjod par bya'o/ /hūm̐ 84—322

zhes brjod pa tsam gyis dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams sgrub ①pa'i mdun du bka' nyan cing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /da ②phyin cad (5)'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur te/ nam mkha' la 'gro zhing 'jig rten gsum po 'khor lo thams cad kun du bskor te/ slar 'ongs nas lha ma stirungs pa la sogs pa sems can thams cad hūm̐ zhes bya bas 'dul bar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje (5sartsu zhes bya ba'i gzugs dang ldan pas 'jig rten gsum po thams cad la bka' 455 cing rdo rje sems dpar bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong nas mnyes par byed cing lo stong du 'tsho bar byed par (6chibacom ldan 'das rdo rje rtsu zhes byed pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni dbang thams cad kyi dngos grub ste/ phyag rgya bsgrub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i ri75rin po che'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas dang por bdag nyid (8)dbang bskur la bsgrub par bya ste/ de nas grub pa dang dbang rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ rdo rje'i dbang dang / rin po che'i dbang dang / chos kyi dbang dang / las kyi dbang rnams so/ /de la rdo rje'i dbang thob na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che'i dbang thob na rin po che thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi dbang gis ni chos thams cad kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /las kyi dbang gis ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang gis gsungs so / /de la 'di ni bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad kyi dngos grub ste/ de 84—323

yang 'di ltar rtag tu gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byas na0)/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad kyis rigasungs so/ /de la 'di ni dngos grub dam pa ste/ de yang ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bdag mnyam mo zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so / /de la 'di dag ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dngos grub rnams te/ de ni 'di ltar mnyes par bya ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / bsrung (kyeb dang / pad+ma'i dngos grub rnams so/ /de la mnyes par bya ba'i dngos grub ni 'di yin te/ji ltar pad+ma 'dod pa bsgoms na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa sems can thams cad mnyes par byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug rjes su dran par byas na sems can thams cad dbang du byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /byams pas 'gengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gro ba thams cad bsrung cab dang / sba ba dang / bskyab nus par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid pad+ma'i ting nge 'dzin du zhugs la pad+ma lag par blangs te bsgrubs na 'jig rten dbang 5phyug gi gzugs dang ldan pa dang / rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan zhing lo stong phrag bzhir 'tsho bar 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pad+mas gsungs so/ /de la 'di dag ni nor bu'i (tshinorigs kyi dngos grub rnams te/ de yang 'di ltar rigs thams cad kyi dbang gi dngos grub dang / gzi brjid chen po dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rin po che'i dngos grub rnams so/ /577de bzhin gshegs pa 84—324

thams cad kyi dbang gi dngos grub ni 'di lta ste/ nyid kyis dbang dbul ba dang / mar me dbul ba dang / ci nus kyis 0)sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par (mibya ba dang / rin po che bsgrub pa'i dngos grub 'di dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (5)mchod na ring po mi thogs par 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po ches gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi thun mong ba'i dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa rdzogs stob// //de nas rtog (5)pa thams cad kyi thabs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la dang po kho nar ni (5)snying po thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'jig rten 'dul ba ji lta bar/ /de 'dra bar ni dngos grub 'dod/ /de yi thabs ni phyag rgya ste/ /dngos grub chen po kun sbyin no/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i thabs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'jig rten 'dul ba chags bral min/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub chags las skyes/ /de yi thabs ni bsgom (7༄pa ste/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi thabs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/bden las 'jig rten 'di nyams pas/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /spros pa med pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchos tu 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rig (8)pa thams cad kyi 9dngos grub kyi rgyud dengo / ma rig mun (17chags 'di la ni/ /rig pa'i dngos grub yod min te/ /de yi thabs lco rani rgya che ba yon/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog thob bo/ /rtog sapa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 84—325

do / /de nas rtog (1)pa thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs so / /de la dang po kho nar ni snying po thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi dngos grub ②kyi rgyud de/ mchod pa rnam bzhi byas nas ni/ /bsod nams chen po thob 'gyur te/ /bsod nams med kyang sangs rgyas mchod/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i bsod nams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/dam tshig gsang ba bsrungs na ni/ /bsod nams chen po thob 'gyur te/ /bsod nams med kyang myur bar ni/ /dam tshig bsrungs na myur du 'grub/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi bsod nams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ sangs rgyas mtshan la sogs brjod na/ /bsod nams chen po 5thob 'gyur te/ /bsod nams med kyang myur bar ni/ /chos sbyin pas ni 94)dngos grub 'thob/ /de la 'di ni rig 5pa'i bsod nams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ bsod nams nang na sbyin pa mchog /byin na bsod nams thob 'gyur te/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs na/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub/ /rtog (6)pa thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de nas rtog 97)pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nagasungs so/ /de la dang po kho nar snying po shes rab kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ yi ge a la 'jug byed cing / /yi ge thams cad rnam bsgoms la / / rang gi kha nas gzhan zhal du/ /79bsgoms na bsod nams thob par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam pa'i dpal gyis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i shes rab kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 84—326

de / shes rab nges 'bigs zhes bya ba/ /ting nge 'dzin ces grags pa ste/ /des ni phyag rgya myur 'grub par/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das shes rab mchog gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi shes rab kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ shes rab sgra yi rjes 'brang ba/ /ting 'dzin tshig ni rab spros pa/ /de bsgoms na ni myur ba yang / /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje blos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rig 6)pa'i shes rab kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rig dang sngags dang khyad par du/ /khyad par yod pa ma yin te/ /shes rab bsgoms na myur bar ni / /nges par dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi ②ye shes kyis gsungs so/ /rtog (kyepa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas rtog ④pa thams cad kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud bshad par bya'o zhes bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la dang po kho nar snying po thams cad tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ mchod pa thams cad rab byas na/(5no dge ba yi ni chos rnams kyi/ /tshogs ni rnam par 'phel 'gyur te/ /de nas tshogs ni 'grub par 'gyur46)/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/'khor lo mang por zhugs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor mang por bris pa'i phyir/ /tshogs rdzogs pas na phyag rgya rnams/ /dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ rjes su yi rangs ( skal sogs tshul/ /de bzhin dam pa'i chos bklags 58)dang / /bzlas pa mang po byas nas 95ni/ /nges par sngags kyi khodangos grub 'thob11ri/ /de la 'di ni rig pa'i 84—327

tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ ma rig rab tu spangs pa dang / /sbyin pa'i pha rol 0)phyin tshul phyir(mi/ /tshogs ni ①yongs su rdzogs nas kyang / /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rtog ④pa thams cad kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi (snyergyud rdzogs sto4)// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rigs thams cad kyi mtshan ma byung (7)ba'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so//de la ji ltar rdo rje 'byung zhe na/ /de nyid bcom ldan sems dpa' ste/ /thams cad sems de nyid bdag po/ /sku dang gsung dang (8)thugs rdo rje13/ /sems dpa' rang byung brtan pa ste7/ /sems dpa' kun gyi mchog sems dpa'/ /rdo rje snying gar rab bsgoms na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes grags te(me/ /'di la rdo rje rab tu gnas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ye shes tshul te mnyam pa med12/ /snying las (12sna tshogs byung nas ni/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs 'gyur te/ /khams kun gyi ni rdul grangs su7/ /de dag nyid ni rgyal ba yin/ /rdo rje'i sku ni de dag skalas/ /rdo rje sems dpar yang dag 'gyur/ /sems dpa' dang po las de nyid / /mtshan ma thams cad yang dag 'byung (me/ /mtshan ma las ni sems dpa' che/ /de las tshul 'di thams cad 'byung / /gang gis 'di ni thos 'gyur 18la/ /dad 19cing 'dzin byed snying gar yang / /rtag tu dga' bas bsgoms nas ni tshoni/ /de dag myur du dngos grub 67thob/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas ni gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud do/ /de 84—328

nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rtog pa thams cad 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi cho ga 6)rgyas pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la dang po kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rtog ②pa thams cad cha'abyung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud 'di yin ④te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes ni/ /rtag tu rnam smin rtog las byung / /⑤mi rtog pa yi ye shes las/ / de phyir rtag ⑥pa zhes brjod do/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rtog ⑦pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de / mi rtog gang la rtog nyid du/ /brtags pas rtog las (kyebyung ba ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /de phyir rtog pa zhes brjod do/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi rtog pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ cho ga bzhin du ri mor bris/ /rtog pa grub sbyin zhes brtags pa6nye/ /rtog dang 7bral ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /de phyir rtog pa zhes gsungs so/ /tustede la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi rtog pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ rtog pa las ni 'dod chags 'byung / /pad+ma la ni de gnas te/ /de phyir rtog la gnas pa ni/ /grub pa nyid du de 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi rtog pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de / rtog pa med pa'i nor bu ni/ /mthu yis shin tu mchog tu 'gyur/ /de ltar rnam par mi rtog pas/ /lha rdzas dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi rtog pa 'byung ba'i rgyud do/ /de nas rtog pa thams cad kyi snying po 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ yid kyis /she'adod pa'i cho ga yis/ /yid kyis 'dod pa 'grub 'gyur tshogete / /ting 'dzin bsgrub 7pa snying la gnas/ /de phyir snying po zhes brjod do/ /de nas rtog pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ ji ltar rgyal 84—329

po'i phyag rgya mchog /khrims ni 'da' ka mi phyed bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po gzugs brnyan gyis/ /mtshan ma phyag rgya zhes par grags/ /de nas rtog pa thams cad kyi sngags 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ 'da' bar bya ba ma yin zhing / /dbye bar dka' la 1)gsang ba nyid/ /gsang ba grub phyir brjod pas na / /de yi phyir ni kyisngags zhes brjod/ /de nas rig (5)pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud de/ ma rig (gepa ni gzhom pa dang / /ngag gi rig mchog 'grub pa'i phyir / /rtogs shing rig pa 95chodangos grub ste/ /de phyir rtog pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /rtog pa thams cad kyi snying po la sogs pa 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud do/ /de nas rtog pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi 67rgyud de/ de la dang po kho nar snying po'i ye shes skye ba'i rgyud yin te / snying po bzlas te bdag gam ni/ /gzhan yang rung ste byung ba na/ /byung ⑦dang 'byung 'gyur gang gis ni/ /mthong zhing thos 'gyur shes par bya/ /de la 'di ni phyag rgya'i ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyud yin te/ bdag gi /cho ga ji bzhin du//gang yang rung ba'i phyag rgya bcings/ /'jig rten pa la bltas nas 99)ni/ /gong ma bzhin du kun shes 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni 3 nisngags kyi ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyud yin te11/ lan cig tsam yang sngags brjod na/ /'das dang 'byung dang byung gang yin/ /rang gi lce la smra 1ge'agyur ba/ /de dag thams cad bden par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rig pa'i ye shes skye ba'i rgyud de/ rig pa lan cig brjod na ni/ /byung dang 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur rnams/ /ji ltar rdo rje'i bka' 12bzhin du/ /yid kyis de ni shes par 'gyurami(/ /rtog pa thams cad kyi 84—330

ye shes skye ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rdzogs sgo6)// //de nas rigs thams cad kyi thun mong ②gi gsang ba'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub (0pa'i rgyud yin no/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sku'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa yin te/ ji ltar de ltar ④'dug nas kyang / / skyil mo krung (5)bcas bsgrub bya ste/ /ji ltar ri mo'i tshul byas nas / /sems dpa' chen po grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sku'i phyag rgya sgrub 6nyepa yin te/ ji ltar ri mo'i tshul du ni/ / brgyad bsgrub 9)tshul du rab tu gnas(8)/ /shin tu khros nas bsgrub (9)byas na/ /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sku'i phyag rgya bsgrub 7pa'i rgyud yin te/ rdo rje skyil mo krung 5nyebacas la/ /lag gnyis rdo rje bcings nas kyang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi sku yi gyur la/ /pad+ma 'byung ba bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i sems dpas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sku'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa yin te/ ji ltar 'dug gam nyal ba'am/ /'chag kyang rung ste de ltar ni/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur na/ /the tshom yi med par 'grub par 'gyurayi/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 7rigs kyi gsang ba'i gsung gi phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud de/ lce rtse shin tu mi bsgul zhing / /so dang mchu gnyis sbyar nas ni/ /rtog yipa thams cad bsgrub bya zhing / /sgra bral rdo rje'i tshig yin 84—331

no / /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gsung 0)gis gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i gsung gi phyag rgya bsgrub (9pa'i rgyud de/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba 'brug sgrar bsgrags/ /khro bo'i ngag ni zab cing bstan/ /rdo rje chen po khro bo'i gsal / /rdo rje khro bo'i gsung 'grub bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i gsung gi phyag rgya bsgrub 55)pa'i rgyud de/ dbugs mi 'byin ltar dbugs 'byin cing / /phra ba'i tshig ni shin tu gsal/ /ting 'dzin ye shes snying po yis/ /zlos pa po rnams grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes kyi snying pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i gsung gi phyag rgya bsgrub ④pa'i rgyud de/ shin tu yongs su gsal tshig gis/ /rtag tu 'dud (5)la brtson byed cing / /tshul 'di bzlas par gyur na ni/ /myur du thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sems kyi phyag rgya bsgrub (67pa'i rgyud de/ rtag tu 'dod pa bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can thams cad bde sbyin pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid du/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'dod pas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sems kyi phyag rgya bsgrub (77pa'i rgyud de/ sems can kun la phan pa dang / /ma rungs pa rnams gdul ba dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung (nyaba'i phyir/ /khro bo dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni 84—332

pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sems kyi phyag rgya bsgrub 6)pa'i rgyud de/ ji ltar pad+ma rab chags la/ /bsgos ②pa'i skyon gyis mi gos pa/ /de ltar bdag gis chags (kyeskyon yang / /srid na chags pa de 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das pad+ma bzhad (gepas gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i sems kyi phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud de/ nam zhig sems can thams cad kyi/ /dgos pa'i don ni kun sgrub cing / /rin chen char ni 'bebs 'gyur zhes/ /grub na myur bar de 'grub bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so / /de la 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub (5)pa'i rgyud de/ ji ltar langs sam 'dug pa'am/ /'chag kyang rung ste de ltar ni/ /lag pa g.yon pas phyag rgya mchog /thams cad byed na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba phyag rgya rdo rjes gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud de/ de lta de ltar gnas nas kyang / /ji lta ji ltar byed kyang rung / /rdo rje khro bo mdzub (neramo bcings/ /gos kyis g.yogs na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud de/ lag ni 57)g.yon pas pad+ma yi(8)/ /khu tshur bcings te sbas nas ni/ /ji dgar myur du pad+ma yi/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par 'gyur / /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub 59)pa'i rgyud de/ g.yon pa'i rin chen khu tshur ni/ /bcings te dam pa'i lag 84—333

g.yogs la/ /ci dga' bar ni rim gror 0)byed/ /rin chen dngos grub thob par 'gyur②/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos gsungs so/ /de la 'di ni rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba'i thun mong gi phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud de/rang gi sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du ni/ /rdo rje dag dang rdo rje'i lta/ /ring por mi thogs mchog 'grub bo/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpas (gugasungs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i rgyud rdzogs stoge // //de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (5)bos nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rtog pa 'di ni 6)byin gyis brlab (7)par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas yang legs so zhes bya ba 'di byin no/ /rdo rje'i theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang 8tsho/ /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo 'di legs par bshad pas 9na/ / legs so bordo rje sems dpa' khyod(mi/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod yonalegs so/ / rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /(gyerdo rje las kha)ni khyod legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus (7pa las rgyud thams cad kyi phyi ma'i phyi ma'i kergyud rdzogs sto1 tsho// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 48chen po phyag na rdo rje stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa tshoge'adis gsol ba 84—334

btab bo/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sems dpa' 0)che/ /sems can don mchog bdag nyid can/ /shākya'i rgyal po ye shes che/ /rdo rje bdag nyid khyod phyag 'tshal / /sems dpa' 'byung ba de nyid don/ /sems can rgyu ste tshul chen po/ /sems can don chen dgos pa'i don/ /sems dpa' sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal / /sangs rgyas chos ni chos chen po/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab skor ba/ /smra ba chen po rab rig mchog /sems dpa' chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /las chen bsrung (5)ba chen po ste/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub ①pa/ /bdag nyid chen po 'gro spyod mchog /sems dpa' rgyu 0khyod phyag 'tshal lo pa rol phyin pa kun brnyes pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mkhyen pa po/ /sems dpa' kun te thabs chen po/ /shes rab chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje chen po mchog gi mchog /thugs rje thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /thams cad gtong ba byams pa che/ /kun mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya seng ge shākya che/ /shākya shākya thub pa che/ /'dul ba chen po khyab pa po/ /'gro don 'dul mchog khyod phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam brnyes pa/ /chos dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ /rdo rje mgon po mgon chen po/ /sems can tshogs ni khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'od chen snang ba chen po ste/ /brtson 'grus chen po stobs chen po/ /dpa' bo chen po rab dpa' mchog /bde spyod dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal / /tshangs pa rang 'byung bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya dpa' bo thub pa che/ /kun bdag thub pa dag pa yi/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i sku ste sku yi mchog /sku gsum sku min sgom pa po/ /kun gyi sku ste sku che ba/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung min gsung ste gsung gi mchog /gsung 84—335

gsum 0stegasung min ston pa po/ /gsung kun shin tu gsung che ba/ /rdo rje'i gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems min sems te sems kyi mchog /sems gsum sems min ston pa po/ /thams cad sems te sems che ba/ /rdo rje sems khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdor (mimin rdo rje rdo rje'i mchog /rdo rje gsum pa rdor min sbyong / /rdo rje thams cad rdo rje che/ /rdo rje rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kun khyab srid pa'i rtse mo mchog /bde gshegs bdag po rgyal ba ni/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ /snang mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad )'di dag ni/ /gang gis skad cig nyan byed dam/ /klog gam yang na sgom 4pa'ang rung / /kun gyis sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed nas kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor (snye/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos bka' stsal pa'i tshig gsan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bos nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yang gcig tu 'du bar mdzad par gsol/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtag par 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor(67/ /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi mdun du rdul phra mo thams cad ji snyed pa'i dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 84—336

thub pas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gyur to/ /de nas yang ①byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtag par 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i (misna tshogs pa'i/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor(mi/ /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul phra mo thams cad ji snyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams su/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dbyings kyis rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i 'khor lo thams cad rab tu bskor bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtag par 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor④/ /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra mo thams cad (zheji snyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams su/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos tshigs su bcad (6)pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtag par 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul bar sna tshogs pa'i/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor(7 / /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin rte phra mo (5)ji snyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams su/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi rgyal pos pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu 84—337

bskor hunyebar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying pos tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtag par 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul bar sna tshogs pa'i/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi ②khongs su gtogs pa'i sems can phra ba'am/ sbom pa yang rung / de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ri rab ri'i rgyal po rtse mo rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / rin po che las byas pa'i khang bu brtsegs par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (migadan la bzhegs nas/ rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i 'khor lo thams cad rab tu bskor bar phyogs kun nas mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /mi yi nang du babs nas kyang / /dgos phyir sems can kun gyi don/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo mchog bskor zhing / /mgon po rab tu bsgrub par mdzod/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa tsho la bos nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /95)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang gcig tu 'du ba 96)mdzad du gsol/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rjer bdag nyid du 7gyur par mkhyen nas phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyed nakyang nga'i thugs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /84—338

rigs 6)thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs su zhugs shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snang bas gotshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /mdor (8)na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /zhugs nas sems can thams cad la/ /phan pa'i phyir ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ de bzhin gshegs pha ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams las/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i sku 'phro ba mdzad pa rnams kyang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thams cad dang / gsung thams cad 'jug pa'i gnas dang / sems kyi rgyud 'byung ba thams cad dang / rdo rje'i tshul thams cad dang / yan lag dang /nying lag thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang / mtshan thams cad dang /dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i khung bu thams cad dang / rdul shin tu phra mo snyed kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / thugs rnams su zhugs nas bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon pa zhig na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rjer de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du bdag nyid gyur par mkhyen nas/ ri rab ri'i rtse mo nas snying po 54)byang chub pa 55nagang 84—339

na ba 0༄der gshegs nas ched du bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi shing drung du 'jig rten pa dang mthun (snyepar bya ba'i phyir rtswa blangs nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma (gesems can brtan zhi)pa yi/ /sems can don ni bdag don mchog /gang phyir gdul dbang brtan pa rnams/ /mu stegs lta bas 55steganas par mdzad/ /mdor na mi 'dul 'jig rten pa/ /lta ba ngan pas ldongs 65pa rnams/ /ye shes snang bas dag bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la (7de kho na nyid mi shes pas 'di skad du kye dge sbyong ji byang chub kyi phyir/'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag cing mi bzad pa la bzod (nyapar mdzad dam zhes gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rtswa 59)de bting ste steng du bzhugs nas lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /grogs po rnams/ kho bos byang chub thob par sgrubs 7shig /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu (sternams kyis 7bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don ma rtogs nas/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gang na ba der dong nas ched du lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin la de ltar gyur pa 'di brjod do/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi tshogs kyis bskor te/ gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po la snyostede ltar gyur pa 'di (7)dag brjod do/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha thams cad dang / lhan cig tu 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi bdag po dbang phyug chen po la de ltar gyur pa rnams brjod do/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi bdag po dbang phyug chen pos lha rnams kyi bdag po mthu 84—340

bo che la sogs pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten dang mthun ①par mdzad cing / yang bla na med par (5)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ston gyis/ 'di ltar 'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa ma yin no ③snyam du shes par ma byed cig④ /lha nyid las de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur gyis/ lha de dag nyid du bsgrub par bya'i(5sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du ni 6)ma yin no/ /de legs kyis der mchod du (ge'adong bar sgrub (shebo/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi bdag po 6)dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa snying po tu )byang chub gang na ba dang /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por byang chub par bzhugs pa gang na ba der dong nas/ ched du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal (/nyate/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ ran gyi snyonagadan 'di las bzhengs la/ lha rdzas kyi gdan la bzhugs te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lha'i bdag po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /grogs po rnams/ kho bo la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sbyin par sgrubs (steshig /de nas de bedag gis 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das bdag mgis bstsal khebar mi nus sotsho / /ci ste bdag cag gis nus par gyur na/ bdag cag nyid yang dag par rdzogs par /shesangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid gsal bar mdzad cing / yang tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /de ni gzugs min gzugs 84—341

min min/ /bden min brdzun min gtsang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /rtogs na rgyal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas lha'i dbang po de dag gis cung zad cig cang mi smra bar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rtswa'i gdan las bzhengs te/ lha de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /grogs po rnams/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'di lta bu rtogs par bya ba sgrubs (15shig /de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ bdag cag gis (nanarngo mi thogs so ni/ /de nas yang (cirabacom ldan 'das kyis (5)gdan de nyid la bzhugs bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /yid kyis rab tu rtogs pas na/ /byang chub sems ni brtan par byos/ /sems dpa' rdo rje brtan byas la/ /sangs rgyas su ni bdag sgoms 6)shig / de nas (7)de dag gis 'di skad du/ de lta bu legs so zhes bya ba thams cad kyis smras nas dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan mo de'i tho rangs 'jig rten dang mthun (8)par bya ba'i phyir/ bdud sde dang bcas pa pham par byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mngon par (9)sangs rgyas nas/ sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad la phan par mdzad pa/'phags pa phyag na rdo rje rang gi thugs la zhugs pa la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dis mngon par bstod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /theg pa chen po tshabadag nyid che/ /snang ba che 6glezhing dag pa che/ /mgon chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus che/ /thabs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dod pa dag pa che/ /kun gyi bde ba bde ba che/ /bde mchog thog ma tha 84—342

ma med/ /bzhad 6)chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyes pa che/ /legs zhes bya ba rab mnyes pa/ /mnyes pa che zhing dgyes pa che/ /rab dgyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rin chen rgyal po che/ /dbang bskur bzang po bdag po che/ /rin chen thams cad mdzes pa che/ /rnam rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gzi brjid gzi brjid che/ /'od chen lham pa chen po ste/ /rgyal ba'i 'od de 'bar ba che/ /sangs rgyas 'od khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan dbal che ba/ /rgyal mtshan che bas nor rab gtong / /nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan yu ba chemi/ /gtong ba'i rgyal mtshan khyod phyag 'tshal(mi/ /rdo rje bzhad pa bzhad pa che/ /dgyes pa che zhing rab dgyes pa/ /dgyes pa'i shugs kyis rol cing dgyes/ /chos dgyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje chos ni chos che ba/ /sems dpa'i chos ni rab sbyong (4)ba/ /sangs rgyas chos te chos rab mchog /'dod chos khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnon po ral gri che/ /shes rab ye shes blo gros che/ /sdig gcod ral gri chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas mtshon khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyu ste 'khor lo che/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo gter chen po/ /dkyil 'khor kun te chos kyi mchog /chos kyi dkyil 'khor khyod phyag 'tshal / /rdo rje gsung ba gsung ba che/ /spros med yi ge chen po ste/ /yi ge med pa bzlas pa che/ /sangs rgyas gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje las te las rab mchog /las chen las rab byed pa ste/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas mchod khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bsrung (5skab go cha che/ /go cha'i mchog ste brtan (phyirapa che/ /bsrung ri rab che zhing snying po che/ /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo che/ /ma rungs thams 84—343

cad skrag byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs chen te/ /bsrung 0)ba mchog khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa phyag rgya che/ /dam tshig chen po bcing ba chel/ /khu tshur chen po phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje khu tshur khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ②phyag bya zhing / /brjod de mchod de bste ①stang bya/ /gang phyir thog ma tha ma med/ /byang chub sems ni khyod yin te/ /khyod la brten nas rgyal ba dang ske/ /dpa' bo byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /byung zhing yang dag 'byung 'gyur bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chos khyod phyag 'tshal lo / /rdo rje las ni khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag par ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /mtshan mchog gis ni khyod bstod pa'i/ /bsod nams gang yin de kun kyang / /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par shog /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /rab dad pas ni lan cig tsam/ /gang gis legs par brjod pa ni/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' (4)chen po phyag na rdo rje la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te/ gsung gcig tu legs so zhes bya ba 'di 957byin no/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi (6)gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo 'di legs par bshad pas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod legs so/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos dzo khyod legs pa ste(8kyi/ /rdo rje las ni khyod 9)legs so'i/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces 17bka' stsal pa dang 1mi/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'phags pa byang chub sems dpar 12bcas pa rang gi thugs la zhugs pa thams 84—344

rdzogs pas na phyag rgya rnams/ /dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni sngags kyi tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ /rjes su yi rang la sogs tshul/ /de bzhin dam pa'i chos klags dang / /bzlas pa mang po byas na ni/ /nges par sngags ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni rig pa'i tshogs kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ma rig rab tu spangs pa dang / /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin tshul las/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs nas kyang / /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rtog pa thams cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud rdzogs sto// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes rigs thams cad kyi mtshan ma 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyi rgyud 'di gsungs so/ /de la ji ltar rdo rje 'byung zhe na/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' ste/ /thams cad sems de nyid bdag po/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ni/ /sems dpa' brtan pa rang byung gi / /sems dpa' kun gyi mchog sems dpa'/ /rdo rje snying khar rab bsgoms na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes grags te/ /'di la rdo rje rab tu gnas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ye shes tshul te mnyam med 'od / /snying las sna tshogs byung nas ni/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs gyur te/ khams gsum kun gyi rdul snyed du//de dag nyid ni thams cad 'byung / /gang gis 'di ni thos gyur la/ /dad cing 'dzin byed snying khar yang / /rtag tu dga' bas bsgoms na ni/ /de ni myur du grub pa thob ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs so/
