chags pa'ang ji lta bu/ /bcing bar bya ba'i las ni ji lta bu/ /'dren pa rnams ni mnyes par ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dir ni gshegs su gsol ba lags/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni ji ltar gdeg par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i bya ba yang ni ①ji ltar bgyi/ / las kyi cho ga'i bya ba ji ltar bgyi/ /②dge ba stug po gsang chen ji lta bu/ /las rnams tha dad bya ba ji lta bu/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan ni ji ltar bgyi / /mchod dang mchod pa'i lan ni ji ltar blang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni 'khor lo ji ltar 'byung / /'khor lo'i rnam pa'i bye brag du zhig mchis/ /dngos dang dngos med ji ltar spang ba lags/ /bla ma gsang byung 'od zer gsang ba cig/ /sbyin sreg 'a༄rnam pa du ru brjod/ /thab khung ji lta bu zhig lags / /sbyin sreg mdor bsdus ji lta bu/ / las rnams ji ltar 'byung ba la / /⑤las rnams rnam pa du ru brjod/ /gsang ba rnams ni rnam pa du/ /mchog tu gsang ba ji ltar brjod/ /de nyid ji lta bu zhig lags/ /phyag rgya nye ba'i phyag rgya ci/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya ji (7ltar lags/ /rigs kyi lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar bsgrub (7bya shin tu bsgrub/ /rdo rje phra mo ji ltar brjod/ /bgegs ni ji ltar bsal bar bgyi/ /mdor na rig pa 'dzin pa dang / /slob dpon ji lta bu zhig lags/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo rnam pa du ru brjod/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid sgrub byed pa'i/ /sna tshogs rtog pa ji lta bu/ /thig rnams rtag rinadapa nyid dang ni/ /dngos grub ji ltar nye bar brjod/ /dngos grub tshogs ni ji lta bu/ /gsang ba kun nas btus pa gsungs / /bdag nyid la ni dbang bskur bar/ /bya ba'i cho ga ji lta bu/ /yang na gzhan dag nyid la ni/ /dbang bskur ba ni ji ltar lags/ /ji ltar 84—437

sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /ting 'dzin ji lta (1)bu zhig lags/ /de nyid rig pa 'di rtag tu/ /rdo rje ye shes ji lta bu/ /gzhan yang dgongs 50pa ji lta bu/ /spyod pa ji lta bu zhig lags/ /gang yang rung ba'i rtags las byung / /ming dang ming med rdzoshes pa'i mtshan/ /las 'bras med par byed po 47dang / /'byin 55cipar byed par phyogang las bshad/ /lus ni nam mkha' bzhin 'byung ba/ /gang las 'byung 7bar brjod par bya/ /ci yi phyir na thar par brjod/ /rnal 'byor pa don ci yin 8brjod/ /rdo rje dbyings ni skyed (97byed pa'i/ /rdo rje phra mo'i rnal 'byor gang / /gzhan yang rang gi rigs dag las/ /rnal 'byor brtul yozhugs ji ltar rtsom17/ /mdor na dbang du bya ba dang / /de nyid gsang ba gang zhig lags/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus pa'i/ /gsang ba rtog chen las gsungs pa/ /dgongs pa rnam pa 12du ma yis/ /gsang ba gsungs shig blo gros che / /rnal 'byor rnam pa du ru brjod/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung du/ /ji ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud du brjod/ /gsang ba'i rigs byung ji lta bu/ /de 1nyani rang byung nyid yin ter/ /khams gsum 'jig rten sa 'og dang / /sa steng skas bla mya ngan 'das/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gsang ba gzhanas / /rdo rje can nyid khyab 'jug rang nyid yin/ /nyi ma zla ba gshin rje drag po nyid/ /rang nyid skye dgu'i bdag ste pha ma yin/ /'gal ba'i tshig ni ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /dri ba'i tshogs 1 gnyis pa 18mdor bstan 19pa'o// //tshangs pa 'jig rten gsum lus dbang phyug che/ /gdung 2 drug tshogs bcas lha'i rigs dkyil 'khor rnams/ /gzhan yang gza' 21dang tshogs sogs gang yin pa/ /nga 2 bdag nyid ces ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /nga ni 'dod pa 84—438

thar ba nga yo)/ /nga ni dmyal ba'i dmyal ba pa/ /nga ni yi dgas (bdud 'gro bdag /tshig de ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang 'dod la chags sems ldan/ /lta bcas tshig ldan 'dzin pa'i lta la chags/ /mu stegs theg dman mngon dga' (bskye dgu'i rigs/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin don rnams rtogs 6)byed cing / /ji skad bshad pa'i sna tshogs rigs dkyil 'khor/ /dag pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas dgongs mi shes/ /rang gi 'dod pas mu ngan (gertog byed pa/ /de la skye dgu'i (6)bdag chen brtse bas gsungs/ /mchod 'os chen po mchog dang ldan pa'i (miganas/ /gsang ba'i dbang (8)mchog mngon bsdus dbye bar gsol6nye/ /skye dgu'i bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gsang mdun du/ /dam tshig mchod pas ji ltar mchod par bya/ /'dod yon lngar 7bcas rol bar byed pa yi(nya/ /dngos grub tshogs mchog chen po thob par 'gyur/ /dman pa'i 'dod las rigs kyi dngos grub 'byung / /dga' snyiba'i tshig dag ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin bha ga ji ltar rtags hu ci 'dra/ /de yi 'jug pa yang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /rdzas de dag ni ji ltar rab tu bsgrubasko/ /'jig rten gsum na dman pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /de nas 'dod chags zhen pas mdangos grub thob/ /'dod chags dag phyir de ni ji ltar rung / /chags bral sdig pas chags dang bral ba la/ /gsang ba bstan 7pas sdig dngos ji ltar 'gyur/ / gtor mas 4 bsod nams mchog thob ji lta bu/ /skye 1shedagu bsad pas bsod nams ji lta bu/ /ma byin blangs pas 19bsod nams 'gyur zhes pa'i/ /'gal ba'i tshig dag ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /dga' ba chen po'i bud med bsten 2 ripa yis/ /tshe 'di la ni sangs rgyas mchog 'grub pa/ /mi gtsang 'dod pa bsten 1pas sangs rgyas 84wa 439

dang ske/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'byung bar ji ltar 'gyur/ /'dir ni brdzun ①dang mtshungs pa'i bsod nams med/ /ji ltar brdzun ni bsod nams ldan par brjod / /'dir ni sems can gzhan bsad bza' bar bya/ /'gal ba'i tshig ni ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /'khor ba spangs kyang chos min 'gyur ba dang / /mya ngan 'das la gzhol ba chos ma yin/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor gyi ni rjes 'jug pa/ /chos min 'gyur zhes ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /dregs dang ser sna sdang ba'i sems ldan pa/ /chos min spyod cing brdzun pa'i tshig (mil chags/ / srid gsum mngon par chags pas rnal 'byor sgrub/ /①'dod pa'i 'dod chags bcas pas rigalhag par rgyal/ /rigs kyi rnal 'byor las byung ji ltar 'grub / /bla med go 'phang dngos grub 'dod pa yis(snye/ /dag cing ngo mtshar ⑥rnal 'byor lhur blang bya/ /skyor ⑦gcin 'thung (8)dang bshang ba za ba yisadhi/ /dag cing mchog gyur rnal 'byor dngos grub 'dod/ /mi gtsang bshang gci zos shing 'thungs pa 7yis/ /yid 'dod dngos grub ji ltar dngos grub 'dod/ /bud med bcas par lhan cig chos spyod cing / / gnyis ka (nyelhan cig gyur pas dag gtsang mchod/ /ji ltar bud med lhan cig dkyil 'khor mchod/ /dngos grub dam pa mchog tu ji ltar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rigs 7'byung kun ldan zhing / /mchog tu mi bzad nyanyedrag po'i las can te/ /dag cing shin tu sdug la mtho bar 'gro/ /'gal ba de ni ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang brdeg dang gsad sapa lhur len cing rki/ /bskrad dang drag pa'i 7las can de dag ni/ /dag cing shin tu sdug la mtho bar 'gro/ /'gal ba de ni ji ltar rung bar 'gyur1 / /gzhan yang bza' dang btung ba lhur len cing / /snying 84wa 440

'byin pa yis dag par 'dod pa nyid/ /de ni dag cing sdug la mtho bar 'gro/ /'gal ba de ni ji ltar rung ba yin/ /gzhan yang nor bu rin chen 'phrog pa yis / /sdug cing bstan la dag cing mthor tu)'gro dang / /gzhan yang nga rgyal ser sna lhur len pas/ /dag par 'gyur ba nyid ni 'gal ba yin/ /gzhan yang las ②kyi rig pa byung ba yis/ /mi dge ba yi galas rnams thams cad bya/ /'khrig sogs las kyi ze tshogs rnam mang po'i/ /las byed pa ni ji ltar skyon mi 'gyur / /gzhan yang brdzun tshig de bzhin 'khrig pa yis/ /dag 'dod ④'phags pa min pas gsang ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i dbang chen 'dod pas bdud rtsi ltar / /sdug cing mthor 'gro ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /kye mgon khyod ni dag pa'i chos kyi (5)tshogs te kyikhyod ni rtag tu rnal 'byor 'gyur/ /kye mgon khyod ni dgyes chen bdud rtsi 'chang ba dam chos gsang ba'i 'byung gnas te/ /kye rgyal khyod ni dri med nyi ma bzhin du mi shes kun du sbyong mdzad pa/ /khyab byed rgyal ba'i ngang tshul 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren chen byang sems dga' ston kye/ /mdor bsdus pa'o// //kun mchog thams cad rig pa ste/ /kun mkhyen dri ma gsum spangs pa(be /byang sems sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid ni/ /ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nyanas kyang / /phyogs rnams kun du gzigs mdzad de54)/ /thub pas mgon rnams rab btud nas/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'di skad gsungs//kye ma'o rnam dag ye shes bdag /kye ma'o sangs rgyas nyer thob pa/ /kye ma'o gar mkhan 'khor lo 'di/ /rang gi ye shes 'dri bar byed/ /rtog pa thams cad kun bsdus pa'i/ /mchog tu gsang ba bshad par bya/ /shin tu rnyed 84—441

dka' dam pa yi/ /rin chen sgrom gyi kha dbye bya/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rgyal mtshan dam pa bsgreng bar bya/ /rin chen sgrom gyi kha phye nas/ /shes rab kyis 1)ni snang bar bya/ /de nas gsang ba mchog gyur pa/ /dam pa yang dag bshad par bya/ /bya ba bsgrub (snyepa'i thabs chen po/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /gsang ba'i bye brag 'byed byed cing / /rnal 'byor dgongs pa rnam par 'grolatsho / /de (genyid dam pa shes byed pa'i/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /rdo rje rnal 'byor cho ga dang / /'khor lo'i rnal 'byor cho ga ste/ /mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya de'i/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /dus gsum khyab pa'i bya bar ldan/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor kun 'byung zhing (5)/ /bya ba kun gyi thabs chen gyi/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor cho gar ldan/ /rdo rje chos ni rab 'jug pa/ /sku gsum zhes bya gsang chen gyi/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /rdo rje rnal 'byor cho gar 6)ldan / /ma rungs thams cad 'dul byed pa/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i / /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /chos kyi rnal 'byor cho gar ldan/ /pad+ma gar mkhan skyed 987byed pa/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /sbyin pa bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rin chen 'khor lo skyed 9byed cing / /byang chub sems dpa' yid ches byed/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs chen po/ /sna tshogs gar mkhan skyed byed pa/ /las kyi rnal 'byor cho ga yi/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang / /de nyid shes shing dgongs pa shes/ /tshul chen mchog ni shes byed cing / /mchog gi dang po sangs rgyas mchog /rtog pa thams cad bsdus 84—442

pa ste/ /go rims ①bzhin du 'jug byed pa'i/ /gcig par sems can bya ba byed / /bya ba chen po mchog zhi ba/ /chos dang longs spyod mchog gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan 'khor lo ni/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyur pa 'di/ /skal ba ji bzhin gsang ji bzhin/ /ji ltar sems can 'dul 'gyur bshad/ /sngon 'gyur 'das pa'i dus su ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na/ /spro ba chen pos ngo mtshar che'i/ /dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad/ /go rims (7bzhin du de yis ni/ /dbang bskur bar du legs thob 'gyur/ /shes rab chen pos pha ①mthar phyin/ /gos kyi dbang ni thob gyur nas/ /'og min stug po nyams dga' bar/ /blo gros chen po bzhugs (༄par gyur/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas mchog 'gyur zhes/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsams nas ni/ /bya ba mthar phyin bdag gis ni/ /sems can don 'byung thob bya zhes/ /bya ba de la dgongs nas ni/ /sngon dang phyi mar bde chen med(5ni/ /chos kyi dga' ba rmad chen po'i/ /dka' ba spyad par bya snyam ste/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs gyur nas/ /bya dka'i bya ba kun ldan de/ /dbugs 56)'byung rngub pa 'gog pa dang / /sems pa (7med cing g.yo ba med/ /lus ni 8)gang yang mi 'gul zhing / /yan lag bskyod 6)par mi byed de/ /de bas g.yo ba med chos mtshe/ /yun ring du ni gnas par gyurayin/ /phyogs bcu yi ni thub nyugedabang po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dgongs 'gyur btu ri/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub dus/ /sdug bsngal bya bar rigs pa min/ /de bas bdag cag kun lhan cig /bskul bar bya phyir 'gro snyam du/ /dgongs nas thams cad rab chas 7te/ /stug po ru ni byon par 84—443

gyur / /byon nas thub pa thams cad kyis/ /bskul ba mchog ni mdzad par 'gyur / /oṃ badz+ra uta ②tiṣ+ṭha ces pa yi/ /rig ②pas se gol brdabs nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun du bslang / /phyogs rnams kun du bltas pa na/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rgya mtsho mthong / /thub pas mgon rnams la btud de/ /bka' ②465 zhes ni gsol ba btab/ /mgon chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis//gsung gcig (gegis ni bka' 0stsal pa/ /sems kyi spyod yul ci 'dra zhes/ /rang gi sems ni so sor rtog⑥ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung thos nas/ /rang gi sems la rtog ⑦bzhin du/ /yun ring du ni gnas pa na(kye/ /sems kyi rnam pa ma mthong ste/ /yan lag kun gyis rab btud nas/ /zhus pa bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /sems kyi rnam pa ma mthong ste/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bum/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun gsungs pa/ /sems kyi spyod yul shes par dka' / /khyod la snying po rab sbyin gyis/ /phra mo'i bzlas pa rab tu spyod/ /oṃ tsit+ta 1)pra ti be dhe ka ro mi/ snying po dag pa blangs nas ⑩ni/ /rang gi sems la rtog 17bzhin du/ /thang cig de la gnas pa na/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du mthong / /de nas sems 'di ci 7zhig yin/ /nyon mongs sa bon can nam ci / /dge ba'am mi dge ba yi sems/ /kun gzhi 1nyas bon can sems sam/ /chos kyi rgyu mthun 7rtogs gyur nas/ /pha rol phyin pa drug bsten pa/ /'di ni sems can dag pa ste/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnas ma yin/ /yun ring 7du ni bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs chen bsags pa ste/ /ji ltar zla ba gang ba 'di/ /dag cing gsal 7la rnyog ma med/ /de bzhin tshogs ni rdzogs pa'i phyir / /sems ni zla ba gang dang mtshungs/ /dngos po yod dang med min pa(me/ /84wa 444

ji ltar zla ba mtshungs nyid yin/ /'on kyang bsod nams ye shes che/ /rdzogs pa zla ba dang mtshungs bstan/ /legs byas tshogs ldan rang sems kyi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong nas ni/ /dga' zhing mgu ba skyes nas kyang / /slar yang tshig tu rab smras pa/ /bcom ldan mgon po bdag gis ni/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun dag cing / /gzung ①dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i/ /rang sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong / /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa/ /thog mar byung ba'i sems 'di bzang / /dang por blo bur nyon mongs rnams/ /byang chub sems kyis dag par byed/ /dngos po thams cad rnam ②spangs pa'i/ /dag pa yi ni snying po 'dis/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub kyi ni sems la rtogs/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta uṅgā da yā ①mi/ snying po dag pa blangs nas ni / /sems kyi dbus su rtog pa na/ /zla ba'i dbus su yang zla ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mthong ba ni/ /thub pa rnams la tshig smras pa/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa dag mthong ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas kun gsungs pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin brtan④/ /brtan par bya ba'i ched du ni/ /de ni legs par bsgrub ⑤par gyis/ /khyod la snying po sbyin bya ste/ /zlos shing de ni brtan ⑥par dgongs/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje chen po sems byed cing / /thang cig so sor brtags pa na/ /shin tu brtan pa mthong gyur nas/ /smras pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su rdo rje mthong / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa yi/ /dbus na rdo rje dang ldan mthong / /de nas sangs rgyas kun gsungs pa/ /lha rnams kun gyi rdo rje che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni skyed ⑦pa yi/ /shin tu brtan pa 'di spros shig /84—445

o badz+ra ād+ma ko3 0)lha/ snying po dag pa blangs nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lus ni ②rnam bsgoms pa / /des (7ni sra brtan khong stong med/ /rdo rje'i sku ni thob gyur nas//smras pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang bdag rdo rje'i skur mthong ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas kun gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam par bsgom4)//oṃ ya thā (3)sarba ta thā ga tā (6)sta thā (7)a haṃ/ snying po dag pa blangs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam bsgoms (7pas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob par 'gyur6)/ /sangs rgyas kun la rab btud nas/ /smras pa bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po bdag la byin rlob cing / /bdag gi byang chub brtan 7par mdzod/ /grags chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis / /rdo rje dbyings kyi tshig thos nas/ /mgon rnams thugs kur zhugs par gyur / /rdo rje yi ni rnal 'byor gsungs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi sa ma bo dhi dṛ nye 17badz+ra ban 1 dha/ grags chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /rig (stesngags chen po thubarjod pa na/ /rdo rje dbyings ni shin tu brtan/ /de nyid ye shes mngon sangs rgyas/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje thugs ka tshominas byung ste/ /chos kyi dbang bskur 7bzhi po yis( 7/ /de tshe thub pa dbang bskur gyur18 / /rdo rje sems dpa' byas pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba/ /'bras bu byang chub sems ldan gang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur yin/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum dag gi/ /sbyin dang sbyin pa'i 'bras bzang dang / /mkha' mtshungs rin chen thob byed pa/ /nor bu rin chen dbang bskur yin/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du ni/ /gzhan gyis dka' ba spyad pa dang / /brtson 'grub kyis ni 'bras bsgrub 19pa/ /rdo rje las kyi skudabang bskur 3lhayin/ /84—446

de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dag /chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul chen te/ /nyon mongs 'dam gyis ma gos pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i dbang bskur yin/ /byang chub sems rdzogs rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi/ /dbang bskur bzhi po de rnams chos kyi dbyings / /de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin yon tan dam pa'i tshogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur bas/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru 'dod/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur bas/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru 'dod/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur bas/ /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /mkha' mtshungs chos nyid snying po can/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur bas/ /sprul pa yi ni sku ru zhi)'dod(9/ /gsang ba bzhi yi dbang bskur bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /thub de rnam snang mdzad chen gyur/ /chos nyid kyang ni yang dag rtogs/ /chos dang ri kyilongs spyod rdzogs par brtag /chos kun dngos po med pa ste/ /mtshan ma med cing gsal byed med/ /mtshan nyid med cing mkha' dang mtshungs/ /dmigs pa rnam par spangs pa ste(4)/ /rang bzhin med cing brjod du med/ /chos kun tshig gi spyod yul min55)/ /gzhan yang gsang bar brtags 6)pa ste/ /de phyir 'dir ni rtogs par brjod/ /rtog pa med pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /chos kyi don 'di ci yin brjod/ /bdag med dngos po yod pa min/ /chos rnams med cing rtog pa med/ /'on kyang chos nyid yang dag rtogs/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par rtogs/ /rtogs ri nopa nyams su myong bar brjod/ /'dir ni ngo mtshar nyid du rtogs ri/ /chos kun gzugs can min pa dang / /gzugs can du yang 'di ru bstan/ /chos kun 84—447

tshig gi spyod yul min/ /sgra ru yang ni 'dir bstan te/ /de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di ru/ /rtog pa rtog pa yin par brjod/ /ci phyir 'di ni ngo mtshar chos /de nyid gsang ba bsgrub 0)pa'i phyir/ /las rnams drug po nyid dang ni/ /gzugs can tshig gi mthu dag dang / /'bras phyir sdom pa'i ngo mtshar te/ /de phyir 'di ni ngo mtshar chos/ /de phyir 'di ni rtog ⑤par brjod/ /de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di ru/ /rtog pa 'ba' zhig ③rtog pa yin/ /yang 'dir rtog pa ji lta bu/ /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nasaringatsho / /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa dag /sten ⑤pa rtog pa nyid yin no/ /sgrub pa'i don ni ji lta bu/ /gang zag chos la ⑥bdag med dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa spangs pa yiX/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa sgrub pal/ /de tshe sgrub pa'i don yin no/ /ci phyir 'di ni rgyud phyi ma/ /rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /'khor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /phyi ma zhes bya pha rol te/ / rgyud ni phyi mar brjod pa yin/ /(91rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /phyi ma snga ma las byung ba'i/ /de nyid gsang ba sbas zhes ⑩pa/ /rgyud ni phyi mar brjod pa yin/ /ci phyir rgyud dang phyi ma lags6me/ /sa mthar phyin pa'i rgyal ba mchog /srid pa'i btson 8ra las rgal kyi yin/ /yang na gang zhig rgal 7gyur pa/ /rgyud ni phyi ma yin par bshad / /rgyud kyi don ni ji ltar byung / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos longs spyod/ /sangs rgyas thugs rjes bskul ba ni/ /rgyud don yang dag byung ba yin7/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs byung ba'i/ /chos dang longs spyod byung ba ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen ni/ /rgyud don yang dag byung ba yin/ /rdo rje 'chang drag 'di ci zhig /sangs rgyas 84—448

gzugs kyis ①mi 'dul ba'i/ /sems can gdug tshogs de yi phyir/ /rang gi ye shes byang chub sems/ /rdo rje drag por yang dag 'byung / /drag po'i don ni ji ltar 'byung / /drag po drag po'i mig gis ni/ /drag po'i khro bo zhes su bstan / /drag po'i las ni spyod byed rnams/ /'chos ⑧shing bzlog par bya ba yin / /rdo rje zhi ba 'di ci zhig /gdug ③pa de kun btul nas ni/ /slar yang zhi bar yang dag byung / /de nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /sems can don gyi thabs ston mdzad/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /khro bo'i dbang phyug dag tu bstan/ /de nyid zhi dang drag po dang / /phyag na rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che//ci yi phyir na zhi bar brjod/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rnal 'byor che/ /sems can smin bya 'ba' zhig phyir/ /nyon mongs gdug ④la brtser phyidagongs shing / /zhi ba'i don ni yang dag byung / /phyag na rdo rje ci yi phyir/ /nyon mongs gdug pa nyes yigazhom phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bzang / /rdo rje phyag na bsnams mdzad pa/ /de ni phyag na rdo rjer brjod/ /dus gsum bdud rnams de bzhin du/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi shigs (7pa/ /byang sems rang bzhin rdo rje ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa'i tshogs/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun dang ldan / /gsang chen rdo rje de lta bu/ /phyag na rtag tu bsnams pas na/ /de ni phyag na rdo rjer brjod/ /rdo rje gtum pa'i (kyedon ci zhig /rdo rje gtum po gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin shin tu brtan/ /nga rgyal nyon mongs zhags pa za/ /byang chub sems dpa' rang byung ba/ /ci yi phyir na gtum por brjod//gtum gdug drag po chen po ni/ /rang byung nga 5)nyid kho na ste/ /srid pa'i zhags pa gcod byed cing / /drag po'i don ni gtum po yin/ /rdo rje khro bo ci 84—449

yin brjod/ /gsod dang skyod pa drag po ste/ /de ni khro bo'i 6)don du brjod/ /nga ni rdo rje me ltar 'bar/ /nyon mongs phyogs rnams sreg byed yin/ /rdo rje rdo rje zhes gsungs pa/ /ci phyir rdo rjer brjod par bya/ /sra zhing snying po khong stong med / /gcad nadang gzhig par bya ba min/ /bsreg par bya min 'jig med pas / /stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya/ /'gro drug 'khor lo spong byed cing / /sdig pa dral bar byed pa yi/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /nyon mongs thams cad sel bar byed/ /rdo rje 'chang zhes gsungs 'di ci/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dang / /byang sems brtan pa gang yin pa/ /de ni rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /de yi rdo rje ji lta bu/ /rtog pa thams cad dang bral zhing / /chos su 'dzin pa rnams (gespangs pa/ /chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer brjod/ /gzugs sogs chos kyi rang bzhin gang / /'gyur ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan pa gang / /de lta bu ni 'di rdo rje/ /rdo rje rigs kyi don 'di ci/ /bden zhing don yod de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur ba med cing skye ba med/ /'gag med de kho na nyid gang / /de lta bu ni rdo rje yin/ /don yod 'gyur ba med pa yi / /de lta bu yi rigs gyur pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su brjod/ /de ni rdo rje'i rigs zhes bya/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i chos/ /byang chub sems dpa' 5zhes su brjod/ /bden zhing slu )ba med pa yi/ /byang chub sems gang de rigs yin/ /rdo rje 'chang ba rnams ni du/ /phyogs rnams thams cad kun khyab pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni/ /chos dbyings dang mnyam thug pa med/ /rdo rje 'chang rnams de snyed do/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun gang gi 84—450

yin / /chos kyi bdag po bla med pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mgon des yongs su bzung lho)ba de'i/ /de yi dkyil 'khor yin gsungs pa/ /ston pa gang zhig 'di rnams su'i/ /rjes su ston ②par byed pa gang / /de yi spyod lam bya ba ci/ /gsang ba kun du bsdus pas gsungs/ /'di yi ston pa byang chub sems/ /rjes su ston byed shes rab thabs/ /phyag rgya rnams ni spyod lam ste/ /sngags rnams de yi bya ba yin/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rigs gang yin/ /rdo rje 'chang ba de kun gyi/ /rigs ni byang chub sems yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtul zhugs bzang / /sangs rgyas kyi yang de nyid yul/ /chen po gnas gang phyizhig na gnas/ /chos rnams kun la gnas med de/ /rtsa ba med sems spyod yul lo/ /chos rnams thams cad gzugs can min/ /chos kyi dbyings te spyod yul med/ /rigs ni rnam pa du yin brjod/ / rtag dang mi 'khrugs rin chen dbang / /'od dpag med pa dngos grub rnams/ /(4)rigs ni rnam pa brgyar gsungs te/ /mdo ru bsdu na rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen dang / /chos dang las dang rnam pa lnga/ /ci yi phyir na rigs su brjod / /mchog dang dman pa'i bye brag gis/ /rigs zhes bya ba de rnams (peganyis / /sems can lam ngan zhugs pa yi/ /rigs ni dman pa yin par brjod / /lam ngan 'gro ba spangs nas ni/ /byang chub sems la 'jug pa chos/ /de bas rdo rje rigs brjod pa/ /rigs de yang ni lnga pa yin/ /rigs bdag rang bzhin 'di ci zhig /byang chub sems ni rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'jigs pa med/ /mgon po chen po rigs kyi bdag /de ni rigs kyang (tshi lnga pa yin / /ci yi phyir na (7 sems dpar brjod/ /sems dpa' zhes bya rnam gsum 84wa 451

ste / /byis pa de bzhin mkhas pa dang / /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rnam gsum sems dpa' brjod par bya/ /yang gsungs pa/ ci yi phyir na sems dpa' 17brjod/ /sems dpa' ci yin gyis pa brjod/ /sems dpa' mkhas pa ci yi phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' ci yin brjod/ /gnas gang zhig tu brjod bya ba/ /de ni de yi sems dpar brjod/ /chos sam yang na chos min dang / /legs byas nyes par byas pa la/ /mi shes mun pas bsgribs (migyur cing / /chos la nyon mongs bdag nyid 'dzin/ /dman zhing gti mug rigs can gyur/ /de lta bu ni byis par brjod/ /nyon mongs kun la chags pa dang / /de bzhin srid pa ngan song gsum/ /mi shes mun pa la chags pa/ /de 'dir byis par brjod par bya/ /sems dpa' mkhas pa gang zhig yin/ /dri ma las 'das nyon mongs spong / /rnal 'byor ldan zhing brtul (7zhugs che/ /mi shes ling tog 'joms byed pa/ /de ni sems dpa' mkhas par ④brjod/ /'dir ni byang chub sems dpa' gang / /chos kyi de nyid rtogs gyur cing / /'khor ba'i gnas nas sad 'gyur te/ /sems can rnams ni sad byed pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpar brjod/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnam pa du/ /de la byang chub rnam gsum ste/ /dman dang mchog dang bar ma'o/ /dman pa nyan thos sems yin te/ /bar ma rang rgyal byang chub bo/ /mchog ni byang chub sems yin te/ /de ni mi 'gyur rdo rje yin/ /sku gsung thugs rnams gzhag (5)pa gang / /byang chub mchog tu brjod par bya/ /ci phyir rdo rje sems dpa' yin / /byang chub mchog gi ye shes gang / /de ni rdo rje nges par brjod/ /ye shes rdo rje las byung ba/ /de ni rdo rje sems dpar brjod/ /rdo rje 'chang ba 84—452

kun gyi rgyal/ /ci yi phyir na sems dpar brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po che/ /dga' chen de ni chags sam ci/ /sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i phyir / /sems can rnams la chags pa ste/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su bsgrags/ /byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu stel/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med gang / /de ni rdo rje sems rang ⑧bzhin/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po ci yin brjod/ /rdo rje rigs kun rgyal po ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhes su brjod/ /dgug dang dbab pa'i rdo rje ni/ /de ni rdo rje rgyal por brjod/ /bsdu ba yi ni dngos po bzhi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang spyad pa/ /sems can dgug pa'i ③thabs zhes pa/ /rdo rje rgyal por yang dag byung / /rdo rje chags pa 'di don ci/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed pa/ /rjes su chags pa zhes su brjod/ /rdo rje chags pa bdud chen po/ /de ni rdo rje chags par brjod/ /sems can smin ④phyir bcom ldan gyis(snye/ /gang tshe byang chub spyod pa spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa rjes chags pa/ /rdo rje chags par yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje legs pa ci yin brjod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed cing / /legs so zhes bya rab ster byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun mgu byed/ /de ni rdo rje legs par brjod/ /sems can dag pa mgu byed cing / /rdo rje 'chang rnams sgrub par byed/ /sems can mkhas rnams dga' byed cing / /gsang ba 'dzin pa rangs par byed/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di chos rnam 6)drug /gang gi tshe ni sngon bsgrubs pa/ /rdo rje legs par yang dag byung / /rdo rje rin chen ci yi phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa gang / /mkha' mnyam rin chen lta bu ste/ /rdo rje 84—453

rin chen skal ba che/ /de ni rdo rje rin chen brjod/ /sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur 1te/ /sems can kun gyi dbang bskur ba/ /byang chub snying po'i dbang bskur gyis/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams 'dzin par byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin pa gang / /mkha' mtshungs rdo rje yang dag byung / /de ni rin chen don yod de/ /de ni rdo rje rin chen brjod/ / rdo rje gzi brjid ci yin brjod/ /(5)ma rig ling tog 'khor ba yi/ /mi shes mun pa 'joms byed cing / /thar pa'i snang ba gzi brjid che/ /de ni rdo rje gzi brjid brjod/ /ci phyir rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin/ /rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /thar pa'i lam 'gro rgyal mtshan te/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan che/ /de ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan brjod / /rdo rje bzhad 57pa ci yin brjod/ /rnal 'byor chen po rdo rje bzhadago/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bzhad byed cing / /byang chub sems dpa' kun dbugs 'byin / /de ni rdo rje bzhad par 5)brjod/ /ci yi phyir na rdo rje chos/ /rnal 'byor chen po sangs rgyas chos/ /sangs rgyas sems can rtogs byed pa/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /de ni rdo rje chos su brjod/ /rdo rje rnon po ci yin brjod/ /shes rab rnon po ye shes che/ /shin tu sdug pa'i nyon mongs gcod / /shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang gcod pas na/ /de ni phyi rdo rje rnon por brjod/ /rdo rje rgyu yi don ci zhig /'khor lo sangs rgyas gar byed pas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu brten / /dam chos ro yi bcud las byung / /de ni rdo rje rgyu (7zhes bya / /rdo rje smra ba ci yin brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos chen po/ /mkha' mtshungs tshig dang bral ba ste/ /tshig me 9tshig las yang dag byung / /de ni rdo rje smra bar brjod/ /ci yi phyir na rdo rje las/ /sems can smin tshadang grol ba yi/ /84—454

sangs rgyas kun gyi las gang dang / /sangs rgyas las ni bdag med pa/ /de ni rdo rje las zhes bya/ /rdo rje srung ①ba ci yin brjod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i srung ba ste/ /theg pa dman pa spong byed cing / /rtse mo nas ltung ②sung byed pa/ /de ni rdo rje srung bar brjod/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin 'di don ci/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed cing / /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gcod/ /srid pa za byed gnod sbyin che/ /de ni rdo rje gnod sbyin brjod/ /rdo rje khu tshur ci yin brjod / /bden zhing gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med de kho na nyid gang / /sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid ye shes/ /de ni rdo rje khu tshur brjod/ /sngon du byang chub sems 'gyur gang / /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag byung / / bsdu ba'i (kyedangos po bzhi po ni/ /rdo rje rgyal por yang dag byung / /sems can smin byed chags pa'o/ /byang chub spyod pa legs pa ste/ /de nyid ces bya dam tshig che / /byang chub sems las yang dag byung / /sngon gyi sbyin pa'i spyod gyur gang / /de ni rdo rje rin chen brjod/ /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /de ni rdo rje gzi brjid brjod/ /'byung po kun la byams pa ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yang dag byung / /chos kyi sbyin pa bzhad pa ste/ /dbang bskur bzhi por bstan pa yin / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ting 'dzin gang / /rdo rje chos ni de las byung / /nyon mongs gcod dzo dbyed rdo rje che/ /rdo rje rnon por yang dag byung / /mngon shes dang ni mthu la (5)sogs/ /de ni rdo rje rgyu ru brjod/ /gzungs la 56)sogs pa grub pa ni/ /rdo rje smra bar yang dag byung / /ye shes chen po chos chen po/ /dam tshig ces bya'i dga' chen po/ /ye shes mngon par rtogs te dag /rdo rje chos las yang dag byung / /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rgyal po/ /rdo rje las su 84wa 455

yang dag byung / /theg pa dman pa spong byed pa/ /de phyir rdo rje srung bar brjod / /nyon mongs srid pa'i gdon chen po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin yang dag byung ske/ /de nyid ye shes mngon 6)byang chub/ /de nyid rdo rje khu tshur brjod/ /las kyi dam tshig bzhi po ste/ /las kyi sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /las kyi 'khor lo ②las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje las ni de las byung / /gzhan yang byang chub sems ni bskyed pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag byung / /rdo rje rang bzhin sems de yang / /rnam pa bzhi ru byung ba ste/ / sgrol ba chadang ni grol ④ba dang / /dbugs 'byin mya ngan 'das 'god byed/ /sems dpa' rgyal po chags pa che/ /rdo rje legs par yang dag byung / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs nyid las/ /rdo rje rin chen rab tu bsgrags/ /bsod nams rang bzhin rin chen de/ /rnam bzhi ji skad (45)bshad pa bzhin/ /ye shes kyi ni tshogs brjod pa/ /de ni rdo rje chos zhes bya/ /ye shes rang bzhin chos de yang / /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag byung / /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa nyid/ /de ni rdo rje las su brjod / /brtson 'grus rang bzhin las de yang / /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag byung / /rtsom 'byedang sbyor (7ba zhes bya dang / /so sor rtog (gudang sgrub pa ste/ /brtson 'grus de bzhin las bzhi po/ /de las mthar gyis byung ba yin/ /sems dpa' 'di rnams gang las byung / /rdo rje sems sogs de bzhin du/ /byang chub sems las yang dag byung / /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa las/ /rdo rje can rnams byung bar 'dod/ /de bzhin pha dang ma ni gang / /ma ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /pha ni thabs la mkhas pa ste/ /pad+ma las ni sangs rgyas sras/ /rdo rje can rnams gang las byung / /rdo rje rgyal po de bzhin chags/ /rdo rje rin 84—456

chen rgyal mtshan dang / /rdo rje chos dang de bzhin ro①/ /de rnams shes rab gtso bor bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje legs/ /gzi brjid de bzhin bzhad pa nyid/ /rgyu dang smra ba sems dpa' che/ /de rnams thabs las labyung ba yin/ /rdo rje las dang rdo rje bsrung ①/ /gnod sbyin de bzhin khu tshur nyid/ /shes rab thabs su grags pa ste/ /brtan ④pa chen po tshogs su bshad/ /rdo rje'i rigs rnams kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma ru bshad/ /rdo rje rin chen mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin pha/ /pha ni rdo rje rgyal po rgyu/ /ma ni rdo rje rnon po ste/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen bzang po yi/ /pad 'dzin gang las byung ba'o/ /rdo rje gzi brjid rin chen pha/ /rgyal mtshan ma ni yin par bstan / /nor bu rin ②chen bzang po yi/ /rin chen gang las byung ba'o/ /pha ni rgyal po rdo rje las/ /ma ni gnod sbyin srung ba ste/ /las kyi rigs can bzang po yi/ /las rnams gang las byung ba'o/ /dang po gang zhig ci zhe na/ /dngos kun dang po sa bon te/ /rdo rje can kun dang po sems/ /'dun dang dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /rigs rnams kun gyi dang por bshad/ /yang gleng gzhi ci yin zhe na/ /rigs bzhi las (5༄ni yang dag byung / /tshangs pa'i gnas chen dang ldan pa'il/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /snying rje chen po gleng gzhi yin/ /dmigs pa gang zhig yin zhe na/ /rtog pa med cing dmigs pa med/ /dang por byang chub sems byung ba'i/ /pha rol phyin pa mchog drug ni//de yi dmigs pa yin par bshad/ /rkyen gang zhe na/ rtag tu srid gsum mngon dga' ba/ /sems can sdug bsngal gyur bltas nas/ /snying rje dang ni ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyis bskul ba'o/ /gsang ba 'di ni gang du 84wa 457

byung / /'og min stug po nyams dga' zhing / /stug po'i zhing khams 'jigs yo)med pa/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /rdzogs par longs ②spyod tshul 'di byung / /khyab bdag 'di rnams gang nas byung / /rdo rje rin chen mchog chen gyi/ /gzhal yas khang pa yid 'ong zhing / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos ldan pa / /de nas khyab bdag 'di rnams byung / /thog ma tha ma med 'di ci/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug chen po gsung / /sems can kun gyi shes pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang 6)/ /chos dbyings rdo rje chen po ste/ /thog ma tha ma med par bshad/ /rab tu dga' ba nyid 'di ci/ /bde chen rab tu grub bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che / /rab tu dga' ba nyid ces bshad/ /rab bzang nyid ni ji lta bu/ /dngos po kun mchog rdo rje ni/ /byang chub kyi ni sems zhes brjod/ /sangs rgyas skyed byed bzang po yi/ /rdo rje rab bzang 95)nyid ces bshad/ /rdo rje snying bdag ji lta bu/ /gdul bya 'phags pa'i skyes mchog nyid/ /de ni rdo rje snying por brjod/ /de rnams bdag po rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje snying po (6)bdag por bshad / /ci yi phyir na kun du bzang / /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ldan pa'i / /'gro ba srid pa'i skye gnas gang / /de kun rtag tu bzang bas na/ /kun du bzang por brjod par bya/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'chang ba gang / /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /rdo rje gang de rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che / /rdo rje rdo rje 'chang bar brjod/ /dang po'i rigs ni ji ltar byung / /(7)sangs rgyas kun gyi 87byang chub kyis/ /grags chen rdzogs par byang chub pa/ /de ni dang po'i rigs byung ste/ /de kho na nyid rigs 9)las so/ /yang na rab tu 84—458

mkhas pa rnams/ /bskal pa grangs med 'das nas ni/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob gang / /de ni dang po'i rigs byung yin/ /chos kun skye ba med pa dang //'byung ba ji ltar rung ①bar 'gyur/ /de nyid rtogs shing shes pa yis chos rnams thams cad rtog ②pa med/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med las/ /rigs de byung ba nyid du 'dod/ /chos rnams 'ga' yang skye ba med/ /chos rnams 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /rnam par rtog pa nyer gzhi gang / /de nyid sangs rgyas rigs chen yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' ci yin brjod/ /chos rnams thams cad rtogs pa dang / /'khor ba'i gnas las sad gyur cing / /sems can rnams kyis rtogs byed pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpar brjod/ /ci phyir sangs rgyas brjod par bya/ /de bzhin nyid bden shin tu brtan/ /de kho na nyid gang rtogs nas/ /chos kun rtogs pa zhes bya gang / /de ni rtogs pas rgyasangs rgyas brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ci yin brjod/ /chos kyi de nyid (geyang dag gnas/ /slar yang gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing / /de nyid lam ni ston byed pa/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs zhes bya/ /bcom ldan 'das ni ci yin brjod / /las dang nyon mongs de bzhin skye/ /de bzhin nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib / /mi mthun phyogs kyi chos rnams gang / /de bcom pas na bcom ldan brjod / /de yi bcom pa ci yin brjod/ /bcom ldan de bzhin bcom par brjod / /'dod pa'i 'dod chags gcod byed cing / /nyon mongs 'joms shing pham byed pa/ /de ni de yi bcom par brjodari ni/ /de bzhin ston pa'i ston pa ci/ /nyon mongs bdud sogs gcod byed cing / /skye dgu ma lus thabs chen gyis/ /ngan 'gro srid las skyob byed pa/ /ston pa'i ston par brjod pa 84—459

yin0)la/ /ci yi phyir na ye shes brjod/ /de nyid shes pas ye shes te/ /slar yang chos su rtog ②pa min/ /rtag dang chad pa spong byed cing / /'chi med de bzhin ye shes ni(gu/ /shes rab ye shes ci yin brjod/ /rnam pa mang po shes byed cing / /rtogs pas sdug bsngal las grol byed/ /kun nas nyon mongs chos spong pa/ /shes rab ye shes zhes su brjod/ /ci phyir shes rab brjod par bya / /rab sbyor sbyor ba shes 'gyur zhing / /khyad par du ni rtogs par byed/ /bden pa de bzhin nyid shes pa'i/ /shes rab shes rab shes su bshad/ /shes rab pha rol phyin don ci/ /nyan thos rang rgyal phyi rol gyi/ /shes rab las ni bla mar brjod/ /de bzhin nyid gzhol pha rol phyin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin zhes bshad/ /tshul zhes bya don ci yin brjod/ /na ni dgag pa'i don chen te / /dngos med dngos po med min pas/ /gang du dri ma med gyur pa/ /de ni de yi tshul du brjod/ /ting 'dzin don 'di ci yin brjod/ /chos kun dngos po med ces pa'i/ /mnyam pa nyid du rab gnas pa'i/ /shes rab can gyis ④lhag par bsten/ /sems la dmigs par brjod par bya/ /ci yi phyir na bsam gtan brjod/ /sdug bsngal thams cad spong byed cing / /nyon mongs dra ba rab 'joms pa'i/ /shes rab bcas par sems pa ni(5)/ /srid pa 'joms par byed pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor don ni ci yin brjod/ /chos rgya (6)chen po dam pa dang / /zab mo'i mchog tu gyur pa des/ /kun shes kun rig (peldan 'byor pa'i/ /rnal 'byor du ni brjod par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa ni ci yin brjodam/ /shes rab kyi na 587des sems pa/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor don sems shing / /sems can kun gyi don sems gang / /de ni rnal 'byor pa don 84—460

brjod / /nga ni kun gyi rgyal po che/ /thams cad rig ①cing thams cad ster/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dang po ste/ /bde ba yi ni rgyu 'di yis/ /de bzhin nga ni 'jig rten gsum/ /khams gsum rnal 'byor rig pa'i mchog /de bzhin 'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /bde 'gro dang ni ngan 'gro dang / /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod yin/ /srid gsum 'di yi don ci ②zhig /sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /srid pa gsum du brjod par bya/ /'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med las/ /'di ltar thams cad rig pa mchog /bdag med byed pa po yang med/ /chos kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /dge dang mi dge ②byed pa yidu/ /bag chags cikyis ni kun du bsgribs/ /chos ni thog med dus can te/ /byed pa po ni yod ma yin/ /rtog ⑤pas nyams pa'i sems ldan pas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur ⑥mthong bar 'gyur/ /kun gzhi sa bon thams cad pa/ /de ni chos kun skyed ⑦par byed/ /bsgos shing bag chags dang ldan pa/ /de ni srid pa gsum zhes bya/ /'dod pa'i las skyes khams gsum gyi/ /rgyur ni kun gzhi de nyid snang ske/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'gro ba yi/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas kyang yin/ /chos kun rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /nyes pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /thog ma med 'byung chos snying po/ /blo (kyebur dri mas nyon mongs 'gyur/ /nga ni kho na chos chen po/ /nga ni chos kyi snying por bshad/ /de bas nga ni rgyal po che/ /nga ni srid pa gsum du bsgrags/ /'jig rten gsum ni ci yin brjod/ /'dod pa 'jig rten de bzhin gzugs/ /gzugs med pa yi skye dgu rnams/ /'jig rten gsum po zhes pa ste6)/ /rang byung nga nyid kho na yin/ /'dod pa zhes bya chos chen te/ /dag pa btsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /gzung 'dzin chos 84—461

rnams zhes bya ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid las so sor rtogayo) /chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med phyir/ /nga ②ni chos de dag par byed/ /de bas nga ni rgyal po che/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bdag por bstan/ /ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin gzugs/ /de bzhin gzugs med rab tu bsgrags/ /stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i①/ /nga 4)ni snying po'i bdag por bshad/ /khams gsum pa yi don ci zhig /'dod khams de bzhin gzugs khams dang / /gzugs med pa ni nyid dag dang / /khams gsum bzang po 'di dag ni/ /rang byung nga nyid kho na yin/ /'di ni khams dang rgyu dang don/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyu sems pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med bshad cing / /smon pa med pa nga nyid bstan/ /'khor ba'i don ni ci zhig yin/ /byis pa rnams ni kun du 'byung / /de bzhin yang dang yang du 'khor / /'khor ba dag pa'i bdag nyid de/ /rang byung (5)nga nyid kho na yin/ /gang la 'khor ba yod pa yi/ /chos ni rdul tsam yod ma yin/ /yang dag ma yin kun brtags 56phyir/ /de ni thog mtha' med pa yin/ /med gang de ni stong pa ste/ /stong pa nyid gang nga nyid do/ /de bas 'khor ba de nyid ni/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal nga nyid bsgrags/ /mya ngan 'das pa ci yin brjod/ /gang zhig de bzhin nyid rtag tsho 7stong / /bden bzhi rang bzhin bzang po nyid/ /mtshan nyid dang ni dngos po gzugs/ /mtshan ma nyid kyang rnam par spangs/ /tshig dang sgra yis gzung bya min/ /rnam par rtog pa yod ma yin/ /de bas mya ngan 'das sgra ru/ /nga 87nyid kho na rab shes bya/ /de yi rtag pa'i don ci zhig /rtag nyid rtag la 'byung gnas te/ /rnam par rtog pa dang bral gang / /rtag pa de nyid kho na ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i (sgra ru bsgrags/ /'jig pa yang ni ci 84—462

yin brjod/ /gang zhig 'khor bar mi 'jug cing / /thams cad mi rtag pa nyid dang / /sdug bsngal 'byung ba 0)'gog byed pa'i/ /'jig pa mya ngan 'das sgra yin/ /dag pa yang ni ci yin brjod/ /yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang min/ / dngos po'ang ma yin dngos med min/ /②brjod bya rjod ②byed ma yin min/ /dag pa mya ngan 'das nyid yin/ /theg pa chen po ci yin brjod / /sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs gyur cing / /theg pa kun las nges rgyal ba/ /yang dag gyur pa'i sems can ni/ /theg pa chen po zhes su bstan/ /mthu dang las rnams 'jug pa dang / /tshogs rnams rnal 'byor ngo mtshar rnams / /rgya che zhes pa theg chen te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo mtshar mchog /nam mkha'i don ni ci zhig yin/ /sa nyid kyang ni ci yin brjod/ /'byung ba med cing rdzas kyang med/ /skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /dus gsum dngos po dang bral mchog /nam mkha' zhes pa'i sgra ru bstan/ /yang dang yang du skye ba dang / /de bzhin nyon mongs kun bdag nyid/ /grangs med dpag med dang bral ba/ /de ni sa nyid brjod par bya/ /'byung ba chen po gang las byung / /'gog pa ci yin gang gis byed/ /ma rig 54)nyon mongs la (5)sogs las/ /'byung ba chen po yang dag 'byung / /sa bon kun ldan kun gzhi 6)ni/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /gnas ni yongs su gyur pa (bedang / /kun gzhi sa bon mi 'byung zhing / /rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba/ /'byung ba chen po 'gog pa yin/ /rtog pa chen po'i rgyal po mchog tu gsang zhing sbas pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ rdo rje rtse mo las shin tu gsang ba stug po'i tshogs kyi las thams cad bsdus pa ste/ drug pa las sems dpa' bcu drug gi bshad pa zhes 84—463

bya ba bshad pa'i dang po rdzogs stol// //ci yi phyir na ②phyag rgyar chabarjod/ /gang gis phyag rgya bcings gyur pa/ /des ④ni srog chags gdug kun dang / /'gro ba sdig can thams cad dang / /rtag tu rgyas ni btab par 'gyur/ /ci phyir sngags su brjod par bya/ /gsang sngags rnams ni 'bod byed cing / /gdug pa thams cad skrod par byed/ /nyon mongs sngags rnams 'joms byed cing / /sangs rgyas chos ni spyan 'dren yin / /ci phyir zhe na rig sngags brjod/ /'dod chags mun pa rnams 'dul zhing ske/ /nyon mongs rnams kyang rnam par 'dul/ /ma rig pa ni zlog ⑤byed pa/ /nga 67ni rig 7sngags legs par brjod/ /gzungs sngags rnams ni ci yin brjod / /chos rnams kyi (sheni rten byed cing / /srid pa'i phyogs ni rab 'joms byed / /sangs rgyas chos rnams thob byed cing / /dge ba la rten 0sbyin pa'ang yin / /phyag rgya yi ni mtshan nyid brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun dang brtul zhugs ldan / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /rdo rje 'chang ba thams cad dag /spyod lam phyag rgya ⑩mtshon par byed/ /sngags rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te/ /chos kyi snying po sgrub byed cing / /chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan/ /sngags kyi mtshan nyid yin par brjod/ /rig (1sngags kyi ni mtshan nyid gsungs/ /'khor bar myong ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /'dod chags la 7sogs nyes pa'i tshogs/ /rigs dang bcas pa zhi byed pa'i/ /rig 34sngags kyi ni mtshan nyid brjod/ /de bzhin kho nar gzungs sngags kyi/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dzin byed cing / /chos rnams 'dzin par 84—464

byed pa dang / /dge ba zhes bya 'dzin byed pa/ /gzungs 6)sngags kyi ni mtshan nyid brjod/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'i gnas ni gang / /ji ltar bcing bya ②thub chen po / /phyag rgya dag ni 'ching ba na①/ /ji ltar rdo rje can kun mnyes/ /dang po kho nar khrus bya zhing / /de bzhin ༅phyogs dag bcing ba dang / /log 'dren rnams kyang bcing bya ste/ /bos dag gtsang ma bgo bya zhing / /grong dang yul 'khor dag dang ni/ /grong khyer ⑤dang ni grong rdal rnams/ /de yi dbus su phyag rgya dgazhi) /nam yang bcing bar mi bya ste/ /lha khang yang na dgon pa'am/ /ri bo yi ni phug dag gam/ /rnam (7pa sna tshogs kyis dben zhing / /'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas gtsang ma/ /der (sheni skyil krung khyabaca' bar bya/ /bkra shis skyil krung nyid bya ste/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub snying por bcings pa bzhin/ /der ni mig dag btsum bya zhing / /so la so ni gzhag par bya/ /mchu gnyis dag kyang mnyam bya zhing / /dran pa rtse gcig byas nas kyang / /sbyor med sbyor ba'i sngags bzla zhing / /phyag rgya chen po bcing bar yibya / /phyag rgya'i rnam pa de lta bu'i/ /bcings pas rdo rje can kun mnyes/ /rig (1sngags ji ltar bzla bar bya/ /dbang phyug chen po gsang bas 8gsungs/ /rig tu sngags dag ni zlos 8pa na/ /ji ltar yid kyis rdo rje bzlas/ /skyil krung ji lta ba bzhin bya/ /dran dang yid ni ma g.yengs snyipas/ /rig ⑩sngags dag ni bzla bya zhing / /sku nyid kyang ni bsam par bya/ /mchu yis ma yin gcig tu kyang min / / rkan gnyis zhu kyis kyang ma yin te/ /lce dang lkog mas tsho)kyang ma yin/ /rtag tu snying ga 6 )nas kyang min/ /shin tu phra ba'i yid kyis ni/ /sems ni chos nyid nang chud bya/ /de ltar bzlas pa byas na ni/ /yid kyis rdo rje bzlas pa 84—465

'byung po kun la byams pa dang / /dud 'gro kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zhi 'dod dang / /byams dang snying rje btang snyoms dang / /dga' ba tshangs pa'i rnal 'byor byung / /rdo rje'i sngags ni brjod bya zhing / /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra ma hā tsa tur bra h+ma thu bi hā ltar pū dzā (55me gha sa mu drwa ④spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin spyod pas/ /(5)sems can thams cad dpal dang ni/ /nor dang ldan pa grub par shog /bde ba ma tshang med par shog /ces pas dbul zhing spro bar bya / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā brjod bha (6)ba dā na pā ra mi tā pū dz+dzatshi me gha sa mu dā ri spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sems can thams cad byang chub dang / /sdom la rab tu gnas par shog /rgyags sogs nyes pa chen po rnams/ /zhi 'gyur kun du spro bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra ma hā bo dhi ha ri9)ra shī la pā 9/ )ra mi tā pū dzā 17me gha sa mu drwa 12spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'jigs dang 'khon nya sogs sdug bsngal las / /stsogs tshapa'i 'jigs kun zhi gyur cig /byams dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos la bdag med bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra ma 12hā dharma a ba bo dhi k+ṣu na 7ti pā ra mi nyu tā pū dzā 1 me gha sa mu drwa 17spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'khor ba mthar thug bar du ni/ /bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /de bzhin sems can thams cad ni/ /de nyid sgrub pa byed par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ sā 2lhar (22pa na ri t+yā 2 ga a nut+ta ra bīr+ya gi pā ra mi tā pū dzā (27me gha sa mu dā 2 s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ srog chags kun gyi 'dod chags sogs nya/ /nyon mongs chen po zhi bar shog /sems can thams cad g.yeng med cing / /bsam gtan bzhi 2dzodang ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā 7ga ta a nut+ta ra ma hā sau 84—474

khya bi hā stir sgyu ②na pā ra mi tā pū dzā ②me gha sa mu drwa ④spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/sangs rgyas ye shes shes rab che/ /sdug bsngal gcod byed bla na med/ /shes rab sbyor bas dag byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sems can dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta (gyer kle sha ts+tsha dud sarba dharma ⑦sa ma n+ta dzñā na ma hā pra dzñā pā ra mi ⑧tā pū dzā 6)me gha sa mu dā tisga ra ca sa ma ye hūm̐/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed kyi/ /bdag nyid kyis ⑩ni rnam bsam zhing / /mchod pa'i phyir ni rnam bsams ⑫nas / /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nir+sā ⑩ta na pū dzā yime gha sa mu dā 7spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed kyi/ /bdag nyid ⑩kyis ni rnam ⑩bsam zhing / /lce ni de snyed 8ldan dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas bsngags ()pa brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bā ka nir+sā ( —)ta na pū dzā 0me gha sa mu drwa 7spa ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu/ de nas rnal 'byor de nyid kyi( ste/ /lus dang ngag sems byung ba yi/ /mchod pa dag ni bsdus nas su/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta nir+sā (steta na pū dzā ( )me gha sa mu drwa klasga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ grags chen ldan pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma lus kun la mchod nas ni/ /dge ba dag ni bsdus ( — 7byas nas/ /sems can don du bsngo bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rjes dran nas/ /sems dpa'i ( )skyil krung bca' bar bya/ /byams sogs rnal 'byor chen po rnams/ /phyogs rnams kun du spro bar bya/ /go cha mchog gi yig ( /gnyis kyis/ /blo ldan bdag nyid go bgo zhing / /rig ( )sngags gang zhig mngon 'dod pa'i/ /rig sngags de ni bzla bar bya/ /rgyud chen gsang ba 'di ru ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i sngags bzlas pa / /brgya rtsa bcu ru bshad pa yin/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig go/ /cho ga'i 84wa 475

sbyor ba 'bring la ni/ /thun mong du ni rnam lngar bshad/ /gang gis sdig ①can 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang ba'i bzlas pa rnal 'byor che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs mchog la/ /bzlas pa 'di ni mchog yin no/ /bkra shis skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /sems kyis sangs rgyas la dmigs nas/ /blo dang ldan pa bdag nyid ni/ /rtag tu kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bsam/ /gtsug tor la ②sogs mtshan bzang dang / /ldan par bdag gis lus bsams te/ /sangs rgyas snying po nang 'dug cing / /nga nyid sangs rgyas zhes su bsam/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las byung ba'i/ /gang gis 'khor lo rnam sprul pa/ /mngon par byang chub chen po yi / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /gdul bya'i tshogs ni longs spyod pa'i/ /chos dang longs ④spyod sprul pa'ang 'grub/ /gnas ni yongs su gyur pa yis/ /sems ni kun gzhi dulas byung min/ /bsod nams ye shes rab rdzogs phyir/ / zla ba gang bar rnam par brtags/ /༷zla ba gang ⑦ba dri med pa/ /snying ga (sheru ni bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rig pa'i yi ge 6)rnam par bsgomaṇi/ /de lta bu yi tshul mchog gis/ /zla ba phyed na (7'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang / /lo gcig na ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji srid skyo bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /de srid rnal 'byor chen pos bzlas/ /lus ni ngal bar gyur pa na/ /phyag rgya bcing ba brtsam par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bzlas pa'i/ /de tshe byang chub mchog bcing 32bya/ /yang na chos 'byung zhes pa 'am/ /shin tu rmad byung podapal be'u'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i rigs bzlas pa/ /phyag na rdo rje rang bdag nyid/ /byang chub snying po la gnas bdag /bdag ni phyag na rdo rje 84—476

bstan / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni rnam par bsgom / /gsang chen rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /①rig pa'i yi ge rnam par bsgom/ /de nas pad+ma'i rigs bzlas pa/ /pad+ma sems dpa' rang bdag nyid/ /zla ba'i dbus su pad+ma che/ /pad+ma'i dbus su yi ge rnams/ /de bzhin rin chen rigs bzlas pa'i/ /rin chen rgyal po rang ②bdag nyid/ /zla ba'i dbus su rin chen ③che/ /rin chen dbus su'ang yi ge rnams/ /de na dulas kyi rigs bzang po / /rnal 'byor don kun sgrub byed la/ /sangs rgyas snying po rang bdag nyidam/ /rdo rje las su rnam par bsgom/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rin chen rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /rin chen rtse mo rdo rje che/ /de yi dbus su'ang yi ge rnams/ /rigs lnga yi ni bzlas pa 'di/ /gsang ba'i bzlas pa brjod par bya/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ste/ /bzlas rgyud gsang ba mchog 'dzin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bzlas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid bkra shis 'dzin/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ⑤su rnam par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas de yi 9thugs dbus su/ /rig ⑦pa'i yi ge rnam par bsgom/ /rang gi lus ni bdag med cing / /chos dang gang zag stong pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas de dag gi gzugs ni/ /bdag med par ni rnam par bsam/ /lus ni sangs rgyas zhes brjod pas/ /sangs rgyas de yang yod ma yin/ /phung po dang ni skye mched khams/ /chos zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas med/ /gang zag nyid kyis sangs rgyas med/ /sangs rgyas med pa yang ma yin(kye/ /pha rol phyin drug sa bon te/ /shes rab sa bon sbyong mdzad pa'i / /gnas dang gnas min skal ldan pa/ /de nyid byang chub bdag med 5༄84—477

'dzin / /de lta bus ni gsang chen gyi0)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bzlas na/ /myur bar slob dpon chen po yis/ /rab tu dga' ba 'grub par 'gyur / /de nas rdo rje'i rigs bzlas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang bdag nyid / /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom / /rdo rje de yi lte dbus su/ /rig pa'i yi ge ②rnam par bsgomadu/ /dngos med ces bya rdo rje de/ /byang chub 'bras bu gang yin pa'o/ /gang zhig rdo rje zhes su bshad/ /gang zhig de nyid 'gyur med pa'i/ /lus kyi de nyid ces brjod la/ /gang zhig chos dang chos nyid stong / /gzugs la lisogs pa'i chos chen po/ /'byung ba che sgra 'dzin pa min(5)/ /lus ni gzugs zhes bya bar brjod / /gzugs zhes bya bar (6)yod ma yin/ /gzugs de yang ni rnam phye la/ /phra mo'i 'du shes rnam par bsgom/ /cha shas su ni rnam phye na/ / gzugs zhes bya ba yod ma yin/ /cha shas de ming rnam phye na/ /cha shas zhes bya yod ma yin / /pagazugs ni stong pa zhes bshad do/ /'di de (kyerdo rje zhes byar bstan/ /gzugs sogs chos rnams thams cad ni/ /stong pa nyid ni rnam par bsgom/ /de lta bu yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rab tu dga' ba bsgrub par bya/ / de nas rin chen rigs bzlas pa/ /97rdo rje rin chen rigs bdag nyid/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /stong nyid nam mkhar (7rnam par bsgom/ /de ni nam mkhar rnal 'byor chos/ /rtog pa dang bcas yi ge 31bsam/ /chos kun dngos med ces bya ba/ /stong nyid de bzhin nyid ces brjod/ /dngos med ces bya'i gzugs med de/ /mkha' mtshungs sangs rgyas spyod yul lo/ /gang la gzugs ni yod min pa'i/ /mig ces bya ba ci yin brjod/ /mig de yang ni gang zhig 84—478

gi / /mig ces bya ba yin par brjod/ /bdag po rgyal po 'di gang zhig /'di yi skye ba'ang ①ji lta bu'i/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi 'dus las/ /mig gi dbang po yang dag byung / /mig de la yang lagazugs med la/ /ci zhig byed de yod pa'ang min/ /mig ni ji lta ba bzhin du/ /thams cad gzung ②dang 'dzin pa spangs/ /bzlas ④pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /chos chen po yi dbang bskur 'gyur / /de nas pad+ma'i rigs bzlas pa/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' rang bdag nyid / /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /pad+ma'i gzugs su rnam par bsgomal/ /pad+ma shin tu dag de la/ /rig pa'i yi ge ⑤rnam par bsgom/ /shes rab chen pos ⑥pad+ma de/ /chos kyi snying por bsam par bya/ /pad+ma chu yis ma gos shing / /'dam gyi nyes pas gos mi 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad de bzhin dag /chos ni gzod nas (pem skyes pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid 'di gang zhig /chos dang chos nyid stong gang yin/ /gzugs sogs chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /chos nyid de bzhin nyid du 'dod/ /de nas las kyi rigs bzlas pa'i/ /las kyi rnal 'byor rnam par bsam/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul 'khor lo 'di/ /chos dang longs spyod thob byed yin/ /gang la chos zhes bya ba med / /sangs rgyas kyi ni rnam 'phrul snang / /e ma'o sangs rgyas de dag snang / /rang gi las kyang sgrub par mdzad/ /de lta bu yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /tshe 'di nyid la dam pa yi58ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mchog thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i snying sogs phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs la bdag por bshad/ /rin chen la 〈chosogs dbang bskur zhing / /dag pa'i mchog ni pad mchog 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas sku ni chos chen la/ /rdo rje rnal 84—479

'byor nges bstan bya/ /byang chub mchog ni kun 'dul ba/ /'di ni bzlas ①pa dam par 'dod/ /de nas slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin/ /phreng ba nges par bsten ②par bya/ /gang du bzlas pa bye ba ①byed/ /rnam gnyis rnam gsum nyung ba'ang rung / /phreng ba sangs rgyas la mdzub ④bcas/ /gung mos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor skyes / /srin lag steng du rin chen skyes/ /mthe'u chung gis ni pad kha ༷phye/ /las kyi phreng bas las byed pa/ /sor mo kun gyis ⑥bya bar bshad/ /rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /'di ni gsang ba'i bzlas pa che/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor bo de tse/ /rdo rje can la ru druk+ṣal/ /phyi rol rdor rigs ⑧dbang po ste/ /mu tig nor bu'i rnal 'byor can/ /pad+ma'i snying po'i phreng ba ni/ /pad+ma'i rigs rnams kun la bsngags/ /yang na kun las mchog gyur pa/ /bo de tse ⑨de srog 'dzin pa/ /lcags kyi bzlas ⑩pa nyis 'gyur te/ /zangs kyi yang ni bzhir /lha'agyur ro/ /ru druk+ṣa 8yi bye ba gnyis/ /mu tig gi 6)ni brgyar 'gyur ro / /dbang po'i stong 'gyur rnal 'byor te/ /dngul gyi 'bum du 'gyur ba yin / /pad+ma'i bye ba brgya 'gyur brjod/ /bo de tse yiyi grangs med do/ /lag pa g.yon pas phyag rgya bcing ⑫/ /g.yas pa phreng ba dang ldan bya/ /ji ltar sngar bshad gsang skyab sogs7/ /rmad byung tu)chen po'i bzlas pa (7bya/ /ci yi phyir na bzlas pa brjod/ /dge ba la brtson rgyal 'gyur zhing / /rmad byung ( )rnams kyang mthong 'gyur la37/ /byang chub spyod pa rgyal 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas rol pa mngon par 'gyur/ /bzlas pas skyo na langs nas ni/ /phyag rgya dag ni bcing bar bya/ /sems can kun gyi ( snyedon bya'i phyir/ /phyogs kun du ni 'dud par 22bshad/ /byang chub sems tshul thob byed pa'i/ /mdo sogs 84—480

gsang ba bklag 6)par bya/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa yang dag bya/ /de nas zas kyi dus su ni/ /rnam pa kun du chang bu sbyin/ /sangs rgyas rig ②pas mngon bsrungs la/ /bza' ①ba dag pa dudabul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid bza' ba dbul/ /legs par bgos nas bza' ba dbul/ /snga dro sdom pa blang bya ste/ /de nyid nyin ⑤byed dang mtshams su/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje nor bu dang ske/ /pad+ma byed pa'i rnal 'byor gang / /rnam pa bzhi po de las sbyoraX/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs byang chub/ /nyin dang mtshan la rnam pa drug /rdo rje dril bu tshogs slob dpon/ /rdo rje can rnams de bzhin drug /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang ni/ /byams pa nyin zhag kun la yang ⑦/ /chos gsum tshangs pa bzhi zhes pa/ /rnam pa brgyad du bzlas par bya/ /'di yi chos chen gsum po la / /rtag tu snyoms par 'jug par bya/ /gsang mchog dkyil 'khor mchog dang ni/ /de bzhin las kun byed pa'o/ /gang du sdig par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /thams cad bza' zhing thams cad len/ /lus nas lhag mar gyur pa spang / /de bzhin dri ma thams cad spang / /nyin re zhing ⑧ni lan gsum du/ /khrus gsum bya zhing gsang 7blang ba/ /gos kyang lan gsum brje bar bya/ /gtsang gos lan gsum yang ni ⑩sbyin/ /sha dang chang dang btsong la sogs(ste/ /dri ngan kha yi 7sgregs pa dang / /'khrig pa 'dod dang bsten (nyepa dang / /sems can 'tshe ④la dga' mi bya/ /brtson zhing las mkhas tshuspyod par ldan/ /sgrin zhing dul la dga' dang gtsang / /bya ba byed cing bla ma 'khurayi/ /dge legs rgyan ni 'chang bar 7byed/ /kun rdzob don dam rnam pa gnyis/ /bslab yinyepa'i 84—481

sdom pa blang bar bya/ / chung ngu bza' zhing bsnyen par bya/ /①kha ni nang du lta yid ②ches/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rig nisngags dang / /gzungs dang lha dang bla ma dang / /rdo rje la ④sogs mtshon cha bzang / /lha yi gnas dang yang dag ldan / /'jigs min g.yo dang sgyu can min/ /mi brtan pa yi blo can min/ /mya ngan 'das la dga' ba min/ / sems ni dbang pos phrogs pa min/ /①blo ldan 'jig rten 'dir mi dga'/ /de bzhin pha rol dga' ba min/ /lus srog btang snyoms mi bya zhing / /bslab (nyapa las ni 'da' mi bya/ /skrag ①ldan nga rgyal ldan pa min/ /'jig rten bya ba 'dod mi bya/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar tshul la ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub par bya/ /smra ba spang zhing brjod chen ldan/ /rten 98)pa spang zhing legs rnyed ldan/ /dpa' zhing brtan 6)la bla mar ()gus/ /sdig pas 'jigs shing 67kun du bsdams/ /ci 7nus ji ltar spro bar bya/ /zla ba'am yang na lo re 'am/ /nyin zhag gcig la lan gnyis su/ /de bzhin bla ma blta bar bya/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang / /de lta bu yi tshul gnas shing / /phyag rgya rnam pa brgyad bcings nas/ /rtag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin / /brtul zhugs tshangs par tu rdzogs gyur benas/ /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'chang ba slob dpon la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur 'gyur/ /rig pa kun bdag rgyal po ste/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid rig /rnal 'byor cho ga de nyid shes/ /de bzhin lha yi rigs rnams mthong / /sdom pa blangs shing (7rnam par mkhas/ /rig pa'i slob dpon dbang bskur 'gyur/ /lam rnams chen po byed rgyal po/ /rig pa ldan zhing de nyid shes / /phan pa dang ni gnod par 7shes/ /lha la 1 tshosogs pa kun dbang byed/ /84wa 482

gnod sbyin 'byung po lha dbang sogs/ /rig pa'i rgyal po mngag gzhug ①pa/ /'di ni chos kyi gru la gnas/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa legs mchod byed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rgyal po/ /mdzod ②'dzin rtag tu gsang ba 'dzin/ /'khor lo grong khyer chen por gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /dam chos bcud kyi snying po skyes/ /snying po 'dzin cing dkyil 'khor mchod/ /dgongs pa de nyid tshul shes 'di / /theg pa chen po'i tshul don shes/ /mchod sbyin lhag pa'i mchod dam pa'i/ /gsang ba yi ni dkyil 'khor bya/ /rdo rje khro bo'i ④ting 'dzin gyiphyi/ /gang zhig gi ni thog ma yiru/ /bgegs kun nges par 'joms pa yi/ /gsang sngags drag po brjod par bya/ /bkra shis sdig pa 'joms byed pa'itshu/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg (0cho ga yang / /nga ni rdo rje me ltar 'bar/ /drag po'i bzod dka' po)ye shes 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bya ba ni/ /yo byad yongs su brtag 7par bya/ /yang na phyi nas byed pa yis/ /ci rigs par ni brtag tu)par bya/ /dpag tshad las lhag mi bya zhing / /khru drug las ni chung ba min/ /sgrub pa bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/ /gzhan yang byed pa bcu gnyis so/ /gal te de ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /dpag tshad kyi ni khyon tsam bya/ /yang na kun nas bzang po ste/ /ngos bzhi dag dang yang dag ldan/ /yang na sgrub pa blon po yin/ /khru stong yod pa mchog yin no/ /yang na kun nas bzang ba yi/ /khru drug pa las chung mi bya/ / yang na tshong dpon 'ga' zhig gam/ /⑫yang na ded dpon yin yang rung / /ngos bzhi dag dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga pa las ni chung mi bya/ /yang na gang zhig gzhan dag gam/ /sgrub pa po dag yin yang rung / /bcu pa las ni chung mi bya/ /zur bzhi dag dang yang dag ldan/ /84—483

rgya cher yang ni mi bya'o/ /yang na sgrub byed slob dpon yin/ /drug pa las ①ni chung mi bya/ /yang na dpag tshad dang ldan pa'o/ /yang na yo byad ldan par bya/ /gal te sgrub byed de rgyal po/ /rin chen phye ma rab tu bya/ /rin chen btags las legs bya zhing ②/ /shin tu khyad 'phags yid du 'ong / / in+d+ra nī ①la sngon po che/ /tshon rtsi sngon po rab tu bya/ /pad+ma rā ga ④'o ga che/ /tshon rtsi dmar po yang dag ldan/ /tshon rtsi ser po mdog bzang po/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od zer ldan / /tshon rtsi dkar po ldan pa yi/ /dkar po dag ni shel las bya/ /bai ḍūr+ya ⑤dang bcod 6)mdog ste/ /tshon rtsi lnga zhes bya bar bshad/ /gal te de ni ma 'byor na/ /rin po che dang bsres pas bya/ /tshong ⑦dpon yang na ded dpon rung ske/ /tshon rtsi dag la rab tu bya/ /yang na gzhan ni 'ga' zhig yin/ /tshon rtsi gzhan ni dam par sbyar/ /thal (8)ba yis kyang dus ci bzhin/ /'dir ni slob dpon dag gis 6)bya/ /rin chen phye mar yang dag ldan/ /yang na yo byad dang ldan pa/ /gal te sgrub byed de rgyal po/ /sna tshogs bye 7ba'i tshad du bya/ /yang na 'bum dang yang dag ldan/ /stong las nyung bar mi bya'o/ /spos dang mar me'i mchod bstod 17dang / /dri yi bum pa nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin bum gang gtor ma dang / /bum pa rnams dang mar me dag /tshong dpon yang na ded dpon rung / /bcu las nyung 7bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan 'ga' tizhig ni 'ongs kyang rung / /bca' ba dag ni stong phrag bcu/ /bcu las nyung bar mi bya'o / /bza' ba dag ni brgya'am stong / /bcu las nyung bar mi bya'o/ /g.yos kyi rnam pa kun dang ni/ /de bzhin dri rnams thams cad kun/ /rol mo sgeg dang rtsed mo dang / /de bzhin phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /de nas rdo rje 84—484

slob dpon gyis/ /de tshe mchod pa byed nas ni①/ /ci nas song ②ni khyed cag rnams la/ /grub ༷par bya phyir brtul zhugs brtsamadu/ /rang nyid khrus byas yan lag byugs/ /dag cing gtsang ma'i dugos gyon cing / /rnam par dben pa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bya/ /me tog spos snod lag thogs gshing / /phyogs rnams kun tu phyag bya'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la ⑧sogs kun gshegs shing / /gsang ba'i spyan ni 'gugs pa yi/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bya/ /de nas gnas ni yang dag bsgruba'o/ /dben zhing kun du tsogayeng ba med/ /ri bo yang hunyeni dgon pa'am / /de bzhin phug gi nang dag gam/ /shing drung gi ni gnas dag gam/ /chu bo'i 'gram mam 8yang na ngogs/ /dngos grub gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /lha rnams myur du gshegs par 'gyur/ /rdo dang gseg ma rus par ldan/ /thal ba ldan ljin mi gtsang bcas/ /rtsub cing rtsa ba khyab la 8sogs/ /de 'brir ④sa gzhi rnam par spang / /shin tu bzang zhing 'od bzang snum/ /tshad dang ldan zhing gseg ma 8med/ /'dom gang yang na khru gang tsam/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyang bar bya/ /grong yidang yul 'khor nyid dag dang / /grong khyer dag dang ljongs dang ni/ /rgyal po'i pho brang tshong dus su(zhe/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bya ba min / /de 'dra'i sa gzhi bsgrubs zhenanas ni/ /steng gi char ni bsgrub (7par bya / /'dom gang yang na khru gang tsam/ /skas gdang bzhi dang ldan pa ru/ /sbyangs te de nas gnas kyi ni/ /dbus su phur bu gzugs sum̐ )par bya/ / rdo rje phur bu'i sngags dang ni/ /()rdo rje phur bu'i phyag rgya yis/ /mchod pa'i sa gzhi ( nye84wa 485

mdzes par bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa byed pas bcag /bgegs ①bcing ba yi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams kun tu bcing bar bya/ /me dang gshin rje chu ②dang ni/ /rlung dang dbang po rdo rje phyogs/ /rdo rje bzod dka'i phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje'i sngags kyis (misbyang bar bya/ /mchod gnas dpag tshad tshad tsam du/ /bcwa (gelnga nas ni yang dag brtsamaphyi/ /gnyis pa'am ni gsum pa yi/ /nya la nyes par mi 56)'gyur ro/ /ci ste 'byor pa med na ni/ /zla ba gcig tsam ⑦rab tu sbyar/ /bcwa 98)lnga nas ni 6)yang dag brtsamacha/ /bcwa (1lnga la ni rdzogs par bya//ci ste zla ba phyed tsam du/ /bcwa tsolnga la ni rnam par sbyang / /ci ste rings na tshes brgyad nas/ /bcwa tu lnga la ni rdzogs par bya/ /tshes dgu dang ni bcu dang ni/ /bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi payi/ /bdun pa lnga pa nyid dang ⑩ni/ /nya la nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /ci ste nyin zhag de brtsams yinas/ /de nyid la ni yongs rdzogs bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor sa gzhi (merab tu bsgrub12 / /rang nyid khrus byas yan lag byugs6)/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gos bgo zhing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu spras/ /rdo rje slob dpon rnam par brgyan / /gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gos dang ldan/ /gtsang ma'i grogs dang lhan cig tu/ /sems can kun don yang dag ldan/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag gzung 2lha/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong du yang / /ci nas mngon par brtson byas kyang / /gang zag bzhi po 'jig rten du/ /bsgrubs 8)kyang 'grub pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /sems ni bskyed par ma gyur dang / /dad med 'grub ( nyapar mi 'gyur nyid/ /the tshom 2 'dzin pa nyid dag dang / /bka' bsgo ba ni mi byed pa'o 5 / /dri yi chu yis 7legs bskus pa'i/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas de 84—486

ni / /dri dang ldan pa'i chu dag gisadhi/ /phyogs rnams kun du chag chag btab / /ba yi lci ②bas legs sbyangs te / /dri dang bcas pas legs byugs te / /de nas gur gum la ④sogs pa'i/ /dri dag gtsang mar sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag byin gyis (5)brlab/ /rdo rje spyan ⑥gyi phyag rgya yis/ /pad+ma'i mig can dag gis ⑦blta/ /dkyil 'khor bar dang tha ma ru/ /sbyin sreg las ni yang dag brtsam/ / sbyin sreg las ni rnam pa lnga/ /(7sbyin sreg las ni rnam par sbyar/ /rig pa'i dngos grub cho ga la/ /sbyin sreg las ni yang dag brtsam/ /de bzhin sngags dang phyag rgya tshogs / /de 'dra'i sngags dang phyag 7rgya'ang min/ /sngon la bgegs rnams gzhom par bya/ /de nas sbyin sreg yang dag brtsam/ /de 'og gsang ba'i mchod chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bri bar bya/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa lnga ru bshad / /yang na bcu drug dag tu 'gyur/ /rang rang gi ni cho ga bzhin/ /sbyin sreg las ni yang dag brtsam/ /dgongs pa'i gang zhig bsgrub 7pa'i phyir/ /gang zhig mchod pa yang dag brtsama'o1/ /gal te mi nus skal chen gyis/ /bza' ba dag ni rab tu bya/ /dri dang bcas pa dang sbyar ba'i/ /yang na dkar gsum bza' 6)bar bya/ /'di ltar rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /byin gyis tsho rlob pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /bgegs rnams nges 'joms nga yi ni/ /slob dpon gyi ni las bzang po/ /bgegs rnams zlog par byed pa'i mchog /bcing ba dam pa bshad par bya/ /rtag tu rdo rje khro bo dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag bya zhing / /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /bshegs rnams thams cad dgug mi)par bya/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad drang bar bya/ /rdo 84—487

rje las kyi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad kun tu dgug /sdig pa med kyis ma 'jigs shig① /sems can rnam par 'tshe ba'ang med/ /rang gi rnam rtog las byung bgegs/ /ma rig las byung mi dge bzhin/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin phyag rgya yis / /bgegs rnams thams cad gzir bar bya/ /rdo rje lug rgyud ②phyag rgya yis / /bgegs rnams thams cad bkri bar bya/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya yis / /bgegs rnams thams cad kun du dbab/ /rdo rje brdab ①pa'i phyag rgya yis / /bgegs rnams thams cad brdab par byadhi/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis / /bgegs rnams thams cad sbar bar bya/ /rdo rje ral gri ⑤phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gcad ⑥par bya/ /rdo rje cod pan phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad brdung bar bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig par bya/ /rdo rje 'khrul ⑦'khor phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad btsir bar bya/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gtub (kyepar bya/ /rdo rje mdung thung phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dbug 6)par bya/ /rdo rje sreg 0byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsreg par bya/ /rdo rje 'khor byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje srad bu'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskyod par bya/ /rdo rje zlog tunyebyed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rnam par brlag /rdo rje 'joms byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhom par bya/ /rdo rje 'jigs tu byed phyag rgya yis/ /84—488

bgegs rnams thams cad 'jigs hu)par byed/ /rdo rje za byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje 'cha' zhubyed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bca' nibar bya/ /rdo rje dral ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dral bar bya/ /rdo rje sgyel ①byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsgyel bar ⑤bya/ /rdo rje slong ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bslang bar bya/ /rdo rje gsod pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gsad ⑥par bya/ /rdo rje 'tsho byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'tsho bar bya/ /rdo rje sgrub pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad yang dag bsgrubasti/ /rdo rje rgyas 'debs phyag rgya yis//gdug pa thams cad rgyas gdab bya/ /rdo rje rlung gi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rlung la bskur/ /rdo rje chu yi ⑤phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad chu la g.yeng / /rdo rje me ni rab rno bas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsreg par bya/ /rdo rje brgyal 5)byed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad brgyal ⑩bar byed(nya/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad sbyin sreg bya/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i 8phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs tunyernams thams cad gzung yibar bya/ /rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad sos gdab bya/ /rdo rje 'bigs 7pa'i phyag rgya yisatso/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dbug par bya/ /rdo rje 'jig yinabyed phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig par bya/ /rdo rje bka' bzhin byed pa yis/ /bkug nas bka' la dgod par bya/ /rdo rje sdigs mdzub yi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bsdigs par bya/ /rdo rje 'gas zhanabyed phyag rgya yis/ /84—489

bgegs rnams thams cad dgas 6)par bya/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs kyi rigs kun gzhom par bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bzod dka' chadang / /rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje rkang pas bsnun (kyepar bya/ /bgegs 'joms pa yi phyag rgya yis/ /de nas ④steng gi bgegs gzhom bya/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i mchog /rdo rje chen po'i gsang rgyud las/‘ /rdo rje khro bo'i snyoms 'jug bya/ /brgya dang rtsa bcu lhag pa dang / /rdo rje slob dpon gsang ⑤ba ni/ /rgyas pa ru ni yongs su bstan/ /bgegs la du )sogs pa gdug pa kun/ /chad pa gcad ⑦phyir btus pa yin(kye/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg las (9)ni yang dag brtsamakyi/ /rnam pa brgyad dang rtsa bcu lhag /rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba ni/ /'di ni gsang ba'i rgyud chen po/ /rgyud de las ni rab tu bshad/ /gsang ba'i sbyin sreg cho gar bcas/ /gzhan yang dang po 1terab bshad bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po gsang ba'i las/ /sbyin sreg las ni rgyun mi gcad(ste/ /las rnams thams cad btus pa yi ge/ /gsang ba rgyud chen 'di ru ni/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa nyi shu yis/ /thams cad bsdus cipar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /mngon spyod kyi ni las dang ni/ /tshe spel ba dang dgug pa dang / /nor dang 'bru ni 'phel ba dang / / bsrung dang bsrung 8ba min dang bgegs/ /sdig pa thams cad rab gzhom dang / /bcing dang gsad 7dang drag po dang / /chags dang rjes su bcom pa dang / /dbang du bya dang gzugs bzang nyid/ /'dod dga'i 7gzugs su snang ba dang / /mkha' la 'gro dang dngos grub kyi/ /rdzas ni grub par bya ba la/ /sgrub tsho12pa'i dkyil 'khor byed pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon 84wa 490

gyis de bya/ /de lta bu yi rnam pa yi/ /sbyin sreg bzang po nyi shur ①bshad/ /ji ltar sbyin sreg cho ga bzhin/ /sngon du thab khung bya ba yin/ /gru ②bzhi la ni rgyas pa steg/ /zlum po la ni zhi ba'o/ /gang zhig 'gugs ④par byed pa yi/ /rdo rje'i rnam par yang dag bya/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i rnam pa gzhan⑤/ /mngon spyod la ni gru gsum ste/ /sdig pa thams cad rab gzhom phyir/ /zlum po rta babs ldan pa yin/ /rin chen rnam pa rigs rgyas la/ /tshe 'phel ba dang 'grib pa dang / /shin tu dag phyir phyag rgya'i dbyibs/ /bsrung ⑥la go cha lta bu yin/ /bcing ba la ni 'obs/ kyis bskor/ /gsad la mche stib dang ldan pa'i/ /ci 'dod gzugs la gang yang rung / /mi snang ba la gzhu dang ldan/ /phyogs dang mkha' 'phur la lcags kyu/ /bka' byed phyag rgya bsgrub ⑧pa dang / /dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub 6)pa la/ /'khor lo 'am ni gru bzhi'o/ /rdzas dang sman ni 'grub pa la / /thab khung bud med yan lag mtshungs/ /yang na thun mong ⑩dngos grub kyil/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ji lta ba/ /sbyin sreg thab khung de mtshungs 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin dngos grub bzang ldan zhing / /thams cad phun tshogs de ltar 'gyur/ /'khor lo sogs la cung zad mthar / /sbyin sreg thab khung brko (glebar bya/ /thab khung nyi shu'o(gye/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga thams cad la/ /thab khung gang zhig mthong tsam gyis/ /sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /thab khung bstan pa bshad par bya/ /sngon du thig ni gdab bya zhing / /tshon gyis sa phyogs legs par bri/ /gru bzhir thig brgyad ces bya ba/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo dbyung tu bar bya/ /gru bzhi'i cha ni mnyam pa ste / /legs par bgos shing legs bris pa/ /rta babs khabazhi dang yang dag 84—491

ldan / /sgo khyud rnams kyis ①legs par spras/ /sgo bzhi dag dang yang dag ldan / /sgo ni cha brgyad ldan par bya/ /dra ba zla ba phyed pas spras/ /rdo rje sgo khyud rdo rjer ldan/ /pad+ma'i nags kyi lhug ②ma dang / /phreng ba rab tu 'khor ba dang / /spyi blugs phyag rgya chen po ni③/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi cha ru bri/ /rtse gsum zla ba phyed pa dang / /ral gri ④gyu mchog mdzes rgyal mtshan/ / 'dod ces dubade ba phyag rgya che/ /lho yi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /'khor lo dung dang dbyug to dang ske/ /rta babs glang po dang ni phag /phyag rgya nub tu bri bar bya/ /mdung thung dril bu ba dan dang / /rma bya de bzhin ra skyes dang / /khyim bya 'thab mo la phyogs pa/ /byang gi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /de yi dam tshig 'khor lo la/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya yang dag bri/ /dbus kyi gnas su cod pan te/ /phyi rol rdo rjes nye bar spras/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'bar ba yi/ /rdo rje shar gyi phyogs cha ru/ /lho ru nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /nub tu pad+ma rdo rje'o/ /byang du rdo rje hūṃ 6)mdzad de / /gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje thabs chen rnams / /phyi rol phyag rgya bcu drug tu/ /thab khung brkos (7pa gang yin pa/ /de yi bla re rnam par bsgom/ /me tog shing dang spos sogs kyis/ /ji bzhin du ni dkyil 'khor mchod/ /rang nyid khrus byas (7yan lag byugs/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan ldan pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu spras/ /dri dag bzang pos dbang bskur 'gyur/ /nga ni pad 'dzin rgyal po ste/ /thor tshugs 6)dbus na de bzhin gshegs/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ldan/ /bud med sdug dang lhan cig tu/ /dpung pa dam du bsdams byas te/ /mtshan ma 'greng 7bar rab gyur nas6gle/ /sbyin sreg las 84—492

ni yang dag brtsamal/ /e ma'o ②bde ba bde chen po/ /'dod chags bde ba bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dod chags che/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bdag grub mdzod/ /'dod chags bde ba rjes dran nas/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags brtag ①mi bya/ /bud med khams ni bkug nas su/ /'khrig pa bdun ni spang bar bya/ /mtshan ma langs par rab gyur nas/ /dbang po nye bar zhi byas te / /'dod chags 0rjes dran gyur nas ni/ /sbyin sreg las ni yang dag brtsam / /mtshan ma phyag mtshan zhes brjod deX/ /langs 0pa lhag par bya ba yin / /rdo rje can gyi phyag mtshan las④/ /mkhas pas lhag par bcang bar ⑧bya / /rdo rje can dang byang sems kyi/ /byang chub sems ni brtan pa dang / /pha rol phyin pa drug gis ⑨mtshan/ /brtse bas rjes chags dngos grub ster/ /shes rab thabs la dga' ba bstan/ /rtag tu bsten par bya ba yin/ /mtshan ma langs par rab gyur nas/ /lhag par yang ni bsten par bya/ /mngon 'dod rig ma sdug gang yin/ /de la ⑩rnal 'byor pas 'o bya7/ /lhag pas phyag rgya che ⑫gyur nas/ /dpung pa dam du bsdam 8par bya/ /rab tu dga' ba mang po gang //de ni rab dga'i sa ru 'dod/ /gang la chags pa tsorab brtags pa/ /yang dang yang du bran 8par bya/ /brtse ⑩dang byams pas yang dag byugs/ /khrel yod pa yi gos kyis chadagab/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs yang dag byugs/ /byang chub kyi ni sems kyis brgyanayi/ /de 'dra'i brtul zhugs ldan pa yi()/ /tshon rtsi chen po bsten ( )par bya/ /gzhan yang phyi yi yan lag dgadu /gang phyir rdo rje can gyis 'dzin/ /sbyin sreg las kyi ducho ga bzhin/ /shar du kha bltas (gesbyin sreg bya/ /ci (steskad gzhung las gsungs pa bzhin/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis 84—493

de bya/ /zhi la sangs rgyas byang chub mchog /rgyas la rdo rje rin chen gyis/ /rdo rje khro bo mngon spyod la/ /lcags kyu yis ①ni 'gugs par bshad/ /bcud kyis ②len la rdo rje'i sman/ /tshe 'phel de bzhin mi g.yo ba'i/ /rdo rje sman gyi rgya chen dang / /rdo rje'i rtse mo nor 'phel la/ /bsrung tshil 'khor lo cho ga ste/ /bzlog pa la ni rdo rje gzung ④/ /g.yon pa lcags sgrog (9phyag rgya ches/ /sdig pa gzhom par bya bar bshad/ /bcing la rdo rje bcing ba ste/ /gsod la rdo rje gsod byed dom/ /chags la rdo rje chags pa yis/ /rjes su bstan ⑥pa la yang bshad/ /dbang la rdo rje dbang gis so/ /ci 'dod gzugs la sna tshogs te/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i dngos grub la/ /rdo rje'i dngos grub rnam 'phrul gyis/ /pad+ma'i sman gyi phyag rgya ches/ /rdzas gsu grub pa'i bde mchog yin/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i grub pa la/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor phyag rgya yis/ /rig pa kun bdag rgyal po yi / /phyag rgya'i mchog (8)de yongs su gzung / /dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la / /pad+ma chen po'i sman mchog gis/ /lag pa g.yon pas phyag rgya bcing / /g.yas pa yis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /rdo rje sna tshogs phyag rgya yis/ /sbyin sreg las la rgyas gdab bya/ /g.yon pa hūṃ ldan sdigs mdzub 6)ste/ /g.yas pa mche ba gtsigs pa ste/ /mngon spyod kyi ni phyag rgya yis/ /rus pa'i phye mas phyogs rnams bcing / /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha kyi:/ groṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍa 11rtsu/ gro: tu)pa ya gro: (nyepa ya hūm̐/ ā bon ya ho ba tshig ban skyabibyā rā dza 1zhes phaṭa/ g.yon pa chos 'chad dang ldan zhing / /g.yas pa yi kyisheni sbyin sreg bya/ /sangs rgyas chos ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /til bsregs 67pas ni sdig pa bsregs )/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da 21ha na badzā ya 32su hā/ lag pa g.yon pa rin chen gyur ge/ /g.yas pa yis 84wa 494
