ni sbyin sreg bya/ /'bru bdun yang na rin chen nas/ /yo byad kun gyis mnyes par bya/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na ①ka ma kā ya ②swā hā/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas ni / /mngar bas me ni rab sbar te/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'bras bsregs dun/ /khyim ni nges par rgyas par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ④ye swā hā/ shin tu mngar ⑤ba'i bud shing gis/ /me ni rab tu sbar byas te/ /ku sha'i myu ⑥ku til bcas pas / /sbyin sreg byas na bsrung ⑦don mchog /oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badzā ya ⑧swā hā/ yam shing mngar po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin drur 6)ba'i myu gu dag /mar smyugs yirdo rje'i phyag rgya tunyeyis/ /bsregs snyin tshe 'phel byed pa'i mchog /oṃ badz+ra ā 0yu ṣe 8swā hā/ bud shing tsha ba rnams kyi ni/ /rdo rje khro bdag ting 'dzin gyis/ /thab 8khung du ni me sbar te/ /tsher ma rnams kyis yidagug par bya / /oṃ badz+ra ā 0kar ṣa tunyeya swā hā/ de bzhin sna tshogs thams cad kyis/ /mkhas pa yis ni me sbar te/ /rtag tu chu skyes sbyin sreg byas/ /rdo rje 'ching bar 'gyur ba yin/ /oṃ badz+ra ban dha ya baṃ/ de bzhin sbyor ba'i cho ga yis/ /mkhas pas yam shing bsreg bya zhing / /'bras bu kha ba'i sbyin sreg byas/ /skad cig gis ni gsod par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra mā ra (rten ( pye ye hūṃ/ de bzhin bla k+ṣa ( nyedamar po/ /bsregs ( gyen dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra rā (steg na ye hrīḥ( ste / sha pus (nyepas ni sbyin sreg byas/ /de bzhin chags par byed pa'i mchog /oṃ badz+ra shaṃ ka rā ( 4ya swā hā/ khros pas 'dod pa'i 'bras bsregs (zhen/ /ci 'dod gzugs ni thob par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kā zhunyam rū su pa ṇi zhu )swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kha ra tsi re sok+kiṇi zhi swā hā/ bud shing ro ni kha ba yis/ /shin tu khros ru pas me sbar te/ /khros pas rdo rje me tog bsregasakhri sku/ /rdo rje bka' bzhin byed par 84—495

'gyur / /hūm̐ badz+ra shaṃ dhika rā ya ②swā hā/ oṃ bhu ②ta ba shaṃ ka rā 0ya swā hā/dngos grub kun gyi cho ga bzhin/ /mkhas pas yungs kur 0sbyin sreg bya/ /yungs kur 0shin tu bkra shis pas/ /dngos grub sbyin sreg mchog yin no/ /oṃ sarba sid dha ⑦ye swā hā/ rig pa 'dzin pa grub bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pas swa sti ka bsreg bya/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /sbyin sreg rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du/ /oṃ sid dha sid dha ye swā hā/ oṃ da la a dhi ⑧pa ta ye swā hā/ maṇ+ḍa la a dhi 1)pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ bhuḥ0swā hā/ oṃ bhu ba swā ⑩tā/ oṃ swa swā hā/ oṃ byur ⑫ bhu ba 8suḥ8su ⑩tā/ oṃ swa sti 0swā hā/ oṃ swa sti na maḥ8swā hā/ oṃ sid dhe spre)pra bhā ta lho)ye swā hā/ oṃ ( nyesarba duḥ 0kha u ⑤pa sha ma ne swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sid dha ye swā hā/ oṃ kār+ya kā ra ṇi puṣ+ṭa dushan ti ke swā hā/ yi ge phaṭa ni mngon spyod la/ /yi ge dzaḥ0yis 'gugs par 'gyur/ /yi ge baṃ ni bcing dul sbyar/ /dbang du bya la yi ge shrī/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bsdigs ( nyal sbyar/ /gsad ⑥pa la yang yi ge hūm̐/ /ha ni bsrung phyib bzang po la/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bzlog pa la/ /shrīs ni sna tshogs gzugs bsgrub bya/ /oṃ ni mi snang bstan pa la/ /ho ni chags dang dgug pa la/ /u ni gsang ba'i dag pa 'dzin/ /mngon spyod ldan la yi ge rtsu/ /hūṃ ni rdzu 'phrul sgrub byed pa/ /lha mo chen po sgrub la lhatsho/ /oṃ ni kun la nges par sbyar/ /yam shing ser po rgyas pa la/ /zhi ba la ni dkar po'o/ /dbang du bya ba dmar po ste/ /nag po mngon spyod las la'o/ /zhi la 0mar gyis byugs (nyapa ste/ /rgyas pa la ni 'o ma bcas/ /dbang du bya la lan tshwar (nyeldan/ /tsha ba dang bcas mngon spyod la/ /dbye ba rgya chen dag gis ni/ /sbyin sreg las rnams shes par bya/ /de nyid sbyin sreg nyi shu 'di/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsang ba 84wa 496

yin / /de kho na nyi shu pa zhes bya ba sbyin sreg gi gsang ba'o// //de nas dngos grub thabs chen po/ /thams cad 'grub 'dod dkyil 'khor du / /grub ①pa'i sbyor ba'i cho ga yis/ /dngos grub tshogs kyi sbyor ldan zhing / /rdo rje yi ni slob dpon che/ /brtan bcas rigs su yang dag skyes/ /theg pa chen por yang dag gnas/ /bskal pa grangs med mthar thug par/ /chos kyi shing rta che la zhon/ /shes rab thabs dang yang dag ldan/ /sems can kun gyi don la brtson/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ②yongs su bzung / /slob dpon chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /mchog tu sa yi mthar phyin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /bgegs rnams ①thams cad bsal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su yang dag ldan/ /sbyin sreg cho ga byas nas kyang / /chos sbyin chen po yang dag brtsam/ /dam chos snying po bcud las byung / /sangs rgyas mchod pa bla med pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul/ /shes rab thabs kyi tshul thob byed/ /rgyal chen shes rab chen po dang / /thabs kyis gormad byung ⑤chos nyid do/ /bram ze bzhin du rigs mchog skyes / /byang chub sems dpa'i gsang chen 'dzin/ /gal te nus na skal chen gyis / /gang tshe mchod pa rtsom pa nas/ /ji srid zin (7par gyur gyi bar/ /bza' ba ⑦dag ni mi bya'o/ /dri dang bcas par nilegs sbyar ba'i/ /yang na dkar gsum bza' bar bya/ /gang phyir rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /byin gyis po)rlob pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /ci ste bzod ldan nyin mtshan du/ /bza' ba dag ni mi bya ste/ /gang phyir chos kyi rang bzhin zas/ /tshim par 'gyur bar the tshom med//84—497

dkyil 'khor dag ni dag byas shing / /dri rnams kun gyis ①mngon 'dus byas/ / sngags kyis (mibasangs pa'i chu yis ni/ /thams cad kun nas chag chag gdab/ /gang tshe mchod par byed pa na/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi ①phyag bya zhing / /bshags dang gsol ba gdab nyid dang / /mchod pa'i sprin dang rjes yi durang / /bdag nyid dbul ba la ⑤sogs pa'i/ /las rnams rim bzhin byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mnyam dbus su/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bca' bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus pa yi/ /skyil krung rnam pa bcu ru bshad/ /gsang chen de nyid mchog 'di ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa'o/ /dpal dang bkra shis sdigs mdzub (6)byed/ /de bzhin g.yas kyi phyed krung ⑦nyid / /phyi rol brkyang (nyadang bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin rin chen 6)rang bzhin te / /de dag bcu ru rang bzhin bshad/ /skyil krung brgya dang bcu lhag pa/ /gsang ba'i rgyud kyi gsang ba yi/ /rgyud de las ni rab tu bshad/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas te/ /sangs rgyas la dmigs sems kyis ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten gsum/ /byams pa 7chen po rjes dran nas/ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mchog /rnal 'byor pas ni snyoms 'jug bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /de nas yang ni las rgyal po/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i bzang po nas/ /bcu phrag gcig lhag brgya ru bshad/ /las thams cad pa gsum du brjod/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /ting 'dzin sbyor ba med par ni/ /dkyil 'khor brtan par mi 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor ba med par ni/ /dngos grub nyid ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de bas rtag tu 'bad pas ni/ /ting 'dzin dngos grub dkyil 'khor bya/ /gal te mchog tu gsang 84—498

ba ni/ /bla med theg pa'i gsang 'dod na/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi spyod yul ni①glu/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /de nas byang sems rnam 'phrul du/ /so so'i skye bos mi nus so/ /de rnams kyi ni ting 'dzin mchog /sems nyid kyis ni yang dag bya/ /dang po'i rgyud las bshad pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas kyi ②ni rnam 'phrul bshad/ /blo ldan byang ②sems ting 'dzin gyisaX/ /bdag nyid rdzu 'phrul chen po dubasam/ /dka' thub sna tshogs drag po ni/ /bdag gis byas par ⑥bsam par bya/ /'og min zhes bya gnas yin pa/ /lha yi gnas ni bsam par byag/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yi(nye/ /dag pa'i 'dus pa rnam par bsam/ /dang por sangs rgyas phyag byas nas/ /de nas thub rnams la de bzhin/ /bka' mnos ji skad bstan pa yi/ /slar yang skyil krung bca' bar yo)bya/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /kun tu dga' byed bsam par bya / /mtshan nyid thams cad kyis brgyan ⑩pa'i/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku dang ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur 5nyeb/ /lnga ni bdag nyid la bsam bya / /rdo rje'i gnas su 'dug bya zhing / /rtse mo mthon por bsam par bya/ /dang por sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //rdo rje shar du 'dug bya zhing / /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rnam par 'phrul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang spro/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnam par sprul//rgyal po dang bcas rigs dkyil 'khor/ /sgo srung lisgog mo la tu sogs dang / /lha mo dang bcas phyag rgya yiyi/ /sbyor bas rdo rje can dbang bskur/ /rdo rje'i las su yang dag bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyi 7ni mkha' dbyings su/ /sangs rgyas 84wa 499

thams cad mos byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ①rang bzhin nyid/ /dbang bskur bar ni yang dag bya/ /rdo rje chos 'dzin rgyal po ru/ /dkyil 'khor bkod la brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgug bya zhing / /rdo rje can rnams mchog zhugs ②bya/ /bsgrub pa dang ni dbang du bya/ /bya ba 'di ni mchog yin no/ /rang gi ②rigs kyi ④dkyil 'khor du/ /gnas de lhag par mos par bya/ /'khor lo ji bzhin bkod ji bzhin/ /phyag rgya ji bzhin dbang byas pa'o/ /las kyi rgyal po phyimachog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //rang nyid khrus byas yan lag byugs/ /rgyan dang gos ni sna tshogs ldan/ /dpung rgyan gdu bu yinyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sor gdub dbu rgyan bcas/ /gser skud ༅mu tig dang ldan pa'i/ /lag pa rkang pa de nas ske/ /lus kun rnam par brgyan 90'gyur ba/ /de bzhin ko sha'i ras 6)lhag pa'i/ /gos dag bzang po bgos zhing bsang 7/ /yang na chos gos 'dzin pa ste/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /gal te skra bregs dge slong ste(nye/ /ring zhing 'khyil la mdog sngo ba'i/ /skra ni sngon po bcing chabar bya/ /yang na rang gi mgo la skyes / /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /yang na rdo rje las su bya/ /rnal 'byor rang bzhin gsang med par/ /dngos grub bzang po thob mi 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su mnyam pa ru/ /ci rigs par ni 'dug nas su/ /shar du kha bltas langs nas ni/ /khengs pa med cing ma 'khrul bar/ /rdo rje sems dpar nya yongs su bskor/ /mtshan brgya chartsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig tu ni brjod par bya/ /bstod 7pa byas nas rang bdag nyid/ /dngos grub sbyor ba 84—500

yang dag bya/ /snying rje chen po sbyor ba yis/ /bdag gis drang srong ①bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /don yod dbang phyug dam pa ste / /theg pa che mchog skyes pa'i mchog /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzodal/ /sems dpa' chen po thabs chen po/ /rdo rje 'khor lo mchod pa che/ /dngos grub chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /rdo rje ming ni yang dag gzung / /phyogs rnams kun tu yang dag bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par blta ②bya zhing / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rjes dran bya/ /slar yang skyil mo krung bcas te/ /nga ni rang nyid 'khor los sgyur / /phyag rgya'i tshogs ni bcing ba la/ /stong las nyung bar mi bya'o/ /tha na rdo rje sems dpa' ni / /de nyid phyag rgya yongs su gzung / /langs nas tshig ni brjod par bya/ /bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rab sgrub ④pa/ /rdo rje la ⑤sogs kun gshegs shig /bdag ni rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag grub mdzodayi/ /tshon chen kha bsgyur ( )dri ldan pa'i/ /slad bu lhag pa grims par bsgrilabya/ /rdo rje srad bu phyag rgya ches/ /dkyil 'khor chen po thig gdab bya/ /'khor lo ji bzhin bkod ji bzhin/ /ji bzhin gzhung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ji bzhin bri/ /rdo rje'i thig ni yongs su gdab/ /de nas de yi rang rigs dzi)gsang / /'khor lo chen po rab tu sgrubatso/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor lo ni/ /go rims 0bzhin du bshad par bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes byas pa'i/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang phreng bas rnam par brgyan(nya/ /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo yi sgo khyud mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje rin 84—501

chen rnams kyis spras/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de yi nang gi rim pa ni/ /'khor lo lta bur bri bar bya/ /rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje ka ba'i mdun ①gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam par brgyan②/ /ji ltar phyi dang nang gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor re re ②rnam par dbye/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor lnga bris gang yin de/ /ka ba mchog ni brgyad kyis spras/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa yin par bshad/ /dbus kyi shin tu dbus song nas/ /chos 'dzin rgyal po chen po ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad khyab bdag che/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni dgod par bya(ga/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni phyogs kun du/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su ni/ /dam tshig mchog rnams bzhi po yang / /go rims (snyebazhin du yang dag bris56/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /mdun rgyab tu ni gnas pa yin/ /rdo rje lcags kyu g.yas phyogs su/ /nub kyi phyogs su bdud 'joms pa/ /rdo rje legs pa rgyal po che/ /chos 'dzin chen po dbang dang ldan//chos 'dzin pa ni byang du ste/ /mdun du rdo rje bsnyems tshul lo/ /de la de yi snying po gsang / /shin tu rtog (7)par byed pa'i mchog /sdug bsngal (shekun las rab grol byed/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskul ba/ /hūm̐ dzaḥpo)ho sā7/ shar phyogs cha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis (/mesong nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus de ru/ /mi bskyod pa ni dgod par bya/ /rdo rje shugs kyi snying po ni//the tshom logacod pa sngon 'gro can/ /tshogs sngon 'gro ba bzang po ste/ /sdig pa thams cad rab 'joms 12byed/ /oṃ be ga ('a kra ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ /thub pa skyes chog 'imi bskyod pa/ /glang po phyag rgya la gnas 84—502

shing / /zhi ba'i phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /de la snying po 'di yin te/ /hūm̐/de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje mchog rnams dgod pa ni/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras shing / /khros bcas bzhin ni 'dzum ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bstan pa che/ /rdo rje 'dod chags bdud chen po/ /rdo rje legs pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje rin chen dgod par bya/ /rdo rje chags pa gang bshad pa/ /rdo rje chos ni dgod par bya/ /rdo rje legs par gang bshad pa/ /rdo rje las ni yongs su gzung 6)/ /dam tshig rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /'khor los sgyur chab dgod par bya/ /thams cad sangs rgyas cod pan ldan/ /'khor los sgyur chabar dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje rin chen de bzhin las/ /pad+ma sna tshogs dga' chen po/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis9)/ /byang chub mchog de yang dag gzung (ge/ /yan lag 'gyur ba lhag ma rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la (5)sogs dgod/ /de nas sangs rgyas rigs bzhag ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi snying po la/ /phyag rgya dang ni snying po bshad / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su gzung / /hūṃ dzaḥ(7)ho swa(8)/ yi ge dza sogs bshad pa la/ /yi ge oṃ ni yang dag dgod/ /ho dhi (9)chos dbyings yi ge a/ /yi ge swa yini yongs su bsgyur/sto/ /rdo rje shugs kyis lhor song nas/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dkyil 'khor lo/ /bcom ldan mchog ni yongs su 'dzin/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje rin chen la sogs bris4gye/ /rin chen gzi brjid rgyal mtshan dang / /rin chen so yi rgyan bcas pa/ /de la yo rnams kyi snying po ni/ /oṃ aḥtā saha/ nub kyi phyogs 57kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs 7kyis song nas su/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje chos/ /'od dpag med ni 84—503

dgod par bya'o/ /de yi snying po ni hrīḥ/ de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje pad+ma la sogs bridhi/ /pad+ma rnon po de bzhin rgyu/ /smra ba phyag rgya pad+ma ②bcas / /de la 'di ①rnams kyi snying po ni hrīḥdo 0mi ro/ rdo rje shugs kyis dusong nas ni/ /byang gi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /bcom ldan 'das ni don yod grub/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni dgod par bya/ /de yi snying po ni kai /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje las la ⑥sogs pa bri/ /thams cad bsrung ⑦ba gnod sbyin che/ /las dang khu tshur shin tu brtan/ /de la 'di rnams kyi snying po ni/ kai haṃ hūm̐ rba/ dbus kyi 'khor lo (nyag bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /rdo rje rin chen de bzhin las/ /pad+ma lha mo bzhi ru bshad//de la de rnams kyi snying po ni/ /oṃ oṃ hrīḥ.a ⑨thams cad kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor chen po las cha dang po'i dkyil 'khor dbus ma rdzogs sotso// //dkyil 'khor dbus ma rdzogs nas ni/ /phyag rgya thams cad yongs su bri/ /phyag rgya de ni byin brlab 9/nyepa/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su gzung / /byang chub mchog tu dbus nas mchog /shis pa shar gyi phyag rgya ste/ /lho yi phyogs su mchog sbyin no/ /nub tu chos kyi 'khor lo 'dzin/ /byang du mi 'jigs sbyin zhes patsha/ /don yod grub pas yongs su gzung / /phyag rgya lhag ma phyag mtshan bcas / /de nas rdo rje sems tshogs bri/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po las rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbus kyi cha zhes bya ba rdzogs skras12 84—504

rdo rje shugs kyis ①song nas su/ /shar phyogs kyi ni dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje rigs chen nyams dga' ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni yang dag bri/ /ka ba brgyad ni rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo yongs su dgod/ /de yi shar gyi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs can yang dag bri/ /ut+pal sngon po 'od chen ldan/ /khro (9bcas bzhin ni 'dzum ldan pa'i/ /drag po 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab/ /rdo rje ti rin sriti ri 'dzin/ /khro bo rdo rje'i lta ba 'dzin/ /gtum pa thams cad rab 'dul byed/ /sangs rgyas mdun du rdo rje 'dzin/ /'bar ba'i dbus su dgod par bya/ /de bzhin 'bar dbus pad+ma dang / /de bzhin rin chen sna tshogs mtshan/ /de nyid shar gyi 'khor lo che/ /shar gyi cha ru song nas ni/ /de yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad yang dag bri/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /phyag rgya brgyad ni yongs su 'dzin/ /mche ba dag ni cung zad gtsigs / /khro bcas bzhin ni 'dzum ldan pa'i/ /lcags kyu rdo rje lcags sgrog ④ dang / /zhags pa phyag rgya bzhi ru bshad/ /mda' dang gzhu ni gnyis su 'dzin//gnyis ni yi ge r+ghaṃ gis bsdus/ /des ni rkang pa g.yon pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po mnan par bya/ /g.yas pas lha mo u ma yi/ /nu ma'i bar du mnan pa ste / /g.yon brkyang (5)ba yis legs par gnas/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab 'od ldan/ /sku mdog sngon po drag po ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje khro bo dgod par bya/ /thams cad khro bo'i 'bar bas khyab/ /mche ba dag ni cung zad gtsigs(6)/ /khro bo sems dpa' khro rdo (7)rje/ /de bzhin khro bo chags pa ste/ / khro bo legs pa 84wa 505

drag pa ste/ /①dbus kyi dkyil 'khor bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje shugs kyis ②song nas ni/ /khro bo'i rgyal po g.yas phyogs su/ /khro bo'i bdag nyid chen pos bskor / /dbus su khro bo khro gnyer can/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ / rdo rje khro bo'i ①dbang bskur ldan/ /thams cad bri zhing yang dag dgod/ /khro gnyer can gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rin chen khro bo dgod par bya/ /khro gnyer nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / /khro bo bzhad pa shin tu byung / /dkyil 'khor dam pa gsum pa ru/ /rdo rje shugs kyis ④song nas ni/ /khro bo'i bdag nyid chen por phyibaskor/ /rdo rje'i sde ni yang dag bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i khro bo dgod par bya/ /chos dang rnon po de bzhin rgyu/ /bzhad pa khro bo rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas ni/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /las kyi rgyal po bdag nyid che/ /rdo rje dbab pa yang dag bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /las kyi khro bo la 6)sogs bri/ /las kyi gnod sbyin srin po dang / /bsdu ba'i rdzu 'phrul khu tshur che/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po kun tu bri/ /de ni rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /dkyil 'khor chen po che zhes bya/ /gsang ba de nyid tshogs kyi bdag /de nas kun gyi snying po ni/ /rdo rje rigs kun nyams dga' ba'i/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni 'dir brjod do/ /drag po ha ha zhes sgrogs hūṃ/ /hūṃ hūṃ zhes sgrogs 'jigs (7par byed / /de yi dkyil 'khor rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i lalegs 'dus bya/ /'khor lo dkyil 'khor grwa 6)rnams su/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /khro bo'i sems ma rin chen dang / /pad+ma dang ni las shes bya/ /kun nas mtshams rnams dag tu ni/ /phyag rgya dam bcas de dag bzung 1 )/ /dkyil 'khor thams 84—506

cad kyi rgyal po las cha gnyis pa rdzogs so/ /shar phyogs kyi cha'i dkyil 'khor yang rdzogs so// //dbus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /ka ba'i phyi rol dkyil 'khor du/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma lha mo phyag rgya bcas/ /shar gyi rdo rje rigs nyid la/ /phyi rol gnas su de bzhin nyid/ /nyi ma la bskyed ①bzhi po ni// rdo rje lha mos yongs su bzung / /②rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sbyor 'byung ba/ /yi ge rtsu ni kun tu dgod/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rigs rgyal po/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni 'dir brjod do/ /phyag rgya rang gi yan lag 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su gzung / /phyag rgya thams cad rab sbyor bas/ /de dag gsang zhing mchog gsang bshad/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las rdo rje rigs chen po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //lho yi rin chen dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis (gusong nas kyang / /de ru phun tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor lo lnga po dgod par bya/ /de yi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni dgod par bya/ /rin chen chen po rta la bcibs/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma de bzhin gshegs/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa'i sku/ /'od zer phreng bas kun tu khyab/ /rin chen phreng ba mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /so yi phreng ba rab bzhad cing / /so yi phreng ba'i phyag rgyar ldan/ /mthe zhu dbo'i rtse mo rgyal mtshan 'dzin / /nyi ma'i dbus na sangs rgyas che/ /zla ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i sku/ /84—507

rdo rje rin chen skal ba che/ /0)rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs mchog go/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /②rin chen sems dpa' pad+ma dang / /de bzhin rdo rje las nyid do/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /'khor los sgyur ①bas rnam par brgyan④/ /rin chen chen po rigs las byung ⑤/ /nor bu'i rdo rje nyi ma 'dzin/ /de nas snying po ni sti:rgya/ lho yi shar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis 6)song nas ni/ /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /nor bu'i 'od chen 1)yang dag bri/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje dbang bskur ldan/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rin chen de bzhin yang dag bri/ /rin chen sems dpa' ⑩de bzhin chags/ /rgyal po legs pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje rin chen sogs phyag rgya/ /rang gi phyag rgya phyag mtshan phrag /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /lho yi gnas kyi steng (nya'adug nas/ /rin chen rigs chen bzang po la/ /rdo rje rin chen bzang po bri/ /rin chen bzhi yi dbang bskur ldanatsha/ sangs rgyas spyi bo 'dzin pa'i mchog /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /rin chen phreng ba'i dbang bskur ldan/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /sems dpa' bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /rin chen rgyal po rgyal mtshan dang / /bzhad dang rin chen rgyal po che/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /nub kyi rdo rje dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma rin chen bdag nyid che/ /rin chen phreng bas dbang bskur ldan6ste/ /rin chen pad+ma'i mchog 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas dbu rgyan sems dpa' che/ /rin chen 7zhi ba yongs su 'dzin/ /zur mig 'dod chags chags pa'i spyan/ /skyes bu 'dul ba la gzigs pa/ /pad+ma 'dzin pa'i rgyal po che/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tshe dpag med/ /de yi 84—508

phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rin chen pad+ma yang dag bri/ /rin chen pad+ma de bzhin rnol/ /de bzhin rgyu dang smra ba 'dzin/ /rdo rje shugs kyis ②song nas kyang / /byang gi phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /rin chen las chen rgyal po ni/ /bdag nyid chen pos yang dag bri/ /bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po don yod grubaske/ /las kun 'dzin pa'i zhusangs rgyas rnam ༷'phrul pa'i/ /rdo rje las te rgyal po mdzod 'dzin pa/ /'khor los sgyur (9ba'i gtso bo mchog dam pa/ /sangs rgyas dbu rgyan las rnams bzhi dang ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yan lag legs par brgyan⑥/ /las kyi rin chen dam pas rgyas gdab cing / /rin chen dkyil 'khor tshogs chen mchog gyur pasargya/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du//las kyi rin chen yang dag bri/ /las kyi srin po gnod sbyin dang / /de yi bsdu ba'i khu tshur 'dzin/ /de nas kun gyi snying po ni/ ṭ+wāṃ/ rin chen rigs chen rnal 'byor pa/ /yi ge ṭ+wāṃ ni brjod par bya/ /ci rigs par ni rang nyid kyi/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan yang dag bri/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po las rkang pa gsum pa rdzogs so/ /lho phyogs cha'i dkyil 'khor yang rdzogs so// //de nyid kyi ni grwa ⑧bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor mdun nas 6)su/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /sems ma'i rin chen de bzhin chos/ /las ma 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu / /gar ma rnam par sgeg mo 7yi/ /nor bu rigs chen bzang po ni/ /rin chen phyag rgyas kun khyab la/ /phyag mchog rang gi phyag rgyas mtshon/ /'od zer 84—509

phreng bas khyab 'od ldan/ /rin chen rdo rjes dbang bskur ba/ /rang rang phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /rin chen mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /rin chen las byung rin chen ldan/ /rin chen rang bzhin khang par gnas/ /spos dang rin chen me tog bcas/ /rin chen mchog chen la gnas shing / /lus la rin chen gos gyon pa/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las nor bu'i rigs chen po zhes bya ba rdzogs so // //rdo rje shugs kyis 17song nas kyang / /nub kyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen bzang po ni/ /dga' ba chen pos yang dag bri/ /de yi nub kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni yang dag bri/ /dbus kyi lte ba'i 'khor lo la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni dgod par bya/ /pad+ma bzang po 'dab (2)ma brgyad/ /'dab (5ma brgyad pa yid 'ong ba/ /chos dbyings brtan pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /de yi dbus su rgyal po che/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rang bzhin mchog /sangs rgyas shes rab thabs ldan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su 'dzin/ /pad+ma gcig po de gnas shing / /de yi dkyil 'khor la brten tshopa/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' bzhi po bri/ /'khor los sgyur 57ba 'jigs pa med/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma dbang bskur ldan/ /rdo rje pad+ma la 6sogs bri/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' 'jigs pa med/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas cod pan ldan/ /chos kyi phreng bas dbang bskur bas/ /pad+ma'i phyag mtshan mtshon cha bsnams/ /sangs rgyas 'phrul 84—510

pas rnam par rol/ /pad+ma'i sems dang de bzhin rgyal/ /rin chen chos ni tshul chen po/ /dam tshig mchog rnams bzhi po ni/ /rim pa bzhin du yang dag bri / /nub kyi shar gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis ①song nas kyang / /de yi dbus su rgyal po che/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo dgod par bya/ /chos kyi snying po rab tu gnas/ /pad+ma 'dab ②ma brgyad la brten / /pad+ma'i ge sar dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs ④can dgod par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /gzugs (snyebazang ldan pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbang bskur (7ldan/ /spyan gsum phyag ni brgyad pa ste/ /thor tshugs tshangs pa dpral bar dbang / /me tog mtshon cha smin mtshams su/ /mig la nyi ma zla ba dgod/ /tha skar nyagazhon nu rna ba la/ /khyab 'jug sna yi rtse mo ste/ /mche ba nag po gsus po che/ /lce la dbyangs can ma yin te/ /gsung dbyangs (kyil ni dbyangs (spyodachen ma/ /ku mu da yidang pad phreng can/ /kha dang 'gram pa dag la gnas/ /spyan la shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gdong gi phyed ni sprul par byed/ /phrag pa g.yas par seng ge ste/ /g.yon pa phag 4)ni yang dag gnas/ /sna yi bu gu gnyis la /tshogeni/ /rgya mtsho nye bar gdung ba dag /dga' bo nye dga' dpung pa la / /lto ba la ni rgya mtsho gnas/ /brla g.yas pa tsho la dpung chen gnas/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug dpung pa la/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po ni/ /mtshan ma'i steng gi sgo na gnas/ /dpal be'u tsosnying ga tsol gnas te/ /lhag pa lha mo chen mo dpal7/ /'og gi kha yi sgo ru ni/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po rnam par brtenayin / /rdzong dang 'jigs byed lha mo che/ /pus mo la ni yang dag gnas/ /rkang pa'i sor mo bcu la ni/ /ma mo bcu ni 1 kun du gnas/ /drag po rje ngar 4784—511

gnas pa nyid/ /chu yi lha mo rgyab na gnas/ /dpyid dang so ga ①dbyar dang ni / /ston dang dgun dang dgun smad lhal/ /g.yas pa dang ni g.yon pa yin①//rkang pa dag la yang dag gnas/ /'og gi 'khor lo rtsibs stong la/ /drag po'i phung po 'ching ④ba dang / /sgra gcan thags bzangs ⑤ris snang byed/ /lha ma yin rnams kun du gnas/ /lag pa bcu yi thal mo la/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu dag gnas/ /mngon par 'dod pa nyid dag gi/ /lha chen la ⑥sogs 'di dag bri / /zhal bzhi phyag ni brgyad pa ste/ /zhal re zhing ni spyan gsum pa'i/ /gos dang gzugs ni bzang por ldan/ /de 'dra'i rang bzhin thub pa dgod/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' yang dag bri/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' lcags kyu dang / /mda' dang pad+ma legs par sbyin/ /nub kyi lho yi tsho 5phyogs mchog tu/ / rdo rje (0shugs kyis ①song nas kyang / /de yi dbus su ⑩sems dpa' che/ /rin chen pad+ma yang dag bri/ /zhal ni bcu gnyis ldan pa nyid / /phyag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i mchog /rin chen pad+mar yang dag bzhugs / /rin chen las ni 'byung bar 'dod/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i rin chen dra (1sogs bri/ /khro gnyer nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / /de bzhin zhal ni bcu gcig pa/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /'od dpag med ni dgod par bya/ /pad+ma chen po rab ster ba/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gtso / /spyan dang phyag ni stong par ldan/ /phyag rgya mtshon cha thams cad bcang //zhal bcu gnyis pa bzang po ste/ /pad+ma'i lha mo yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu dang ldan/ /tshogs kyi dbus na rnam par rol/ /de yi phyogs rnams 84—512

thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' yang dag bri/ /sgrol ma gzhon nu'i mthu can dang / /mgrin sngon tshangs pa'i mdog las byung / /nub kyi byang gi cha ru ni / /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /pad+ma la ①sogs dgod par bya/ /zhal drug phyag ni bcu gnyis pa'i/ /phyag rgya mtshon cha 'dzin pa'i mchog /chen po sna tshogs rab ster ba②/ /pad+ma las ni yang dag bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rgyal / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun gnas pa/ /pad+ma'i srin po gnod sbyin dang / /pad+ma'i khu tshur yang dag bri/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang rgyab dang ni/ /mdun nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas snying po ni ha/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po hrīḥduste / thams cad kyi ④snying po yin no/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po gsang zhing mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las rkang pa bzhi pa rdzogs so(ge// //pad+ma'i rigs kyi tshogs dag gi/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs nas ni/ /de yi 'khor lo'i ⑥ga ⑦bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' (nyerin chen dang / /las dang chos ma yang dag bri/ /sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu/ /gar ma 'di ni yang dag bri/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po las pad+ma'i rigs chen po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //byang gi las kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis 5)song nas kyang / /de yi dkyil 'khor rgyal po ni/ /'khor lo lnga lnga dgod par bya/ /de yi dbus su 84—513

las chen po/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni dgod par bya/ /chos 'dzin pa yi rgyal po che/ /nam mkha' lding gi gdan la bzhugs/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /las kyi phyag rgya yang dag bri/ /las kyi sems dpa' rin chen dang / /de bzhin las dang chos nyid do/ /rdo rje shugs kyis ①song nas ni/ /byang gi shar gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /mi bskyod pa ni sangs rgyas che/ /rdo rje las ni dgod par bya/ /de yi mchod pa mtshon cha bcas/ /de yi phyag rgya bcas pa bzung / /las chen 'dzin pa bzang po ste/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa yang dag ldan/ /②de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /las kyi sems dpa' yang dag bri/ /sems dpa' chags pa'i rgyal po che/ /legs pa de bzhin las nyid do/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /byang gi lho yi cha ru ni/ /rin chen ting 'dzin rgyal po che//rin chen las ni yang dag bri/ /rin chen char ni rab 'bebs shing / /sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rin chen las ni yang dag bri/ /sems dpa'i gzi brjid rgyal mtshan dang / /las dang bzhad pa rnam sbyong ba/ /las kyi rin chen bzang po la/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje shugs kyis (7song nas kyang / /byang gi nub kyi cha ru ni/ /pad+ma'i las kyi sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su yang dag bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /pad+ma'i las ni yang dag bri/ /pad+ma rnon po de bzhin rgyu / /de bzhin smra ba las yin no/ /rdo rje shugs kyis phyisong nas kyang / /byang gi byang phyogs dkyil 'khor la/ /las chen 'dzin pa dbang zhen pa / /las kyi rgyal po yang dag bri/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /las kyi sems dpa' dgod par bya/ /las kyi srin po gnod sbyin dang / /de bzhin 84—514

bsdu ①ba'i khu tshur nyid/ /de nas snying po ni aḥl/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po ni aḥniste / thams cad kyi snying po yin no/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba zhes bya ba las rkang pa lnga pa rdzogs so/ /byang gi cha'i dkyil 'khor yang rdzogs so// //byang du dkyil 'khor bri ④byas te/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs nas ni/ /de yi 'khor lo'i grwa ⑤bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni dgod par bya/ /sngar gyi dam tshig bzhi po ni/ /thams cad sum cu dhirtsa gsum yin/ /dbus ma zhes bya sum ④cu gsum / /shar gyi phyogs na sum cu gsum/ /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs cha'o/ tsho/byang dang lho yang de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po gsang zhing mchog tu gsang ba las las kyi rigs zhes bya ba rdzogs so / /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor (nyethams cad kyang rdzogs so// //brgya drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o(1)/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchog /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/ /'khor lo chen po'i grwa ⑩bzhi ru/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ni bri bar bya/ /'khor lo sbyor chen shar lho ru/ /zla ba'i gzugs su dgod par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dgod par bya / /'dzum zhing zla ba'i mdog can te/ /'od zer dmar po sna tshogs 'bar/ /sems dpa'i 6)skyil krung yang dag bzhugs/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul 'chang ba'i mchog /phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yon na dril bu bsnams / /mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems dpa' che/ /sems can kun gyi don 84—515

sems pa/ /de yi pad+ma yang dag gnas/ /de 'od dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /gsang ba lnga ni yang dag bstan/ /dang po dang ni gnyis pa ni/ /g.yas kyi phyogs na yang dag gnas/ /gsum pa dang ni bzhi pa ni / /g.yon logs na ni rab tu gnas/ /lha mo rdo rje ca co sgrogs/ / pus 'khyud nyu7rang gi lha mo de/ /de yi glo na mgo sgyur ②zhing / /'dzum bcas kun du lta ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag la 'jus/ /chu srin gyi ni rgyal mtshan bsgreng (5)/ /de yi glo na bzhad bcas shing ④/ /rdeg byed skye dgu'i bdag mo yi/ /rdo rje ca co'i sgra sgrog (snyedang / /de bzhin rdo rje don yod dga'/ /lha mo rdo rje 'dod dbang phyug /gzi brjid dga' ba'i rdo rje ma/ /lho dang nub kyi mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /de yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /pad+ma chen po dgod par bya/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' dgod par bya/ /zhal bzhi phyag ni brgyad pa ste/ /'khor los 6)dkyil 'khor 'od bcas pa/ /de yi pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /de 'od dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ /pad+ma'i rigs can las byung ba/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /kun nas gsang ba'i lha mo yi/ /de nas ming ni rab bshad bya7/ /rdo rje dpal dang (87rdo rje dkar/ /rdo rje sgron ma rdo rje can/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /nub byang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bri 6)nas ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma yang dag ldan/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rin chen sems dpa' dgod par bya/ /sngon dmar 7gyi ni 'od kyis khyab/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /de yi pad+ma yang dag gnas/ /de 'od dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ /rin chen rigs chen las byung ba'i/ /lha mo 84—516

bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /nam mkha' las byung mkha' rdo rje/ /nam mkha'i mdog can skye dgu'i bdag /rin chen dpal ldan lha mo che/ /rin chen dang bcas rigs mdzes ma/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /byang shar mtshams kyi 'khor lo la/ /de bzhin ut+pal sngon po'i 'dabatunye/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bri bar bya/ /ut+pal sngon po de dbus su/ /las rnams 'dzin pa chen po'i mchog /sangs rgyas kun las ②sogs bshad pa/ /rdo rje'i las ni dgod par bya/ /de yi pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /de 'od dkyil 'khor la brten cing / /las kyi rigs can las byung ba'i/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /las rgya ①rdo rje rin chen ma/ /las ma chos ma dpal ldan che/ /ji ltar sngon du rdo rje'i rigs/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /de nyid pho nya mo ru gnas/ /de nyid lha mor yang dag gnas/ /de nyid sgeg mo rnam sgeg sogs/ /phyag rgya'i rgya mtsho gzhan yang byed/ /ser mo dmar mo nyi ma mtshungs/ /ut+pal sngon po'i mdog ④'drar 'gyur/ /bsnyems bcas zhi ba'i dbang bskur ldan/ /rang gi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /de nas snying po ⑤rgyu hrīḥyim aḥtso)/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po gsang zhing mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las rkang pa drug pa rdzogs so/ /mtshams rnams kyi dkyil 'khor yang rdzogs so// //brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa lngar ldan/ /'khor lo yongs su rdzogs nas kyang / /de yi mtshams kyi logs rnams su/ /lha bzhi dag ni yang dag bri/ /shar du rdo rje chen po ste/ /rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba'o/ /rdo rje rigs chen mtshan ma ste/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rab 'jigs pa'i/ /lho ru rin chen phun tshogs pa/ /chu lha 84—517

rin chen chu srin rnams/ /rin chen rigs chen mtshan ma ste/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod/ /nub tu sa lha bri bar bya/ /rtsal ldan skyes bu zhes bya 6)yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dzin byed cing / /pad+ma'i rigs kyi mtshan ma'ang tsha yin/ /byang du rlung gi skyes bu ni/ /rlung gi shugs kyis gos 'chang zhing ske/ /de bzhin las kyi rigs 'dzin ma/ /g.yo zhing rtsal ldan bri bar bya/ /brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa dgu ru/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag bsgrub / /chos kyi tshul gyi gru 'chen po/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po las 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //thun mong 57mchog tu gsang ba yi/ /rdo rje rig ⑥pa 'dzin pa'i phyamachog /rang rigs 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /phyogs gcig tu ni bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbus su ni/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnam snang mdzad/ /seng ge pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de ni byang chub mchog 'dzin pa/ /mi bskyod pa ni glang chen bcibs/ /rin chen dbang ni rta la bcibs bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa ni/ /rma bya'i khri la yang dag bzhugs/ /don yod grub pa bla na med/ /mkha' lding dbang po yang dag bzhugs/ /'di rnams kyi ni bzhon 8par bshad/ /rigs mchog kun gyi dbye ba'o/ /mi bskyod pa yi sa gnon te/ /de bzhin rin chen dbang mchog sbyin/ /tshe dpag med kyi ting 'dzin sbyin/ /don yod grub pa'i mi 'jigs sbyin/ /sngon po ser po de bzhin dmar / /kha dog ljang gu 9las 'dzin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yid 84—518

'ong / /sku mdog dkar po rab tu bsgrags/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen la/ /rdo rje phreng bas rdo rje mtshan/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sbyor 'byung 6)ba/ /rdo rje'i ri mo yang dag bri/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen bzang po la/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas pad+ma mtshan / /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor sbyor byung ba/ /pad+ma'i srad bus thig gdab bya/ /rin chen rigs can bzang po la/ /rin chen phreng bas rin chen mtshan/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor sbyor byung ba/ /rin chen ri mo rnam par mdzes las kyi rigs la sna tshogs bshad/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rigs mchog la/ /'on kyang rdo rje khyad par gyis/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor sbyor byung ba'i/ /rdo rje shar gyi phyogs cha ru/ /lho ru rin chen dkyil 'khor te/ /nub tu pad+ma yang dag bshad//byang du las ni yang dag sbyor/ /rdo rje can kun khro gnyer can/ /rin chen tshogs ni rab bshad pa/ /pad+ma chen po dul zhing zhi/ /drag po zhi ba (2skalas 'dzin pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor lo ru/ /'khor lo chen po yang dag bri / /de nas phyi (kyirol 'khor lo sogs/ /cho ga 'di kun de dang 'dra/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po gsang ba chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po las gsang ba zhes bya ba rkang pa bdun pa rdzogs so/ /las kyi rnal 'byor las byung ba rdzogs so// //nang gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs nas ni/ /tshon rtsi las (4)ni dgang bar bya'o/ /thig dang ri mo thams cad ni/ /tshon rtsi kun gyis rab tu dgang / /dang po nas ni tha ma ru/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor kun du bri/ /mnyam zhing kun du cha mnyam pas/ /gru bzhi ru ni rab tu brtag55ci /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta 84—519

babs bzhis ni mdzes byas pa/ /ka ba brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /yid du 'ong zhing legs par phye/ /thig bzhi dang ①ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje rin chen srad bu yis/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /kha khyer gyis ni yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje kha khyer mdzes byas la / /zla ba phyed pa'i lcug mas khyab/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i zhutshogs dang ldan/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes/ /g.yer ku'i dra bas ①yang dag ldan/ /kha dog sna tshogs rnam par brgyan④/ /de dang dbus kyi dubar thig la/ /byang chub sems rnams yang dag bri/ /bskal pa bzang po stong dag ni / /'das ⑥pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams/ /shar du thams cad rdo rje mtshan/ /lho ru rin chen phyag mtshan bsnams/ /nub tu pad+ma rdo rje sogs/ /byang du las kyi rdo rje bsnams/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha gang dag /phyi rol thig la yang dag bri / /drag po la lasogs lha chen rnams/ /snam bu las ni lus phyed duphyung ⑨/ /dbang phyug chen po tshangs pa che/ /khyab 'jug g.yung drung gzhon nu ni/ /rigs bcas dpung dang bcas rgyal po/ /shar gyi dkyil 'khor yang dag bri/ /'khyil pa'i 'od can gtum po dang / /ser skya rdo rje ser skya rnams7/ /rigs bcas 'khor lo yang dag ldan/ /lho yi phyogs su yang dag bri0/ /myos pa phreng ldan rgyal nyid pa/ /rnam par rgyal dang skyel byed rnams/ /rigs bcas dpung dang yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ru yang dag bri/ /ko shi gos can me dang rlung //rdo rje 'jigs byed la 7sogs rnams/ /nub kyi cha las 'og tu ni/ /byang gi cha ru yang dag bri/ /de bzhin dpung dang bdag por bcas/ /ma mo 'jig rten rab grags dang / /gtso bo 'khor lo rnam rol pa/ /lha min la 6)sogs rdzu 84—520

'phrul che/ /phyi rol 'khor lo'i rigs su bshad/ /rgyud chen gsang ba zhes bya las / /stong phrag bcu ru bshad pa rnams/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bri/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor gnas zur du/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ni bri bar bya/ /me tog spos la ①sogs ldan pa/ /mchod pa'i lha mo yang dag bri/ /ji ltar nus shing bri ba dang / /ji ltar mdzes shing rjes su mthun②/ /ji ltar rang gi rigs bshad pa / /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bri/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po dkyil 'khor chen po gsang zhing mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor mchog tu mdzes pa zhes bya ba rkang pa brgyad pa rdzogs so// //de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma lus pa rdzogs so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ma lus par phyidagug pa 'di 'byung ngo / /'di lta ste/byang chub kyi sems dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dgug pa nyid dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la thabs ④mkhas pa chen po 'jug par byed pa nyid dang / don thams cad la mngon du phyogs pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa dang /byang chub chen po'i tshogs bsags pa dang (5)/ sems can gyi don la mi slu ba dang ske/ theg pa chen po 'di las theg pa gzhan la 'dod pa mi bskyed shunacing 'gyur ba med par 'ching ba nyid dang / thabs dang / shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med pa sdud par byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chen po nyid la yang dag par byed pa nyid do/ /de la shar gyi sgor rdo rje lcags kyu chen po zhes bya ba rdo rje 'dzin 84—521

dgod par bya'o/ /lho ru ni rdo rje zhags pa zhes bya ba dang / nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ①ces bya ba dang / byang du rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dgod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor chen po gsang ba zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshul ched du brjod pa las rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rdzogs so// //de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul thob byed② / /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs nas ni/ /dam tshig mchog chen sems dpa' yis/ /bskor ①ba dag ni lan gsum bya/ /ma lus gsang ba blta bya zhing —/ /kun du tshogs nas dga' bar bya/ /gsang ba chad na dag bya zhing / /lhag ma ④rnam par sbyang bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yisal/ /myur du phyag rgya che bsten 6)bya/ /mtshan brgya nyartsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig tu ni brjod par bya/ /'khor lo zur ni yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje lha mo spyan drang bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten spyan drang bya/ /sgo yi dbus na gang gnas pa/ /sgo srung ⑧rnams ni spyan drang bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po spyan drang bya6)/ /de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la 7sogs las byas te/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni yang dag bcing / /brgya dang rtsa brgyad dag bya ba/ /rdo rje lcags kyu (nyakun du dgug /rdo rje zhags pas gzhug tu par bya/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog yonyekun du bcing //rdo rje dril bus dbab par bya/ /sgo'i bya ba'o/ /de nas dbus su 'dug byas nas / /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub 'ches/ /rdo rje dbye ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /84—522

sgo rnams thams cad dbye bar bya/ /sgo sung ba ru ①dmigs nas ni/ /sgo rnams dbye bar bya ba yin/ /rdo rje sdigs ②mdzub ②phyag rgya yis/ /gdug pa thams cad bsdigs par bya/ /gang tshe mchod pa yang dag rtsom④/ /ji srid dus kyis durdzogs 'gyur ba/ /grwa ni thams cad dag tu ni/ /bdug nyuspos rnams ni gdul ⑦bar bya/ /sngon du sgo yi las byas te/ /de nas mchod pa yang dag bya/ /dang por me tog shing la ⑧sogs/ /spos dang mar me phyag rgyar bcas/ /mtshams kyi dus las sngon du ni/ /bum pa rdo rje spyan drang bya/ /rdo rje bum pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /ci nus par ni spyan drang bya/ /bum pa shin tu bzang po gcig /rin chen sna bdun las byas mdzes/ /yang na rin chen dang bsres pa'i/ /rdo rje dri yi chu ldan bya/ /rdo rje chu yi sngags dang ni/ /rdo rje phyag rgya chu gtsang ma/ /stong dang rtsa brgyad bzlas byas na/ /rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i chu ru 'gyur/ /bum pa'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra u da 6)ka hūṃ/ me tog gi sngags ni/ /oṃ badz+ra phusne hūṃ/mar me'i sngags ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ā 0lo ke hūṃ/ dri'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/bdug spos kyi sngags ()ni/ oṃ badz+ra dhū (gepe hūṃ/ spos dang me tog la 4)sogs pa//thams cad phyag rgya ldan par bya/ /rdo rje phyag rgya gzung 8byas nas/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis rab tu sbyor/ /dgongs ma'i dus nas brtsams nas ni/ /khrus kyi cho ga yang dag bya/ /lus la dri yis byug 8pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis yilegs par brgyan/ /rdo rje'i shugs kyi sngags dang ni/ /rdo rje'i shugs kyi phyag rgya yis/ /'byung ba dang ni 'jug pa yi(na/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyes mi 'gyur/ /smin (nyam rdo rje ri mo mtshan/ /sangs rgyas phyag rgya la yi sogs tshogs/ /sems dpa' thams cad 'gom byas kyang / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyes mi 'gyur/ /84—523

der ni 'gyod pa med par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dril bu dkrol ①ba yis/ /cho ga chad dam lhag kyang rul/ /'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ①ni cho gar ldan/ /kun du 'jigs ④par mi bya'o/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor go cha yis/ /sangs rgyas skyon du 'dzin mi mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya ches/ /dkyil 'khor mchod phyir 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas dkyil 'khor dbus su ni / /rdo rje dag ni dgug par bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu kun ⑤bcings nas/ /sor mo yis ni dgug par bya/ /de nyid rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /rgyud las dgug pa nyid du gsungs/ /de bzhin rdo rje rigs chen la/ /rdo rje lcags kyu yang dag bcing ske/ /rin chen lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yisayi/ /rin po che ni dgug par bya/ /pad+ma lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ni/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag la bshad/ /las kyi lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /las kyi rigs chen dgug par bya/ /rdo rje chen po'i lcags kyu bcing / /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bya/ /dkyil 'khor lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang bya/ /phyi rol rdo rje lcags kyu bcing / /phyi rol rdo rje rigs spyan drang / /bkra shis rdo rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan drang bya/ /byang mchog ༷lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams spyan drang bya/ /rin chen lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis / /rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan drang bya/ /snying po'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /phyag na rdo rje spyan drang bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /kun la nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /bsnyems tshul sngags kyi phyag rgya yis/ /rnam snang yang dag spyan drang bya/ /sangs rgyas lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin kho nar sangs rgyas rnams / /dam tshig lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /dam tshig sems dpa' spyan drang 84—524

bya / /dgug ①pa'i sbyor ba byas nas ni/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad gdon par bya/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs nas ni/ /mchod pa'i sprin rnams yang dag sgrub②/ /bdag nyid dbul ba la ②sogs pa'i/ /ji skad bshad pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /bshags dang gsol gdab mchod pa dang / /bdag nyid dbul ba la dusogs rnamasal/ /bdag gi bya ba rdzogs nas ni/ /phyag rgya bcing ba yang dag brtsam/ /brgya 'am yang na stong dag gam/ /brgya phrag brgya ni bsdus pa yis/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs ni bcing byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas dkyil 'khor las byas te/ /ji srid skya rengs dushar gyur paX/ /de srid phyag rgya yang dag bcing ⑦/ /nges par dngos grub ster bar byed/ /de nas langs te phyag rgya bcas/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol byung nas ni/ /gdug pa la ⑧sogs kun bsdigs te/ /dkyil 'khor mchod phyir 'jug par bya/ /rang gi khrus byas lus dris byugs/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa'i rgyan gos ldan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos gyon zhing / /phreng ldan kha ni dri zhim pas/ /rdo rje gar gyi sbyor ba yis me tog spyi bor gzhag byas te/ /rol pa'i rdo rje dga' ba yis/ /zhugs nas mgon la rab btud cing / /de nyid 'dod chags rjes chags dang / /de nyid bskul ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ⑨ba/ /sangs rgyas kun ni bskul bar bya/ /skyon dang bral zhing rtag ⑩pa ste/ /'dod chags kun ⑪la rjes chags pa/ /mchod 'os chen po rgyal po che/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod/ /de nas dam tshig mchog gi ni/ /phyag rgya cho ga bzhin bcings nas / /rdo rje slob dpon zhugs nas ni/ /lcags sgrog 8phyag rgya yang tsodag bcing tso/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /de nyid rdo rje lcags kyu bcing / /84—525

steng du se gol brdabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bsdu ba'i sngags ni dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥyi/ /shar gyi sgo ru yi ge dzaḥni/ /de bzhin lho ru yi ge hūṃ/ /nub tu lcags sgrog ①chen po /④/ /byang du kun du dbab pa aḥ༅/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /las 'di dag ni yang dag bshad/ /las ni kun du rdzogs byas nas/ /de bzhin ngo mtshar mthong 'gyur ba/ /cho 'phrul chen po rmad 'byung yiche/ /sna tshogs brgya dang rtsa bcu ste/ /cho 'phrul rmad byung (7)chen po rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis mthong 'gyur/ /dngos grub bdag nyid chen po kun/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje can dang byang chub sems/ /de bzhin rigs ni rnam lnga dang / /rdo rje dbyings ni bdag nyid che/ /bcom ldan mchog kyang gshegs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems sogs sangs rgyas sras/ /ngo mtshar slob dpon gyis mthong 'gyur/ /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma nyid/ /ji bzhin cho ga bcas par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rdzu 'phrul dngos grub dag /mthong nas dkyil 'khor bya ba yin(kyi/ /ji ltar bkod pa 'khor lo dang / /ji ltar yo byad zad pa dang / /ji ltar brtul yonyezhugs spyad 7pa bzhin/ /de bzhin dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen dang / /sangs rgyas yang dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'khor lo chen po byon/ /'di ni ngo mtshar mchog yin no/ /ji ltar de rnams bzhugs pa bzhin/ /de bzhin 'khor lo yongs su bzung 67/ /ye shes bzang po 7khyab pa yi/ /rmad byung 32dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor rmad byung 'thams cad ni/ /sa dag brtol nas mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang na dkyil 'khor bar snang gi/ /nam mkha' la gnas mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang na 84—526

sangs rgyas kun gang ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang na phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rab mthong 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs bzhin du/ /rdo rje can gyis bdag nyid mthong / /yang na gsang ba lnga zhes pa'i/ /yang na sangs rgyas mkhas pa'i mchog /yang na dkyil 'khor gnas de ni/ /stong phrag gsum ni yongs su gzung ①/ /yang na rdo rje sems gcig po/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po zhes bshad do②/ /de yi mtshan mo nyin mo mthong / /nyi ma'i 'od kyis kun khyab pa'i/ /yang na nyi ma 'char ba ste / /yang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dag pa'i zhing ni mthong nas su/ /sangs rgyas rol pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dus pa shin tu dag pa yi/ /dbang bskur ba ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /rmad byung (bsna tshogs zhes bya ba/ /rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar 'di mthong 'gyur/ /rdo rje slob dpon skal chen gyis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa sna tshogs 'gyur/ /yo byad tshogs par gyur kyang ni/ /gang zhig bsgribs par gyur pa yigo/ /de bzhin ngo mtshar nyid mi mthong / /rnal 'byor gzhan ni yang dag rtsom/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcings nas ni/ /sdig pa dral ba yang dag bya/ /rmad byung sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ /la lar zhugs pa tsam gyis ni / /'grub pa nyid du gdon mi za/ /dang po thun la 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin la lar mtshan phyed na/ /gsum pa'ang skya rengs (5)'char na 'grub/ /de bzhin la lar nyi shar na/ /de ma thag tu mngon 'dod pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /skal ldan thar par 'dod 'gyur na/ /sa ni dang por 'dod pa ste/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob nas/ /gang gis gnas med 'gro ba'o/ /yang na 56)rig pa 'dzin nyid dam/ /de bzhin rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /84—527

ji ltar mngon par 'dod par 'grub/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yongs su 'dzin/ /mtshams ①med lnga po byed pa dang / /de bzhin sdig pa kun byed pas/ /gang tshe lan bdun byas nas ni/ / bsgrub pas ②rnal 'byor 'grub par 'gyur/ /'byung ba bzhi las gzugs can min/ /nam mkha'i gzugs su rtag tu 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings gsu 'gyur ba nyid/ /rdo rje'i bka' ni gzhan du min/ /gang dag ④lan bdun bsgrubs na ⑤ni/ /sdig pa dge ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /nyes par byas pa bsod nams tshogs/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /dad pa med par gnas pa dang / /gang tshe the tshom za 'gyur ba/ /de ni rnal 'byor nyams par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni yongs ma bzung / /sngon du bsnyen pa nyams 'gyur te/ /rtag tu brtul khyezhugs nyams par 'gyur/ /de 'dra la ⑦sogs bgegs mang dang / /nga rgyal 'di dag rnam par spangs/ /sdom pa yongs su ma bzung zhing / /rnal 'byor de nyid tshul shes min/ /rdo rje slob dpon mi brtan la'agyur/ /'grub pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis6)/ /gal te rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur/ /mkhas shing sdom pa blangs pa dang / /byang chub sems ni yongs su gzung / /gang tshe 'tsho ba don yod cing / /gal te skye ba 'bras bcas ⑩'dod/ /'bad pas thams cad nyid kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po yang dag brtsam/ /byang chub sems dang ldan gyur nas/ /rig pa'i sdom pa 'dzin pa yi/ /de nas rnal 'byor yang dag brtsam / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab 'grub 'gyur/ /yang zhus pa/ /rig pa'i rgyud ni rab bsgrub (1phyir/ /sdom pa ji ltar blang bar ⑩bgyi/ /ji ltar dam tshig bsrung 7bar bgyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa ji lta bu/ /sems can kun gyi 84—528

don bya'i phyir/ /byang sems yang dag bskyed nas ni/ /theg pa gzhan la 'dod mi bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor yang dag brtsamacha/ /dkyil 'khor gang na gnas kyang rung / /slob dpon gyi ni mdun song ste/ /zhabs dag la ni btud nas brjod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas②/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan ②pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol④/ /slob dpon gyis ni nye bar brtag /rnam pa kun du dri bar bya/ /dam tshig brjod bya gang zhig ni/ /snod du rung ba de gzhug ⑤bya/ /bu dang slob ma ma yin min/ /snod dang ldan la sbyin par dubya/ /gal te snod dang ldan par shes/ /srog dang bdog pa kun sbyin bya/ /sngon du dkyil 'khor rab 'jug cing / /cho ga bzhin du bcug ⑦nas ni/ /de nas me tog bcas thal mo/ /lus btud dga' ba che rnams kyisal/ /bshags pa dang ni gsol ba gdab/ /rjes su yi 6nyerang kun du bya/ /rgyud dbang gsang ba las gsungs ⑩bzhin/ /mchod pa dang bcas yongs su bsngo/ /phyogs rnams kun du phyag bya zhing / /sdom pa chen po blang bar bya/ /slob dpon la ni rab tu brjod/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol(spre/ /thub pa'i nyi ma ma lus pa'i//sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ /slob dpon dbang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor bar ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen po 'jug 8par bgyi/ /gsang ba'i rigs mtho thams cad du/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur (nyeb/ /skal ba 84—529

chen po bdag la 465/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol①/ /dbang bskur ②ba ni rmad byung ②che/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag ④cu slob dpon gyuradu/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol(6)/ /gsang ba'i rigs las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje'i rigs bcas 'khor lo ste/ /rta babs bcas par yang dag ldan/ /slob dpon gyur par shes par bya/ /bdag nyid nye bar zhi ba nyid/ /byang chub sems ni yongs su gzung (pe/ /gsang ba yi ni 'khor lo ru/ /sdom pa dang bcas 'jug par bgyi/ /de nas slob dpon gyis tshi'adi skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gsang ba ①chen po rigs dag pa/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod ⑩'dod dam/ /des kyang 'tshal zhes brjod par bya/ /yang slob dpon gyis ⑪'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te⑩/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o⑩/ /rdo rje dril bu 8phyag rgya yang / /blo chen gyis ni gzung bar gyis8/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo yirje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung (3bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs / /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du / /zang zing mi 'jigs nyamachos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam 6)bzhi rtag tu sbyin//phyi dang ni tshogasang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis (nyagazung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs 2 dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs( ste/ /84—530

las kyi rigs ①mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya⑤/ /gang tshe nyams 'gyur ①rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis ༷srog chags gsad dumi bya/ /ma byin pa duyang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log ⑦par mi spyad ⑤cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o / /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi7/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can gdul phyir ma gtogs ⑩pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang ⑪/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya / /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang spang mi bya/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa'i/ /khyod kyis brnyas (nyepar mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon 8pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom snyipar mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tsotu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun /nyesdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /de nyid kyis kyang brjod par bya/ /'dir ni slob dpon bdag la gson/ /gtso bo ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin du ni bgyid par 'tshal / /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i / /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed (nyapar bgyi/ /84—531

sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ①ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud ⑧pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis ①brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te rjogazung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar (5)bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi4)/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu577/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i nitheg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed (97bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis 0sdom pa ma lus gzung 3rnye/ /ma grol ba ni grol chabar bgyi/ /ma rgal 8ba ni bsgral bar bgyi / /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /cho ga ji bzhin dbang bskur bya / /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur chab/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad / /de lta bu yi 7cho ga yis/ /rtag pa nyid du spyod pa na/ /slob dpon rdo rje 'chang chen du/ /'di ni 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rdzogs so// //84—532

de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i las/ /yang dag nyid du bshad par bya/ /slob ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /ji bzhin gsang ba chen por gzhug /snod dang snod min brtag ①pa nyid/ /bdag nyid chen pos mi bya'o/ /'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis ①kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub par 'dod/ /gal te de ni snod min na/ /de la gzhug pa sbyin par bya/ /yang na gang zhig don gnyer 'gyur/ /de la ji ltar bde ba nyid/ /ci ste gang zhig 'dug par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas gzhug ②pa sbyin par bya/ /gang phyir mthong ba tsam gyis ④ni/ /thams cad 'grub par gdon mi za/ /'on kyang gang zhig 'dug par 'gyur/ /de la las ni bya ba min/ /gzhug pa tsam zhig sbyin bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad nyid mi bya/ /dga' zhing dad dang ldan gyur phyin/ /snod du rung ba brtag par bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro sngon song ba'oX/ /de la gzhug pa sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje slob ma la sbyin bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' chesal / /sbyor bzhin su yin brjod par bya/ /dkar po dmar po dang ldan pa'i / /gos kyis ⑧mig ni bkab gyur dang / /rdo rje 'jug byed phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje slob ma gzhug par bya/ /de nas sgo yi las bya ste/ /sngon la rdo rje lcags kyu yis / /rdo rje lcags kyu ⑨dgug bya zhing / /yi ge dzaḥyini brjod par bya/ /badz+ra e ku (nyasha dzaḥyi/ rdo rje lcags kyu bkug (nyenas ni/ /rdo rje zhags pas gzhug par bya/ /lho yi sgor ni sbyor bya zhing / /yi ge hūṃ ni brjod par bya/ /hūṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ rdo rje zhags pas bcug nas ni/ /lcags sgrog tsoldan pas bcing bar bya / /nub kyi sgo ru bcings tsonas ni/ /yi ge baṃ ni brjod par bya/ /badz+ra sbo tso ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags kyu 7yang dag dgug /rdo rje zhags pas gzhug bya zhing / /84—533

rdo rje lcags sgrog 0)gis bcing bya/ /rdo rje dril bus yang dag dbab/ /badz+ra gharje aḥl/ rdo rje gzhug pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod phyir gzhug par bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya chen po yis/ /rdo rje'i ye shes yang dag dbab/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dam tshig phyag rgya chen po yisal/ /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bskul dubya / /dam tshig bdag nyid chen po yis/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dbab par bya/ /sa ma ya hūṃ/ de nas mchod pa phyag rgyar bcas/ /spos dang me tog la ⑤sogs tshogs / /phyag rgya dag ni thams cad bya/ /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bskul ⑥bya/ /de nas cho ga ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje slob ma mna' bsgag (7bya/ /badz+ra u dud ka /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur (9)bas/ /ji ltar 'dod pas dbang bskur ⑩bya/ /badz+ra a bhi ṣe lto ka /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /de nas de la dbab pa sbyin/ /badz+ra ā 3)be sha a a/ bcu/ nyi shu/ sum cu/ bzhi bcu/ lnga bcu/ drug cu / bdun cu/ brgyad cu/ dgu bcu/ brgya/ rdo rje yis 0ni sngags 'di yis / /thams cad du ni yang dag dbab/ /de nas gdong g.yogs dgrol ⑫bar bya/ /rdo rje'i mig 7ni bla na med / /badz+ra ak+ṣatu 7/ rdo rje'i rigs ni skal ldan gyi/ /dkyil 'khor ltos shig ces brjod bya/ /badz+ra pā sh+ya tu)ho/ de nas de la bum pa bzang / /rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur(6/ /gang ming bzang 3 ba tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa / snod ni yang dag brtag bya zhing / /de yi ye shes yongs su sbyang ( spe/ /gal te snod du rung shes na/ /rnam par dbye bar dga' bar bya/ /he badz+ra nā ma / 2cho ga bcu/ gzung 22nyi shu/ chu sum cu/ rdo rje bzhi bcu/ rin chen lnga bcu/ pheg rdob drug cu/ kha sbyar 2 bdun cu/ bzhad pa brgyad cu/ dag 84wa 534

pa dgu bcu/ sems dpa' ①brgya/ sangs rgyas stong / las nyis stong /gzugs sum stong / rnal 'byor bzhi stong / 'dzin pa lnga stong / gzugs drug stong / kha dog bdun stong / dbyibs brgyad stong / mtshan ma dgu stong /tshig 'bum/ a 'bum phrag gcig ni yongs rdzogs nas/ /'khor lo'i mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /gsang ba yi ni spyod yul gzhan/ /de nas las ni rab bshad bya/ /slob ma'i cho ga dang ②ming gi dam tshig rdzogs so// //ye shes dag pa bdag nyid che/ /de nas gsang ba rab bshad bya/ /gang gi nunyecho ga thams cad kyis/ /'khor lo chen po brtan 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas sems dpa' sems dpa' nyid/ /sa yi mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /gsang ba'i dam bcas yi ④rang bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs (snyedag pa/ /rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /ye shes dag pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje'i thugs 'dzin gyur yinas ni/ /mtshan nyid dag ni yang dag brtag /rnal 'byor dpe byad don ldan pa⑦/ /mtshan nyid rjes su brtag par (8)bya/ /rdo rje'i thugs kyi rjes sbyor bas/ /ye shes dag pa yang dag gzung / /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa mchog /ye shes bzhugs pa kun du bshad/ /de nas ye shes dam pa yis / /'jig rten 'das pa rab gzhug bya/ /mtshan nyid chen po dang ldan pa'i / /rtogs tsa)pa'i sa la yang dag brtenaril/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spyod yul mchog /rdo rje chos ni yid nyu1'ong ba'o/ /thim dang chos sku zhes bya dang / /bsdigs dang 'od zer lnga pa dang / /glog dang chu zla zhes bya bas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yang dag 'thob/ /chu yi zla ba bzang po yis/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 84—535

spang bar bya/ /nyi ma lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /rigs chos skar ma zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gnod pa 'joms byed pa/ /e ma'o gsang ba chen por bshad/ /gsang ba zhes bya rdor 'od 'byung / /gzhan yang zla ba phyed par 'dod/ /pho nya'i dkyil 'khor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bcing ba rtse gsum sbyor las byung / /lcags kyu shin tu 'bar ba dang / /gtum po rdo rje can gyi ①tshogs/ /rtog ②pa'i gnas ni yongs 'gyur ba/ /thob byed rdo rje chen por 'dod/ /kun gyi gong ma'i 'og ma yis/ /nyi tshe ba de spang bar bya/ /mchog tu gsang ba rdzogs so// //de nas mchog tu gsang ba rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul can/ zab pal/ tshul rgya che ba mkhas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul las kyi ①tshogs ston pa/dga' ba chen po'i bkod pas kun khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi libyang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la ⑤sogs pa rnams kyi chos kyi mdzod 'byung ba ⑥rol pa'i 'khor lo chen po 'di las phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud mchog ces bya ba 'byung ste/ gsang ba mchog tu rgya che ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab las rnams ston/ /rol pa'i 'khor lo chen po ru/ /chos kyi mdzod ni 'dzin par bya/ /re zhig dang por las kyi 7tshogs bstan par bya ste/ 'di lta ste hūṃ/'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gzung 97ba yi/ /sbyor thabs yi ge hūṃ brjod de/ /'di yis kyang ni rgyal po dang / /phyag rgya'i rgyal mo brgya ru 'gyur/ /gnyis pa ni byang chub chen po'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshul la 'jug pa yin no/ /'di lta ste hūṃ/ 'dis ni phyag rgya zhes bya yi9)/ /yi ge hūṃ ni brtan par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya'i rgyal mo rnam 84—536

pa stong / /gsum pa phyag rgya stong phrag ni/ /brgya yi ①tshogs su 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lor 'jug pa yi/ /yi ge hūṃ gis brtan par 'gyur/ /hūṃ rnal ②'byor bzhi pa'i dbye ba ni/ /brgya phrag khri ru 'dir 'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /phyag rgya'i rgyal mo kun hūṃ bcas/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya ji snyed yod/ /mngag gzhug ①pa ni bye bar 'gyur/ /rtse gsum la dusogs mtshon cha ni/ /rtag tu phyag rgya'i rgyal po yin hūṃ/ /de nas sngags kyi tshogs 'byung ste/ / ṭag gi ⑤bcu/ maṭa nyi shu/ phaṭa sum cu/ raṭa bzhi bcu/baṭa lnga bcu/ riṭa drug cu/ khaṭa bdun cu/ phaṭa brgyad cu/ taṭa dgu bcu/taṭa brgya/ ka ta ni la na stong yin/ /ta dang wa 0zhes bya ba dang / / ḍa ni ⑦rnam pa ⑧bcu ru 'gyur/ /yi ge ḍa ni ⑨lan gsum 0sbyar/ /yi ge a yang rnam pa bzhi/ /yi ge ba ni rnam pa lnga/ /yi ge a ni lan drug sbyar/ /ka ni lan bdun yang dag sbyar/ /yi ge dha ni lan brgyad sbyar/ /yi ge sha ni phyed du 'gyur / /khiṭa ni stong phrag brgya ru 'gyur/ /stong phrag brgya las rnal 'byor gyis / /phyag rgya'i rgyud ni btu bar bya/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa gsang ba'i rnal 'byor chen po'i drug pa gsang ba'i tshogs chen po'i mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po shin du gsang ba'i tunyernal 'byor rdo rje rtse mo las/ byang chub pa'i tshul rgya chen po latshona'ajug pa zhes bya ba'i le'u gnyis pa rdzogs so// //rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba yang rdzogs so// //de nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul rgya chen po 'di las dkyil 'khor chen 84—537

po'i dang por phyag rgya dang nye ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba'i ye shes 'byung ste/ gang tshe rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rdo rje slob mar gyur pa na/ /phyag rgya nye ba'i phyag rgya bcing —/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /gang tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'ching ske/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam du 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje rgyal po 'ching / /rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje chags pa 'ching / /rdo rje srin po rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje legs pa 'ching / /rdo rje las ni rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje rin chen 'ching / /rdo rje smra ba rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje gzi brjid 'ching / /rdo rje rgyu ni rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'ching / /rdo rje rnon po rab tu 'ching / /gang tshe rdo rje bzhad pa 'ching //rdo rje chos ni rab tu bcing / /de lta ①bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yang dag sbyar/ /phyag rgya nye ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya brtan par 'gyuram/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje'i lcags kyus bkug nas sul/ /rdo rje'i mdas ②ni dga' 90bar bya/ /rdo rje'i mdas ④ni 'phangs nas ⑤sul/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis bsgrub bya/ /phyag rgya ji bzhin bkrol nas ni/ /de ni bcing ba 6)rab tu bya/ /mchod pa'i cho ga 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor mchod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin g.yon pas gar bya zhing / /g.yas pas khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /dpral bar yongs su bskor nas su/ /kha yi mdun du dgod par bya/ /rdo rje nyi ma bzhad pas bgad(7/ /mnyam zhing cung zad gdangs te gnas/ /ral gri dri ma med snang bas/ /rdo rje glu ni blang bar bya/ /rdo rje khro bo'i mdzub 8mo ni/ /yang dag bsgreng (97ba legs par bsgrub7/ /de nas spyi gtsug kha dag tu/ /las byas dkyil 'khor mchod pa na/ /rigs kyi lha 84—538

yi sbyor ba yis/ /legs par bsgrub ①pas gtam 'grub ②bya/ /dang por bdag nyid rdo rje sems/ /de bzhin lha nyid brtag par bya/ /brtul ②zhugs sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rigs kyi lha nyid bsgrub par bya/ /'khor lo rnam pa du ru brjod/ /ji ltar rigs de bzhin 'khor lo/ /ji ltar dgod pa de bzhin 'gyur / /ji skad gsungs pa dgongs pa bzhin/ /mdor bsdu na ni rnam pa lnga/ /rdo rje rin chen de bzhin chos/ /pad+ma sna tshogs shin tu bstan/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnal 'byor gsang / /'khor lo rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /gsang ba rnam pa du ru 'gyur/ /gsang ba rnam pa lnga ru brjod/ /rgyas pa'i sgo nas rnam pa mang / /sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen dang / /chos dang las ni grags chen no/ /cho ga rnam pa du ru brjod/ /mdor na rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /mngon spyod kyi ni rtog pa la/ /rdo rje sbyor ba las byung du/ /rdo rje sbyor ba bla med pa/ /tshad med bgrang du med pa yis/ /ji ltar gdul bya rnams kyi khams/ /de bzhin rdo rje sbyor 'byung rnams/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du ji ltar brjod / /gsang ba lnga ldan gang yin pa'i/ /de ni rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya/ /dbang bskur phyag rgya chen po dang / /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor 'byung / /ji ltar gsang ba'i rigs las (4)byung / /gang zhig sngon du chos nyid snang / /yid la byed pa dang ldan pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi thabs chen po/ /de bzhin gsang ba rab tu brtag /'di yi rtag tu de nyid rig(5༄ /rdo rje'i ye shes ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar bsgoms pas rdo rje can/ /mngon par sbyor ba de nyid rig(ner /de tshe ye shes rang bzhin sems/ /de nyid ye shes brtan par 'gyur/ /mchog tu gsang ba ci 'drar brjod/ /phyag rgya rnam pa lnga ldan pa/ /de ni mchog 84—539

tu gsang ba bsgrags/ /phyag rgya nye ba'i phyag rgya bsdu/ /nye bar bzhad pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nyid kyang ni ji lta bu/ /rig pa'i bsgom ①pa bstan pa dang / /ting 'dzin sgo dang yang dag ldan/ /rig pa'i lha mo'i 'khor gyi mchog /de nyid du ni rtag tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje phra mo ji ltar brjod/ /shes rab can gyis ②bdag bsam bya/ /da ⑧ni su zhig bdag mi dmigs/ /'byung ba bzhi yi byarang bzhin lus/ /'byung ba rnams las duji ltar 'byung / /de nas lus 'di thams cad ni/ /rnal 'byor spyi bo nas brtsams te/ /rkang pa yi ni mthil bar du/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zla ba'i rdo rje dbus gnas par/ /yang na bdag nyid bsam par bya/ /yang na snying ga'i rjodabus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /yang na zla gnyis yang dag ldan/ /dbus su rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /yang na rdo rje'i dbus gnas pa/ /lus kun brtan par spro bar bya/ /yang na rdo rje bdag nyid sku/ /rdo rje'i dngos po rnam spangs pa'i/ /yang na mkha' mtshungs chos shes pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yang dag gzung ⑦/ /lce ni rkan (shel sbyar byas te/ /sna yi rtse mor blta bya zhing / /rdo rje phra mo bde reg pas / /sems ni mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur/ /rdo rje phra mo'i bde reg la/ /rtag tu mtshan ma'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma de ni spro byas te/ /phyogs kun du ni yongs su spro/ /s+pha ra ṇa badz+ra/ ci ste sems ni spro bar 'dod/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /sna yi rtse mor phyin bar du/ /sems ni slar yang bsdu bar bya/ /saṃ ha (9cir ṇa bobadz+ra/ de nas brtsams te mnyam bzhag pas//gang zhig cung zad ci bsgom pa'i/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med cing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa spang ba'o/ /badz+ra badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ sems can gang la 84—540

byams pa ni/ /rtag tu brtan par dmigs nas su/ /sems ni spro ba'i spyod pa yis / /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /ma hā badz+ra be+e tri ②spa ra ṇa/ sdug bsngal kun la ②yang dag gnas/ /sems can 'di rnams rab tu dka'/ /snying rje chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /ma hā kā ③ru ṇi ༷spa ra ṇa/ mya ngan 'das la btang snyoms gzhag /sems can don ni yang dag brtsam/ /kye ma sems can 'di 'dul ⑤dka'/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /ma hā u pe k+ṣi nispa ra ṇa/ thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal bsal/ /gzod ⑦nas dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /kun nas nyon mongs mi dmigs 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa grol ba'ang med/ /sarba bud+dha ⑧pa mo da ⑨smra ra ṇa/ mkha' 'am gzhan gyi phyogs dag tu/ /rdo rje phra mo'i sbyor ba yis /snying ga'i 0rdo rje byang chub sems/ /shin du mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom/ /rdo rje phra mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /go rims ⑩ji lta ba bzhin du/ /phyag na rdo rje'i gzugs chen po/ / dam pa'i 8chos nyid bsgom par bya/ /rnam pa tsomachog rnams kun ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje phra mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya/ /bud+dha a nu smṛ t+yā tsobe sha /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rang bdag nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /rang gi snying ga'i tsodakyil 'khor du/ /zla bsgom rmad byung yirnal 'byor che/ /sa man+ta bha dra ā be ⑩sha /(nyezla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rang bdag nyid ni rdo rje'i gzugs/ /4)rnam pa'i mchog rnams ne )kun ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' cho ga bzhin/ /badz+ra sa twa/ rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /⑥rdo rje sems dpa' rang bdag nyid/ /snying gar ( sheza ba'i dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i 84—541

dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /badz+ra sa twa sa mā dhi tshwa nā be ①sha /rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rang bdag nyid/ /bsgom zhing snying gar ⑤zla ba'i dkyil/ /dbus su sems dpa' rnam par bsgom / /ta thā ga to lhani/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam bsgom pa/ /rnam pa brgya dang rtsa bcu ni/ /rgyas pa ru ni ci rigs par/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad / /rdo rje phra mo rdzogs so// //'jig rten pa ni ji ltar 'dod/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni gter gnas pa/ /snying gar ④yongs su bsgom par bya/ /sa yi gnas kyang bsgoms na ⑤ni/ /gter dag rab tu mthong bar 'gyur/ /badz+ra ni dhikhya/ rin chen chen po'i rdo rje gzugasal/ /nam mkha' la ni yongs su bsgom/ /gang du lhung bar mthong ba ni/ /de ni chagater yod shes par bya/ / rat+na (8)ni po)dhi'i/ lce la pad+ma'i gzugs dag ni / /shin tu mnyam par bzhag lto)pas bsgom/ /de na yod ces bcas nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lce nyid rang nyid smra/ / dharma ni dhi(nye/ lus kun rnal 'byor chen po yis / /rdo rje'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /kun du babs nas gar lhung (nyeb / /de na gter yod bstan 7pa yin/ /kurma ni dhidhi/ gter shes pa rdzogs so / / //rdo rje dbab pa 'byung ba yin/ /chu ni rdo rje'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /sgom zhing rdo rje'i shugs kyis 7ni/ /chu yi steng du 'gro bar bya/ /badz+ra dza ( 7la ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs su ni/ /rdo rje sems sogs 'dod pa rnams/ /rang 84—542

bdag nyid ni bsgom bya ste/ /'dod pa'i gzugs nyid thob par 'gyur/ /badz+ra rū ①pa/ chos kun mkha' dang mtshungs pa ste/ /bdag ni srinam mkha' zhes rang nyid/ /de nyid dag pa bsgom ②bya ste/ /de ni mi snang ba nyid 'gyur/ /badz+ra ā kā lika /rdo rje'i skas la 'dug nas ni/ /'dzeg pa ru ni bsgom byas na / /ji srid du ni 'dzeg pa'i gnas/ /de srid nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /badz+ra ma rtal/ mi snang ba dang / mkha' la 'gro ba dang / chu'i steng du 'gro bar bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i gzugs nyid shes pa rdzogs so// //zla ba'i gzugs la 'dug nas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yirnam par bsgom/ /lag na rdo rje bsgoms na ni/ /rdo rje rig pa (pe'adzin par 'gyur/ /badz+ra dha nir/zla ba'i gzugs la 'dug nas su5)/ /rdo rje rin chen bdag rang nyid/ /rab tu rin chen bsgoms nas 0ni/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ / rat+na dha hunyar/ zla ba'i gzugs la 'dug nas su/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa (nyerang bdag nyid//lag pa pad+ma dag tu bsgom/ /pad+mo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pad+ma dha tunyer /zla ba'i gzugs la 'dug nas su/ /rdo rje'i las su yang dag brtan/ /lag tu las ni bsgom byas na/ /las kyi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /kurma dha ra/rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid rdzogs so// // phyag rgya kun gyi ting nge 'dzin/ /nam mkha'i yidabyings su kun bsams tso nas / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid ji srid 'dod/ /de srid skad cig gis 'phar tso'agyur / /badz+ra/ dngos grub kyi ni ting 'dzin ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su 84wa 543

kun bsams nas/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob cing / /myur du ye shes rang grub 'gyur/ /shud+dha/ shud+dha/ rin chen rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su kun bsams nas/ /rjes su dran pa bstan ①pa yin/ /myur du rin chen 'dzin mtshungs 'gyur/ /badz+ra badz+ra/ thams cad sangs rgyas gzugs rang bzhin / /nam mkha'i dbyings su mos byas nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi ched du 'gyur/ /bud+dha bu / mchog gi dngos grub rdzogs so// //rang nyid rdo rje khu tshur ni/ /chags pa'i dga' bas mig gdangs ②pa/ /de yis gang la bltas pa ni/ /des kyang nirdo rje can du mthong / /oṃ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi byam ṭa/ gsal zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i mig /mig 'bras kun du 'dren byed dupa / /'bar ba'i lta ba zhes su brjod/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs dubyed pa/ / dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi stirma ku (she sha dzaḥpo)/ khro gnyer bsnyer ba rab 'joms pa/ /khros pas mig ni rab tu g.yo/ /khro bo'i lta ba la brten tshunas/ /'jig rten gsum yang gzhom par bya/ /gro dha dṛṣ+ṭi hriḥ/ ri rab 'onyuri bo mas tsor/ / brtan zhing mi 'dzums 7pa yi mig /byams pa'i lta ba zhes bshad de/ /gdon dang rims dang dug 'joms pa'o'i/ / dṛ nye tiṣ+ṭa 47/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dgug pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / chad pa gcad ⑩pa dang /yongs su bskyab 7pa'i las rdzogs so// //bde ba gzhan ni yod nyid min/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches(ste/ /84—544

'on kyang dgug ①pa bde ba ste/ /de ni kun las khyad par 'phags/ /dus 'dir skal ba chen po ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po byed pa las/ /dngos grub med kyang bde ba gang / /bde ba kun las khyad par 'phags/ /lha dang mi yi 'jig rten pa'i/ /bde ba bsdus ②par 'gyur ba yis/ /rdo rje slob dpon bde ba gang / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /yang na gang zhig dngos grub thob/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rab shes bya/ /rang gis rtogs ①pa gang yin pa/ /gzhan dag ④gang gis shes par 'gyur/ /sar chud rgyal ba'i gnas dang ldan/ /gsang ba'i dngos grub ster mdzad pa/ /bde ba thob pa gang yin pa/ /de ni gsang ba 'dzin ji bzhin/ /gsang ba yi ni tshogs chen po/ /'di la zhugs (snyepa gang yin pa/ /sa thob par ni shes bya ste/ /mi ldog rgyal ba'i bdag nyid srasal/ /rgyal ba'i gnas kyi sa thob kyang / /yid ches par ni mi 'gyur te/ /de yis sa brgyad kyi bar du/ /theg pa dman pa spong mi 'gyur/ /gsang chen rtog pa 'di ru ni/ /zhugs pa bdag nyid rgyal ba'i 0sras/ /theg chen la ni gzhol ba rnams/ /yid ches par ni 'gyur ba ste/ /gsang ba yi ⑦ni phan yon ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis (kyeni rab tu mkhyen/ /'dir ni yon tan stimador bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /yon tan gyi dbang du byas pa'i rgyud rdzogs so// // byed pa po dang skyed byed med/ /las dang 'bras bu gang las bshad/ /nga ⑩zhes ji skad bshad pa la/ /nga ni byed po skyed byed dang / /nga ni skye dgu'i bdag po yin/ /nga ni sna tshogs bdag po ste/ /byed po skyed byed mes po yin/ /84wa 545
