yang gsungs pa/ dag pa de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /sems dpa'i snying po zhes byar 6)bshad/ /nga ni de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /sems can thams cad bdag dang mtshungs/ /mya ngan 'das bcas sa 'og steng / /sa bla 'jig rten 'di sems can/ /ma lus srid pa dag gi ②gnas/ /sems tsam du ni rab tu 'jug /sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /de ni byed po 'byin ①byed brjod / /nga ni rgyal po sems dbang phyug /ci phyir nga ni byed por bshad/ /ji skad gsang ba gzhan las gsungs/ /nga nyid rang las byung ba ste/ /mya ngan 'das bcas sa 'og steng / /sa bla srid gsum 'jig rten gsum/ /gang zhig gnas zhes bya ba'i sems/ /gnas med las byung gang yin pa/ /snying po de bzhin gshegs dag pa/ /de nyid rang byung nga nyid do/ /nga ni rdo rje can yang yin / /sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa dang / /nyes pa thams cad zad pas na / /nga ni byang chub sems rdo ④rje/ /nga nyid rang nyid byung ba'o/ /nga nyid yang ni khyab 'jug ste/ /gzung ba la 95)sogs kun spangs pa'i/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid rnam shes/ /bdag dang nyon mongs med pa ste/ /de bas nga ni khyab 'jug bshad/ /nga ni de bzhin nyi ma ste/ /ci phyir de nyid ces bshad pa/ /zab mo'i chos ni ngas rtogs pa/ /de phyir rang byung nga nyid ni/ /nyi ma zhes ni bya bar brjod/ /nga ni zla ba ru brjod de/ /nga ni chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /zhi ba ru ni rtogs par bshad/ /de bas zhi ba chen po yis/ /nga ni zla ba blo gros ches / /nga 7ni de bzhin 987gshin rje ste/ /ji (9)bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi / /ye shes chen po lhag par bshad/ /de nyid rtogs pa gang yin pa/ /gshin rje nga ste gshin rje 'dzin/ /dbang po ste/ dbang po mi 7'phrul zhes bya 84—546

ba / /'khor ba las rgal pha rol ①phyin/ /ye shes nor ni bsgrubs pa yis/ /nga ni dbang byed dbang po yin/ /skye dgu yi ni bdag po ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi rnam pa ni/ /skye ba rtsa nas 'don byed pa/ /sdug bsngal chen po yongs su shes / /de phyir nga ni skye dgu'i bdag /nga ②bdag nyid ni mes po ste/ /nga yis bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs nas/ /thar pa'i grong khyer chen po ru/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bsani/ /nga ④nyid kho na mes po yin/ /nga 0ni 'dod pa'i 'jig rten yin/ /ngo bo nyid dang longs duspyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa'i sku ni rab ⑦'jug byedadu/ /rol chen 'jig rten zhes bya ba/ /'jig rten lta ba ston byed yin/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las bsgral yin/ /nyon mongs chen po rnam par spang / /srid par bshad de/ srid pa'i zhags pa yo)gcod byed pa/ /nga ni srid pa'i rgyal po che/ /khams gsum pa ni/ rgyud ni khams zhes rab tu brjod/ /byang chub sems zhes bya bar bshad/ /nga ni theg pa gsum 'dzin pas/ /nga ni khams gsum pa ru bshad/ /sa 'og ni/ yang dag de nyid rdo rje che/ /stong nyid de bzhin nyid ces bshad/ /ji ltar sa ni 'dzin pa'i ⑩mchog /de bzhin (steng ni chos 'dzin pa/ /sa steng ni/ sa steng nam mkha' zhes su brjod/ /nga ⑫ni rang bzhin gyis 'o mkha' 8mtshungs/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med pa/ /nga ni sa steng de nyid bshad/ /me ni/ nga ni gzod tsonas ma skyes 'byung ba med//bdag min bdag med nga ni skye dgu'i bdag /srid pa'i 'khri shing gis bcings sems can gdungs/ /nga ni grol byed 'khri ⑩shing dag byed pa/ /rlung ni/mtshan ma rnam par bsgoms nas ni/ /mtshan ma med pa 'dus ma byas/ /byang sems 'khri shing zhags pa dag /'thor byed de bzhin rlung yin no/ /nga ni 84—547

dbang phyug chen po ste/ /rdo rje tshogs kyi bdag po chen po byed/ /nga ni sangs rgyas dbang phyug gzhan ci smos/ /bdud rtsi chen po thar ①pa'i grong khyer che/ /nga ni dbang phyug ②dbang sgyur chadabang phyug che/ /nga ni brtul zhugs zhes bshad de / /nga ni nyon mongs 'joms par bshad/ /nga ni rga dang 'chi ba las/ /nges par grol bas tshangs par bshad/ /'jig rten gsum gyi ④lus su ni/ /zhags pa zhe sdang (snyegati mug ni/ /khams gsum 'jig rten gsum yin no/ /nga ni srung byam bran du 'gyur/ /de rnams 'byung bas khams gsum nga ⑦/ /gdong drug ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen dang / /chos dang las dang gsang 'dzin bcas/ /rnam pa drug ni 'khor lo che/ /nga ni gdong drug mchog chen po//gzhan yang / bza' ⑧dang tshogs 6)sogs gang yin pa/ /nga bdag nyid ces ji ltar rung bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gdon la 7sogs pa kun/ /sems las kun du byung ba'i rlabs(3/ /nga ni thugs 'dzin rgyal po ste/ / de bas tsong ni srid pa'i gnas/ /nga ni 'dod pa ste/ thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/ /dgongs pa mthar 7thug nga 8yis bshad/ /nga ni sems can kun la 'dod/ /de bas nga ni 'dod par bshad/ /thar pa nga ste/ nga nyid thar cing sems can kun / /so sor yang ni grol bar byed8/ / de bas rang byung nga 7nyid ni/ /thar par bo'adzin pa'i rgyal po yin/ /nga ni dmyal ba ste/ nga ni bdag dang chos rnams min/ /nga ni chags sdang 6)kun du bral/ /nga yis 'chi med lam bstan pas/ /nga ni dmyal ba'i dmyal ba pa/ /nga ni yi dgas te/ mngon par 'dod pa nga yis 'thob/ /sems can sgom pa smin par byed/ /nga yis dga' 37ba'i gnas thob pas/ /nga ni yi dgas yi dgas 6)skyes/ /dud 'gro nga ( ste84—548

ste dud 'gro skyes①/ /'khor ba'i chu bo brgal dka' bsal/ /sems can dag ni thams cad gnas/ /ji ltar mi shes rmongs gyur pa/ /de bzhin nga yis grol ②bar byed/ /gzhan yang nga ni chags pa ste/ /sems can grol ba rjes chags phyir / /srid pa gcod byed ①zhe sdang dang / /gsang mdzod 'dzin pas ser sna can / /sems can 'dod pas 'dod pa dang / /sems can smin byed sems can nga / /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i rgyal po gang / /de ni nga yi ⑤'jigs byed sras / /des na dugasang ba chen po yiX/ /nga ni chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub gsang 'dzin po/ /de bas nga ni gsang ba'i bdag /yang na ⑤byin gyis rlob ⑨pa dang / /bsnyems bcas sgeg pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ /tha ni de yi steng sbyar nas/ /gang du gsang bar brjod pa'o/ /da ra dharma ⑩da ra gsang / /nga ni lnga lnga 'dzin pa yin/ /rma bya chen po ⑩mdzod ldan ma'i/ /nga ni gsang ba'i bdag por bshad8/ /rtsa dang pags pa 0nu mar ldan/ /mdzod ⑫sogs gsus pa 'phyang ba dang / /zla ba'i steng na gar byed pa/ /de rnams gsang ba'i rgyal po yin/ /sa la bsnyems pa'i gar byed pa/ /rdo rje gar byed skra dkar tso'ajoms/ /dra ba spus ⑩len gsus pa can/ /mdzod ldan dang ni gos 'dzin ma/ /yi ge ta 'don zla ba dang / /mchog dang 'jigs 'byed bzhin ldan ma/ /sgra gcan ()rdo rje rjes mthun ()sgra/ /mche ba 'byin pa myos gu pas khyab / /de bzhin spyod pa yang dag ldan/ /phreng ldan gti mug 'joms byed ma/ /spyan 'dren 'dus byas thams cad ma/ /yun ring gar gyi tshogs ldan ma/ /rigs kyi gar na 6nyespyod ma dang / /'jigs byed rnam ()par 'jigs byed dang / /gar gyi gnas byed ces bya dang / /gar byed rdo rje'i gar byed ma/ /phul byung 84—549

thams cad 'thor 6)byed ma/ /lnga phung skyabs dang 'dzin byed pa/ /rkang ②gdub kyis ni bdud kyi tshogs 'joms byed/ /'brug gi ①bdag po rkang gdub kyis 'dar ①byed/ /rkang gdub kyis ni yang yang bdag chen duskyel/ /bskyod ⑥pa'i 'dar 'dar brtan ⑦pa skyel 6)byed pa/ /lag pa rked pa ji bzhin bskyod pa'o / /gar gyi rol pas ①kun du sdud byed ma/ /rdo rje nyi ma sa 0yi gar/ /de bzhin na di (1kyi si ri/ /zas chen gar ma'i gsang ba ste/ /de bas nga ni gsang ba'i bdag /hā hā hā thā pā tā pa kā ta tsos ra ma tsor hūṃ/ rnal 'byor chen po spyan 'dren ma/ /gus ldan ma dang sprul 8byed gzhan/ /'phrog ma 'joms byed gzhu ma dang / /snying po bdud ma sgra sgrogs ma/ /pheg rdob 'dzin dang drag po dang / /gzhan yang rdo rje ldan par bshad/ /rta sgra'i 8tshogs ni drug ldan ma/ /'od tshogs kyis ni mtshan mo 'joms byed ma/ /seng ge yi ⑩ni nga ro sgra sgrogs 7pa/ /rta yi sgra sgrogs sgra gcan 6nyam dang ni/ /gzhan yang gsang ba stug pos khrus byed ma/ /sna tshogs ha ha sgra yis 'phrog bdag ma/ /spyan bzang yangs 17ma gsang ba ston byed ma/ /gzhan yang 'bad so )pas dga' ba nyid byed ma/ /gzhan yang spyan yangs ut+pal gyis brgyan du nyam/ /sprin 'joms byed cing k+ṣ-i ges rnams kun 'joms ma/ /seng ge'i bzhin rol gong nas go rims na ldan/ /de 'dra'i 'khor ni dam pa dang ldan pa/ /gzhan yang gsang ba'i yid la haṃ 3 tshosgrogs pa/ /de bzhin rim ( 2gyis dge legs nyid byed ma/ / ṭu hūṃ ṭu 2 rgyu dha ri dha da 3 tshori/ ma hā shri nyari sha yang 27na shri ya ri sum̐ )rka ma ta sa ta (nyakai /de kho na nyid kyi gsang ba rdzogs so// //84wa 550

de yi dkyil 'khor zhugs nas ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga mchog gis/ /rnal 'byor pa ni rol byed na/ /des ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i mdo yi 6)dbang bshad (snyepa'i/ /sems can spyod pa ji lta bu/ /yang gsungs pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bshad ①pa/ /gsang ba yi ni rab sgrub ④pa / /dang por de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /sgrub pa yi ni rol par bya/ /bha ga ci yin brjod par bya/ /'joms pas libha ga zhes su brjod/ /gang du nyon mongs 'joms byed pa/ /shes rab lus 'joms nyon mongs pa/ /de bas shes rab bha gar brjod/ /de bas rtags ni ci yin brjod/ /rtags ni mtshan ma zhes byar bshad/ /blo ldan shes rab rtags (9)las byung / /byang chub sems ni thabs chen po/ /de ni rtags su rab tu bsgrags/ /bha gar ling ga bcug nas su/ /'khor lo'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs gang yin/ /mkhas pas 6)sgo gnyis gzung (kyibar bya/ /de ni bcug pa zhes bshad de6)/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por 'gyur/ /de nas dgongs pas ⑩bshad pa yi(nye/ /bha ga ru ni rdzas bsgrub (snyepa/ /gsang rgyud dbang po las gsungs bzhin / /bsgrub pa dag ni ji ltar bya/ /bha gar gur yi gum phyung nas ni/ /mtshan ma yang ni gzhug 8par bya/ /rdzas rnams bzang po thob par 'gyur/ /rnam pa bzhi yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /bha ga pad+ma zhes byar brjod/ /mtshan ma rdo rje zhes bshad do/ /rdzas ni pad+ma'i steng bzhag nas/ /rdo rje srub mas bsgrub tsopar bya/ /shin tu chags pas 'dod chags can/ /des ni gsang ba rab bsgrub yi'agyur/ /'dod chags chags pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub chen po dzi tshoji ltar 'gyur/ /'di 3 ni chags can 69rab bsgrub ( na'agyur/ /bden pa nyid 84—551

du yang dag bshad/ /'dod chags bral ba gsang ba med/ / de ni ①gsang ba 'grub mi 'gyur/ /dad pa'i dad pa chen po yis/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba las byung chags/ /bsgrub ②pa la ni 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de yis sgrub ②pa gdon mi za / /chags dang bral ba'i sdig pa ni/ /gang zhig gsang la duchags bral 'gyur / /sangs rgyas byang chub spyod dubyed pa/ /sdig chen 0kha na ma tho che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu smad/ /chos la kha na ma tho med/ /de yis gsang ba rab 'grub 'gyur/ /rnam pa thams cad nyon mongs kun/ /'joms pa 'dod chags mchog yin no/ /'dod chags zhe mesdang sogs nyon mongs/ /rtogs dang mtshungs pa'i chos med do/ /skye dgu kun bsad bsod nams ji lta bu / /ji srid 'khor bar bcings bar dul/ /srid pa zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba'i btson ⑨ra 'di ru ni/ /sems can kun gyis gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa/ /des ni gsang ba rab 'grub 'gyur/ /nor ni 'khor ba zhes bshad de⑩/ /sems can de rnams nyon mongs 'gyur/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'grub 'gyur/ /bud med rnams dang lhan cig rtse/ /des ni gsang ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang gi rigs kyi lha mo gang / /rig pa'i lha mo bla med dang / /lhan cig rnal 'byor rol pa yis/ /rol pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te rigs ni 'grub 'dod na/ /brdzun pa'i tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /chos kun dngos po med pa ste/ /brjod min tshig gi spyod yul min/ /med pa gang yin brdzun tshig ldan/ /rig ⑩pa'i bzlas pa 7bden pa yin/ /gal te dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub 7'dod na / /sems can gsad 7bya de bzhin bza' bar bya/ /sems can chags pa 84—552

zhes bshad de/ /ming dang gzugs la kun du chags/ /bkug nas zos par gyur na ni/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /'khor ba spangs kyang chos min 'gyur ba ni/ /'khor ba spong ba gang yin pa/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs 'gyur/ /blo ldan theg pa dman dga' ba/ /de ni rtag tu nyes ldan yin / /mya ngan 'das la mngon dga' na/ /sems can don la phyir phyogs 'gyural/ /blo ldan theg pa dman dga' ba①/ /de ni rtag tu nyes ldan yin/ /ser sna can ni de yi ②rigs bsgrub ①'gyur/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag 'gyur zhing —/ /srog gi phyir yang gtong mi byed/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs ldan 'gyur ba / /des ni gsang ba rab bsgrub du'agyur/ /drag dang ldan pa'i sems ldan pa / /des ni 'grub par 'gyur bar 'dod/ /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu drag po nyid du 'gyur/ /sdig pa sdang dub rnams spong yin/ /des ni gsang ba rab 'grub 'gyur/ /chos min spyod pa rnal 'byor mchog grub yin / /gzung dang 'dzin pa chos shes pa/ /gang tshe spong bar gyur pa ni/ / rtag tu chos mchog spyod pa ste/ /des ni gsang ba rab 'grub 'gyur/ /srid gsum mngon par chags pas rnal 'byor bsgrub⑦/ /srid gsum la ni chags par 'gyur/ /sems tsam du ni rtogs pa'i phyir/ /de ni rnal 'byor bsgrub ⑧pa yin / /rtag 5)tu 'dod pa'i 'dod chags rgyal 'gyur gang / /gsang ba chen por brtan par bsgrub ⑩pa yin/ /'dod par bya ba 'dod pa ste/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags zhes bshad do/ /rab tu dga' nyunyul chags pa ste/ /blo ldan blo gros de la chags/ /gci ba khyor ba gang 'thungs nasku/ /bshang ba tshogecung zad bza' bar bya/ /thams cad dag pa'i brtul zhugs kyis8/ /myur du dngos 84wa 553

grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /gci ba rdo rje zhes bshad de/ /bshang ba pad+ma yang dag ldan/ /dga' ba'i chos la reg ①pas ni/ /de nas ②thar pa'i grong khyer 'gro / /rnal 'byor chen po bha ga 'thungs / /rnal 'byor rab tu bsgrub ①par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gang / /bha ga yi ni sgra ru bsgragasaX/ /gang zhig bdud rtsi btung ba btung / /rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /bud med sdug dang lhan cig tu/ /dkyil 'khor chen po brtag ⑥par bya/ /rigs kyi lha mo rnal 'byor byung / /rig pa sdug pa nyid yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba brtag byas na/ /skad cig de la rang ⑦'grub 'gyur/ /khro zhing gtum la drag po ste/ /rdo rje yi ni rigs su 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal rnams la khro / /'khor ba'i sbyor 'byung las sdang bdu/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor phun tshogs 'gyur / /rigs ni nyams par 6)'gyur ba yin/ /dge ba thams cad spangs nas ni/ /chos min ⑩pa ni yang dag spyad/ /bya min 7byed pa'i rnal 'byor pasal/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs nas / /dge ba la ni rab tu 'jug /chos la lta bar gyur pa nyid/ /chos min kun du spyod mi bya/ /bya min yigang zhig dngos med de/ /de nyid brtan 8par byed par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po de lta bus/ /rtog pa chen pos rab 'grub 'gyur/ /rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i drug pa gsang ba'i tshogs chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba rtogs dhipa'i rgyal po chen po shin tu gsang ba'i rnal 'byor rdo rje rtse mo las rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dgongs pa rnam par 'grel pa zhes bya ba rnam par bshad pa snyigasum pa rdzogs so// //rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes bya ba las de 84—554

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos mchog /gsang ba'i chos kyi gnas ①mchog tu gsang ba yang rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa sras bcas la/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal nas/ /mchog tu rmad byung rig pa'i rgyud/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /hūṃ a dza ka ra / dha ra ho/ dha ra sa/ o a dra ②na ha ha he wa nir/ dhi dha dha/ dhī ༷ṅgā ra ṇi/ ma he duto raṃ ka kra ṇi4)/ ka ba tse ①rgyu baṃ/ de la gsang ba mchog tu gsang ske/ /ye shes dam pa'i rang bzhin cheni/ /rgyal po gsang ba'i mdo dbang po / /theg pa chen po kun du bsdus/ /rigs 'byung blo ldan chen po dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ba dang / /rdo rje kun dbang cho ga ni/ /shin tu rmad byung yonyerab bshad bya/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru ni/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun 'byung ske/ /rmad byung 0chos kyi rgyud chen po/ /thar pa mchog tu bstan 7pa ste/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnam snang mdzad/ /thugs ka nyurtenas ni rgyud 'di byung yin/ /kun du bzang po cirdo rje'i bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'od po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /don yod dbang phyug dam pa ste/ /theg pa chen po byang chub sems/ /bden pa dam tshig ces bya ba/ /thub pa chen po chos phung po / /stong phrag dag ni grangs med gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog chen gyisali / /chos kyi mngon par rtogs pa bshad/ /so sor rtogs pa'i mngon skirtogs dang / /de bzhin mngon par byang chub dang / /dpe byad mchog ni mngon du byung / /de bzhin ye shes thob pa nyid/ /ye shes chen po'i chos 'di 84wa 555

ni / /sangs rgyas kyi ①ni mngon rtogs ②bshad/ /theg pa chen po'i mngon rtogs ③yin/ /shin tu gsang ba'i tshul chen po/ /rang sems so sor rtogs pa ni / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul chen po/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa mchog /theg pa chen po mngon par bsdus/ /mthar thug sa ste rgyas chen po/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs/ /ye shes thob par rtogs byed pa/ /spyod pa bcu yi byang chub che/ /pha rol phyin pa dam pa bcu/ /sa bcu kun du rtogs pa ste/ /theg pa chen po mngon par bsdus/ /byang chub chen po rgya che ba/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs byang chub/ /theg pa chen po mngon par bsdus/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /theg pa chen po chos kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /chos kyi gnas ni yongs su gyuraphyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchogayi /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu dag /mkha' mnyam dang ni mtshungs pa yin/ /gnas ngan len ni kun las grol/ /rnam par rtog pa kun las grol/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun dag pa/ /dang por zla ba bzhin du mthong / /thugs rje'i brtse ba yang dag byung / /sems can yongs su 'dzin par byed/ /byang chub sems ni dag pa che/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni gos pa med/ /dge ba'i chos kyis kun du gang / /nyon mongs thams cad nges par 'joms / /zla chen gang ba'i dbus su ni/ /byang chub zla ba gnyis pa ste/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum byang chub/ /yang dag blangs las byung ba nyid/ /dam pa'i chos mchog grangs med pa/ /sbyin pa'i spyod pa mchog dang ldan/ /sa dang sa ru rtogs byed pa/ /ye shes dag pa zag pa med/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 84wa 556

dbus su ni/ /de ni rdo rje shin tu brtan①/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /snang ba med cing gnas med pa/ /ma skyes ma byas dag pa ste/ / skyes dang 'jig ②pa rnam par spangs/ /mi tshig mi chod mi phyed pa/ /lhag ma med pa'i chos kyi sku/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid yang dag byung / /rdo rje'i sku ni bla na med/ /sku dang gsang ba de bzhin spyod/ /spyod yul kun du rtogs pa dang / /lnga po de dag kun thun mong / /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /chos kyi ye shes bla na med/ /lnga po de dag gsang zhes bya/ /snying por yang ni de dag gsungs/ /gang phyir don kun grub pa'i phyir/ /sngon ni don kun grub par byed/ /bcom ldan kun du bzang po dang / /rdo rje'i las ni bla na med/ /rdo rje'i dbyings ni brtan pa'i bdag /rnam par snang mdzad bla na med/ /de dag gsang ba'i mtshan yin te/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni gnas skabs ③thob/ /de nas snying po ni/ o tsit+ta pra ti rtsibo dhe ⑤ka ro mi/ oṃ bo dhi ⑥tsit+ta uta pā da yā (7mi/ o tiṣ+ṭha nibadz+ra oṃ badz+ra ād+ma 6)ko ⑩lha/ oṃ ya thā sarba ⑩ta thā ga tā sta thā 8a thegerta/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /thub pa yi ni thugs kur bzhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsung 8/ /rdo rje'i rig ⑫pa 'di brjod do/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi saṃ bo dhi dṛ ⑩bha badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha/ sangs rgyas grags chen thams cad kyis/ /rig pa 'di ni brjod pas na/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub chen po/ /de nyid ye shes mngon sangs rgyas/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /nyid kyi thugs las byung bar gyur/ /chos bzhi'i rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /byin nas lha mo dbang bskur 'gyur/ /sems can kun don yang dag ldan/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /mkha' 84wa 557

mtshungs brjod las yang dag byung / /rin chen chen pos dbang bskur 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes che/ /'jig rten dbang phyug chen po byin/ /bya ba kun la don yod pa/ /dga' ldan la 6)sogs rnam par 'phrul/ /gdul bar bya ba thabs kyi las/ /sangs rgyas kun ②gyi byin gyis brlabasani/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gang / /byang chub sems ni tshul chen po/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam par grol/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo chen pos byin/ /dbang bskur tsam gyi ④mod la ni/ /gsang ba'i ming (7ni yang dag byung / /sangs rgyas kun bdag rgyal po ste/ /kun mchog dbang bskur dam pa'oyi/ /de nas snying po ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta e shwa dzu a bhi ṣe (7)ka hūṃ/ de nas sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /chos ni mngon sum gyur mdzad pa/ /stug (8)po'i gnas nas gshegs nas 6)ni/ /sangs rgyas lhan cig sna tshogs che/ /rnal 'byor dang bcas bdag nyid che/ /rdo rje'i dbang po'i gnas su gshegs/ /de nas ngo bo nyid sku las/ /slar yang byung ba spros par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las chen po/ /ci bzhin sngon gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rdo rje'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur7/ /sngon hūṃ sangs rgyas mdzad pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni mdzad pa bstan/ /gsang ba rol pa'i 'khor lo ru/ /sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid che/ /sna tshogs rnal 'byor bdag nyid che/ /'khor lo thams cad bzhugs par 'gyur/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nyu1thams cad du/ /ci bzhin sngon gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /sangs rgyas rol pa yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas ston pa bzhugs par 'gyur/ /dus gsum ye shes rjes mthun yo ni/ /84—558

sangs rgyas kyi ni rnal 'byor brjod/ /hūṃ badz+ra sa twa/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ཿtrīḥdu/badz+ra dharma/ aḥdubadz+ra kurma/ bskal pa grangs med gsum sngon du/ /bcom ldan byang chub mdzad pa gang / /rnal 'byor sems dpa' bzhir bcas pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor snang bar bgyi/ /byang chub chen po chos kyi mchog /byang chub sems ni tshul chen po/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin bgyiX/ /zla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor snang / /pha rol phyin pa spyad pa ni/ /sngon du bcom ldan spyad pa gang / /rdo rje rin chen sbyor ba yis/ /zla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor snang / /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs/ /chos kyi mchog ni rab rtogs pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi (9sbyor ba yis/ /zla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor snang / /sems can smin cing grol bar byed/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rab tu 'jug /brtson 'grus dang ldan las chen po/ /zla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor snang / /byang chub sems ni gsang chen po / /bsod nams tshogs dang shes rab dang / /byang chub spyod pa rab sbyor ba//rgyal po bzhi ni rab tu 'byung / /go cha'i sbyor ba gang yin dang / /spyod pa de bzhin mngon rtogs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub che/ /rgyal po bzhi ni rnam par byung / /byang chub snying po mngon rtogs (7dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur dang / /chos kyi 'khor los brtul rdzib dang / /rgyal po bzhi ni rnam par byung / /chos mchog mngon par rtogs pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin sgo gzungs dang ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thabs chen po/ /rgyal po bzhi ni rnam (8)par byung / /rgyal chen rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang / /de bzhin chos ni mngon rtogs 5)dang / /chos mchog byang chub chen po dang / /rnam pa bzhi ni yongs su byung / /mgon 'iripo thugs ka /rjenas spros nas/ /rgyal po bzhi ni rnam 84—559

par byung / /phyogs rnams thams cad kun nas ni/ /sa ni thams cad g.yos byas nas/ /phyogs rnams thams cad kun nas ni/ /'od kyi ①snang bas gsal bar byas/ /mgon chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ched du brjod pa ched ②brjod do/ /e ma'o gsang ba'i chos chen po/ /e ma'o ye shes bla na med/ /e ma'o rol pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas rmad byung che/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thabs chen po/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ldan pa nyid/ /mi snang rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /'di ni snang ba bcas par dmigs/ /rgyal po rnal 'byor che de rnams / /phyogs rnams kun du gsal byed cing / /chos kyi sku yi ting 'dzin brnyes / /nam mkha' dang mtshungs rmad byung ①ba/ /gang zhig shar gyi phyogs cha ru / /sangs rgyas grags pa chen po kun/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag spros/ /chos kyi sku ru spros nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings ni stug por 'gyur/ /gang phyir shar du yang dag byung (7/ /mi bskyod rjopa ni bdag nyid byas/ /lho ru rdo rje rin chen te/ /nub tu rdo rje chos yin no/ /byang du rdo rje las nyid de6)/ /chos kyi sku ru ldan par 'gyur(7/ /ma lus mchog tu bstan 87pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad phyogs bzhi ru/ /mi bskyod yo)rdo rje rin chen dbang / /don yod grub pa bla na med/ /rgyal po bzhi ni phyogs bzhi ru / /rdo rje'i steng du bzhugs 7par 'gyur/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams (7bzhi dag tu/ /mnyam par dmigs nas bzhugs par gyuradzin/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag bsdus/ /chos dbyings brtan (nyepa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba kun du khyab par bsdus/ /dbus su mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang bskur ba/ /phyogs dang mtshams 84—560

kyi ①sangs rgyas kun/ /brtan ②par mdzad nas rab tu bzhugs/ /gdug pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog mi bskyod ③pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad dunas/ /shar gyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /dbang bskur ba ni rgyal po che/ /nam mkha' thub pa'i skyes mchog ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan ⑤mdzad nas/ /lho yi phyogs su bzhugs par gyuraX/ /dag pa'i chos 'dzin rgyal po che/ /chos 'dzin gtso bo chen po ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/ /nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'dzin rgyal po/ /don yod grub pa bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/ /byang gi phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ /mi bskyod ⑦rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /mkha' snying rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje las ni don yod grub/ /gsang zhing shin tu gsang ba mchog /chos dbyings brtan pa gang yin pa/ /de nyid mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag por bshad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad phyogs bzhi ru/ /sbyin pa bzhi ni rab tu bshad/ /phyogs mtshams nidrug ni brtan mdzad nas/ /rnam par snang mdzad yang dag ldan / /shar gyi sangs rgyas dbang phyug rgyal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'jigs 6)mi mnga' / /thub pa mi bskyod snang ba des/ /snying po bzhi ni gsungs par 'gyur/ /hūṃ badz+ra satwati/ dzaḥ7badz+ra rā dza/ ho badz+ra rā ga /sā (gebadz+ra sā dhu/ge/ dam tshig sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /de bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /'jigs pa mi mnga' sems dpa' bzhi/ /mgon po yi ni thugs las byung / /phyag na rdo rje bzang po mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu chen po bsnams/ /rdo rje chags pa bdud 84—561

chen po/ /rdo rje legs pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje rgyal po bzhi thub pa/ /thub pa'i thugs ka hu)nas byung ba/ /grangs ②bzhi dang ni ldan pa dag /'khor lo'i rim gyis (mibazhugs par gyurabya/ /rdo rje rin chen skal ba che/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rab grags pa/ /lha yi bdag po sangs rgyas chosadu/ /snying po bzhi ni gsungs par 'gyuradu/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+nasti/ oṃ badz+ra te dzaḥ/ ṭ+wāṃ ⑧badz+ra ke tu/ hā badz+ra hā yonyes/ rdo rje rin chen stobs po che/ /grangs bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan / /rin chen rgyal po las byung ba/ /thub pa'i thugs ka ⑩nas byung ba/ /rdo rje rin chen rin po che/ /rdo rje gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan shin tu mthong / /rdo rje bzhad pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /de dag re re las kyang ni/ /rgyal po grangs med rab tu byung / /g.yas dang g.yon dang rgyab (nyudag dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun du bzhugs/ /dag pa'i chos ni ye shes che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dag pas/ /snying po bzhi ni gsungs par 'gyur()/ /hrīḥ6)badz+ra dharma/ dhīḥbadz+ra tīk+ṣa0/ yaṃ badz+ra he tu'i / raṃ badz+ra bhā ṣarkya/ chos kyi rgyal po bzhi yang ni/ /mgon po'i thugs ka ⑩nas byung ba/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /'khor lo rim (nyebazhin bzhugs par gyur/ /chos rnams kun la don yod pa/ /spyod pa yi ()ni slob dpon mchog /don yod grub pa rgyal po ches/ /snying po bzhi ni gsungs par 'gyur rme / /kai badz+ra kurma( nya/ haṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ hūṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ baṃ badz+ra musbyi 3/kun kyang 'khor lo yang dag ldan/ /ye shes dag ( gepa mchog gi rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul 'khor lo ni/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchog /sngon gyi byang chub sems gang ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par byung / /bsdu ba'i 84—562

dngos po bzhi po ni/ /rdo rje rin chen nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dag pa/ /de ni rdo rje chos mchog ldan/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'khor lo ni/ /rdo rje las su rnam par 'phrul/ /de nas chos ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten/ /byung gyur byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa bla na med/ /byang chub sems ni mchog tu 'dzin/ /dag pa'i chos kyis ①'dul mdzad pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po che/ /dbu ma'i chos las rnam par byung / /gzhan yang rjes su brtse dang de bzhin sbyin②/ /shes rab thabs dang yang dag ldan/ /chos kyi rgyal po bzhi po de/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs las byung / /'du shes 'du shes med pa min/ /btags pa ma yin gnas pa med/ /bdag dang chos nyid lta ba min/ /rnam rtog las ni byung ba min/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru ni/ /so sor snang ba yang dag byung / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yis ni/ /chos kyi longs spyod 'di lta bu/ /thams cad brjod pa dang ①bral zhing / /zhi dang phra ba libalta bar dka'/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dgongs mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nyid theg pa che rang bzhin/ /mdzod 6)chen po yi 4)rang bzhin mchog /shes rab chen po thabs chen po/ /theg pa chen po'i mngon par bsdus/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mngon par rtogs/ /sngon du bcom ldan mdzad gang yin/ /sems dpa' bzhi po de rnams te/ /theg chen mngon par rtogs par 'dod/ /byang chub kyi ni sems de las/ /thub pa mi bskyod rnam par byung / /sems de yang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rnam pa bzhi ni yang dag byung / /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje / /rdo rje phyag na rdo rje yin/ /sgrol dang grol dang dbugs 'byin pa/ /84—563

lcags kyu 'dzin pa rab tu gnas/ /sems dpa' bstan pa don yod pa/ /ye shes de nyid shin tu chags/ /slar yang bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ /legs pa las ni yang dag byung / /gang zhig mgon po thub 'byin pa/ /sems can rjes su 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya bsti/ /de ni slar yang rnam pa bzhi/ /chos kyi sbyin pa rin po che/ /mi 'jigs gzi brjid yang dag gnas//byams pa rgyal mtshan yang dag brjod/ /zang zing bzhad ②par yang dag ldan/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rgyal po/ /tshe dpag med ni rnam pa bzhi/ /so sor rig pa mngon par rdzogs/ /ting nge 'dzin sgo pad+ma can/ /sdug bsngal gcod pa shin tu rno/ /chos kyi 'khor lo tshe dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rnam 'phrul gzhan② / /brjod du med pa'i chos kyi mchog /don yod grub pa mdzad pa ste/ /thabs de yang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /sems can la ④sogs 'dul ba las/ /rdo rje las ni mchod pa che/ /theg pa gzhan du mi 'jug pa/ /rdo rje bsrung ⑤bar rab tu brjod/ /gdug pa 'dul (7zhing nges byed pa/ /phyir mi ldog pa khu tshur yin/ /de nas 'di rnams kyi tshigasang ba'i mtshan ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje gzi brjid/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje rgyu/ rdo rje smra ba/ rdo rje las(gu/ rdo rje srung 6)ba/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur/de la dang po ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje las de nas rnam grangs mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag tu med pa don yod par grub pa/ de nas 'di rnams gsang ba'i snying po ni hūṃ oṃ ā ha7/rgyal po'i snying po ni oṃ 174 hrī hoḥ7/ bcu drug gi snying po ni hūṃ dzaḥ( ho sā0/84—564

oṃ slo ṭ+wāṃ ①ha/ trī dhi ②me raṃ kai haṃ hūṃ baṃ/ shin tu gsang ba'i rgyud chen po 'di'i pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa rnam pa bcu drug tu ①yang dag par byung ba gang yin pa de ni rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa'o/ /byang chub spyod pa'i mthu yis ni / /sangs rgyas nyid kyi 0pha rol byon⑤/ /de bas dupha rol phyin ldan pa/ /rdo rje sems mar brjod par bya/ /bsdu ba yi ni dngos po bzhi/ /so sor rtogs ⑦pa mngon par rdzogs/ /chos bzhi gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje rin chen ma ru brjod / /gsang ba'i chos kyi ye shes ni/ /de nyid pha rol phyin pa mchog /pha rol phyin pa che las byung / /rdo rje chos mar brjod par bya/ /sbyor ba yang dag shes pa ⑧gang / /rdo rje las mar ⑨brjod par bya/ /rgyal po pha rol phyin bzhi ni//rdo rje pha rol phyin pa mchog /gang phyir ⑩rnam par rol pa mchog /sgeg mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /brgyan tunyepa'i lus can yid 'phrog pa/ /phreng ba tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /ched du brjod pa ched du brjod/ /glu ma bzod pa'i pha rol phyin / /myur du sangs rgyas ster byed pa/ /gar tsom brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa/ /me tog bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /kun tu mtshungs par 'phro 8ba yi/ /bdug ④pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dri nga mi dge las phyir phyogs/ /thabs ni dri dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs rnams kun du snang byed pa/ /smon lam snang ba chen po 8yin/ /thob pa'i pha rol phyin zhes pa / /stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa mchog /mi shes mun pa 'joms 'byed ⑩pa/ /lha mo ye shes pha rol phyin/ /bdud rnams thams cad pham byed pa/ /lha mo mi thub pha rol phyin/ /byang chub rdzogs pa'i byang chub che/ /rdo rje'i pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor phyimadzad ma/ /bdag med chos kyi rang 84—565

bzhin mchog /rdo rje'i lha mo yang dag byung / /rdo rje pha rol phyin pa mchog /de nas de 6)rnams kyi gsang ba'i ming ni rdo rje sems ma/ rdo rje rin chen ma/rdo rje chos ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ rdo rje phreng ba ma/ rdo rje glu ma/rdo rje gar ma/ rdo rje me tog ma/ rdo rje bdug ②pa ma/ rdo rje dri ma/ rdo rje mar me ma/ rdo rje tho ba ma/ rdo rje ye shes ma/ rdo rje mi thub ma/ rdo rje las ma / sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs chen po/ /rnam pa bzhir ①ni rab tu 'jug /sems can dgug pa'i thabs chen po/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhes byar bshad/ /byang chub spyod pa la spyod la/ /rdo rje zhags par rab tu bsgrags/ /theg pa gzhan la 'dod med pa/ /de ni rdo rje lcags sgrog ④bshad/ /chos rnams thams cad skye ba med/ /rab tu 'od gsal gzod (snyenas zhi/ /rdo rje theg pa theg chen po / /rdo rje dril bu zhes byar brjod/ /de nas 'di rnams kyi gsang ba'i ming dag ni rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog(6) /rdo rje dril bu/de nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs kyi 'khor lo de dag thams cad kyi snying po ni hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ 7775 ho/ rdo rje pha rol tu (8)phyin pa rnams kyi'o/ /dzaḥshu baṃ hoḥyi)/ 'khor lo'i rol pa la gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /chos kyi longs spyod rdo rje can/ /chos sku bla na med par 'gyur/ /dbus kyi sangs rgyas sangs rgyas bzhi/ /'khor lo lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin 'thob mdzad la7/ /re re zhing yang rdo rje ni / /grangs med pas kyang yongs su bskor/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs las byung / /dag pa'i chos kyi tshul chen po/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ni/ oṃ satwa brdzu 31o rat+na baṣ+ṭha12/ oṃ dharma baṣ+ṭha12/ oṃ kurma brdzus/ oṃ badz+ra lilā 'gye/84wa 566

oṃ badz+ra yo) mā lezhu/ o badz+ra gī te②/ o badz+ra rnar 528/ oṃ badz+ra saspre/ o badz+ra dhū ⑥se/ oṃ badz+ra gan gadhe/ oṃ badz+ra ā ⑧lo ke/ o badz+ra ang ku po)sha /o badz+ra pā ⑩sha /o badz+ra sbo ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi7/ de nas 'di dag thams cad kyi thun mong gi snying po ni hūṃ/ mgon po rnam par snang mdzad che/ /'khor los sgyur (geb chen po bzhi/ /sems dpa' chen po bcu drug dang / /gsang chen lha mo bcu gnyis dang / /sgo srung ba ni bzhi dag ste/ /sum cu rtsa bdun las mi nyung / /gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi po ni/ /phyis kyi pha rol phyin pa mchog /gsang ba'i lha mo kun las ni/ /rjes thog tunyenyid du yang dag byung / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid ches/ /sum cu rtsa bdun bgrang mi bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs ka tsonas/ /chos kyi rigs mchog yang dag byung / /byang chub sems las kun du byung / /mi bskyod la tsosogs tshogs chen po/ /nga yis yirdo rje rigs su brjod/ /phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid che/ /sbyin pa'i spyod pa kun du byung / /rin chen 'byung ldan la yige sogs pa/ /nga yis yinyerin chen rigs su bshad / /rin chen rdo rje bdag nyid che/ /sbyin pa spyod pa kun du byung / /dag pa'i chos la kun du byung / /tshe dpag med pa la yo)sogs pa/ /de ni pad+ma'i rigs su bshad/ /rdo rje chos ni bdag nyid che/ /grub pa'i las las kun du byung / /don yod grub pa la khri )sogs las/ /de ni las kyi rigs su bshad/ /nam mkha'i mdzod ni las chen po/ /rdo rje ji bzhin lha mo yang / /lha mo ji bzhin bsten ( nyate 'dra/ /ji ltar bstan pa de bzhin zhi/ /ji ltar zhi ba de bzhin byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod mtshungs/ /shar gyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /rdo rje rin chen rin chen mchog / lho yis 2 phyogs su yang 84wa 567

dag bzhugs/ /rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon/ /nub kyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /bya ba kun la don yod pa/ /byang phyogs su ni bzhugs par 'gyur②ske/ /dbus su mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ②rnal 'byor che/ /zla ba gang ba bzhin du zhi/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bla na med/ /gang phyir kun du sngon 'gro ba/ /rdo rje byang chub sems don ldan/ /de las spyod pa de las chos/ /de las spyod pa spyad dka' ba/ /sems dpa' chen po bla na medag / /rdo rje rnal 'byor bzhugs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gcig gis/ /mgon po la ni gsol ba btab/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems / /mgon po la ni gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub khyod rag lus / /khyod la brten nas de bzhin gshegs/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa kun / /khyod la brten nas 'byung bar 'gyur④/ /dang po'i thugs ni rnal 'byor che/ /byang sems shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /kye ma sems can 'di sdug bsngal / /sangs rgyas chos kyi snod min pa/ /sems can kun gyi don ched du/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor dam pa gsungs/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun mchog gnas kyi dbang phyug gis/ /mgon po'i gsung ni gsan nas su/ /'khor lo'i sbyor ba gsungs par 'gyur/ /de ni (5)yang dag bshad par bya/ /'khor lo chen po grong khyer che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs las byung / /snying po'i chos mchog rnal 'byor ldan/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i bstan pa yinayi/ /sems can 'di dag gdul bya min/ /de rnams bde ba'i don ched du/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bshad par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga'i tshul/ /bdag (7nyid ji bzhin rnal 'byor byas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob 'gyur ba/ /de la dang 84—568

por rab bshad bya/ /de ru sems can thams cad kun/ /shin tu brtan par rab 'jug na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rdo rje nyid/ /thob 'gyur de la the tshom med / /theg pa chen po mngon par bsdus/ /sangs rgyas byang chub shin tu gsang ske/ /thar pa mchog tu bstan pa nyid/ /sngon du gzhung mchog mnyan par bya / /bskal pa brgya phrag dag tu ni/ /ji ste mngon par brtson byas kyang / /gang zag bzhi ni 'jig rten du/ /bsgrubs ①kyang 'grub pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni ma skyes dang / /the tshom ②ldan pa nyid dang ni/ /bka' bzhin du ni mi byed pa/ /dad pa med nyid 'grub mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar dus gsum gshegs de bzhin/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ③nas/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad byas te/ /the tshom ④med par byed pa'i mchog /khyim pa dang ni rab tu byung ⑤/ /phyogs ni gnyis po 'dis bsgrub ⑥bya/ /ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham ⑦pa ru/ /go rims (kyebazhin du rab bshad 5)bya/ /byang chub sems ni lhur blangs nasakyi/ /lha gzhan 'dod pa brtson mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad bya ste/ /de gzhol ba la brtson par bya/ /srog gcod rku (7dang 'khrig pa dang / /brdzun yidang myos byed rnam par spang / /khyim pa'i sdom pa la gnas nas / /de tshe rig pa'i rgyal po bsgrub(nye/ /gal te de ni rab byung gyur/ /sdom pa gsum la yang dag gnas/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa mchog yin no/ /zla ba'am yang na lo re'o/ /de bzhin yang na lo gcig tu/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /sngon du rig pa'i brtul zhugs bya/ /nyin re zhing ni ci nus par/ /thun gsum du ni cho ga bsgrubatso/ /rtog pa 'di ni thun bzhi ru/ /ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham par ni/ /sdig pa 84wa 569

thams cad bshags par bya/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang sangs rgyas kun la gsol ba gdab/ /de yi bsod nams byang chub bsngortsi/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi/ /sangs rgyas bla med thams cad la/ /gsol ba gdab cing rab btud nas/ /zhabs la mnyam bzhag phyag bya'o/ /ji skad gzhung rgya che las gsungs②/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni sbyor ba yis/ /rgyud gzhan dag ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab brjod bya/ /de la snying po ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo ②pa sbru nā yā āt+na ④rna nir+sā ta yā 0mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha ⑥su 'cha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā las bhi ṣe kā 6)ya āt+na ⑩rna nir+sā 7ta yā ⑩mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra (sterat+na 8a bhi ṣiñtsa 48/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā 8pra bar ⑩ta nā tunyeya āt+na ()rna nir+sā gu ta yā 0mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra bar ta ya 'du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzā 6)karma ṇi āḥ tsorna nir+sā ⑤ta yā limi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kurma ku ru rmā me/ phyag rgya dang bcas cho gar ldan/ /yang dag nyid du rab bshad bya/ /sor mo thams cad sbyar ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mor ( nyerab tu brjod/ /sa phyogs gtsang mar 'dug nas ni/ /mkhas pas yan lag kun phyag bya/ /rdo rje thal mo brkyang 0nas ni/ /rgyal ba rnams la dbul bar bya/ /mgo bos de bzhin byas nas ni/ /mkhas pas dpral nunyebs phyag bya'o / /mgo bo nas ni phab 0byas nas/ /de bzhin kha yis phyag bya'o/ /de bzhin snying gar (rtebazhag byas nas/ /spyi bo nas ni phyag bya'o/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor pas phyag bya/ /slar yang cho ga la gnas te/ /mchod pas cho ga dang ldan pa/ /spos dang me tog mar me dang / /dri dang phreng ba byug pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran byas nas/ /sems can kun la mi 84—570

'jigs sbyin/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i sbyor ba yis/ /ci nus par ni mkhas pas dbul / /gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gos dang ldan/ /gtsang ma'i grogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje'i sdom pa bla med par①/ /bslab pa'i gnas ni blang bar bya/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i sbyor ba yis②/ /dad cing de la rab gzhol bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /slob dpon yang ni phyi ma yin/ /nyin re zhing ni ci nus par/ /khrus bzhi dag ni rab tu bya/ /rnal 'byor ji ltar khrus bya ba/ /go rims ①bzhin du rab tu bshad/ /sdom pa gsum la rab tu gnas/ /dang po khrus su brjod pa yin/ /gnyis pa rgyud las gsungs pa yisal/ /bshags dang gsol ba 'debs la ⑧sogs/ /phyag rgya bcing ba gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa chu ste tha ma yin/ /khrus kyi cho ga 'di yis ni/ /mkhas pas 'dir ni khrus bya'o/ /gos ni lan gsum brje ba yi/ /sgrub pa pos ni cho ga bya/ /sdom pa la ni legs gnas pa/ /gos ni dang por brje ba dang / /gnyis pa cho ga bsgrub ⑥pa dang / /gsum pa ngo tsha khrel yod pa/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni gsum po (3)dag /lan gsum du ni brje bar bya/ /gang la kha na ma tho med/ /thams cad bza' zhing bsten (shepar bya/ /sha dang chang ponyedang sgog pa sogs/ /bza' ba min pa rnam par spang //dri nga ba dang mi gtsang nyid/ /bza' dang btung ba rnam par spang / /gzhan la gnod pa dang ldan pa/ /lus kyi phyir yang bya ba min/ /'khrig pa bdun dang yang dag ldan/ /mi sdug sgom pas spang bar bya/ /yid gzhungs mkhas shing gsal ba dang / /theg pa chen po'i don sems pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul rgya che/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la tsosogs/ /klog pa dang ni bsam 47pa dang / /yang dang yi yang du gsol ba gdab/ /dgra dang grogs dang bar ma la /84—571

sems snyoms mi 'jigs rab tu byin/ /snyan ①cing bden par smra ba yis/ /zhe snang 'joms byed byams pa bsgomaphyi/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med cing / /'dus byas dang ni 'khrul pa tsam/ /blo ldan brtan pas brtag par bya/ /'dus byas kun la rmongs mi bya/ /'tsho ba'i srog gi phyir yang ni/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu ②phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o / /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bya gzhan/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas ④mi bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /sbyor ba lhod par mi bya zhing / /cho ga ston pa lhur blang bya/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa la / /go rims dubazhin du bslab par bya/ /sems can gyi ni don ldan pas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad/ /kha na ma tho chung yiju yang / /srog ni ⑦btang snyoms dor mi bya/ /khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba'ang rung / /'dris pa thams cad rnam par spang / /bu dang chung ma dag la yang / /srid pa'i bcing ba las grol bya/ /brkam zhing chags la sdang ba dang / /rmongs shing 2le lo ldan pa'ang min/ /bag yod shin tu brtson ⑨pa yis/ /rnal 'byor cho ga bsgrub 7par bya/ /lta ba kun las rnam par grol/ /de nyid las ni legs par mthong / /dge zhing dgongs pa bshad pa yi(nya/ /don shes don ni rtogs par 'gyur / /rigs dang mi rigs cho ga shes/ /de nyid rnal 'byor shin tu mkhas/ /brtse ldan byang chub spyod par ldan/ /spyod pa rnams la rab tu mkhas/ /de 'dra'i tshul ni sna tshogs dang / /de lta bu yi bsgrub 62pa yiyon/ /dngos grub dang ni thar pa 'thob7/ /dngos grub kun la the tshom med/ /gnas dang gos dang bza' ba yi/ /lhag pa thams cad rnam par spang ski/ /lha rnams brnyas ⑩par 84—572

mi bya zhing / /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /le lo med par nyin re zhing / / bsrung ba ①yi ni cho ga bya/ /bgegs med 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /rang sems 'di ni gdul bar dka'/ /pha dang ma ru 'dzin pa dang / /bram ze dge slong de dang ②'dra/ /dag cing dul la zhi ba dang / /bsdams shing thar pa nishes pa dang —/ /rgyal srid mtho ris longs spyod min/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 'phel phyir min/ /gzhan du sems can don gyi phyirabya/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges byas pa/ /zas kyi tshod ni shes pa dang / /mtshan mo gnyid kyang sad par bya/ /'dod chags skyon la ⑤sogs pa gzhan/ /sems kyis rnam par mi brtag yigo/ /sems ni rab tu dang byas nas/ /g.yo ba med cing nges byas pasadhi/ /legs par smra zhing rab tu 'byed/ /chos ni nges par don gnyer byed/ /mngon spyod kyi ni bya ba bzhin/ /sems can gnod dang 'tshe mi bya/ /nyes ldan gdug pa'i sems can rnams/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug mi bya/ /lha yi sku dang phyag mtshan dang / /lha yi bzhon pa dag dang ni/ /dman ma lha yi grib ma (kyedang / /lha yi mtshan ma thams cad dang / /bza' 6)ba dag ni sna tshogs pa/ /mtshan ma ⑩gzugs su byas pa dang / /bgom ⑩par mi bya bza' mi bya/ /nam yang brdzi bar mi bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum dang 'brel pa'i zas/ /nam yang nye bar longs mi spyodakyi/ /tha na phul dang dman ma yi/ /dri yang mnam ⑩par mi bya'o/ /ri bo 'am ni tsonags kyi nang / /gtsang zhing yid 'ong dben pa 'am/ /chu bo'i 'gram mam skyed tsomos tshal/ /ne'u gsing yishin tu yid 'ong ba'am(nye/ lha khang gtsang ma nyams (nyedaga' 'am/ /khang pa gtsang ma dben pa 'am/ /gang du tshogs pa med pa ru/ /sangs rgyas la dmigs sems kyis (7ni/ /gtsang ma'i 84—573

grogs dang lhan cig tu/ /de 'dra'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /thar pa'i ①mchog tu bstan pa nyid/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag brtsamal/ /thun bzhi dag tu sbyor ba yis/ /mgon po mchog la phyag bya zhing / /sangs rgyas rjes dran sgom pa pos/ /bshags pa la ②sogs de bya'o/ /mchod pa nyid kyang ci nus bya'o/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya yang dag bcing / /mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad ni/ /phyogs kun du ni yang dag spro/ /sa gzhi ④dag ni ma lus nyid/ /kun nas rin chen shing ldan dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs mchog ldan dang / /rgyal ba rnams (gel dbul bar bya/ /me tog shing dang bdug pa dang / /dri yi tshogs ni yid 'ong dang / /rin chen rang bzhin rgya mtsho ni/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la 'bul(67/ /de nas phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /me tog bdug pa la (pesogs sprin/ /rol mo'i tshogs ni yid 'ong ba/ /mchod pa'i sprin ni rnam par bsam / /mchod pa thams cad rab byed pa/ /rig pa'i rgya (nyachen 'di rnams dang —/ /phyag rgya dag kyang yongs gsal ba'i/ /bsam pa yis ni gzung 6)bar bya / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta put+pa pū dzā 7me gha sa 6nyamu dra yi)spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bṛk+ṣa 9/nya5 dzā 7me gha sa mu dra 7smra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan padha pū dzā lho 7me gha sa mu dra 6nyaspa ra ṇa sa ma 17ye hūṃ/ gang du rgyal chen me tog dang / /bdug pa dang ni dri yi tshogs/ /de bzhin kun du yang dag sbyar/ /tha na rgyan spel rnams kyang ngo / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya tshul chen dang / /phyag rgya chen po bslab par bya/ /theg pa chen po bsdus pa las/ /ji skad rgya chen gsungs de bzhin/ /sems can thams cad bskyab ne tshopa dang / /bde ba chen po'i rgyu dang ni/ /'gro ba gsum las dgrol ( nyaba'i phyir/ /de lta bu yi bsam pa 84wa 574

byal/ /'dir ni lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /bag med nye bar zhi ba dang / /mi rnams sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /rab tu mthar phyin de bzhin nyid/ /theg pa dman par 'dod byed pa/ /'khor ba rnam par gzhol ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bdag nyid ches/ /'di de bsam par bya ba yin/ /bdag gi bsod nams stobs dag gis/ /bde ba thams cad tshogs kyi mchog /sems can thams cad bde chen ldan/ /ma lus par ni grub gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /'byung po kun la 0)byams par shog /dud 'gro thams cad 'jigs med shog /ngan song thams cad zhi gyur cig /bde ba chen po 'di bsams nasal/ /sdig pa dral ba bcing bar bya/ /sdig pa thams cad dral byas shing / /de bzhin ngan song thams cad do/ /phyogs rnams thams cad sangs rgyas kun/ /yang dang yang du rjes dran nas/ /gsang ba'i mdo sde ma lus pa/ /yang dang yang du bklag (0par bya/ /mi ldog byang chub sems dpa' ru / /gcig tu 'gyur 'dod sems kyis bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bla na med/ /rnal 'byor chen po bsgrub par bya/ /zla ba'am yang na zla ba drug /lo gcig gam ni de las gzhan/ /rig (pepa'i brtul zhugs 'di 'drar bya/ /phyag rgya thams cad yang dag bcing / /sangs rgyas rnams la nyin re bzhin/ /nges par lha bshos dbul bar bya/ /lha bshos snang ba ster byed pa/ /de bzhin rig pa'i lha bshos la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo che/ /thams cad du ni rjes dran bya/ /'ching ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyis (5)brtan bya/ /rdo rje go cha'i sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bsrung bar bya/ /de lta bu yi cho ga yis/ /rnal 'byor bya ba bsgrub par bya/ /bsrung /phyirab byas shing brtson 'grus brtsam(tsun/ /84—575

stobs chen spro ba bskyed pa yis/ /nyin re zhing ni brtags nas su/ /rtog ①pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /sku mdog dkyil 'khor ji bzhin par/ /ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham pa ru/ /dgug pa la ②sogs las rnams ni/ /thams cad mnyam par gzhag par bya/ /ci nus ③par ni ④nyin re zhing / /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /mtshams ⑤med lnga po byed pa yang / /lo gcig na ni rab 'grub 'gyur / /theg pa chen po'i 6)tshogs nang na/ /mchog 'gyur rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur / /rgyud gzhan gyi ni cho ga dang / /mdo sde dang bcas ci bzhin du/ /de nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs blang / /sdom pa'ang dor bar mi bya zhing / /kha na ma tho rdul tsam 9)yang / /'gyod pa ru ni bya ba yin/ /gnas ni yang dag brtag par bya/ /tsher ma la ⑧sogs dang bral ba/ /ri bo 'am ni dgon pa 'am/ /lha khang skyed po)mos tshal dang ni/ /chu yi 'gram dang 'brog dgon par/ /gang du phyogs ni gtsang mar gyur⑩/ /gseg ma gyo mo bong ba dang / /rdo ba dag ni bsal bar bya/ /shin tu legs par dag bya ste/ /gang phyir lha rnams yongs su 'dzin / /gal te de ni sbyor lhod gyur/ /rnam pa kun du mi 'jigs yibya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal po che/ /chos kyi bdag po dgongs pa can/ /thugs rje snying por ldan gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas nyes par 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /gnas ni kun du dag bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor yang ni ci nus par/ /rgya ru dpag tshad tsam bya lho ste/ /khru drug las ni dma' ba min/ /sngon la phur bu gdab bya ste/ /rdo rje lta las (stesogs pa 7bcing / /de nas yo byad thams cad ni / /cho ga mchog gi 7blang bar bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid 'dir/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bsgrub par bya/ /thal ba la yisogs dus ji bzhin/ /84—576

mkhas pas dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /ji ltar nus shing spro ba dang / /ji ltar rdzas ni 'byor pa dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor chen pos bya/ /yang na sems kyis brtag yo)par bya/ /ci ste bsgrub ②pa rgyal por ①'gyur/ /cho ga gzhan gyis dublo ldan pas/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni dag par bya/ /tshon ⑤ri lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /khru ⑥ni stong dang ldan pa mchog /yang na rgyang grags ④tsam du ni④/ /sa yi cha ni thig gdab bya / /gal te 'byor pa ldan pa min/ /khru bzhi mdo ru bsdus par ⑨bya/ /yang na phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /khru brgyad dang ni yang dag ldan/ /in+d+ra ⑩ni yoskrel shin tu sngo/ /tshon rtsi sngon po rab tu bya/ /pad+ma rā ga shin tu dmar/ /tshon rtsi dmar po zhes byar bshad/ /rdo rje mchu dang mchu tsochen po/ /ser po yang ni yang dag ldan/ /dag cing dang ba'i 4gegaser dang ni/ /kha dog ser po 8ldan par bya/ /shin tu dag pa shel dang bas/ /tshon rtsi dkar po rab tu bya8/ /gang phyir rgyal po nor chen ldan/ /tshon rtsi 'di dag yang dag bshad/ /phyug cing nor dang yang dag ldan/ /gal te de ni khyim bdag gyurayi/ /khru brgya yongs su tshang bar bya/ /bcu drug las ni nyung mi bya/ /tshon rtsi dri dang yang dag ldan/ /gur gum la tsosogs dang bsres pa/ /tshon rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan / /mkhas pa yis ni dkyil 'khor bya/ /phyug cing nor dang yang dag ldan/ /tshong dpon yang ni ded dpon nam/ /khyim pa 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ /gzhan dag dga' zhing 'ongs gyur na/ /rin chen phye ma dang bsres tunyepa'i/ /tshon rtsi chen po rab tu bya/ /rams dang ba (7bla la ce )sogs pa/ /tshon rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdag nyid chung ba'am che ba'ang rung / /de yi 'byor pa brtag ( spe84—577

bya ba/ /ji ltar rigs hu)par nges par sbyar/ /rgyal po la ni tshad bshad pa/ /khyim bdag la yang de bzhin no/ /tshong dpon dang ni ded dpon gyi/ /khru ni lnga bcu nyid kyang ngo / /gzhan dag dga' zhing 'ongs ①gyur na/ /khru ni nyi shur byas pa yin/ /gal te dngos grub bsgrub ⑧'dod na/ /khru drug las ni chung mi bya / /mang po de bzhin nyung ba yang / /dri dang kun du yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu sna tshogs dri yis ni/ /sngon du sa gzhi dag par bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor ngos dag gi④/ /grwa ⑤ni bzhi po thams cad du/ /shes rab can gyis bdug spos bsregayi /gang phyir rdo rje can dag gshegs/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas de na(pe / /sngags kyis bsangs pa'i (8)dri chu yis6)/ /rtag tu legs par chag chag gdab / /gang phyir rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur/ /nyin zhag drug gam bdun brgyad dang / /mar dang 'o ma 'bras chan 7nyid/ /slob dpon zas ni dkar gsum bza'17/ /yang na thun mong 'gyur pa'i zas/ /ci ste bzod ldan nyin mtshan du/ /mi bza' bar ni bsgrub par bya/ /gang phyir chos kyi rang bzhin zas / /stobs ldan 'gyur bar 9)the tshom 7med/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni rgyal chen po/ /gang yin bsam pas bya ba'o/ /bco 8lnga la ni brtsams nas su/ /gnyis pa'i nya la rdzogs par bya/ /yang na mar gyi ngo la ni/ /bcu bzhi la ni yang dag brtsam/ /bco polnga la ni thug ⑩par bya/ /legs pa ru ni rdzogs par bya / /yang na tshes brgyad nas brtsams te/ /tha ma nya la kun du bri/ /yang na bcu bzhi la brtsams te/ /nyin zhag gnyis par yang dag bri/ /yang na bco (nyalnga de yi ni/ /snga dro de yi yang dag brtsam(nya/ /tshul chen po dang mtshungs pa yi / /dkyil 'khor shes rab can gyis bri/ /gang gi tshe ( nyanas brtsams nas su//84—578

ji srid rdzogs par ma gyur par/ /gal te kun nas mi bza' bar brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par bya/ /dri dang bcas shing legs byas pa yang na dkar gsum bza' bar bya/ /gang phyir rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /byin gyis brlab ①par mdzad par 'gyur/ /bsod nams che ②zhing bkra shis pa'i/ /nyin zhag dag pa gang yin pa/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /skal ba chen pos dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /dbus kyi cha ru 'dug par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la dmigs nas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /sems ni yongs su 'dzin byed pa/ /lus ni drang por byas nas su/ /bshags la ②sogs pa'i las rnams ni/ /thams cad sngon du bya ba yin / /byang chub sems la brtson gyur 0cing / /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad pa yis / /phyogs bcu ru ni phyag byas nas/ /bdag nyid kyang ni spro ba bskyed⑤/ / deng bdag skye stib 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba'ang 'bras bu yod/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dam tshig gis/ /deng ni srid par mnyam par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' (7rtse gcig pa'i/ /sems kyis phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'byung ba'i/ /bdag 'gyur bar ni the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /deng ni bdag mchod bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas(she/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /de ltar dga' ba dang ldan pas/ /de nas dbus su 'dug gyur ⑨nas/ /spos kyi reng bu 7lag thogs pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bya/ /sems ni dga' zhing mgu ba yis/ /tshig ni 'di skad brjod par bya/ /yan lag kun gyis tunyerab btud de/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsol ba gdab/ /ma lus phyogs na 84—579

bzhugs pa yiyi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje bdag ming 'di zhes byaphyi/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas la ③sogs kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni bdag la stsoladhi/ /tshig ni de skad brjod nas su/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bca' dubar bya/ /chos chen po la snyoms zhugs yinas/ /bdag nyid ting 'dzin dang ldan bya/ /gal te nus na skal ba ches/ /yang na sems kyis bsgrub ⑦par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /ting 'dzin zhes bya ci 'dra dang / /rdo rje'i gzugs dang ldan pa la/ /rnal 'byor pa yis snyoms 'jug bya/ /yang na rnal 'byor gang rung la//nus na snyoms par 'jug par bya/ /sems ni mnyam par gzhag 'gyur ba/ /go rims (gyibazhin du bshad par bya/ /bcom ldan sngon ni ci 'dra ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid 'gyur ba'i/ /de 'dra bar ni bdag rang nyid/ /rnal 'byor don sems bsam par 6)bya/ /dka' thub sdom pa sna tshogs pa/ /bdag gis 7bya bar bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa chen po ni/ /stong gsum pa ni bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas bskul ba bla na med/ /shes rab can gyis ⑩bskul ba bsam/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag byas shing / /ci 'dod pa ni bka' nod bya/ /nges par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang sems so sor tsobartag par bya/ /byang sems yang dag bskyed (nyanas ni/ /dbus su zla ba brtag par byam/ /de nas rang gi ye shes brtag /zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje bzhin/ /rang lus rdo rje'i gzugs su ste/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rang bzhin nyid/ /de nas sangs rgyas mngon rtogs nas/ /rang bdag nyid ni dbang bskur 8bya/ /rang bdag sangs rgyas thams cad du/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor blta bar bya/ /ri 84—580

rab ri yi rtse mo ru/ /stug po'i gnas las babs nas su/ /rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni①/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rnam 'phrul bya/ /sems dpa' bzhi ni phyung nas su/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan byas nas / /phyogs bzhi ru ni dgod par bya/ /mtshams ②su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun / /bdag nyid yang dag byin gyis brlabs/ /phyogs bzhi ru ni sangs rgyas kyi / /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po byung / /'khor gyi 'khor lo dang dubacas nyid / /dkyil 'khor thams cad blta bar bya/ /sems dpa' gsang ba'i lha mor bcas/ /sgo srung durnams ni bsam par bya/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor dag pa ni/ /snying po chen po brtag (nyapar bya/ /rang gi 'khor lo yang dag bzhugs / /'khor lo lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /thabs chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mtshan ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas kyang / /rdo rje'i lta bas blta bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /slar yang snyoms par 'jug par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs dbus su/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par ni/ /mgon po'i snying ga yinas gzung bya/ /sems dpa' kun gyi spyan snga ru/ /bka' ni rim ⑦bzhin nod par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑧dbang bskur gyis/ /rang bdag nyid ni dbang bskur bya/ /gsol ba btab pas postegasan par bya/ /bdag ni rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /chos kyi sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ting 'dzin shin tu bla na med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas kun/ /byin gyis brlab ⑩pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas kyang / /bka' ni nye bar nod (nyebya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang bdag nyid/ /nam yang dor 84—581

bar mi bya'o/ /skyil krung bshig ste langs nas ni/ /rang gi ①'dren pa'i zhabs phyag bya/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gang ba ru/ /phyogs rnams bzhi ni blta ②bar bya/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni brjod par bya/ /bdag nyid rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje can/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /bdag ni phyag na rdo rje mchog /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ rdo rje yi ni gsang sngags 'di/ /lan cig nyid ni brjod par bya/ /bdag ni gtso bo rdo rje che/ /byin gyis brlab ①pa mi 'dor ro/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kun du gang / /'khor los lnga par yang dag gnas/ /bsnyems bcas rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul ldan par bya/ /slar yang bdag nyid go bgo zhing —/ /bdag nyid dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gcad 8)par bya/ /lag nyed (9pa yi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rab tu mnye/ /rdo rje gtun shing nyid kyis ni/ /bgegs rnams thams cad brdung bar bya/ /rdo rje ral gri rab rno bas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gtub par bya/ /rdo rje mche (6)ba drag po yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dbug par bya/ /rdo rje bzang po'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhom par bya/ /rdo rje ral gri'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gzhig par bya/ /rdo rje mche ba stirab grags pas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog (kyiphyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /84—582

bgegs rnams thams cad drang bar bya/ /rdo rje mdung 6)thung phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad dbug par bya/ /rdo rje dbab (7pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskyel ①bar bya/ /rgyas pa yis ④ni ci nus par/ /lus rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /bgegs ni 'ga' yang yod min zhes/ /sems ni dag par gyur pa ⑤yin/ /rang sems bdud ces 6)bya bar bshad/ /bgegs nyid kyang ni rang gi sems/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsalag / /rnam rtog las ⑧ni bgegs rnams 'byung / /gdul bar dka' ba'i sems gzung zhing / /'dod pa lnga ni spang bar bya/ /sngon du rjes dran nas brtsams te / /yang na rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /bcom zhing nges par bcad nas ni/ /yi ge hūṃ gis bskrad 6)par bya/ /rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje ra ba bcing bar bya/ /hūṃ mdzad rdo rje bsdam ⑩bya zhing / /de ni rdo rje ra bas bskor(nya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya ches/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag byin brlabs (snyenas/ ci/ci nus par ni rgyas pa ru/ /ra ba mchog yosteni bcing bar bya/ /rtog pa kun la nges sbyar nas/ /sems ni dag par 'gyur ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi skimatshan nyid ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzung 7bar bya/ /grogs dag dang ⑩ni thams cad la/ /g.yel ba med par bsrung yinabar bya/ /gsor nyunyezhing legs par bkal ba dang / /tshad dang ldan zhing mdzes pa dang / /dri zhim reg bya 'jam pa dang / /legs par byas shing sra //smub dang / /dri bsung zhu )dang ni yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs tshon gyis kun du khyab/ /dri bcas tshon du spang bya zhing / /chos kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de nas de ni yang dag bshad/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ / dkyil 'khor 84—583

kun gyi gsang ba che/ /lasangs rgyas brtan pa'i rdo rje can/ /sems can 'di rnams gdul bya min/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /tshogs ni kun du ma bsags pa②/ /bsod nams tshogs dang mi ldan zhing / /sangs rgyas 'byung la chags dang bral/ /sems can de rnams mos bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang ldan pa/ /de ni sridakyil 'khor 'dzin du 'jug /yang na bsod nams dag gi tshogs/ /de ni rang nyid kyis ④mthong 'gyur/ /gang phyir tshogs bcas longs spyod dang / /chos kyi sku ni bla na med / /rdo rje'i dam chos las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ⑤ba 'dzin du gzhug /gal te de ni tshogs bsags gyur/ /sngon du sangs rgyas rjes su mthong ske/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor ba la gnas te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong 'gyur/ /tshogs ni bsags pa med pa dang / /sangs rgyas mthong ba med pa ru/ /des ni thos pa rnyed ⑥mi 'gyur/ /dang por 'dir 'jug smos ci dgos / /gang phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'di ni gsang ba mtshungs med pa / /'di ni theg 7chen snying po ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ / bskal pa 3)grangs med pa ru byung / /sa yi 6)pha rol phyin pa mchog /gang phyin kyigasang ba mtho ba thob/ /rab tu dga' ba sgrub par 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa de brtson / /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'das/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob cing / /rdo rje nyid ni the tshom med/ /yang na mthong ba tsam gyis (1ni/ /skye ba bcu drug mya ngan 'da'atshi/ /rab tu dga' ba thob pa yang (nya/ /yang na rdo rje nyid kyang ngo ske/ /sa la nyi zla ltung byed cing / /de ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'gyur/ /so so'i skye bos sangs rgyas nyid/ /'grub par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /rnal 84—584

'byor mchog ni bla ①med pa②/ /de phyir rnal 'byor chen po sbyor/ /gal te sangs rgyas nyid 'dod na/ /brtson 'grus chen pos bsdad ①mi bya/ /tshad ni ji skad bshad pa ru/ /de bzhin gzhung gi durjes 'brangs nas/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par bya/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan//cha mnyam pas ni mdzes par gyur/ /dar gyi ⑤chun pos brgyan ①gyur cing / /rin chen dra bas rnam par brgyan⑦/ /g.yer ku'i ②dra bas yang dag ldan/ /kha dog lnga pos rab tu mdzes/ /dril bu'i dra bas shin tu spras/ /rnga yab sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ /phreng ba rnga yab bla ①re dang / /nyi zla dag gis nye bar mdzes/ /kun nas phyi rol gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje kha khyer yang dag rten/ /kun du kha ⑩khyer dang ldan payi/ /sgo ni kha khyer med pa'o/ /rtse mo rdo rje sngo rang bzhin/ /gzhan ni gser gyi mdog 8can dang / /dmar po pad+ma lta bu dang / /gzhan yang shel ltar dkar ba dang / /rin chen rang bzhin mchog kun gyi8/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes par bri bar bya/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni mdzes pa mchog /rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis 8mchod/ /rim gnyis sgo dang yang dag ldan/ /rta babs sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ /dkar zhing gsal dang rdo rje dang / /nyi zla dag gis rnam par spras/ /'dab lim bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sgo bzhi dag ni mchog tu mdzes / /mtho zhing yangs la mdzes pa ste/ /rdo rje rdo rje yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje sgo srung 8skal chen po/ /bdag nyid rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin/ /gtum po srung byed rnal 'byor pa7/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /lho ru rdo rje zhags pa ste / /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog gotunye/ /rdo rje dril bu skal chen po/ /byang gi sgo 84—585

ru yang dag gnas/ /'jug pa dang ni 'byung ba'ang rung / /rdo rje shugs ni brjod par bya/ /ri mo dman ma brdzis byas na/ /dam tshig de nyid mthong mi 'gyur / /o badz+ra be gā kra ①ma hūṃ/ gang gi dus su thig 'debs pa/ /rdo rje'i thig ni brjod par bya/ /sa yi cha ni ma lus pa/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru ②dra mā gti kra stim hūṃ/ sngon du tshon rtsi'i phye ma la/ /'bar ba'i blta ⑤bas yang dag blta/ /badz+ra rā ga ⑥zhes brjod na/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra rā ga hūṃ/ mtshams ⑦kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams (nyernams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras6)/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /logs dang cha ni mnyam pa dang —/ /kun nas cha ni rnam par phye0/ /dkyil 'khor cha ni rnam par gsal/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de yi nang gi rim pa ru/ /zhugs nas 'khor lo de mtshungs pa/ /kun du cha ni mnyam par bri/ /ka ba brgyad kyis (nyanye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje'i ka ba'i mdun gnas 8su/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni lnga yis brgyan(nya/ /gnas lnga dag ni thams cad du/ /'khor lo lnga ni dgod par bya / /'khor lo'i dkyil 'a khor dbus su ni/ /kun du bri zhing dgod par bya/ /rdo rje bsnyems 6tshul gyis bltas nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzung bar bya ma badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ de la dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas rgyal po dgod par bya/ /gang gi thugs las nges byung ba/ /gsang ba'i tshogs ni stug cing brtan / /rnam par snang mdzad rnal 'byor che/ /phyogs rnams likun du rnam par gsal/ /gang gi rimatshan smos tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol 'gyur / /'khor los sgyur 7ba tshogs chen po/ /sems dpa' bzhi po rgyal po 84—586

che / /phyogs rnams dag ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje shugs 'chang dag gis dgod / /shar du rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /lho ru rdo rje rin chen no/ /nub tu rdo rje chos zhes pa/ /rdo rje'i las ni byang du'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lnga po ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas cod pan ldan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras pa/ /nam 6)bza' dkar po dag mnabs ②pa/ /de la 'di rnams kyi snying po ni/ o sarba yo gī ②sha ra ④ya hrī ⑤rgyu/ o badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na yirgyu/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kurma hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje che/ /rtse mo lnga pa dgod par bya/ /rdo rje rin chen rin po che/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i pad+ma ste/ /rdo rje las kyi rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje rnon po mtshon cha che/ /rnam snang rang gi phyag rgya ni/ /ye shes khu tshur yongs su 'dzin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa/ /'od kyi dbus su yang dag gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po bzhi po kun/ /bcom ldan 'das las rab tu byung / /gang na 'khor lo med pa yi/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo'i grwa bzhi ru / /btsun mo chen mo lha ⑦mo bzhi/ /dgod pa'i chos nyid bsam (kyepar bya/ /rdo rje sems ma rdo rje chos/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen ma/ /rdo rje las ma btsun mo che/ /dkyil 'khor grwa bzhir bri bar bya/ /rdo rje sems ma byang sems ma/ /pha rol phyin pa chen po mchog /lha mo chen mo rdo rje chos/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /dpal chen rdo rje rin chen ma/ /bsod nams kyi ni tshogs gter byed/ /mkha' mdzod yinaces bya rdo rje las/ /las kyi pha rol phyin pa mchog /de nas 'di rnams kyi gsang ba'i ming ni/ dpal chen rdo rje dkar mo dang / /rdo rje sgrol ma mkha' rdo rje/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad las/ /de dag gsang mchog bla na med/ /thams cad zla ba gang 'od ldanayi/ /rked 84—587

par bsnyems bcas rol par ldan/ /ji ltar rgyal ba'i rnam bzhi bzhin/ /rang gi phyag mtshan gyis brel ①phyag /seng ge'i snyoms tshul rol ldan pa/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas su/ /shar gyi mi bskyod dkyil 'khor la/ /zla ba'i dbus su mi bskyod pa/ /ston pa'i phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /mkhas pas yang dag bri zhing dgod/ / de yi phyogs rnams yongs su 'dzin/ /mkhas pas yang dag bri zhing dgod/ /②de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /dam tshig dag ni bzhi po bri / /mdun du phyag na rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu g.yas su'o/ /rdo rje chags pa de bzhin g.yon/ /rgyab tu legs pa yang dag bri/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras shing / /rdo rje phyed pa'i dbang bskur ldan/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas ni/ /lho yi rin chen dkyil 'khor du/ /zla ba'i dbus su rin chen 'byung ske/ /mchog 'dzin pa yi phyag rgya 'dzin/ /mkhas pas yang dag bri zhing dgod / /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rin chen sems dpa' bzhi po ni / /mdun du rdo rje rin chen te/ /g.yas su rdo rje gzi brjid do/ /g.yon du rdo rje rgyal mtshan te/ /rgyab tu bzhad pa yang dag bri/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis spras shing / /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur ldan/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas ni/ /nub tu pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su 'dzin/ /dbus su 'dug pa 'od dpag med/ /sems dpa' chen po ye shes che/ /phyogs bzhi ru ni dgod par bya/ /rdo rje chos ni mdun du ste/ /g.yas su rdo rje rnon po'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje 'khor lo ste/ /rdo rje smra ba rgyab tu'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /byang gi las kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /tshe(5)thub pa don yod grub pa dgod/ /de yi phyogs 84—588

rnams thams cad du/ /las chen po dag yang dag bri/ /kun nas phyogs ni bzhi dag tu/ /phyag na rang gi phyag mtshan mtshon/ /mdun du rdo rje las yin te / /g.yas su rdo rje sung ba'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje gnod sbyin te/ /rdo rje khu tshur rgyab tu'o/ /de nas phyag mtshan bcu drug dang / /dbus ma nyi shur rab bshad bya/ /bcu drug dbus ma nyi shu ni/ /go rims 6)bzhin du rab bshad bya/ /ji ltar rigs shing 'tsham ②pa la/ /rdo rje chen po rtse lnga pa/ /rdo rje rin chen ①rin po che/ /rdo rje pad+ma chen po dang / /rdo rje rnon po dbus ma yin/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rdo rje che/ /de bzhin rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin/ /rdo rje chags pa gzhu nyid do / /rdo rje legs pa'i rdo rje gnyis/ /rdo rje rin chen chen ④po che/ /rdo rje gzi brjid ⑤nyi ma ste/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan sgreng ⑥/ /rdo rje bzhad pa tshems tshichen po/ /rdo rje chos kyi pad+ma ches/ /rdo rje rnon po (nyeral gri bzang 6)/ /rdo rje rgyu yi 'khor lo che/ /rdo rje smra ba'i yi ge ste/ /rdo rje rnon po las chen po/ /rdo rje srung tiba'i cho ga (nyaste/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin mche ba che/ /rdo rje khu tshur bsdams 7pa ste/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu dag ni sgo ba bzhi / /rdo rje sems ma'i yo rdo rje che/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen nor/ /pad+ma rdo rje chos ma ste/ /rdo rje rnon po las ma yin/ /grwa chabazhi dag tu gsang ba yi /phyag mtshan de rnams dgod par bya/ /'khor lo chen po'i phyi rol gyi/ /grwa ⑫bzhi dag ni thams cad du/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rdo rje lha mo yang dag bri/ /rdo rje sgeg mo rdor phreng ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje glu ma nyid/ /bsnyems bcas phreng ba pi bang tsodang / /glu gar gsang ba'i lha mo rnams/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor mtshams ()rnams su/ /mchod pa'i lha mo yang dag bri/ /me 84—589

tog spos dang de bzhin dri/ /mar me nub byang mtshams su'o①/ /mar me la ②sogs bar ③nyid kyis④/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor thams cad du/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' che/ /stong ni nges par dgod par bya/ /mtshan ma ji bzhin ci rigs pas/ /byams pa la (gesogs ma lus pa/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa yi/ /sems dpa' chen po dgod par bya/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni / /kun du bri zhing dgod par bya/ /rang gi snying pos kun dbab phyir/ /rang rang gi ni snying po yin/ /de la snying po ni 'di rnams yin no/ /oṃ dubadz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ badz+ra e ku (3)sha dzaḥ(9/ badz+ra rā yo)ga ho/ badz+ra sā bidhu sa/ dam tshig mchog gi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra (nyam ṇi otso/ badz+ra te tunyedza ④a/ badz+ra ke tu dzā8/badz+ra hā skyas hā / badz+ra pad+ma hrīḥ/tunye badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha 7sgo/ badz+ra he tu rma()/ badz+ra bhā ṣa ( nyaro/ dbang gi sems dpa' dang / ye shes kyi sems dpa' chen po'i snying po'o/ /badz+ra kurma kai/ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ las kyi sems dpa' chen po'i snying po'o/ /de rnams ni rab tu gnas pa'i snying po yin no/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi snying po ni/ badz+ra hūṃ/ rat+na 〉( ste/ dharma hrīḥ snye / kurma dzo gha/ lha mo rnams kyi sngar bshad zin to/ /sgo sung 8)rnams kyi yang de bzhin no/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad dgod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las bshad par bya ste/ kun nas rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos kyi blo can gyis bri bya( dzī/ /dpal mchog dang po las gsungs pa'i/ /sems dpa'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs/ /lan bdun du ni brjod par bya/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la/ /lan bdun du ni bskor bar bya/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 84—590

rdzogs par ni/ /mkhas pas 6)thams cad blta bar bya/ /gal te chad dam lhag kyang rung / /rdo rje shugs kyis dag par bya/ /'khor lo chen po dag par byas/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor yang dag gzung / /rgyal ba rnams la bdag nyid ni/ /dbul ba'i las ni kun du bya/ /de nas yo byad thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni mchod par bya/ /ci 'byor pas ni bya ba ste/ /dman par gyur kyang nyes (mipa med/ /'byor pa ci nisnyed yod pa kun/ /go rims ④bzhin du rab tu dbul / /bum pa gang ba 'bum phrag gam/ /stong ngam yang na brgya yang rung / /mar me 'bum phrag stong ngam ni/ /yang na stong ngam brgya yang rung / /dri dang spos kyi snod 'bum mam45)/ /yang na stong ngam brgya yang rung / /ga pur a ga ru nyid dang (6)/ /du ru ska (pedang tsan+dan sogs/ /mang sbyar dri zhim dang ldan pa/ /spos rnams 'di dag bsreg par bya/ /gser ram dngul gyi snod dag dang / /sa las byas kyang nyes pa med/ /yo byad ji snyed yod pa kun/ /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhag par bya/ /de la kong (0bu stong phrag gam/ /mar me sdong bu shin tu 'bar / /tha na mar me snod gcig ste/ /ma tshang gyur kyang nyes pa med/ /dar ni phyar bar bye ba bre(9)/ /rnga yab phreng bas rnam par brgyan7/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes/ /sna tshogs bzhon pa brgya 'am (ge ni / /stong phrag gcig kyang nyes pa med/ /thams cad ma tshang gcig nyid kyang / /bde bas rol mo mchog rnams bya/ /phan pa'i zas ni stong phrag dang / /bye brag dag ni /gergya mtsho tshogs/ /bca' ba sna tshogs pa yang ste/ /gal te ma tshang nyes pa med/ /dri dang gos bzang thams cad dang / /dri /dzo zhim pa yi byug pa dang / /bya ba mchog ni nye bar skomadzes/ /bla re rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /84—591

sna tshogs dri yi chus bkang ba/ /bum pa shin tu yid 'ong dang / /me tog shing ni brgya nyid dang / /bzhi yang nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /dri dang me tog thams cad dang / /bdug pa yid du 'ong ba kun/ /gal te sbyor ba ldan gyur na/ /mchod pa rnam pa thams cad bya①/ /mchod pa dang ni gtor ma nyid/ /ji bzhin sgrub pa pos de phul/ /de bzhin dngos grub rdzu 'phrul ni/ /mthong ba'i chos la thob par 'gyur/ /sngar ni ji skad bsgrags pa bzhin/ /thams cad cho ga bzhin du dgod/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bya zhing / /mchod pa nyid kyang rab tu bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo phyag byas nas / /pus (7mo btsugs te 'dug nas ni/ /yang dag par ni dgug par bya/ /sems dpa' rdo rje lcags kyu bcing / /rdo rje lcags kyu brjod par bya/ /nyi shu gcig tu bzlas pa yis(kye/ /de bzhin gshegs ④rnams kun du gshegs/ /de nas sgo srung (9bcings nas ni/ /yi ge dzaḥ0ni yongs su brjod/ /rdo rje can ni thams cad dgug /the tshom med par gshegs par gyur/ /rdo rje zhags pa bcings nas ni/ /cho ga ji bzhin nges par gzhug⑦ /rdo rje lcags sgrog bcings nas ni/ /dbang du yang ni rtag tu bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis/ /de dag nyid kyang dbab par bya/ /rdo rje gnas pa'i phyag rgya yis②/ /gnas rnams kun ni dgod par bya/ /ci nus par ni rab tu bsgrags6)/ /de nas mchod pa rab tu bya/ /spos dang me tog la 7sogs pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor kun la sbyar/ /bdag nyid dbul dang mchod pa dang / /bshags yidang gsol ba btab la 62sogs/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas kyang / /sdom pa yang dag spyad par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ches/ /bdag nyid la ni 84—592

dbang bskur bya/ /se gol dag ①ni brdab bya zhing / /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa kun/ /bkug cing rab tu bcug nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog yang dag dbab/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ches②/ /dral nas de ni ①yang dag dbabadu/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /ye shes dag pa skye bar 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i ye shes 'bab⑤par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbab pa yang dag brjod/ /ji ste babs par ma gyur skyon/ /yi ge a yis dril bu dkrolaX/ /mtshams ⑧med lnga po byed pa yi9)/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'di lta bul/ /ye shes dam pa skye 'gyur zhing / /rmad ⑩du byung ba'ang 'dis mthong 'gyur / /brgya las rtsa bdun lhag pa nyid/ /mtshan ma'ang de las lhag 'byung 'gyur / /gzhan dag gang yang rung ba nyid/ /gal te bsod nams skal ba ⑪che / /des ni sangs rgyas thams cad mthong / /yang na byang chub sems dpa' 'am / /yang na rdo rje 'dzin gang nyid/ /yang na 'od zer 'phros pas tunyemathong / /hūṃ sgrogs 'brug gi sgra dang ni/ /spos dang me tog dag gi bar/ /ba spu langs pa la tsosogs byung / /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol byung nas ni/ /sems ma'i phyag rgya ldan gyur pas/ /sor mo gnyis kyis 0phreng ba gzung ⑫/ /gar gyi tshul gyis zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje gar ni tsorab bskor bas/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo rab zhugs ⑩nas/ /phreng ba nyid ni dor bar bya/ /phreng ba de ni gar babs pa/ /de dang de ni skad cig 'grub/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcing byas na/ /dngos grub thams cad nges pa ru/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gzhan yang de la rdo rje 'chang / /byin gyis (3rlob pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /langs nas der ni bcom 84—593

ldan 'das/ /yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang rung / /'dar ba dang ni g.yo ba'ang rung / /de bzhin yan lag 'khums ①pa dang / /yang na tshig ni byung ba dang / /ci ste hūṃ ni brjod pa'ang rung / /nges par legs so zhes bya ba/ /cho ②'phrul bde ba chen po ni/ /rmad byung nibasam gyis ④mi khyab ste/ /rdo rje slob dpon skal ba ches/ /mthong 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /de nas langs te brjod par bya/ /mgon po thub pa la btud nas/ /ci 'dod pa ni bka' nod (5)bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' ⑨thub che/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rab tu gzhug par bgyi/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu khams gtsam gyi/ /sems can kun gyi bde gang yin/ /des ni rdo rje slob dpon de'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rdzogs so// //de nas slob ma gzhug par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po der ni ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad 'jug tu rung ngo / /snod dang snod ma yin pa yongs su brtag par mi bya ste/ gzhug pa la mngon par zhen pa yongs su gzung ⑦bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thams cad kyis mthong ba tsam gyi (nyamod la phyir mi ldog pa 9nyid du 'gyur ro/ /dad pa med pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags pa dang / rgyud yongs su ma smin pa dang / mos pa med pa mang du zin kyang 'on kyang mthong ba tsam gyis so/ /gang gi phyir gsang ba chen po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor gsang bas 'dul 84—594

ba'i thabs dang / 'khor lo'i tshul dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phrul pa pa ②ston pa yin te/ de'i phyir mthong ba tsam gyi ②mod la ngan song thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba'i ①sras ni 'jigs ④pa med/ /ngan song sgo ni bcad pa dang / /thams cad thar pa la gzhol dang / /phyir mi ldog pa nyid du 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song stephyi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed yidu gzhug /sems can kun gyi don bsams nas/ /sdom pa yang ni sbyin par bya/ /srog gcod pa dang ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log ⑦par g.yem pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos ⑧pa'i chang dang / myos par 'gyur ba ⑨dag de nas brtsams te spang bar bya'o/ /sngon la sdom pa 'di dag ni/ /ji ltar 'dod cing mos pa ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni sbyin bya ste/ /rang dbang med par sbyin mi bya/ /gal te de ni dad gyur na/ /de la sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /sdom pa gsum la bkod nas ni/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bstan ⑩par bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ste/ /bslab (skyepa lnga la rnam par gnas/ /byang chub sems la mchog brtson bya/ /sems can shin tu gdul dka' gang / /sdom pa 'dzin par mi byed cing / /dad dang ldan pa med pa yang / /'jug pa nyid ni dgag mi bya/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /de dag gi ⑩ni sku ru 'gyur/ /mthong ba tsam gyi tsomod la ni/ /sdom pa dag par 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid ngan pa'i sems can gang / /khro zhing shin tu gshe ba dang / /bzhad yigad byed cing 'phyar tshuyang rung / /de nyid rgyu ru 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ru/ /de nas yang dag 84—595
