bshad par bya/ /ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham pa ru/ /rdo rje slob ma gzhug par bya/ /sbyor ba bzhi yis phyag bya zhing / /rdo rje sngags kyang bsgom par bya/ /sngar bshad cho ga ji bzhin du/ /phyag bzhi dag kyang bya ba yin/ /stod g.yogs ①gos ni dmar po dang / /dmar pos mig kyang dgab par bya/ /gos ni dmar po bskon 97byas te/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /shin tu gsal ba 'ching du gzhug /snying po lan cig brjod bya zhing / /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ②zhes bya ④brjod/ /dga' zhing mgu la rangs pa yis⑤ sor mo gnyis kyis ༅phreng ba blangs/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ⑦ni/ /slob dpon chen pos (migazhug par bya/ /sa ma ya hūṃ/ shar gyi sgo yi nang du ni/ /yi ge dzaḥṇini yang dag brjod/ /lho ru zhags pa'i yi ge hūṃ/ /nub tu lcags sgrog ⑩bo lhan cig /byang du dril bu byang chub par/ /yi ge a ni brjod par bya/ /dus phyis rol pa dang bcas par(me/ /bkug ste phyag kyang btsal bar bya/ /bshags dang gsol 7gdab mchod pa dang / /yongs su bsngo tsodang rjes yi rang / /bdag nyid dbul ba nyid kyang ni/ /go rims chabazhin du byed du gzhug /deng bdag ye shes rdo rje ni/ /the tshom med par bskyed 8par bya/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /khyod ni phung bar gyur ta re/ /brjod nas phreng ba dor du gzhug /rdo rje'i phreng ba sbyin par bya/ /phreng ba de ni gang du babs/ /'grub par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le/ rdo rje'i tshig ni rab brjod cing / /deng nas gdong g.yogs yidagrol bar bya/ /nges par yid ches sbyin bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor ltos zhes brjod par bya/ /oṃ nga ni rdo rje sems rang nyid / /sangs rgyas snying po las byung ba/ /rdo rje mig ni dbye bar ⑩bya/ /84wa 596

kyai ①rdo rje yi ni ②dkyil 'khor ltos/ /dam tshig nyid ni sbyin bya zhing / /sems ma'i phyag rgya steng du bcing / /'di ni khyod kyi ⑧dam tshig 'joms/ /rdo rje tshig ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ u da ka ṭha0/ rdo rje gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /phyag na rdo rjes srung bar byed/ /dam tshig nyid ni mnyam gyur dun/ /'bras bu 'di ni thob mi 'gyur/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs ⑥pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /'thungs ①shig rdo rje bdud rtsi 'thungasadu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mna' yi ni/ /snying po 'dis ni mna' bsgag①go/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid ni/ /de ring khyod kyi snying la zhugs / /gal te tshul 'di ⑩smras na ⑩ni/ /skad cig de la dral nas gshegs/ /gang zhig sdom pa mi len cing / /shin tu gdul dka' dad med la/ /gzhug pa tsam ni sbyin par bya/ /de la las ni mi bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad dang ldan / /sdig la 'jigs shing rab tu bsdams8/ /dad dang ldan 8pa phun sum tshogs / /de la dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /de la dam tshig gang zhe na/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /gtso bo de dag lhur blang bya/ /'tsho ba'i srog gi phyir yang ni/ /byang sems nges par dor mi bya/ /lha rnams la ni smad mi bya / /sngags dang phyag rgya nam yang min/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas mi bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs/ /bzhon ④pa mtshon cha phyag mtshan dang / /dman ma lus kyi grib ma lirnams/ / gya tshom du ni brdzi tsomi bya/ /nam yang bza' bar mi bya'o/ /bdag gis 8sngon ni ji ltar mthong / /sems can gzhan la brjod mi bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bslab 8pa ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /sems can gsad par ()mi bya zhing ⑩/ /theg pa gzhan la 84wa 597

dga' mi bya/ /sems can don dang 'khor ba las/ /nam yang skyo bar mi bya'o//pha rol phyin drug spyod pa ni/ /nam yang dor 6)bar mi bya'o/ /bya ba ma yin rtag tu spang / /khyod kyi dam tshig sdom pa yin/ /gal te snod ldan mchog yin na/ /'di 'dra'i dam tshig brjod par bya/ /ci ste min na btang snyoms gzhag② /ci ste 'dod pa bde bar bya/ /sbyor ba 'di dag thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus (7pa ru/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi dam tshig mchog /thams cad du ni sbyar zhi)bar bya/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje slob ma (snyegazhug par bya / /rdo rje chos ni bsgrub 97pa yis/ /dngos grub mchog kyang sbyin par ⑨bya/ /gal te rdo rje can rang grub/ /mkhas pas gzhan la'ang bslab (kyepar bya/ /rang nyid ye shes yang dag skyes/ /de bzhin gzhan la bskyed (9)par bya/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing cho ga shes/ /dam tshig dngos grub dang ldan pa'i/ /dad dang ldan pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dir ni slob dpon 'gyur ba yin/ /de yis mchod pa byas nas ni/ /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshams ⑩med lnga po byed pa yang / /lan bdun gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje slob ma la brjod bya/ /'di las 'jig rten gzhan du min/ /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /khyod 'dir rdo rje can du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod sprul zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skye/ /'khor ba'i gnas kyi btson nyalhar ru/ /slar yang sdug bsngal 'gyur ba med/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs pa ru/ /de 1 ring khyod ni gyur pa yin / /nga 1 ril spyi bos gus pas gtugs/ /lus ni theg gsum pha rol phyin/ /mi khom sapar ni skye mi 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod pas nyes pa med/ /rab tu 84—598

dga' ba'i sa thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje can khyod brtson par gyis/ /gzhan tsho 6)bcu drug gis (gyithob pa(mi/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis ④sa thob kyang / /dkyil 'khor gsang ba mthong ma gyur/ /ji ltar khyod ni der gyur pa(snye/ /de bzhin theg pa yid ches min/ /skye dang skye ba thams cad du/ /rdo rje can ni ston (7brtson 'gyur/ /skye ba bcu drug mthar thug pas/ /zhi ba ⑦ sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i gnas kyi sa thob cing / /bskal pa (shegrangs med 6)gnyis dka' 7spyod/ /gsang ba'i theg par ma zhugs par/ /bcu drug gis ni 'gyur ba yin/ /'byung po kun gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /lha tshogs gdug pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje can gyis (nyazil mi non/ /rims gdon dug dang phyag rgya dang / /mkha' 'gro la 4)sogs 'jigs pa'i gdong / /nga rgyal dang bcas gzhan dag gis/ /slar yang khyod ni zil non min/ /de ni bskal pa brgya yi ru yang / /rdo rje'i yon tan nyid brjod 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i snying po mchog mthong 'gyur/ /nam yang 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems dpa'i rang bzhin phyag rgya bcingasayi/ /brtson 'grus chen pos brtan par bya/ /ji skad du ni brjod par bya/ /dbab pa bla na med pa ste/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar bshad / /rdo rje ye shes bla tshemed pa'/ /de nyid kyis ni dbab par bya/ /badz+ra ā yonabe sha aḥ/nye/ de nas dbab par gyur pa nyid/ /mngon par shes pa 4)drug thob cing / /ye shes dam pa thang cig gis/ /sngon byung min pa'i dga' bde dang / /dga' ba mgu ba mchog dag dang / /rig pa thams cad mngon du 'gyur / /rdzu 'phrul dag ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /84wa 599

de nas 6)phyag rgya snying gar ②dgrol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /rtag tu snying gar nizhugs par 'gyur/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ④sto me bha brgya/ shā 0shwa to me bha ba / skṛ rgyad yaṃ ⑧me a dhi ti ⑨/ sarba sid dhi ⑩ma me pra yats+tsha hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥyi/de nas snying po 'di yis ni/ /phreng ba nyid ni dor bar bya/ /pra tīts+tsha 8ho/gnas gang du ni phreng ba babs/ /de yi lha ni rigs de yin/ /go rims ⑫bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gsang ba chen po bstan ④par bya/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas sa ni the tshom med/ /dri dang ldan zhing yid 'ong ba/ /bum pa'i chu ni blangs nas ni/ /snying po 'di yis dbang bskur ⑫bya / /sdug bsngal rab tu 'khrud pa'i mchog /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsaphya/ de nas phyag rgya gang rung bas/ /phreng ba byin nas dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje'i ming gi ⑩dbang bskur la/ /ming gi sgra ni rab sbyar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa a gi ṣiñtsa tsomi/badz+ra nā 67ma a bhi 0de ka ta he badz+ra nā ma/ slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /de la ye shes bslab par bya/ /bzhi las gang yang rung ba ni/ /skal ba ji bzhin dri bar bya/ /gal te nor gyi dngos grub smra/ /de ni rnam bzhir bshad par bya/ /nor gyi ye shes chen po bzhi/ /dngos grub rnams ni bslab par bya/ /gang na 0gter ni yod re ba/ /der ni skyil mo krung bcas te/ /snying gar ()rdo rje bsgoms na 0ni/ /gter gyi gnas ni rab mthong 'gyur / /badz+ra ni dhi/ nam mkhar rdo rje bsgom bya zhing / /me long la ni yang dag blta/ /gang du lhung bar mthong gyur pa(3/ /de na ( )gter ni yod par bstan / /rat+na sgo ni dhi/ rang gi lce la rdo rje bsgom/ /'di na yod ces rang nyid smra/ /dharma ni dhi/ rdo rje las ni yang dag babs/ /gang du babs pa der 84wa 600

bstan to/ /kurma ni dhi/ gal te rdo rje'i dngos grub smra/ /rnam pa bzhi ni bslab par bya/ /chu ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin mthong / /shin tu mnyam gzhag dga' bar 'gyur/ /chu ni stug pa'i phyirang bzhin mthong / /chu yi steng du bcag par 'gyur/ /badz+ra dza la/ bdag nyid ting 'dzin dang ldan pas/ /yang dang yang du dga' bar bya/ /bdag nyid dga' ba'i gzugs su ni/ / bsgoms na ②de dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /badz+ra rū ②pa/ bdag nyid nam mkha'i ④rang bzhin mtshungs/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid bsgoms shing / /rdo rje dbab pa bskyed ⑤byas nadu/ /myur du mi snang ba nyid 'gyur/ /badz+ra ā kā sha /rdo rje'i skas ni nam mkha' la/ /bsgom zhing steng du 'dzeg byas na/ /ji srid du ni 'dzeg pa'i gnas/ /de srid mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur/ / badz+ra ma ༷hā/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'dod smra na(she/ /ye shes rnam bzhi sbyin par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus ⑨gnas shing / /nam mkha' la ni bdag nyid gnas/ /lag na rdo rje dang ldan par/ /bdag nyid yongs su bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gal te chos kyi phyag 'dod na⑩/ /gnas sam yang na gzhan yang rung / /bdag nyid gnas par bsgoms (nyen ni/ /de ltar gnas shing lag pa ru/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab bsgom zhing / /bdag nyid rdo rje chos su stetunye/ /pad+ma rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /badz+ra dha tshur/ pad+ma dha tsor/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dug ste/ /bdag nyid las dang yang dag ldan/ /nam mkha' la gnas bdag nyid ni/ /las kyi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rdo rje rin chen dang / /de bzhin du ni bdag nyid gnas/ /lag tu rin chen rnams bsgoms na/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /kurma dha snyir/ rat+na dha tso84—601

ra / gal te sangs rgyas dngos grub smra/ /ye shes rnam bzhi brjod par bya/ /rtag tu nam mkhar ①bsgoms nas ni/ /lus ni yang ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni gnas thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid myur du 'phar/ /badz+ra ṛ dhikhya / stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin bstan / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid ji srid 'dod/ /de srid skad cig gis 'phar 'gyur / /badz+ra badz+ra/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dag /yan lag pad+ma dang ldan zhing / /bdag nyid dag par rab bsgoms nani/ /mngon par shes pa lnga thob 'gyur/ /shud dha/ shud dha/ nyin mtshan brtson 'grus dang bcas pas④ / /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' yi/ /dbyings su bzhugs par bsams na ni/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su mos byas nas/ /brtan par rjes su dran grub na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /satwa satwa/ bud dha bud dha / gang tshe gsang ba'i lha mor 'gyur/ /de yi rigs kyi lha ru 'gyur/ /ye shes dag pa brjod bya zhing / /de la mna' yang bsgag (gepar bya/ /ji skad gsang mdo dbang gsungs pa/ /de bzhin bha gar gzhug par bya/ /yid kyis thams cad bcug nas ni/ /de yi lus ni mnyam du spro/ /mi bskyod thugs ka ⑥nas byung 97)ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs ka (nyanas/ /de yi thugs kur 6)zhugs nas 7ni/ /sangs rgyas kun ni mnyam du spro/ /ting 'dzin sbyor ba la gnas te/ /mnyam par bzhag pas pheg rdob bya/ /rdo rje thal mo'i pheg brdabs pas/ /dngos grub thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /badz+ra pā 6)sha /rin dbang thugs ka bonas byung ste6nya/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs ka (7nas/ /84—602

sangs rgyas kun ni bcug nas kyang / /bdag nyid rdo rje'i lha mo ru/ /rdo rje thal mo byas nas ni/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthil ①brdab bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bsgrub bya zhing / /rdo rje ye shes yang dag brdab/ /rdo rje dbab pa byas nas ni/ /de bzhin du ni bha gar zhugs/ /rdo rje thal mo byas nas ni/ /sor mo'i rtse mos mnyam du brdab/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /rtag tu nyon mongs dang 'brel ba/ /nyon mongs zhes bya'i sgrib pa dag /skad cig gis ni rigs brgya 'joms/ /badz+ra ha ②na/ de bzhin bha gar gnas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas sku ni mnyam du spro/ /rdo rje lha mor rang bdag nyid/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs kur tshuganas/ /rdo rje lha mo bcings nas ni/ /badz+ra badz+ra lan gnyis brjod/ /rdo rje bsdams pa nges bkrol na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'i mchog /badz+ra ha ra/ de nas rnam par snang mdzad bsgrub ④pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni/ sngar gyi ting 'dzin ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje dbyings ni rab tu bya/ /rnal 'byor lnga la'ang rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang rnyed dka' min/ /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti bo (gedhe ka ro mi/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta uṅgā da yā 6)mi/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ badz+ra ād+ma ko (7rta/ o ya thā (kyisarba ta thā ga tāsta thā kyi)a ⑩lha/rnal 'byor lnga po 'di yis ni/ /phyag rgya lnga ni yang dag bsgrubadzirnya/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bdag nyid/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyag rgya rnams so/ /sems dpa'i 8skyil mo krung 'dug ste/ /rdo rje gsor la gzung tu bar bya/ /sku dang gsung thugs phyag rgya dag /rdo rje sems dpa' yirang nyid 'gyur/ /badz+ra satā yilha/ bsgrub 7pa dag gi mchog chen po/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya//84—603

rang nyid rdo rje gsung gis ①bshad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bsgrub par bya /bsnyems ②bcas rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /rdo rje bsnyems nitshul yang dag gzung / /rdo rje dbab par rang gyur nas/ /bdag nyid rdo rje zhes byar bsgom/ /badz+ra satā ④lha/ rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan zhing / /dkyil 'khor ma lus ston mdzad pa/ /phreng ba'i rnam pa 'od dang ldan/ /rgyan dang gos dang kha dog ldan//ḍa ba ta ni brjod bya zhing / /sems dpa' chen po rjes dran bya/ /ye shes sems dpa' gos pa med⑤/ /dga' bdag 0ji srid mthong bar du/ /badz+ra satwa dṛ ⑦rgyal/ sems dpa' mdun du bltas ⑨nas ni/ /bdag nyid la ni yang dag dbab/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa aḥyi/ sdug cing che ba'i sku de ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyus yang dag dgug /dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ7/ rdo rje yi ni sngags 'di yis8/ /bdag nyid chen pos blta 8bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka 8ru/ /slar yang de yi snying gar 8gzhug /sa ma ya aḥtso/ zhes brjod nas ni rnal 'byor pa / /zla ba dang ldan steng du gnas/ /ci 'dod pa yi bya ba byed/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'di ji bzhin/ /de nas sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rang gi phyag rgya yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /rdo rje can kun bsgom par bya / /gang dang bogang la mos gyur pa/ /de bzhin snying po bzla bar bya/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di (8yis ni/ /rdo rje can dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rab grub nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs grub pas/ /'khor los yo)sgyur ba nyid thob 'gyur/ /rgyal po bya ba sngon 'gro bas/ /mnyes pa dang ni dbang bskur bya/ /thun ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /chos kyi bzhad dang dga' bar 84wa 604

'gyur① / /ting 'dzin gzungs kyi 'khor lo dang / /gsang ba'i mdzod ni bla na medal/ /smin pa dang ni grol ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas byang chub brtan ②pa'i mchog /rtog pa gsang chen 'di las ni/ /phyag rgya grangs med yang dag byung / /rigs kyi dbye ba yang dag ldan/ /rgya cher rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /go cha ma bgos snod mi 'gyur/ /le lo khro dang g.yengs ①bcas pasabya nges par 'dzin par mi nus te/ /de bas nyung bar (nyerab tu bsgrags/ /mdo sde'i dbang po gsang rgyal po/ /de nas phyag rgya rab tu bshad/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs / /rin chen snod du blta gribar bya/ /ye shes kyi mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje 'chang ⑦rnamatsha kyi snying po/ gang las ⑧'khor lo yang dag byung ⑨/ /rnal 'byor thams cad kun 'byung ba/ /mchog tu gsang ba bshad par bya/ /dbus kyi 'khor lor yang dag bshad/ /rnam 'phrul zhes ni ⑩rab tu bsgrags/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul te/ /'khor lo thabs ni rab ston pa/ /'khor lo lnga ru yang dag bshad/ /thabs ni rnam pa lnga yang yin/ /gsang ba yi ni dbye ba gnas/ /'khor lo yi ni rnam 'phrul ston/ /dbus ma gang yin byang chub sems/ /shar gyi bsdu 6)ba rnam pa bzhi/ /lho yi tshogs 5nyesu bshad pa ste / /bsod nams tshogs dang yang dag ldan/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams dang / /chos su 'dzin pa rnam 4)spangs pa/ /nub tu yang dag brjod pa yin/ /byang ni sems can smin byas te/ /phyi rol grwa bzhi gang yin pa/ /tshad med pa ni bzhi dang bcas/ /byams pa snying rje btang snyoms dang / /84—605

dga' ba zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /gang zhig thig skud yang dag bshad/ /chos kyi rgyun gyi lam las byung / /lta ba thams cad rnam dag 'di/ /theg pa gzhi 6)ni rnam par spangs(gyi/ /gang zhig kha khyer zhes bya ba/ /ting 'dzin chos nyid dag pa ste/ /rdo rje lha mor yang dag bshad/ /gzungs kyi sgo zhes bya bar bshad/ /sgo ru yang dag bshad pa gang / /thar pa'i sgo ni bzhi po yin/ /rta babs dang ni dra 6)ba nyid/ /chos mdzod rang bzhin grong khyer yin/ /dra ba dra phyed bla bre ④ni / /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rnam 'phrul pa/ /tshon rtsi yang dag bshad pa gang zhu)/ /de 'dra ba yi byang chub tshogs/ /gang zhig mar me yang dag bshad/ /de na 6)chos kyi snang ba mchog /dri ru yang dag bshad pa gang / /grags pa'i dri ni bla na med/ /rdzu 'phrul byug pa gang yin pa/ /tshul khrims dri yis byugs pa yin/ /bza' ba dag ni sna tshogs pa/ /chos kyi zas ni bla na med/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bar bshad/ /rtog 9 pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /grong khyer du (gyini bshad pa gang / /de ni thar pa'i grong khyer mchog /gang zhig dkyil 'khor yang dag bshad/ /chos kyi snying po rang bzhin grong / /nad med ces ni bya bar brjodam/ /de ni dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /dbus su rnam snang mdzad ces pa/ /chos kun gcig tu bsdus pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rgyal po gtso bo che/ /phyogs rnams kun du rnam par gsal/ /rdo rje sems dpar 99)yang dag bshad/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mchog /de bas rgyal po byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems las 7yang dag byung / /rdo rje rgyal por yang dag byung / /sems ni rnam pa bzhi zhes bya/ /sgrol dang grol dang dbugs dbyung dang / /mya ngan 'da' bar lcags kyu'o/ /rdo rje chags par yang dag bshad/ /byang chub spyod pa la 84wa 606

sbyor ba/ /rdo rje legs par yang dag bshad/ /rab tu sbyor ba ston pa nyid/ /rdo rje rin chen yang dag bshad/ /sems can bsam pa yongs rdzogs byed/ /rdo rje gzi brjid yang dag bshad/ /chos kyi sbyor ba 'od byed pa/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yang 0)dag bshad/ /sems can 'khor ba las grol byed/ /rdo rje bzhad ②par yang dag bshad/ /sems can the tshom gcod par byed/ /rdo rje chos su yang dag bshad/ /chos kyi ye shes bla sa)na med/ /rdo ④rje rnon por yang dag bshad / /nyon mongs gcod cing 'joms byed pa/ /rdo rje rgyu ru yang dag bshad / /'khor lo rnam 'phrul ston byed pa/ /rdo rje smra bar yang dag bshad/ /rdo rje chos ni ston byed pa(5)/ /rdo rje las su yang dag bshad/ /sems can 'dul bar byed pa'i mchog /rdo rje srung bar (6)yang dag bshad/ /sems can grol bar byed pa'i mchog /rdo rje gnod sbyin yang dag bshad/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa zad (7byed pa/ /rdo rje khu tshur yang dag bshad/ /byang chub mchog ni brtan par byed/ /rdo rje sems ma rdo rje chos/ /rin chen las kyi rdo rje ma/ /rdo rje rin chen chos chen po/ /las kyi gsang ba las byung ba/ /rdo rje lha mo lhag pa (kyebargyad/ /pha rol phyin 5namachog lhag ma brgyad/ /chos ma shes rab pha rol phyin / /las ma thabs kyi mchog yin no/ /pha rol phyin bcu dam tu )pa ni/ /sa bcu dag tu yang dag bshad/ /dam pa'i chos kyi grong khyer srung / /byang chub sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /e ma'o ye shes e ma'o chos e ma'o thar pa'i grong khyer mchog /e ma'o rnam 'phrul 'khor lo ni/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug dag gis bstan/ /chos kyi sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /mgon pos thar par dgod par mdzad/ /gang du sangs rgyas rgal /1 gyur nas/ /sems can rnams 84—607

kyang grol ①bar mdzad/ /'di ni chos kyi rang bzhin grub/ /'di chos rang bzhin shing rta ste/ /chos kyi rang bzhin snying po 'dirgya/ /'di chos rang bzhin grong khyer yin/ /de kho na nyid mchog tu gsang ba'i rtog ③pa'i rgyal po chen po gsang ba'i rnal 'byor chen po rdo rje rtse mo las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdo sde'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa ste le'u ④dang po rdzogs so// //dngos grub thams cad bla na med/ /de nas gsang ba bshad par bya/ /rdo rje'i rig ⑤pa 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag nyid kyis ni sbyar bar bya/ /cho ga ji lta ba dubazhin du/ /phyag rgya bcing ba bshad par bya/ /ci rigs par ni bcing bya yil/ /gzhan du myur du 'grub mi 'gyur/ /thal mo mnyam pa bcing bya ste/ /sngon la thal mo mnyam par bya/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo bcings/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcing bar bya/ /sor mo rdo rje bsdams bcings nas(kye/ /snying po brjod cing dral 97)bar bya/ /de nas phyag rgya dbang du gyur⑩/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med / /badz+ra 67brnya traṭa7/ 'di tsodi sngon du brjod bya zhing / /de nas phyag rgya yang dag bcing / /gang gi drung du bcings pa ni/ /bdag nyid yang dag byin gyis brlabs/ / ma hā yis ma ya satā 8lha/ shes rab can gyis ⑩dbab pa bsam / /bdag la sems dpa' dbab par bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /snying po yang ni brjod par bya/ /a phyag rgya bcings pa tsam gyis dhini//yan lag kun la yongs su gnas/ /snying po brjod par bya ba ste/ /snying po 'di dag nyid yin no/ /sa ma yo (nyarta/ de nas bdag nyid byin brlabs (rkyenas/ /84—608

rang lha yang dag rjes su dran/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /snying po brjod par bya ba ①yin/ /sa ma ya satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa sbol/ phyag rgya bsgrub ②pa lhur len pa/ /de nas shes rab can gyis bsgrub/ /dam tshig sems dpa' chen po dag /rnam pa bzhi ni bsgrub par ④bya/ /de la 'di rnams kyi gsang ba'i snying po ni/ an+d+ra sidhi/ badz+ra sidhikhya/ badz+ra bīr+ya0/ bud dha sidhi0/ de nas phyag rgya brtan par byed pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+wa dusatwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha 6)dro 0sto me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wayi/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wati/ a nu rasto me ⑩bha wa0/ sarba sidhi m+me 8pra ⑩yats+tsha/ sarba kurma su tsa me/ tsirta ⑩the ⑫yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥyi/ bha ga wān du sarba ta thā ga to 0badz+ra ma ⑤me muñtsa brdzu bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥdu/ mtshams ④med lnga po byed pa yang / /rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'drar du'agyur/ /phyag rgya thams cad 'grub 'gyur zhing / /thams cad 'grub par the tshom dumed/ /de nas phyag rgya 'thams cad dgrol tsob ni thun mong yin no/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcings nas ni/ /tha mar bdag nyid dbang bskur bya/ /sor mo'i rtse mos phreng ba che/ /rnam bzhi yang na rnam pa gsum / /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ⑥a bhi k+ṣizhuzhu / shes rab can gyis go cha bcing ci nus par ni dbang bskur bya/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /phyag rgya thams cad brtan par bya/ /badz+ra (nyeka 6)pa tse na baṃ gnye/ gang nas byung ba der grol te/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /gnas de ru ni dgrol bar bya/ /gzhan du bya ba mi byed do/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥyi/ mgon po thal mo mnyes bya zhing / /rdo rje thal mo bcing bar bya/ /snying po 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /rdo rje can kun mnyes par bya / /badz+ra tu ṣ+pe ho/ cho ga 'di yis dgrol bya ste/ /phyag rgya dgrol ba mchog 84—609

yin no/ /phyag rgya thams cad brtan 'gyur natu)/ /rdo rje can ni mnyes par 'gyur / /snga dro'i dus su nyin re zhing / /shin tu bsdams shing gsang gyur pa(gyi / /rdo rje sems dpa' ci 'dod bzlas/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur / /badz+ra satwa/ gsang ba'i yi ge rtsu bzlas pas/ /rnam pa lnga ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /zla ba gnyis pa yongs su bsgom / /bdag nyid sangs rgyas dang ldan pa/ /rdo rje'i dbus su bsgom par bya / /mdor na rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /yi ge hūṃ ni sbyar bar ①bya/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bsgrub par bya/ /hūṃ/ de ltar rnam pa bcu drug ni / /phyag mtshan thams cad rab tu bsgom/ /zla ba'i dbus su rab sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid thams cad skad cig 'grub/ /yang na yi ge sbyor bas ni/ /dbus su sbyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /zla ba yi ni sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge dza sogs 'grub mi 'gyur/ /yi ge ho dang sa dang ni/ /yi ge oṃ sogs rab sbyor bas/ /zla ba la ni oṃ a traṃ/ /yi ge haṃ ni rab tu bsgrubasti/ / hrīḥdang dhīḥ(5)dang r+ghaṃ paṃ raṃ/ /kai haṃ hūm̐ baṃ bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /rdo rje bzlas pas 'grub par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /bcu drug bdag nyid rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du bsgrub bya zhing / /zla ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /de kho na bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ nyi ma shar ba nas brtsams te/ /bdag nyid dbul ba la (6sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod par bya/ /rdo rje can rnams bzod par gsol/ /phyag rgya thams cad bcing bya zhing / /rdo rje thal mos mnyes par bya/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /84—610

thams cad byas nas gdon par bya/ /lan gsum dang ni lan bdun du/ /bskor ba dag kyang rab tu bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /mkhas pa yis ni dral bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya che/ /'khor lo'i dbus su steng du bcing / /gang gis sems ni dag gyur pa/ /phyag rgya thams cad yang dag bcing ske/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥdhi/ snying po 'di ni brjod nas su/ /phyag rgya thams cad steng du bcing / /sgo ②dang phyi rol mchod pa la/ /rdo rje'i mu ni brjod par bya/ /gsang ba 'di ni gsang ba che/ /rdo rje'i rig pa ③'dzin pa ni/ /shes rab can gyis ⑤kun mi bstan/ /sdom dang ldan pa mchog la sbyin/ /shin tu snod ldan pha rol la/ /de ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs te/ /lag pa g.yas su rdo rje ste/ /g.yon du dril bu sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs gsang chen po/ /snying po 'di ni sbyin par bya/ /de byin snying gar ⑤'dzin du gzhug /thams cad bsgrub ⑥pa'i mchog yin no/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ⑦phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang ⑧/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtanapo)/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ā+oṃ dhā tshur yā (memi badz+ra satwa/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de nas thams cad mtshungs pa ru/ /phyag rgyas ⑫dkyil 'khor dgrol bar bya/ /badz+ra satwa muḥ/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba rdzogs so// //ji ltar cho gar rab ldan nyid/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po che/ /de bzhin kun du bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po che/ /kun mchog dbang phyug dam pa yis/ /rnal 'byor gyi (nyani rgyud bsdus 84—611

pa / /mchog tu gsang ba gsungs par gyur①/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas mgon po che / /spyod pa spyod ⑤phyir byung ba ste/ /chos kyi mgon po rnal 'byor che/ /rgyud rnams thams cad yang dag byung / /sangs rgyas med cing sems dpa' med/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor sgrub pa med/ /sa dang gsang ba mchog med de/ /de bzhin gdul tshuba'i don du byung / /sangs rgyas mchog dang dam tshig mchog /sems dpa' mchog gi bsgrub ④pa dang / /gsang mchog sems dpa'i ⑤spyod pa mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor yang dag byung / /yon tan mchog dran dam tshig rnams kyi mchog /yon tan mchog dran dbu rgyan dam pa ste/ /grags 0chen dang ldan spyod pa mchog 'dzin pa/ /yon tan mchog ldan rnams kyi spyod pa mchog /rdo rje chen po rab bsdams can/ /rnal 'byor chen po spyod pa chen po spyod / /gsang ba chen po'i ⑦yon tan 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bde ba chen po yang dag 'byung ba stsol9gyi/ /yon tan mchog dran yo)ldan pa cod pan mchog /dam tshig tshogs mchog 'byung bas rgyan ⑩gyur pa/ /mi g.yo rab mchog mchog ster dri ma med/ /spyod mchog spyod pa'i mchog ste dri ma med/ /tshogs kyis ⑩bskor bar ⑫shin tu bzhad 6)mdzad pa/ /gnod byed 'joms pa tra 8ṭa tra ṭa sgrogs/ /g.yo byed bskyed 7pa'i bzhad cing bzhad par mdzad/ /yon tan mchog drag tsa la tsa ⑩la pa/ / da ha da ha 7pa ya gnod mdzes 'joms/ /ha ra ha ra ha re ha re las mchog 'joms/ /gnas chen po ni stobs kyis 6)grub mdzad pa/ /rigs (rkyemachog stobs kyis sgrol so )zhing sgrol mdzad pa/ /ha ha hā ha ha hā ha ha hā/ hi hi tī hi hi tī hi hi tī hi hi tī/ hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu/ rab mchog bdag nyid mkhas pas 'dren gyur pa/ /ṭa ṭa ṭī ṭa ṭa ṭī ṭa ṭa ṭī ṭa ṭa ṭī ṭa ṭa 84—612

ṭī ṭa ṭa ṭī ṭa ṭa sa①/ ṭu ṭu rgya rgya/ n+ya n+ya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya rgya/ rgyan gyi ②spyod pa 'dar zhing 'dar bar ②mdzad/ /spyod pa spyod pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur / /spyod pa spyod byed rab mchog bdag nyid can/ /dam tshig rgyan te rigs drug mchod gyur pa/ /bdag po chen po 'phrog byed 'joms par mdzad/ /'phrog ①byed bsgrub ⑤pa rnams ni grub mdzad pa/ /mchog 455 dumachog gi bdag nyid yang ⑦dag byung / /ta te ṭa ⑤te bstan pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /yi ge dza las rab byung mchog ste ①rgyu ni dang po las sbyor ba/ /ho ho 'dod chags mchog ldan bud med bstan byed sa ni len pa rab ster ba/ /oṃ ni dang po bla med ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭi sa a ni gzi brjid rab 'bar ba/ / traṃ traṃ 7rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor rdzogs byed ha ni bzhad pa yang dag sbyor/ /trī ()ni chos can byed cing rab rno dri med hi ni rgyu yi 'khor lo che/ /haṃ dang raṃ ni tsomakha' dgyes smra ba'i sbyor ba 'ching byed a ni sna tshogs byed/ /haṃ ni bsrung 8ba tra ta 'ges byed ta ṭa ta ṭi sa ④rgyu ni za zhing 'cha'/ /baṃ ni dga' byed dga' ste tsha ta tsha ti ṭa ni rab dga' byed/ /haṃ ⑩ni rdo rje bstan pa dang bcas bde brtan ⑩'dod chags/ bcas pa dga' 0byed do/ /ho ni mgon po skye ba mchog gi rgyur gyur hri ni dga' ba bdag nyid can/ /hi 8ni spyod pa 'god (7byed dul spong mchog ste dus gsum mgon pos bskor gyur pa/ /gsang zhing gsang ba'i yon tan kun mchog dri med ho ni byang chub spyod pa mchog /mchog gi mchog ste mchog stsol ()go 'phang mchog thob yi ge hūṃ ni 465 (spreb mchog /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad 'joms shing rab 'phro hūṃ gi mche ba'i mtshon char ldan/ /sna tshogs dga' ba mchog gis rnam par brgyan 'amadzes yi ge i dang yang dag spel/ /he ho haṃ ni 84—613

yid 'ong hūṃ gis rnam 'joms ①gnod mdzes nges 'joms bdag nyid can/ /bde mchog glu dang rol mo dang bcas pa/ /gzugs bzang dang ldan lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ /zla ba ltar dkar 'phro ba'i zhal mnga' ba/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i yon tan brtsegs pas mtshan/ /rin chen kun gyis rnam spras (9yid 'ong ba / /rin chen dra ba'i bla res rnam par mdzes/ /rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod cing mdzes/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ni 'jigs med pa/ /sa rnams kun gyis (kyirnam sbyang dri med pa/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs rtogs bdag nyid can/ /chos mdzad yongs su rtogs pa'i zas dang ldan/ /bsod nams de yis bskyed pa'i dga' ba che/ /tshangs pa'i gnas 9)'byor gru bzhir yang dag gnas / /chos mchog go rims (9bzhin du thig btab pas/ /'khor lo mu khyud rab tu mdzes bris pa/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la ni gtso 96)bo bzhugasal/ /ting 'dzin mchog rnams kha khyer gyis mdzes pa/ /gzungs kyi lha yi tshogs kyis mchod pa'i tshogs/ /thar pa'i theg pas byams pa'i sgo yis brgyan/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor la ni 'dren pa bzhugs/ /pha rol phyin pa (kyebatsun mo gar byed pa/ /sems can smin byed rnam par 'phrul la dga'/ /bsam gtan zas ldan mngon shes mchog gis brgyan/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la ni 'dren pa (9)bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor de ni gtso bo'i chos nyid can/ /chos nyid bstan pa'i snying po kun zhugs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 7tshogs 'dus mdzes pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba zhes byar bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang phyug dam pa che / /gsang ba kun 'byung ting 'dzin yang dag gnas/ /de ni rnam snang thub pa'i chos nyid gzigs/ /gzungs dang dam tshig yang dag 'byung ba mchog/84—614

dga' ba'i chos bzhin rdo rje yang dag gnas/ /de ni rnam snang thub pa'i dbang phyug gtso/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nges par phyung / /hūṃ/ shin tu dag pa'i chos nyid lta bur byung / /sangs rgyas dbang phyug dam pa'i kun gyi mchog /rtse gcig dang bcas e ma'o dga' ba che/ /sangs rgyas sku yang bud med gzugs can te/ /sems can khams ni gdul phyir yang dag gnas/ /bud med gzugs kyang 17chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung rgyud (miganas gyur pa/ /rang gi rigs chen byung ba des byung mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā tī shwa ri ①rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra brdzu ṇi ④rgyu/ o rat+na brdzu ṇi (5)rgyu/ o dharma ⑥ brdzu ṇi (7)rgyu/oṃ kurma brdzu ṇi (kyergyu/ mchog gi dang po rmad byung 59)gsang ba lnga/ /sangs rgyas lngas byas bud med gzugs can te/ / smad byung dang 7bcas dbang phyug dam par gnas/ /rdo rje gsang chos nyid kyi gsang ba mchog /'khor lo'i sbyor bas kyang ni bzhugs gyur pas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis ni shar du bzhugs/ /de ni rigs kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor brjod/ /re re zhing yang rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor 'khor lor yongs su bshad pa mchog /de yis mi bskyod (1mchog tu byung ba yitsho/rnye/ /mchog tu gsang ba yi ni dkyil 'khor gsungasatu / /o badz+ra sa twa gu h+ya sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ gu h+ya badz+ra satwa/ e ku yisha tshuhūṃ / o badz+ra 8gu h+ya rā ge rā tsho ga ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sā dhī tshonashā ri hūṃ/ rdo rje rin chen dkyil 'khor bstan gyur pa/ /de yis ༷/slar yang snying po bzhi gsungs sos ) / /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya rat+na 731ris ma yaṃ ( 2ju/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya pra bha ( snyezhu/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa ( ridzā gra gu h+ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya hā sa sa hūṃ/ rdo rje chos ni dbang phyug dam pa che/ /de yis 'a slar yang snying po bzhi gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma gu h+ya sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ 84wa 615

badz+ra gho ṣa ①gu h+ya ②rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dumaṇ+ḍa le duḥ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya bā tsa ⑤sa ma ye hūṃ/ ⑥rdo rje las ni yongs su dag pas mchod/ /'khor lo thams cad la ni yongs gnas mdzes/ /chos mchog dbang phyug dam pa mchog gyur pa/ /de yis snying po bzhi ni gsungs par 'gyuraX/ /oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya ⑧karma sa ma ye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya ka ba tse hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya rdas yo)r+sā ra ṇi kyirgyu/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya musbyi hūṃ/sngar bzhin 'khor lo'i grong khyer yongs gnas pa/ /rdo rje'i gzugs su yongs gnas mdzes gyur pa/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sras te rdo rjer bcas/ /'on kyang da ltar bud med gzugs su sprul/ /de dag srid pa dag byed rab tu ⑩'bar/ /thar pa'i grong du 'dod chags dag byed pa/ /rtog dang rnam par rtog pa bzlog ⑫pas dag /chos la dga' zhing sku mchog 'byung 'gyur ba/ /bden dang mi bden rnam dag nyi shu dang / /chos dang chos min dga' zhing dga' ba'i snod/ /byed dang byed min rdo rje tha dad gcig /rdo rje ldogebastan pa ho yis rab sbyong spyodaski / /gsang 'byor rin chen las byas chos grong ste/ /rnam 'phrul 'khor lo 'di ni ma pham don/ /rdo rje bla re'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gsang dbang rdo rje chen po yis/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer mdzad/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /'khor lo lnga ni yang dag byung / /de bzhin gshegs rigs zhes bya dang / /mi phyed brtan 7par byed pa dang / /byang chub spyod pa rab spyod mchog /theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi ⑩mchog /gdul ⑩bya ji bzhin 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gtso bo'i spyod 1nyepa ji bzhin lhan cig spyod/ /sems can gdul bya ma yin snod mchog min/ /mthu chen rnams ni dngos grub stsol (7mi mdzad/ /der ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin dag /yon tan mang po yang dag 84—616

'byung ①/ /sems can rnams ni gdul bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo yang dag labyung / /de nyid sangs rgyas sras bcas pa/ /de nyid 'khor lo'i grong khyer che/ /mchod pa sgo srung nidang bcas pa/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag byung / /mgon po rdo rje gsang dbang phyug④ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad / /rdo rje chos kyi sbyor ba yis⑤/ /rdo rje pha rol 6)phyin pa mchog /sngon ni ji ltar de bzhin phyisal/ /de bzhin dbus su rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs yin te/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba yang dag byung (nya/ /rdo rje dbyings ni ji skad brjod/ /de nyid gsang ba zhes byar brjod/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus pa/ /rgyas par phyag rgya dang bcas par/ /'khor lo lnga yi dkyil 'khor mchog /rgyas pa ru ni yang dag bshad/ /mdo sde'i gsang dbang rgyal po ni/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus las/ /gsang ba'i rgyud dang phyag rgyud yo)dang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zla ba dag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ni/ /de dag rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi snying rab mchog /mdor na drug tu bshad pa yin/ /dam chos spyod pa dang ldan pa/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /nus pa ji bzhin rigs pa bzhin/ /ji ltar spyod pa dkyil 'khor mchog /ci rigs par ni cho ga bzhin/ /mchog tu rmad 'byung cibashad par bya/ /sngon la de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /sems dpa' nga 7yis dbye bar bya/ /nga yis mdo sde gsang dbang 7bshad/ /gang du byis pa dag rmongs pa / /rdo rje slob dpon skal ba che/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya bcu drug ni/ /gsang ba nges par bslab par yistebya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rkang lag thal sbyar rdo rje ni/ /kha gyes rdzipa ni 84—617

bsgom bya zhing / /rdo rje can yang chags par bya/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di / /zla ba gcig tu ①yongs su bsdu/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug lha mo nga / /dbus ma la ni yongs su gzung ②/ /sgeg pa dang bcas 'gro bya zhing / /rnam par 'phrul pas bzhin rmongs bya/ /bsgom pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje can yang mnyes par bya/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings nas su/ /bdag nyid yang dag byin gyis ②brlab/ /bsgom pa'i ⑤phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /sku yi phyag rgya rnam par bcing —/ /lag ngar lcags gyur ⑤bskum bya zhing / /bdag nyid yongs su bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin bsgom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i mda' ni kun du dgang ⑥/ /lag ⑦pas legs so zhes bya zhing / /dpung pas bdag nyid go bgor (nyabya/ /slar yang gsang ba ⑨bya ba ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni / /bdag nyid rdo rje gcig pu gnas/ /gsang ba lha mo'i dbang phyug mchog /de bzhin lag ngar bkug bya zhing / /spyi bor rdo rje bsam par bya/ /phyogs gcig tu ni nga 'dug ste/ /rdo rje gnyis kyi go cha bya/ /thams cad rdo rje'i lus yin te/ /rin chen mig ni yongs gsal ba/ /gdong dang tshig ni pad+ma dang / /me tog kun bo'adar bsgom par bya/ /byis pa bzhin du mig bskyod cing / /bud med rgyu mtshan yang dag bsgrubatunya/ /smin ma bskyod cing khro (sheganyer gtsigs1ge / /khro bo'i cilta bas mig gdangs pa/ /khro mo'i 7lta ba 'dod chags che / /'dzum bcas mig ni btsum par bya/ /mig gdangs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i lta bas bgrad par bya/ /slar yang tshig ni rnam pa bzhi/ /ho ni rkan dang lkog ma la/ /dza ni lce yi dbus dang 7rtse/ /oṃ ni lkog ma mchu yidag la/ /84—618

mchu dang mchu yi rtse la baṃ/ /de rnams gsang ba rab rgyas pa/ /bskrad ①dang spyos ②dang gcad ①pa dang / /bcing ba rdo rje tshig gis bya/ /de bzhin kho nar zla dbus na/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rang bdag ④nyid/ /rin chen chos dang de bzhin las/ /gsang ba'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /cho ga thams cad rgyas pa ru/ /rdo rje gsang ba rjes su/ srung ⑤/ /ji ltar rnal 'byor yang dag gnas/ /de bzhin gsang mchog 'dzin pa gnas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bla na med/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje phra mo bsgom par bya/ /dpa' bo rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /phyi rol las grol yang dag gnas/ /langs sam yang na 'dug kyang rung / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yang dag brtsam/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul dag pa/ /spyod pa chen po ༅tshul chen po/ /bdag nyid chos chen rab bsgoms nag/ /rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'du byed sdug bsngal chen po las/ /dga' ba'i spyod pas spro bar bya/ /snying rje chen pos dmigs nas ni/ /sems can btang snyoms dor mi bya/ /lce dang rkan dul sbyar bya zhing / /sna yi rtse mos 5)bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /sna yi rtse 7mor de bzhin gnas/ /snying ga'i yinyespyi bo ci nus par/ /sku ni thams 8cad yongs su spro/ /rdo rje phra mo'i bde reg 4stepas/ /sems ni mnyam par bzhag par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mdun du rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje phra mo yongs su spro/ /rang gi lus kyi mdun du ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 8thugs dbus su/ /rdo rje kun gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /lte bar sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje phra mo 84wa 619

bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rnam ①bsgoms sems gang zhig /gzugs med bstan du med pa dang / /rmongs pa med cing 'jigs pa med/ /rdo rje phra mor 'dir brjod do/ /dngos po med cing rdzas med pas/ /snang ba med par rab tu bsgom / /bdag med sems can med pa ru/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rnal 'byor bsgomadu / /lus ni rdzas lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khams bzhi la ni yang dag brten / /skye mched bcu gnyis nyid dang ni/ /gzhan yang khams ni bcwa ②brgyad dag /sha dang rus pa khrag nyid dang / /rkang dang klad ④pas kun du khyab / /sna tshogs rdzas kyis kun du khyab/ /bad kun mkhris pa la ⑤sogs tshogs / /sna tshogs srin bu'i ⑥rigs kyis khyab/ /dri ngan mi gtsang 'byung ba ru / /rang gi lus la so sor brtag /sdug bsngal gsum ni kun 'byung bar/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rtag ⑦tu ni/ /lus ni rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /rang sems so sor brtag bya ste/ /gang zhig de ru yang dag byung / /'gro ba med cing song ba med/ /de la 'pho ba yod ma yin/ /de la 'byung ba yod min na(kye/ /gang las sems ni yang dag byung / /yang dag ma yin kun rtog 'di/ /brdzun bzhin sems ni rmongs par byed/ /sems med tsam yang yod khyim yin/ /brdzun bzhin 'byung ba 7snang bar 'gyur/ /'di la gnas dang mtshan nyid dang ske/ /rab gnas 'byung ba yod ma yin/ /gzung bar dga' ba gti mug che//rdo rje phra mor brjod par bya/ /de lta bu yi rnal (nya'abyor gyis/ /sems bsgom pa yi rnam pa bzhin7/ /lus dang sems dang tshor ba dag /phra mo'i rnam par bsgom par bya/ / sru gla yo badz+ra/ rdo rje reg pa'i tsomatshan ma yi/ /gnas ni yang dag shes par bya/ /de ni byung na spro bya ste/ /stong gsum du ni yongs su spro//84—620

s+pha ra ṇa badz+ra/ reg pas sbyor ①ba bsdu bya ste/ /skrag cing rmongs par mi bya'o/ /gnas gsum du yang bsdu bya ste/ /blo yis so sor brtag par bya/ /saṃ ha ra ṇa ②badz+ra / chos la dmigs pa'i sems nyid ni/ /rmongs shing gzhom ③par mi bya'o/ /rdo rje de ni brtan bya zhing / /rdo rje phra mo reg par bya/ /badz+ra dṛ 0nye tiṣ+ṭha/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'jigs med pa/ /rgyal po tshangs pa'i gtsug phud can/ /spyi bor sems dpa' bsgom bya zhing / /sku ni thams cad yongs su spro/ /badz+ra ād+ma /du /dpral bar rdo rje rin chen ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya /mtshan ma/ dag ni spro bya zhing / /sems dpa' kun yang spro bar bya/ /badz+ra rat+na ⑥ ād+ma ga⑦ /rdo rje chos ni shin tu dag /sna yi rtse mor bsgom par bya/ /de yi mtshan ma spro bya zhing / /lus rnams kun yang spro bar bya/ /badz+ra pad+ma ād+ma ⑧ka /lus kun la ni yang dag khyab/ /chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su bsgomal/ /de yi mtshan ma spro bya zhing / /sems dpa' kun yang spro bar bya/ /sarba badz+ra 0ād+ma ⑫ka /sems dpa' de bzhin rin chen las/ /chos ni spyi bor bsgom par bya/ /de yi mtshan ma spro bya zhing / /sku ni thams cad yongs su spro/ /sarba badz+ra/ sna la lcags kyu yang dag gnas/ /blo ldan mi yis bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzhug bya ⑩zhing / /rang 0gi lus ni brtan par bya/ /snying ga ④'dod chags gnas su ni/ /'dod chags rnam par dag pa bsam sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes bya ste/ /chos kyi dbyings 8ni brtan par 'gyur/ /legs so zhes pa gzung bya ste/ /spyi bor yang dag gnas pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes bya zhing / /chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su spro/ /skṛ tsod badz+ra e ku ⑩sha /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rā ga ṣ+ṭṛ (shed ye ā di 47badz+ra dusbyi/ snying gar rdu )rdo rje 84—621

nyi ma ni/ /blo ldan mi yis bsgom par bya/ /'od kyi gzi brjid spro bya zhing / /'jig rten kun kyang spro bar bya/ /spyi bor 'khri ①shing 'od bcas pa/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /rin chen char dag spro bya zhing / /snod kyi sprin ni yang dag spro/ /bzhad pas bde ba bsams nas ni/ /shin tu sdug bsngal nges par sbyar(mi/ /chos kyi char yang spro bya zhing / /snang ba'i sprin yang spro bar bya / /skṛ tsho da ya badz+ra srur+ya tiṣ+ṭa badz+ra dh+wa dzā gre/ hro ④da ya badz+ra hā sa/ spyi bor rjes dran nas brtsams nas/ /ral gri gtso bo bsam (9par bya/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gcad (6)bya zhing / /sems dpa' thams cad spro bar bya/ /snying ga'i ⑦'khor lo'i gnas su ni/ /chos kyi rgyu mthun dubasgom par bya/ /nam mkha' kun du spro bya zhing / /chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su spro/ /de yi rigs las byung ba'i sgral/ /shes rab can gyis lce rtser bsam/ /chos kyi tshig ni spro bya zhing / /phyogs rnams kun du yongs su spro/ /hre 6)da badz+ra gho ga⑩/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra skṛ (nyud yaṃ/ pra be sha badz+ra wāk+ka'/ spyi bor rjes dran nas brtsams te/ /mchod pa'i las ni rnam par bsam/ /mchod pa'i phyir ni rdo rje spro/ /phyogs rnams kun du spro bar bya/ /snying gar /sterdo rje go cha ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bsam/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol byed pa/ /go cha'i rnam par mispro bar bya/ /spyi bo nas brtsams rkang mthil 7du/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bsam par bya/ /rdo rje'i snying po gzhug bya zhing / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin thams cad spro/ /tsotho (med badz+ra ka ba tse/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra yo badz+ra musbyi hre 19da yaṃ/ grogs dang grogs min ma lus pa/ /'byung po kun la byams pa ni/ /ma lus lus pa med pa ru/ /mnyam du khyab par spro bar bya/ /kye ma sems can 'di sdug bsngal/ /'gro ba lnga ru kun du 84—622

'khyamasal / /nyin dang mtshan du rab sbyor bas/ /snying rje nyid ni spro bar bya/ /nyin mtshan dge dang zhe sdang med/ /sems can dge ba don gnyer gang ②/ /rjes su yi yarang bde chen porjo/ /sems can kun la yongs su spro/ /rgal ①bar dka' ⑥ba'i lam zhugs shing / /sangs rgyas byang chub la gnas pa/ /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir/ /blo chen ldan pas btang snyoms bzhag /ma hā mi tri sā phyar ṇa/ ma hā kā (gyiru ṇi kā 6)ya s+pha ra ṇa0/ sarba bud dha pra mo da 7spa ra ṇa / ma 8ho pe k+ṣa s+pha ra ṇa(ste/ nam mkha' ci'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni ⑩rnam par bsam/ /sems can mnyam par dmigs pa yis /nam mkha' kun du yongs su spro/ /badz+ra musbyi ⑩bha ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /snying ga 0rdo rje chos nyid brtan/ /don rnams thams cad bsgom par bya / /chos kyi dbyings tunyeni yongs su spro/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran nas brtsams te / /rnam pa kun du sna tshogs nyid/ /de ni rang gi bdag nyid bsgom/ /chos kyi dbyings ni yongs su spro/ /rdo rje phra mo gzhan dang ldan/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam bsgom pa/ /myur du phyogs kun yongs su spro/ /snying gar yirdo rje bsgom bya zhing / /ma hā bo dhi satwa bi sha( )/ bud dha a nu smṛ ti bi 4)shwa4 /badz+ra pā ṇi so dar+sha ya/ sa rū khri dpe/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /sa man+ta bha dra bi shwazhen/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /bdag nyid rdo rje rnam par bsgom(9/ /badz+ra satwa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas paras / /rdo rje bsnyems sa pa rol bcas pa badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sa mā ( )dhi dzñā na ru nibi shwasaste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rang dunabadag nyid/ /ta thā ga ta sa mo haṃ/ dbang po 84—623

gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon dag gis ①bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /shes rab can gyis ②nges par bya/ /mnyam ③par bzhag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsam/ /ji bzhin mtshan gyis brgyan ④pa ru/ /rtag tu bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas de bzhin bdag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas rtag tu bsgom/ /sangs rgyas gang yin de bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas mang por yang dag gnas/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni yang dag brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas kun pyokhur mnyes par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta (snyes mo haṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /ji ltar sku mdog cho ga bzhin / /dbang po gnyis ni yang dag gnas/ /de bzhin bdag ni rtag tu bsgom / /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa mo haṃ/ bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa' mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni yang dag brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /nges par 'jig rten pham 6)par bya/ /khams kyi snying po gang yin dag /de ni rdul bral dri med dag /bdag ni rdo rje chos nyid du/ /rtag tu bsgom par bya ba yin / /badz+ra dharma sa (7mo haṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje chos dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni yang dag brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /rdo rje'i chos ni thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i las ni bdag nyid de/ /tha dad med cing rtags gcig gis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod de/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma sa mo haṃ/ bdag ni rdo rje las dang mtshungs//rdo rje'i tshig ni yang yang brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /rdo rje las dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /nga ni rdo rje rin chen nyid/ /sangs rgyas 84—624

kun gyi dbang bskur ①ba/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rin chen mtshungs par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na las mo haṃ/ bdag ni rdo rje rin chen mtshungs / /rdo rje'i tshig ni yang yang brjod/ /rdo rje rin chen sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur thob par 'gyur/ /gzugs gnyis 'brel pa ni dbang po gnyis zhes bya'o/ /bdag gi ③lus gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dusku gang yin pa gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa ni dbang po gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa zhes bya'o⑤/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /rdo rje gcig tu mos byas shing —/ /sangs rgyas gzugs dang mtshungs pa ru/ /dbus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /nam mkha' la ni rdo rje bsgom/ /rdo rje gcig ni yongs gsal yib/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyisal/ /dbus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /rdo rje gcig ni yongs gsal bsani/ /rdo rje rin chen ting 'dzin gyis6)/ /dbus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /ci nus par ni byin gyis brlabakyi/ /rdo rje gcig ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje chos kyi ⑩ting 'dzin gyis/ rtag tu bdag ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom bya zhing / /rin chen bdag nyid dbus su bsgom/ /kun du rdo rje'i dbus su ni/ /rtag tu bdag nyid las su bsgom/ /gtso bo gang dang gtso dag gisal/ /sku mdog 8cha byad ji bzhin du/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bsgom par bya /sems can dam pa de nyid thob/ /bdag gtso tunyerdo rje'i tshig brjod cing / /rdo rje'i thugs su bsam par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur/ /yang ni yibasgom pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /rang dbang du ni rab bshad bya/ /ji ltar yid las byung ba bzhin/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 84—625

rnam par bsgom/ /sna yi rtse mo la brten nas/ /sems kyi rgyun ni yang dag gnas / /brgya las rtsa bdun lhag par ni/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /gal te bsgoms 6)pas dngos grub 'dod/ /rdo rje bsgom pa bsgrub par bya/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran sbyor ba yis/ /sgrub ②pa'i rnal 'byor yang dag gnas/ /sems dpa' rjes dran sbyor ba yis/ /gdon mi za bar nges par bya/ /gang dang gang la 'dod pa nyid/ /bdag nyid rdo rjer bsgom par bya/ /sku mdog rnal 'byor ji bzhin du/ /ci rigs par ni sna tshogs bdag /yang na rdo rje bsgom gtso bo/ /sgrub ①pa yang ni bsgom par bya/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar ④rnam 'phrul 'khor lo byung / /e ma'o ngo mtshar spyod mchog dam pa bsgrub⑤/ /kye ma'o ngo mtshar gsang mchog gnas thob pa/ /bdag ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i sgrub pa ste/ /rnal 'byor rig pa sgrub byed pa / /mchod pa bsgrub ⑥pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /de nas mchod pa rab bshad bya/ /thun bzhi dang ni kha dog bzhi/ /dus bzhi yi ni rab sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rjod 97)byed cing / /sangs rgyas la ni mchod par bya/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs spros (8)shing / /mchod pa rnams ni yongs spro zhing / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub 6)pas/ /rtag tu yang dag rnal 'byor bsgom/ /mchod la spro ba yang dag sbyor/ /zhes bya chos ni yongs su spro/ /ting 'dzin sbyor ba la gnas te / /chos kyi mchod pa rab tu bya/ /o sarba (1ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa a nut+ta 12ra pū dzā kyi spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje yi ni gsang sngags 'di/ /yang dang yang du rab tu bzlas/ /rdo rje dbyings ni sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya lnga ni rab tu bya / /so sor rtogs dang mngon rtogs dang / /rdo rje de bzhin rdo rje bdag /84—626

rgyas par ①ru ni sngar bshad pa/ /rdo rje dbyings ni rab tu bskyedaphyi/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ma lus pa/ /rang gi bdag nyid bsgoms nas su/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis/ /thub pa dbang phyug dag la dbul/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis / /thub la mchod pa phul nas ni/ /bdag ni mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /bdag gis ༷khams ni rnam par spros/ /byang chub sems ni spros nas su/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug dag la dbul/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu bsgrubasti/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa/a nut+ta dur pū dzā ⑦smra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad dbang bskur ba//rdo rje rin chen spros nas ni/ /bdag ni mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /bdag gis khyakhams ni rnam par spros/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug dag la dbul/ /rin chen mchod pa rab spro zhing / /bsdams pa'i sbyor ba rab tu bsgrub6)/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a nut+ta tsor pū dzā (skyes+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ snga ma ji lta ba bzhin du/ /rnam par snang mdzad ting 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar sems dpa' phyung ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag ni bsgom par bya/ /rang bdag nyid ni bsgoms yinas su/ /rmad 'byung tsochen po yongs spro zhing / /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur / /de lta bu la snyoms zhugs te④/ /rdo rje chos ni rab tu byung / /phyogs rnams kun du spro bya zhing / / sangs rgyas rnams tsol dbul bar byayi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma a nut+ta 5 ra pu dzā tunyespa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ ting 'dzin sbyor ba la gnas te/ /rdo rje las rnams spro nas ni(khe/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bya zhing / /thams cad du ni spro bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kurma a nut+ta so )ra 84—627

pu dz+dza yasga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ mchod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /thun ②bzhi ru ni bsgom par bya/ /mchod pa'i cho gas 'grub 'gyur te/ /sdig pa can yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchod pa'i las ni bla na med/ /ci rigs par ni rab bshad bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgyal por ldan/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba ād+ma ③nir+sā lita na pū dzā duspa ra ṇa kurma badz+re a/rdo rje sems dpa' rang bdag nyid/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid yang dang yang du ni/ /sangs rgyas kun khyil dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba ād+ma ⑦nir+sā nisto na pū dzā ⑨smra ra ṇa kurmā gre 7dza/ rdo rje lcags kyu rang bdag nyid/ /phyogs kun du ni spro bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgug bya zhing / /thub pa dag la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba āt+pa ⑪nir+sā 7ta na yis nu rā ga pu dzā ④spa ra ṇa kurma bā ṇi hūṃ ho8/ rdo rje'i rigs ni rjes chags par⑩/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /chos rnams dag la mnyes byas shing / /'di brjod nas ni spro bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba āt+pa 7nir+sā (snyeta na sā 4)tho kā ( ster pū dzā (7spa ra ṇa kurma tuṣ+ṭi du)rma0/ rdo rje rin chen rnal 'byor che/ /bdag nyid yongs su bsgom par bya/ /rin chen mchod pa bla na med/ /phyogs rnams kun du spro bar bya/ /oṃ na maḥ( stesarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi zho ge'i ka rasne lispyo badz+ra 9 snam ṇi ( )o/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal po che/ /byang chub snying por dbang bskur ba/ /sems kyang de ltar bsams (7nas ni/ /rdo rje rin chen nyid thob 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rdo rje gzi brjid ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du snang byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskul (3 bya zhing / /mchod pa gzi brjid yongs su spro/ /oṃ (1sarba ta thā ga ta srur+ya bh+yo/ badz+ra te (nyadzo ni dzā 6)84—628

la hrīḥ/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan kun du mthong / /shes rab can gyis rgyal mtshan bsgreng ①/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod bya zhing / /rdo rje'i sngags kyis ②bskul bar bya/ /oṃ na maḥdusarba ta thā ga ta ā shā dupa ri pū ra ṇi/ tsin+ta rjom ṇi dh+wa 0dza a gre gtsā/ grags chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dkyil 'khor shes rab can gyis bltani/ /rtag tu bdag nyid dga' bya zhing / /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bskul bya/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sdi ⑨ti pra mo bya byaka re bh+yo badz+ra hā se hāyi/ sems can thams cad chos chen po/ /bdag ni 8chos chen dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bskul tsobya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid kun/ /dkyil 'khor grong khyer thams cad gdabatso/ /shes rab can gyis 8bdag nyid bsam/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis tsorab bskul ⑩bya/ /oṃ tsosarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma sa mā dhi bhi stu yino mi ma hā dharma a gre pya hrīḥ/ bdag ni shes rab ral gri rno/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo'i yi ge rab tu bskor0/ /mdo sde thams cad 'dzin pa yin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradzñā tsopā ra mi tā duni ra ha re chatu no tsomi ma hā gho ṣa ⑦nu ge snyetso/ sems can dag phy-ini kun gyi tshig /bdag ni sems dpa' smra ba brtan⑥/ /rdo rje smra ba gsang ba'i bdag /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarnyi bhā ṣa bud gu dha saṃ gī 0ti bhirga ya du)stu no mi badz+ra wā 0tse baṃ/ bdag ni chos kyi 'khor lo skor(ste/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sbyin byed ⑥pa/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo yongs su bsngo/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spro bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ak+ṣa ra pa ri ba'i dha na sarba mu ṭ+wāṃ te na ya tsos no mi sarba maṇ+ḍa ()le rgyu⑥/ bdag ni rdo rje las rgyal po/ /phyogs rnams kun du rab mchod byed/ /me tog bdug 84—629

pa la sogs dri/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis bskul bar bya/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta dhū ①pa me ②lha s+pha ra ṇa pū dzā nikarma ka ra ka ra④/ cho ga bgos pa dang ldan pa/ /me tog mchod pa 'bul byed pa/ /bdag nyid rang nyid rgyal po stephyi/ /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bskul dubya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ⑦phub nipra sa ra s+pha ra ṇa ṇipu dzā ⑩ garme ki ri ki ri(7/ bdag ni rdo rje gnod sbyin te/ /nyon mongs za byed chos sgron 'bar8/ /phyogs rnams kun du spro bya zhing / /snang ba 'bar ba yang dag spro / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā 8lo ka ④〈 la s+pha ra ṇa ⑩phu dzā ⑨karme ⑩bha ra bha ra/rdo rje khu tshur yang dag nyid/ /dri yi snod dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs rnams kun du spro bya zhing / /char rnams kun gyis (nyerab mchod byed/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta garnya yishes mu dra ( )sga ra ṇa (15 dzā ( nyekarma ku ru ku ru/ sems can kun don yang dag ldan/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas kyang / /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /mchod pa mchog ni rab bsgrub 3pa/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ād+ma phyi nir+sā ta ( 2na pū dzā 8 me ghas mu dra ( )spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ shes rab can gyis ( nyedakyil 'khor bri/ /yan lag kun gyis rab btud bya/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bya zhing / /phyogs rnams kun du spro bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nir+sā ta rten pū dzā nyame gha sa mu dra 6)sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas geni/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pas/ /rdo rje las rnams byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje yi ni glu 'di yis/ /rang bdag nyid ni dga' bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bya zhing / /rdo rje'i sngags kyang rab brjod bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bā ka nir+sā sa ta na pū dzā 8steme gha sa mu dra pu spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ phyogs rnams kun du mchod pa kun/ /mkhas pa yis ni 84—630

bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bya zhing / /rdo rje'i sngags ni rab bskul bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā 6)ga ta tsit+ta nir+sā (mita na pū dzā ①me gha sa mu dra ④spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ phul nas shes rab can ⑤gyis ni/ /rdo rje btsun yimo'i ting 'dzin bsam / /rdzas mchog ldan pas spro bya zhing / /sangs rgyas kun la yongs su dbul / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ⑦ra har+sha (kyer ti t+pā po)ti su kha a nut+ta dhir pradzñā pū dzā (spreme gha sa mu dra 8spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches/ /bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kun bsdus pa/ /shes rab can gyis dkyil 'khor bsam/ /mchod pa'i tshogs ni bla med pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /tshe dang mdog dang nad med nyid/ /phun tshogs bde ba tsho thams cad 'thob/ /sdig pa thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gang zhig gis/ /nyin re bzhin du mchod byas nayi/ /the tshom 8med par dngos grub kun/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis ⑩bslab pa dang / /phyag rgya thams cad bsam par bya/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus las/ /phyag rgya shin tu rgyas par bshad/ /rdo rje las kyi go rims (lhebazhin/ /shes rab can gyis dkyil 'khor bslab/ /rdo rje dbyings dang rab mtshungs pa/ /slar yang rnal 'byor pa la bshad/ /'jig rten mgon po rdzu 'phrul che/ /rtag tu de bzhin mchod bya ba / /gsang mchog rnal 'byor pa dag a/ /de las gzhan yang rab bshad bya / /gang tshe sngon du sems bskyed pa/ /rdo rje sems ni bla na med/ /byang chub sems ni brtan bskyed nas/ /mchod pa'i bya ba bslab par bya/ /rdo rje 84—631

slob ①dpon gyis sbyor ba/ /rdo rje dga' ba bsam par bya/ /'dod chags dga' ba bskyed nas ni/ /dga' ba'i mchod pa rab tu mchod/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas bsgom bya zhing / /bsgoms nas mchod pa rab tu bya/ /dga' ba chen po'i bde don du/ /rig pa'i lha mo rab 'brel ②pas/ /bud dha la.ād+ma rjo ko rtaphyi/ byang chub sems ni rab bskyed nas/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas zhes bsam bya/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs sogs rnams kyis⑥/ /rang bdag nyid ni dbang bskur bya/ /bud dha a bhi ṣiñtsa ⑦mi/ byang chub sems ni rab bskyed nas / /bdag ni sangs rgyas zhes bsam bya/ /rdo rje yi ni glu blang phyizhing / /bdag nyid mngon par mchod par bya/ /bud dha sidhi ka ro 7mi/ byang chub sems ni brtan bskyed yinas/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas zhes bsam bya/ /rdo rje gar gyis tunyegar bya zhing / /mkhas pas ⑩bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /bud dha pu dzā8—/ sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje mchog /sbyor bas de bzhin phyag byas shing / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byas nas/ /nges par phyag ni byas par 'gyur/ / pra ṇa mā 8mi/ rdo rje sku gsung thugs las byung / /sangs rgyas bsod nams chen po kun/ /rjes su yi rang mchog bdag gis/ /myur du sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /a nu mo de/ bdag nyid dbul ba la sogs pa/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /mchod pa kun gyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /mchod pa'i bdag nyid can gyis 7mchod/ /bud dha pū dzā8/ rdo rje sku gsung thugs las ⑩byung ske/ /dge ba'i tshogs ni thams cad kun/ /yongs su bsngo tsoba'i mchod pa yis / /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /pa ri ṇa maḥ(nye/ chos kyi dbyings ni snying po che/ /'dod pa'i 'dam gyis gu ma gos pa/ /gzod yinas 84—632

dag pas skye ba med/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho pad+ma mtshungs/ /sarba shud dhatshi/chos rnams thams cad ma skyes pa/ /gzod ②nas zhi zhing gos pa med/ /blo ⑧bur dri mas gos pa med/ /yi ge a yis rnam par sbyangs/ /sa man+ta bha dra/ e ma'o 'khor lo bde rang bzhin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /chos rnams thams cad nyid kyi 0ni/ /'dir ni de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu/ /dharma ⑤tsakra/sgra brnyan dang ni mtshungs pa'i sgra/ /med ⑥de gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin du/ /bdag ces bya ba 'ga' yang med/ /nis pra pañtsag / sngon du blo dang ldan pas bsamadu/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom bya zhing / /de 'og rdo rje sna tshogs brjod/ /de nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i/ /rang gi lus ni phra rab dag⑨ /rdo rje'i gzugs su bsgom bya zhing / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya badz+ra kā ⑩ya/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i/ /yan lag rnam pa ji snyed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom bya zhing / /thams cad yongs su spro bar bya/ / dharma kā ⑩ya/ rang gi lus la gnas pa yi8/ /phra rab rdul ni ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /don yod mchod pas rab mchod bya/ /satwa kā ya/ de bzhin lus ni thams cad kyi/ /rang gi phra rab rdul rnams ni/ /kun du bkod 'o pa'i bsgom byas te/ /de ni sangs rgyas mchod par bshad/ /bud dha kā ya/ sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su mnyes/ /byang chub sems dpa' slob gang yin/ /shes rab can gyis mchog gsang bslab/ /sangs rgyas sa ni thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /lus rnams thams cad yongs su bsdams/ /yan lag kun la chags pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang 84—633

bcas pa yis/ /lus kun la ni yongs su chags/ /bde ba'i mchod pa rang byung ba/ /e ma'o rjes su chags mchod bdag /rdo rje'i tshig ni brjod par bya/ /e ma'o yid 'ong e ma'o sdug/e ma'o dga' ba rab tu mdzes/ /chos kyi 6)chags pa 'dod chags che/ /gang la rab dga' chags 'gyur ba/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med pa/ /stong pa 'dod chags brjod par bya/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spang bya zhing / /sems can yang ni dor mi bya/ /sred pa dang ni chags dang spyod/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam par spang / /ming dang gzugs ②ni shes bya zhing ①/ /mtshan nyid gsum ni rtogs par bya/ /theg chen bde ba zhes bya ba//'dod chags chags par rab brjod par/ /lta ba thams cad mi gzung zhing / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnam par spang / /rtog dang rnam par rtog pa med/ /sdug bsngal thams cad nges par gcod/ /phung po dang ni skye mched khams/ /rtog pa rdul tsam khuyod ma yin/ /de la 'dus byas yod ma yin/ /'dus byas min pa nyid kyang med/ /skyes pa bud med dag nyid med/ /bdag dang sems can rnam rtog med/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs spangs/ /de lta bu yi chags pa yis/ /gang du rdo rje can chags 'gyur / /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes chags bya/ /kha ⑤yi 'o ni mchog khyadag pa/ /gsang ba'i (7sbyor bas rab bsgrub bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa/ rjes su chags pa'i cho ga bstan/ /dpung pa dam por bsdam bya zhing / /'dod chags chags par bstan pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab 'grub 'gyur/ /chags pa lnga (kyelas rnam grol bas/ /'dod la chags par mi bya zhing 9tsho/ /blo ldan cho gas yidaga' ba yis/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub 84—634

par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga yis/ /gsang ba thams cad rab bstan bya/ /zhi ba thams cad mnyes bya zhing / /rdo rje sems sogs mnyes par bya / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ /rdo rje can dang dga' chen po/ /'dod chags chen po 'di lta bus/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /o sarba rā ga ra ti su kha yā 6)mi hūṃ/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa mchog /gang zhig byas nas gsang ba kun/ /brtags nas 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /lhag par shes rab can gyis ②bslab/ /mtshan ma brtan por rang ①'grub nas/ /pad+ma'i lte bar 'dug bya zhing / /mtshan ma mchod rten byin brlabs nas/ /rang bdag rdo rje mtshungs pa nyid/ /mdo sde gsang dbang rgyal po las/ /de yis shin tu gsang tshig gsungs/ /de ni dgongs pas gsungs pa ste/ /de ni dgongs par shes par bya/ /mtshan ma phyag mtshan zhes byar brjod/ /brtan pa lhag pa nyid yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i phyag mtshan gang / /mkhas pas lhag par bcang bar bya/ /pha rol phyin pa drug spyod pa/ /de yi mtshan mar rab tu bsgrags/ /gang phyir lhag par bstan ④par bya/ /blo ldan rnams kyi rigs 'byung 'dod/ /mtshan ma brtan par rang gyur pa/ /de dag kho nar rab tu bsgrags / /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs su brjod par bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /rdo rje mtshan mar 'di brjod (pebya/ /byang chub sems kyi (6)rab sbyor bas/ /mtshan ma brtan por brjod par bya/ /pad+ma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /pad+ma'i lte bar 'dug bya ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /rnal 'byor yang yang snyoms 'jug bya/ /bha ga ling ga'i sbyor ba ni/ /yang dang yang du bsten byas nas/ /g.yo dang nyes pa rnam (7naspangs par/ /gdon mi za 84—635

bar yang dag byung / /shes rab dang ni byang chub sems/ /yang dang yang du bsten byas nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub gdon mi za bar 'gyur/ /bsgrub byar gyur pa'i chos 'di ni/ /lus can kun gyis rnyed par dka'/ /byang chub sems dad shes rab che/ /mchod rten mtshan ma'i rjes chags bya/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'di bsgom dang / /'di lta bu yi sgrub ①pa dang ske/ / spyod pa ②gsang ba 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba nyid ①thob 'gyur/ /gsang ba dgongs pas bsdus pa yi༅/ /mdo (nyalas rgya cher ji skad gsungs/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje gsang dbang bsdus pa yi(nya/ /sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /gsang ba chen po bsgrubs ⑦na ni/ /skad cig de la rab 'grub 'gyur/ /kha cig nyin zhag de nyid la/ /yang dang yang du 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gnyis gsum bzhi lnga'am/ /drug dang bdun la the tshom med/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang / /ci rigs (7pa yi cho ga yis/ /lo gcig tu ni rab sbyor bas/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //gsang ba yi ni dkyil 'khor mchog /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga ni/ /ji ltar rigs shing 'tsham pa ru/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya6)/ /mdor na rig pa'i brtul 7zhugs ni/ /gong du dkyil 'khor las bshad bzhin/ /ci ltar spro zhing ci nus par/ /sngon du mkhas pas bshad par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal ba che/ /rgyal po tsho1kun du khyab pa'i 'od/ /the tshom med par stong phrag brgya//rtag tu rdo rje'i tshig brjod bya/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje goms bya ste/ /rdo rje rnal 84—636

'byor goms byas te6)/ /chos rnams ②dag pa goms par bya/ /goms pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs rab spong nyon mongs bzlog par bya/ /rnal 'byor goms pa yis ni rnal 'byor bsgrub / /bzlas pa tsam gyis dga' chen 'grub 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor cho gas bsgrub pa 'grub ④par 'gyur/ /yang na bzlas pa tsam nyid ni/ /bzlas pa mchog gis ⑤bzlas pa ⑥bya/ /rnal 'byor rig pa bsgrub ⑦pa'i phyir/ /dngos grub cho gas bzlas par bya/ /de ni rnal 'byor cho ga yis/ /skad cig sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor cho ga ⑧med par nidhi/ /'grub min 'di la the tshom med/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi0/ /gsang ba bzhi ni yang dag bshad/ /gsang ba chen po tshad med pa/ /bzhi po thams cad bsdus pa yin/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg cho ga dang glu/ /phyag rgya bcing ba lhur len pa/ /rig pa'i mchog gi cho ga ni/ /gsang ba bsdus pa dang po yin/ /gsang dang skem byed phur pas btab/ /brdeg ⑩pa dang ni mngon spyod dang / /bgegs bskrad pa yi 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /gsang ba'i bsdus 7pa gnyis pa yin/ /go cha mi 'gyur bcing ba dang / /spyod tu dang de bzhin rab bskyod tsodang / /bdag nyid mngon par bsrung 8nyid dang / /bgegs rnams bsal yibar bya ba dang / /rdzas 'phrog pa dang gzhom pa dang / /gdug pa thams cad mngon bsrung 5 ba/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba bsdus pa gsum pa yin/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas (nyamachod pa dang / /de bzhin rig pa'i dngos grub nyid/ /bgegs rnams bsod nams nye bar bsdu//gsang ba bzhi par 'dod pa yin/ /gsang ba bzhi po thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin ()rdzu 'phrul kun bsdus pa/ /gsang ba mchog gi rgyud chen po/ /rgyud de 84—637

las ni rab tu bshad/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /de ni rgyud mchog las bshad bya/ /gang phyir rig pa 'dzin kun gyi②/ / bzlas brjod ②sbyin sreg bsgrub ②par bya/ /bzlas brjod sbyor ba med par ni/ /rig pa'i dngos grub ④'byung mi 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg tsam ni med pa ru/ /rig pa'i bya ba byed mi 'gyur / /gang gis ⑤rnal 'byor brtson 'gyur bayi/ /bzlas pa'i rim pa bshad bya ba/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po 'di ni gsang mchog yinaske/ /gsang ba'i rigs 'dir bzlas pa ni/ /rnal 'byor nyi shu yang dag byung —/ /bzlas pa rnam pa nyi shu ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud du nyi shu gcig /gnas ngan len (7gyi bag chags rtogs/ /rtog pa bag chags zhes bya ste/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis (guthim 'gyur te/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis brjod par bya/ /nyes pa byas pa spong ba dang / /de bzhin srid pa sbyong 6)byed cing / /rmad byung kyisna tshogs mthong 'gyur te/ /de bas bzlas pa (1brjod par bya/ /byang chub spyod pa 'byung 'gyur zhing / /tshul mchog mthong bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de bas bzlas pa'i cho ga ni / /rnal 'byor pas ⑩ni nges par bya/ /gsang ba chen po'i rgyud 'di ru/ /hūm̐ ni dang por khorab tu bsgrags/ /gsang ba thams cad yang dag 'byung / /hūṃ gis 77bzlas pa brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tsogatso bo ni/ /de bzhin yi ge hūṃ rab mchog /gsang ba thams cad 'khor lor bcas/ /rigs lnga dag dang bcas pa 'byung / /'dir ni yi ge tsū 'byung bar/ /sngon la shes rab can gyis brtagatsha /lce sogs thams cad khong stong du/ /lus kun la ni brtag par byam/ /sbyor ba bcu las 'byung mi 'gyur/ /so las rnam pa kun du min/ /lce dang rtsa ba las kyang min/ /rkan 7las rnam pa kun du min/ /gnas gang las 84—638

ni sbyor ba 'byung / /snying ga ①nyid las 'byung mi 'gyur/ /khong stong dngos po thams cad la/ / skye ba ②nyid ni snang mi 'gyur/ /yi ge hūṃ gi ⑧sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi dbyings la yang dag sbyar④/ /de nyid nyon mongs can mi 'gyur/ /kun gzhi sa bon thams cad pa/ /rkan ⑤dang lkog ma'i 'bad pa dang / /lce yi tshogs las yang dag 'byung / /yi ge hūm̐ gi sgra byung dub/ /de ni mi rtog yang dag byung / /de ltar 'byung ba'i sbyar ⑦ba las/ /gnas kyi nyon mongs can mi 'gyur / /tshig dang bcas pa'i ji bzhin sgra/ /'dus byas thams cad dor bar bya / /ji bzhin rtsu gi sbyor ba las/ /chos rnams thams cad skye ba med/ /rnam par rtog las yang dag byung / /de ni mi rtog yang dag 'byung (mi/ /'khor ba dag po)gi thog ma ni/ /ji ltar yang ni shes mi 'gyur/ /'dir ni skye ba mi snang zhing ske/ /'dus byas dag ni 'jig pa min/ /de bas yi ge hūm̐ tsam gyis/ /'dus byas so sor brtag par bya/ /dag cing mthar thug gnas nyid ⑩ni/ /hūm̐ gis kyang ni sbyar bar bya/ /rang bzhin med pa'i sgra 'di ni/ /yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung (nya/ /'di la dngos po yod ma yin/ /rang bzhin med cing bdag med pa/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin nyid ni yod ma yin/ /bdag gam sems can gso ba med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spang 4)/ /zag pa med cing 'dus byas min/ /gnas ni dag pa brtan tu par bya/ /dngos grub sbyor ba'i ye shes kyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni yang dag 'byung ski/ /ye shes dag pa yang dag 'byung ski/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis brtan par bya/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po yang / /'dir ni nye bar mi dmigs te/ /gang 84—639

phyir dus gsum gshegs snying po/ /sangs rgyas snying po tshogs su bshad/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang / /rdo rje can ni ①rgyal sras bcas/ /hūṃ tsam gyi ②ni sbyor ba yis/ /kun du yang dag dgug par bya/ /yi ge ①spyor ba gcig gis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po brtan④/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /'di ni rang gi sbyor bas gnas/ /chos kyi rgyu mthun rjobag chags ni/ /byang chub sems ni ma rtogs par/ /thog ma med ldan du'akhor ba las/ /'byung ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /byang chub kyi ni sems med par/ /'gas ④kyang mya ngan 'da' mi nus/ /gal te sangs rgyas 'byung med na/ /nyan thos dag ni ga las byung ⑧/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba yod min na/ /rang rgyal de ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' med/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gang las 'byung ⑨/ /gal te byang chub sems med na/ /de bas 'khor lo 'di kun ni/ /byang chub sems las yang dag byung / /byang sems gsang ba chen po ni/ /yi ge rgyu las yang dag byung / /sangs rgyas thams cad rab 'byung ba/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi snang bar 'gyur / /gang phyir mtshan ldan gzugs can ni/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rab 'byung ba/ /hūm̐ yig gi tini sbyor ba hūm̐/ /de nyid rdo rje yang dag byung / /chos dbyings rab sbyor rdo rje ni/ /de las yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bla na med/ the tshom med par rnal 'byor kun/ /yi ge hūṃ gi sbyor bas 'grub/ /de lta bu yi bzlas pa yis ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /sngon ni bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor las byas dge ba bsngo(7/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yis ni/ /rang gi sems 84—640

kyang bsngo ①bar bya/ /rdo rje chen po mthar phyin byed/ /byang chub sems kyis ②bsgral bar bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po che/ /sems can thams cad gos pa med/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /nyon mongs 'dam gyis ①gos pa med/ /ji ltar zla ba bzhin du dag /zla ba gang ba'i 'od gsal ba/ /rtag tu yang dag rdzogs par gnas/ /rab tu dang ba du'agrub par 'gyur/ /'di ni dang po chos ye shes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin/ /rtag tu dag par gnas pa ste/ /rang gi nyon mongs dag gis bsgribs/ /de bas rang sems rnam pa ni/ /zla ba gang bar shes par bya/ /bdag ni 'ga' ⑤yang yod ma yin/ /chos nyid 'di ni rgyal bas shes/ /ye shes zla ⑥ba gang ba min/ /gang phyir bdag ni yod ma yin/ /zla ba gang ba dang mtshungs rigs/ /gang phyir dag cing gos pa med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes skyon med pa/ /zla ba'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /mthong nas shes rab can gyis ⑦bsam/ /'di yang gang gis rtogs par 'gyur/ /yun ring dus su sdug bsngal ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /nyon mongs pa yi bag chags kun/ /de bzhin sbyong nibar byed par bsam/ /byang chub sems ni sems chen po/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms byed pa/ /chos kyi rgyu mthun 6)bag chags kyi/ /gnyen po ru ni byung ba yi0/ /de bas 'di yi mthu yis ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rnam par spyod7/ /gnas ngan len ni bag chags bcas/ /'dod pa'i 'dam gyis 7gos pa med/ /nyi ma lta bu'i sems chen po/ /nyon mongs rtsa ni rab sreg byed / /zla ba lta bu'i sems chen po/ /dge ba'i sman ni rnam 'phel byed/ /sos ku'i tsha ba'i zla ba bzhin/ /nyi ma'i gdung ba rab sreg byed/ /shar bar 84—641

gyur pas zhi bar byed/ / gdung ba thams cad zhi bar byed/ /②nyon mongs gdung bas ma gdungs shing / /mi shes pa la nyi ma nyid/ /byang chub sems ni zla ba chel/ /nyon mongs gdung ba zhi byed par / /kun nas nyon mongs bag chags bcas/ /gnas ngan len ni 'joms pa'i mchog /khab len gyis ④ni lcags bzhin du/ /nyon mongs bag chags 'dren ⑤byed pa/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor pas/ /byang chub sems de bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas de ru/ /slar yang zla ba rnam par bsgom/ /byang chub sems kyi mthu 6)yis ni/ /bag chags thams cad sreg byed pa/ /ye shes de ru 'byung ⑦'gyur te/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog mtshungs med pa/ /bdag med de bzhin stong pa nyid/ /mi shes ri bo 'joms par byed//rdo rje dang mtshungs khong stong med/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin snying po che/ /'jig (nyatshogs ri bo brtan pa ni/ /rdo rje des ni 'joms par byed/ /de phyir rdo rje'i rang bzhin bstanalho)/ /de bas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zla ba'i dbus su zla ba mtshungasatshi/ /zla ba gnyis dbus rdo rje yis67/ /rdo rje'i ye shes brtan par bya / /stong nyid de bzhin nyid de nyid/ /yang dag mtha' dang 'dus ma byas/ /skye ba med cing 'gag pa med/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni bsgom par bshad/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan pa mchog /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa ni/ /zla ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ gi sbyor ba de yis ni/ /rdo rje'i mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /lus kun la ni spro bya zhing / /stong pa nyid dang mtshungs par sprosal/ /gzugs 'di nyid ni ming tsam ste/ /dngos po 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /cha shas kyis kyi ni rnam dpyad na/ /gzugs zhes bya ba yod ma yin/ /'de dag 84wa 642

phra rab rnam brtags kyang / /phra rab zhes bya yod ma yin/ /'jig rten kun rdzob ces bya ste/ /dam pa'i don du yod ma yin/ /de lta bu yi rang bzhin du/ /gzugs zhes bya ba yod ma yin/ /gzugs de yod pa ma yin na/ /ji ltar yod ces bya ba yin/ /gal te gzugs de yod min na/ /ming yang de la yod ma yin / /ming ni gang las yang dag byung / /ming zhes bya ba ci 'dra bar①/ /dngos zhes bya ba de dang mtshungs/ /ming des so sor brtags byas na/ /gnas gang zhig na rab tu gnas/ /dngos po gcig ni rnam phye na/ /ming ni mang po yang dag byung / /re re yi ni dbye ba yis/ /sngar gyi ming ni nyams par 'gyur / /de la ming ni yod min pa/ /ming ni yang dag 'byung ba med/ /gang la ming ni yod min na/ /ji ltar ming du brjod par bya/ /gang gis ming ni rab gnas pa/ /rnam pa kun du dmigs mi 'gyur/ /gzugs ni nye bar mi dmigs la/ /de la gzugs ni ji ltar yod/ /'di ni yang dag mi ①rtog pa/ /bag chags dag gis kun nas dkris/ /gang du byis pa rab rmongs shing / /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar gzugs ni rnam bsgom pa/ /de bzhin tshor dang 'du shes dang / /so so ji ru ni rnam phye lan/ /de la snying po dmigs mi 'gyural/ /gang la snying po yod min pa/ /de la dngos po ji ltar yod/ /gang la dngos po mi dmigs pa/ /dam pa'i don ni ji ltar yod/ /gang zhig (debastan par mi dmigs pa/ /de ni yod min dngos por med/ /chos rnams thams cad med pas na/ /skye ba med par brjod par bya/ /gang zhig ma skyes de yod min / /gang zhig yod min ji ltar yod/ /mkhas pas chos rnams thams cad ni(7 / /'gag pa med ces bya bar parabarjod/ /skye ba med cing 'gag pa med/ /84—643

de ni gzod ①nas zhi bar 'dod/ /de phyir rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /'di ni stong pa nyid du brjod/ /'di ni yang dag de nyid che/ /yang dag mtha' ru brjod par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings ni snying po che/ /theg pa chen por brjod par byam/ /de ni snying po khong stong med/ /rdo rje'i bstan ②pa bla na med/ /lus kun la ni spro bya ste/ /bdag gi ①lus ni 'di lta bu/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid ces bya gang —/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni yongs su spro/ /bsgom pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i chos ni skye ba med/ /'dir yang 'byung ba snang ba med/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /skye bar yang ni snang mi 'gyur / /chos nyid dag pa bden pa gang / /yang dag mtha' ni zag pa med/ /chos dbyings brtan ④pa dam pa ni/ /yi ge hūṃ du 'dir rab bsgrags/ /rdo rje yi ge hūṃ de nyid/ /chos dbyings stug po bstan pa yin/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /rdo rje gang yin de nyid hūm̐/ /chos nyid dag pa 'di lta bu/ /rdo rje ye shes yid 'ong ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che/ /rdo rje bdag gi lag na gnas / /de bas rdo rje can kun gyi/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor thams cad dang //yi ge hūm̐ la sbyor ba yis/ /spros med rnal 'byor bsam par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /snying ga'i (5)dbus su bsgom par bya/ /zla ba de la zla ba gnyis / /dbus su zla ba rab bsgom bya/ /zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dbus su yi ge hūm̐/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgom bya/ /de lta (6)bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /lus kun rab tu bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bzlas pa yis/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid myur du thob/ /hūṃ rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad bsgom pa rdzogs so// //84—644
