hūm̐ gi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /yi ge thams cad rnam par bsgom/ /sems dpa' chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge bcu drug dag pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yi ge hūṃ/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas rigs byung ba/ /rdo rje can dag kun gyi hūm̐/ /drag po gcod kun rab tu bsgom/ /oṃ ni rin chen yang dag ldan/ /trī ①ni pad+mar yang dag ldan/ /yi ge a ni sna tshogs brjod/ /de lta bur yang bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ ni sangs rgyas rdo rje dag /ṭ+wāṃ ②ni rdo rje snying po ste/ /yi ge hrīḥnini rdo rje bstan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje yi ge a/ /hūm̐ ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ / rdo rje rgyal po yi ge dza/ /༷ho ni rdo rje chags pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa yi ge sa/ /oṃ ni rdo rje rin chen te/ /rdo rje gzi brjid yi ge a/ /ṭ+wāṃ ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan te / /rdo rje bzhad ⑤pa yi ge hasti/ /yi ge hrīḥni rdo rje spyan/ /rdo rje rnon po yi ge dhe / /oṃ ⑦ni rdo rje 'khor lo ste/ /rdo rje smra ba yi ge sa/ /yi ge kai ⑧ni rdo rje las / /rdo rje bsrung ⑨ba yi ge rta7/ /rtsu ni rdo rje gnod sbyin te0/ /rdo rje khu tshur yi ge bam̐/ /gang dang gang la 'dod pa nyid/ /snying gar 8de bzhin bsgom par bya/ /yi ge rgyu ni rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa yis/ /gzugs gcig rnam par spro bar bya/ /yi ge hūm̐ bzlas tsam gyis (nyeni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rang 8bdag nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i gzugs su ste/ /rdo rje gcig ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje'i dbus kyi lte bar ni/ /de ru yi ge hūṃ bsgom bya/ /theg pa chen po mngon 8par bsdus/ /ji bzhin mdo yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /ji bzhin rgyal po skyes bur bcas/ /yi 84—645

ge phyu ni dang por bcasatunye/ /de bzhin yid kun rnal 'byor pas/ /snying ga ①ru ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i gzugs su ste/ /dbus su yi ge rtsu bsgom bya/ /de bzhin yi ge thams cad kyang / /rnal 'byor pas ni snying gar ①bsgom / /zla ba'i gzugs las yang dag gnas/ /bdag nyid yongs su bsgom bya zhing / /rigs kyi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rang bdag nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gang 'ga' zhig /gang dang gang zhig mngon 'dod pa/ /rigs (7pa de ni snying gar 'a)bsgom/ /yi ge rtsu ni dang por sbyar/ /gang phyir de las rtogs pa 'byung / /de bzhin yid kun rnal 'byor pas/ /snying gar bsgoms ⑥pas bsgom par bya/ /yang na nam mkha'i sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni dang por sbyar/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin bsgom bya zhing / /yi ge dag ni thams cad sbyar/ /yang na nam mkha'i zla dbus su/ /gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ bsgom bya/ /bdag nyid rigs kyi lha mor bsam/ /skad cig de la rab 'grub 'gyur/ /hūm̐ ni ji skad bstan pa bzhin/ /sngags kun rab tu bsgom par bya/ /rig pa kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /rgyud kun yang dag bsdus ⑦pa ste/ /bzlas pa'i gsang ba des spangs 6)pa/ /gsang ba 'di ni rnam pa drug /rig 'dzin rnams kyi snying po dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni bsdus (9)pa dang / /don yod shin tu rmad 'byung ba/ /gsang ba las kyang mchog gsang bshad/ /bzlas brjod tsam gyi sbyor ba yis/ /lta ba'i ri bo 'joms par 'gyur/ /rang gi snying ga'i 7dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de dbus su/ /zla ba gnyis pa bsgom par bya/ /dbugs 'byung rngub pa gang yin pa/ /rdo rje yi ge hūm̐ du bsgom/ /me bsrubs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /84—646

steng dang 'og tu rgyu bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag gnas/ /dbus su yi ge hrīḥhu)bsgom bya/ /steng 'og 'gro ba bsgom par bya/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni de sbyar nas/ /ji ltar shing skam gtsub stan ②pa/ /gtsub shing yang dag sbyor gnas su / /rtsol ba byas pa tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig gis ni me ④'byung bzhin / /yi ge a ni gtsub stan ⑤te/ /yi ge rtsu ni gtsub shing yin/ /rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /skad cig gis ni ye shes skye/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ye shes/ /yi ge hrīḥ.aru 'dir brjod 7bya/ /byang chub sems ni yi ge hūm̐/ /me yi sbyor bas bsrub par bya/ /bsrub (kyepa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /ye shes dam pa skye bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje de ni bsreg bya ste/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /bha ga sangs rgyas kun shes rab/ /ling ga rdo rje brjod par bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /bha ga ling gar rab tu bsgrub5)/ /bha gar ling ga bcug yinas ni / /mdo sde gsang dbang las gsungs so/ /bha ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /mkhas pas ling ga gzhug par bya/ /gsang ba gzi brjid chen po 'di/ / mi bsrub pa 47yi sbyor ba yis/ /'ga' zhig gis ni 'di bsgrubs yonyen/ /skad cig gis ni ye shes skye/ /bzlas 4)pa gsang ba rnam pa bdun rdzogs so// //sbas pa gsang ba rgyud chen po/ /'di nyid rnal 'byor kun du bsdus/ /'di yinyid chen po bsdus 7pa ni/ /de ni yigazhan yang rab bshad bya/ /zla ba gang ba yang dag gnas/ /bdag nyid rdo rje bsgom par bya/ / de yi 4 7dbus su rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje rigs kyi bzlas pa 4 bya/ /zla ba gang ba la gnas par/ /bdag nyid pad+mar 0)bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma de/ /pad+ma'i rigs 84wa 647

kun bzlas par ①bya/ /zla ba gang ba la gnas par/ /bdag nyid nor bur bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su rin chen dang / /rin chen rigs kyi bzlas par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje gcig pu ni/ /rdo rje rnon por ②rab tu bsgom/ /de yi las kyi rigs mchog la/ /las kyi rigs kun bzlas par bya sangs rgyas rjes dran nas brtsams te/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kur ②zhugs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs kun bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs chen po/ /sems dpa' gcig ni rnam par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kur duzhugs nas 0ni/ /rdo rje rigs kun bzlas par bya/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' chen po'i gzugs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rnam par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kur 0zhugs nas ni/ /pad+ma'i rigs kun bzlas par bya/ /nor bu rin chen skal ba che/ /rdo rje rin chen rnam par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kur ⑦zhugs nas ni/ /rin chen rigs kun bzlas par bya/ /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje las/ /sems dpa'i gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kur ⑧zhugs nas ni/ /las kyi rigs kun bzlas par bya/ /bden pa dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab grol byed/ /thos pa tsam gyis ⑨thabs chen po/ /yang na snying gar rdor ⑩rang bzhin/ /sna tshogs bdag po bzlas brjod (nyamatshungs/ /shes rab can gyis chagang bsams 8pa/ /phun sum tshogs kun bde bar thob/ /gsang ba yang dag bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni rnam bsgom bya/ /de yi thugs kur yi'ajug bya zhing / /yid kyis thams cad bcug yinas ni/ /de yi sku ni mtshungs par spro/ /de yi thugs ku'i ⑩dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni rab tu bshad/ /ji bzhin sngon gyi rjes 84—648

'brangs ①nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spro/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bzlas na/ /the tshom med par sangs rgyas kun / /skad cig de nyid kyis 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mda' ni zhi ba 'di/ /'di lta bu yi gzugs bsgom bya/ /de yi thugs kur zhugs ②nas ni/ /rdo rje'i gar dang mtshungs par bsgom/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje'i rigs can thams cad ni/ /the tshom med par dngos grub kun/ /ye shes bzlas ③pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /pad+ma'i sems dpa' bsgom bya zhing / /thugs kur 0ji bzhin 'jug par bya/ /sna tshogs thabs ni rab bsgoms ⑤na/ /pad+ma'i rigs can 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje rin chen bsgom bya zhing / /thugs kur ༅ji ⑦bzhin 'jug par bya/ /rin chen mdzod ni bcug dunas su/ /yang dang yang du spro bar bya/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje rin chen dga' chen po/ /the tshom med par dngos grub khyakun/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur / /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'dir/ /rdo rje las su rnam par bsam /de yi thugs kur 7zhugs nas ni/ /sna tshogs rnam 'phrul spro bar bya/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis(spre/ /sna tshogs mdzod ni rab spros nas/ /the tshom 8med par dngos 'grub kun/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 8'grub par 'gyur/ /shin tu gsang ba 'di lnga ni/ /bzlas pa gsang ba bla na med/ /de lta bu yi tsosbyor ba yisayi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bzlas pa'i cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di/ /rgyud kyi snying po kun bsdus shing / /nyon mongs thams cad rab 'joms ladhi /rig pa 'dzin pas bzlas par bya/ /bzlas pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /rig pa'i brtul tsozhugs nges par blang / /gal te 'di ni dngos grub 'dod/ /rnal 84—649

'byor pa yis brtul zhu)zhugs bya/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog tu brtson par bya/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus pa/ /bye ba gsum ni yongs su bzla/ /bye ba gsum ni bzlas byas nas/ /sgrub pa dag ni brtsam par bya/ /byang chub sems ni dga' chen po/ /shes rab can gyis (midakyil 'khor bri/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /sems can gcig gis yang dag bri/ /gang phyir rgyal po mchog gsang dbang / /rdo rje mchog ni rab ster byed/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis/ /de ni sngon du yang dag brtsam/ /shes rab can gyis chadakyil 'khor bri/ /khru ni bcu par yang dag bri/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo (gebazhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /ka ba brgyad ⑤dang yang dag ldan/ /dar gyi yichun pos rnam par brgyan⑦/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /kha khyer dag gis shin tu spras/ /rin chen dra bas yongs su bres la/ /gser skud (9)dril bu g.yer khas brgyanasnyi/ /sgo khyud dang ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje 'ching bas rab tu bcing / /rdo rje rin chen rab tu bkod/ /rdo rje thig gis thig btab (1pa/ /dri yi sbyor ba'i cho ga dang / /7phur bus bgegs ni bsal (12bya zhing / /tshon rtsi lnga yi srad bu ni/ /rdo rje gsang bas bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya / /ji skad sngar bshad de nyid ni/ / rdo rje gsang ba yongs su bkod/ /tsordo rje gsang ba yongs bkod nas/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rab mdzes la/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rab tu dgod/ /rdo rje chags pa yongs su dgod/ /tshon rtsi lnga ni rab tu dbye/ /ji skad gsang rgyud las gsungs bzhin/ /dkar po sna tshogs 'od 'bar ba/ /sngon po ser po 84—650

shin tu 'bar/ /btsod 6)sogs dang ni rab tu ldan/ /'od zer dmar po sna tshogs ldan/ /sna tshogs tshon rtsis bri bar bya/ /'od zer dmar po sna tshogs 'bar / /rdo rje 'khor lo yongs bkod nas/ /zla ba gang bar rab bkod ②do/ /'khor lo thams cad yongs su bzung ①/ /kha dog ji bzhin rigs pa bzhin/ /ji ltar mdzes shing shin tu dkar/ /ji bzhin zla ba nya ba mtshungs/ /zla ba gang ba yang dag bri/ /zla ba gang ba'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bri / /gang gis mtshan ni bzung ba yis/ /skad cig gis ni sdig las grol/ /'dzum ④pa dang bcas zla ba'i mdog /shin tu chags pa dga' chen po/ /myur du rdo rje'i tshig brjod de(ge/ /rdo rje nyid kyi snying po yin/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥyi/ rdo rje'i glu ni blang bya zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab ster byed/ /'dod pa'i chags pa yang dag ⑦dran/ /thams cad rjes chags bde ba thugs mchog mnga'/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu dga' ba mchog /kye khyod bde chen bstan (7pas dzi)'phel mdzad pa/ /rab tu myur du sgrub pa kyi'agrub par mdzod(2/ /rdo rje'i glu ni de lta bu / /blang tunyezhing 'khor lo spyan drang bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /rjes su chags shing rab 'grub 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung yang dag gnas//rdo rje bsnyems (stetshul 'chang ba'i mchog /rol pa dang bcas spyan yigayo ba/ /bsnyems 8tshul chen po dga' ba che/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis rdo rje ni/ /thugs ka tsoru ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /g.yon pa dril bu yang dag ldan/ /slar yang bsnyems yinatshul dang bcas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje che/ /rgyal po chen po thub pa che/ /spyod pa chen po theg pa che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub 84—651

mdzod / /①rin chen chen po rdo rje che/ /rgyal mtshan chen po dran pa che/ /sangs rgyas dran pa rdo rje che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /bde ba chen po bla na med/ /sa dang pha rol phyin bde bar(snye/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /shes rab chen po rdo rje che / /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad las byung ba/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje che/ / rdo rje sems ni rdo rje che/ /①rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /rdo rje chen po chags pa che/ /rgyal po chen po thub pa che/ /don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /chos kyi srid pa ④'khor lo che/ /smra ba'i las ni bla na med/ / bsrung zhing bsrung ⑤ba drag po che/ /rdo rje khu tshur bdag grub mdzod/ /rdo rje yi ni glu 'di yis/ /de nyid mchog tu bskul yinas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom 7med/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom bya zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma dang mtshungs par/ /dkyil 'khor du ni yang dag bri/ /de nas rdo rje bltas (nyanas ni/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad gdon 6)par bya/ /chos kyi rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ /dbab yidang gzhug pa la sogs pa/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis / /las rnams thams cad yang dag bya/ /bum pa la sogs yo byad dang / /spos dang me tog la sogs mchog /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis las rnams thams cad yang dag bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rig pa yis/ /bum pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ /de ni zhabs kyi drung bzhag na/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu ru 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga ji bzhin 'jug bya zhing / /84—652

rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya ches/ /bdag nyid la ni dbang bskur 6)bya/ /rgyu gis ②yang dag zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje mchod pas ①yang dag mchod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ci rigs par ni bsgrub par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang bar gnas/ /phyag rgya chen po yongs su gzung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rang bdag nyid ni bsgrub ④par bya/ /de nas gsang ba phyag rgya che/ /skad cig re re bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /brtan par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgrubs nas ni/ /shin tu bstan ⑤pa bla 4)med pa( )/ /rjes chags sems dpa' chen po ni / /skad cig gis ni bsgrub ⑧par bya/ /de 'dra'i mchog tu gsang ba mthar phyin pa/ /sems dpa' rgyal chen yongs su dag pa mchog /dag pa'i tshul 'di cung zad mtshungs pa med/ /rjes chags 'dod chags yongs su dag pa mchog /rdo rje rgyal mchog rab dag 6)dri ma med/ /gsang ba las byung 'khor lo dam pa 'dzin / /rig pa'i gsang sngags tshul 'di byang chub byed⑩/ /snying rje dang ldan spyod (nyapa spyod byed pa/ /de bzhin rab 'jigs sdug bsngal chen po'i pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /mchog tu mkhas shing phra la spre rgyud dang rgyud dag las byung ba/ /de ru srid pa dag gi dra ba chen po gcod mdzad pa/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo las byung gsang ba de 'drar bshad/ /gsang rigs mchog tu byung ba'i 4nya'akhor lo ste / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yidagongs pa gcig /sras kyi gtso bo dbang sgyur 8rgyal po ste/ /de yis thar 7pa'i grong khyer rab tu bshad/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po de kho na nyid 4 dam pa mchog tu gsang ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po tsho rdo rje rtse mo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdo sde gsang ba'i dbang po de 84—653

bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa ste ①le'u gnyis pa rdzogs so// //de nas rnal 'byor gsang ba che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kun 'dus (7pa/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan pa'i mchog /nam mkha' sna tshogs dngos ldan pa/ /ri dbang rgyal po chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sprul pa sprul/ /rdo rje dbang po chen po'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag 'dus(mi/ /rdo rje rgyal po rtse mo ste/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor yang dag byung / /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po che/ /chos dang longs ④spyod rdzogs pa'i mtshungs/ /rdo rje kun gyis phyirab mdzes pa/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i 4)gnas de ru/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po che/ /rnal 'byor pa ni mi gsung (7)bzhugs/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung yang dag bzhugs/ /gtso bos chos kun dbang du 'gyur(kye/ /rol bcas rdo rje bsnyems 6)tshul ldan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas gcig ste/ /chos ⑩chen po yi rnal 'byor mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug la gsol btab/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yostodaga' chen po/ /sems dpa' byang sems las byung ba/ /rang gi rigs 'byung bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang ba rgyal po ste/ /rgyud kyi snying po gsang ba che/ /gsang ba chen po rigs kyi dbang / /mdo sde gsang dbang rgyal po ste/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus yi pa/ /zhi bas byang chub 'grub 'gyur te/ /thams cad yang dag bsdus yo pa min/ /gtum po thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /rang rigs rtag tu bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang ba 84—654

rgyal po ste/ /kun du mi gsung 6)bzhugs par gyur②/ /mi gsung nigasang ba ma gsungs te/ /zhi ba'i dubade ba la bzhugs gyur⑤/ /gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa mchog /sems dpa' chen po snyoms par zhugs/ /rtog cing dugazigs par mi mdzad de/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor bzhugs par gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan par mdzadapya//sangs rgyas gcig bzhin yang dag 'gyur/ /don yod grub pa bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnal 'byor che/ /gsang ba kun (kyelas yang dag byung / /rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje can la bskul ba 6)gsungs/ /oṃ badz+ra yis twa uta ⑩tiṣ+ṭha/ rdo rje bskul ba gsungs pa natso/ /chos dbyings sangs rgyas gcig pu nyid/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs par gyur/ /thub pas mgon rnams la btud nas/ /tshig ni 'di skad gsungs par gyur/ /rnam pa kun du ci zhig bgyi/ /bdag la sangs rgyas kun gyis (nyagasungs/ /phyag na rdo rje brtan pa la/ /de nas tsosangs rgyas kun gyis tshugasungs/ /gsang ba rdo rje rigs zhes pa/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yithos nas/ /rdo rje dbang po'i gnas snang byed/ /rab tu btud nas tshig gsungs ⑩pa/ /mgon po rnal 'byor gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gi snod dang tunyeldan pa'i mchog /'di ni (khesems can 'ga' yang med/ /gang phyir mu stegs la chags shing / /skye dgu lta ba'i dri mas khyab/ /sems can 'di dag gdul ( )bya min/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi snod ma yin/ /log pa'i lam du yang dag zhugs/ /mun pa stug po la gzhol ba / /la la lha mi lta la (nyechags/ /kha cig brtul zhu zhugs lta ba'i gnas/ /kha 84—655

cig dka' thub gdungs pas 'khrul/ /nyon mongs pas ni 'khrug ①pa'i sems/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la chags/ /skyo bar yang ni mi 'gyur te/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gsang 'di la/ /nam yang sbyor bar ②mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'dod chags che la chags/ /'dod pa'i chags pa dag las rgyal/ /sangs rgyas byang chub chags bral ba/ /gsang ba 'di la sbyor mi 'gyur/ /lta ba'i chags pas rgyal bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i chags pas lta ba can/ /srid pa'i zhags pas shin tu chags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la chags bral/ /nga rgyal lhag pa'i nga rgyal bcing (5)/ /gdug cing drag la shin tu khro/ /snying rje med cing brtse ①med 'gyur / /de la gsang ba rung ma yin/ /rmongs pa kun mkhyen yin snyam pa/ /ye shes chen po la mkhas pa/ /gsang ba 'di ni rung ma yin/ /'dren pa ⑤ji ltar bshad par bgyi/ /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po nyid/ /sha za 'byung po gsang ba pa/ /lha la sogs pa gdug chen po/ /bstan pa la ni 'jug mi 'gyur / /nga ni sangs rgyas rab tu zhi/ /byang chub sems ni dga' chen po/ /sems can 'di dag shin tu gdugasti /bdag gi tshig ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /nga ni rgyal chen theg chen la/ /nam mkha'i ⑦dbyings bzhin rab tu yangs(gyi/ /kye ma sems can 'di dag dman/ /bdag gi tshig ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /nga yo)ni theg chen dag pa ste/ /nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos pa med/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di nyon mongs/ /bdag gi tshig 'di 'grub mi 'gyur/ /nga ni shes rab ye shes che/ /theg pa che 7la shin tu bstan/ /kye ma 9)sems can shes rab ngan//bdag gi tshig 'di 'grub mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams chen po ye shes che/ /nga ni mchod pa chen po'i tshogs/ /kye ma'o yo)sems can bsod nams chung / /bdag 84—656

gi tshig 'di 'grub mi 'gyur/ /sems can 'di dag nye bar 'tshetshi/ /'jigs pa sna tshogs kun du khyab/ /rnam rtog gis bskyod shes rab ngan/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi snod ma yin/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /bdag po chen po dbang phyug kyang / /rmongs pa kun sel nyid gyur pa/ /stobs chen rdzu 'phrul chen po ste/ /de la rgya pa po grogs byed yod/ /sgyu ma'i sngags ni yongs su 'dzin / /de ni mi rgyud ces phyibya ste/ /sems can rmongs byed lhur len pa/ /de ni rgyal po lha chen po/ /gtso bo rgyal po chen po mtshungs/ /de ni dbang phyug che zhes bya/ /gdug pa'i sems can 'joms byed pa/ /de yi gzugs can rgyal po che/ /skyed ①byed byed pa po bdag po/ /tshangs pa chen po rgyal po che/ /lta ba sna tshogs rab ster ba/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi rgyal po che/ /dbang po zhes bya sha tsi'i ④bdag /brtson 'grus dbang phyug chen po'i bu/ /gdong drug rdzu 'phrul chen po can/ /dpung chen zhes bya'i ming che ste/ /gzhon nu mi pham med lnga ming ⑤/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lnga ni/ /khams gsum gyi ⑥ni bdag por bshad / /rgyal po lnga ni gzi brjid che/ /lus gsum gyi ni ngo mtshar che/ /skul 6)byed dbang phyug chen po ni/ /tshangs pa khyab (kyi'ajug dbang phyug che/ /de yi lus can rgyal po che/ /dbang phyug chen po zhes grags pa/ /sems can gdug pa shin tu drag /sngags bcas 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rgyal po lnga po de dag ni / /sems can dag ni rnam 5narmongs byed/ /lta ba chen po 'dzin byed cing / /bdud kyi dbang du gyur pa ste/ /nyon mongs chen pos rab nyon mongs/ /gzhan yang kun nas nyon mongs byed/ /sems can dag ni 'joms byed cing / /bdag gi tshig 'di 'grub mi 'gyur/ /dbang phyug chen po bdag nyid che/ /84—657

bdag nyid dam pa'i yid chen po/ /de lta bu yi rnam rtog gis/ /sems can rnam par rmongs par byed/ /tshangs pa 'byin 6)byed skye dgu'i bdag /byed pa rang bdag byed pa po/ /lta ba chen po de lta bus/ /sems can dag ni rnam rmongs byed/ /khyab 'jug kun song khyab byed pa/ /khyab 'jug rang bzhin grong khyer kun/ /de ltar yang dag mi 'dzin pa/ /lta ba'i 'ching ba rab ster byed/ /rgya cher rgyal po 'di rnams ni/ /lta bar smra la nges par ston②/ /rmongs pa mkhas pa yin sems shing / /sems can 'ching bar byed pa yin/ /sems can de rnams gzhan gyis bskul / /lta bar ⑦smra ba dunges par stenayi/ /khyab 'jug tshangs pa la sogs pa/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag byed deX/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rnam kun du/ /bdag gi tshig 'di 'grub mi byed/ /sems can 'di rnams rmongs par gyur6)/ /de la gsang ba rung ma yin/ /de lta bu yi rnam pa yis(9)ske/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑩mkhyen nas ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni (1mi gsung 7bzhugs/ /mgon po chen po sangs rgyas kun/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pas/ /gsung gcig gis ni gsang ba che/ /rdo rje yi ni tshig 12gsungs pa/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di gdul dka'ayi/ /gdug cing drag la shin tu gtum/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mi 'dul ba/ /de phyir bdag cag gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod shes rab chen po ste/ /khyod ⑫ni thabs chen brjod par bya/ /byang chub sems ni thabs chen po/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges par 'joms/ /gdug pa thams cad rab gdul ba/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdug pa 'dul byed rnam 'phrul ba/ /thabs chen po ni rab tu gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis yisems can 'di/ /84—658

'dul bar mi 'gyur snod min la/ /thabs chen khro ba 6)chen po ni/ /thub pa chen pos bstan ②du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi tshig gsan srinas/ /phyag na rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /tshig dag gis ni zhus ④gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'di skad gsungs/ /e ma'o gsang ba 'khor lo che/ /thabs chen bdag nyid chen po ste/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bstan pa'i dngos/ /thabs kyi 'khor lo rab ston pa / /ji skad du ni bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyi/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /drag po nyid ni bstan par bya/ /de skad gsungs nas sems dpa' che/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /mi gsung bzhugs nas rnal 'byor gyis/ /drag po nyid la snyoms par zhugs/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje mchog /ces bya'i ting 'dzin de lta bu/ /drag po chen po snyoms par zhugs/ /de bzhin thugs ka (snyenas byung ba/ /drag po 'jigs ①rung yi ge hūṃ/ /khro bo chen po brjod par 'gyuragyu/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad khro rgyal po/ /mgon po thugs ka (nyanas byung ⑨gyur/ /sa gzhi ma lus g.yos gyur cing / /sa 'di dag ni sgra sgrogs gyur/ /stong gsum ma lus 'di dag ni/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bya brjod par gyur/ /tshad med gzhal du med pa yi7/ /khro bo'i rgyal po byung gyur pas / /phyogs rnams kun du gdug chen dag /skad cig de la gtum par ⑪gyur / /slar yang gcig tunyenyid gyur nas ni/ /gong bur byas nas rab bsdams te / /khro bo'i rgyal po sku chen po/ /'jigs su rung ba gcig tu gyur/ /de ni khro bo'i rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi grags chen po/ /khro rgyal mdun du 'dug nas ni/ /slar yang snying po rab tu brjod/ /hūm̐ t+ya r+ghaṃ t+ya/ 'jigs su rung ba'i spu langs byed/ /gnod sbyin kun bdag gnod sbyin te/ /rdo rje 84—659

gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul che/ /khro bo chen po brjod pa yin/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od kyis 6)khyab/ /rdo rje me ni drag po che / /ma lus gsal zhing me 'bar gyur/ /phyi rol gyi ni gdug pa can/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /rdo rje me ni rab 'bar bas/ /g.yo ba med cing shi bar gyur②/ /lha chen la sogs gdug pa rnams/ /gang dag rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis (migadungs nas/ /g.yo ba med cing 'bar bar gyurasti/ /de ni rdo rje gnod sbyin che/ /drag po'i gzugs can rab 'jigs byed/ /khro gnyer bsnyer ba'i gdong can te/ /de bzhin gnag ⑤dang sngo bar gyur/ /mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ /dbu skra gyen brjes shin tu skrag /spyan dmar spyan dang ldan pa ste/ /de bzhin rdo rje bstan pa'i zhal / /drag po rdo rje drag tshogs 'dzin/ /gcig pu 'bar ba rab ldan pa/ /zhags pa lcags kyu rdo rje bdag /sangs rgyas thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /sa rnams ma lus g.yo bar byed/ /sa 'di yang ni g.yo bar byed/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'byung po sogs/ /g.yo ba med cing 'og tu 'gyel/ /de ni drag po gnod sbyin che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /de yi spyan sngar 'dug nas ni/ /ched du brjod pa yang dag brjod/ /e ma'o byang chub kyi ni sems / /kun du bzang po kun dge ba/ /sems can 'dul ba'i thabs su ni/ /brtse med khro bo nyid du gyur/ /sngar ni rdo rje sems dpa' gang / /zhi ba'i gzugs su rnam gnas pa/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin 'dzin gyur nas/ /rdo rje drag po zhes byar grags/ /de ni drag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jigs rung ba spu langs par byed / /yi ge hūm̐ bzhi'i phyag rgya yi/ /snying po gtum po nyid kyang gsungs/ /oṃ 84—660

sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi 6)sa/ gro: ②pa ya / gro: ④pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra rgyu phaṭa/ shin tu gtum zhing cher grags ⑤pa/ /de bzhin thugs ka yinas byung ste/ /zhal bzhi dang ni phyag brgyad pa/ / bskal pa ⑦yi ni me ltar drag /rdo rje dus kyi me ltar byung / /nyon mongs phyogs ni rab sel ⑧byed / /smin ma bskyod pas gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /de bzhin rnam par 'jigs ⑨pa'i gdong / /'jig rten gsum sreg dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje can kun sreg par byed / /'bar phreng 7kun du 'khrigs pa'i sgra/ /rdo rje bskal pa'i me ltar ⑪'bar / /rdo rje tsū mdzad phyag rgya ni/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni yongs su gzung ⑫/ /rdo rje bsdams pa 'dzin rgyal po/ /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pas brgyan/ /rdo rje yi ni lu gu rgyud/ /phyag gnyis na bsdams 'jigs rung zhal/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdigs (nyebyed pa/ /rdo rje gtum po ④yang dag byung / /drag po bka' ni nod 8par byed/ /myur ba ru ni bka' stsol cig /min na tsosangs rgyas khyed rnams kun/ /the tshom med par bza' bar bya/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungasakhye tsho/ /ṭaka ki 'dzaḥ()rgyu shin tu drag /rigs dang bcas par lha chen po/ /stobs chen po yis dgug par gyis/ /de nas rig pa'i mchog rgyal po/ /bsnyems rdu )pa'i tshul gyis du bzhad byed cing / /khro bo drag po rnga sgra sgrogs / /rdo rje zhags pa bskul zho snyebar bya/ /rdo rje zhags pa drag po che/ /dpung bcas grogs dang bcas pa dang / /de bzhin rigs dang dkyil 'khor bcas / /song la dbang phyug chen po khug /badz+ra pā 0sha rtsu/ dbang ldan rgyal po chen po ni/ /sna tshogs rang gi 'khor na gnas/ /'jigs byed ma dang lhan cig tu/ /'dod pa can ni mchog tu rol/ /rdo rje zhags pa der song ste/ /84—661

khro bo'i sgra ①yis bsdigs par gyur/ /dbang ldan rgyal po la smras pa/ /khyod la ston pa spyan 'dren mdzad/ /skrag cing khros nas lha chen pos/ /'jigs pa yi ni tshig brjod pa/ /nga ni 'jig rten gsum rgyal po/ /nga las②ston pa gzhan yod dam/ /rdo rje zhags pa khro bo ches/ /tshig ni lan gsum brjod par gyur/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po che/ /khyod la shin tu spyan 'dren mdzad/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po yis/ /slar yang lan gsum smras pa ni①/ /nga ni kho na rgyal po rang —/ /nga la spyan 'dren gang zhig yod/ /de nas zhags pas bka' bzhin byed / /khro bo drag po byarab 'jigs pas/ /yan lag thams cad bcings nas ni / /dbang phyug chen po bkug (snyepar gyur/ /'jigs shing skrag nas lha chen po / /shin tu smre sngags 'don cing ngu / /skyabs ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /'jigs pa chen po kun du byung / /stobs dang de bzhin nga rgyal gyis/ /stobs dang shugs ni bstan 96)nas su/ /zhags pa bcad nas bros par gyur/ /rang gi gnas su song gyur nas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi lha rnams bos/ /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas/ /skad cig gis ni 'dus gyur nas/ /'khor rnams dag ni ngu bar gyur/ /ji ltar 9)sngon gyis nim byas pa'i/ /de lta bu ni yang dag mthong —/ /sems can rab drag 'di su zhig /rdo rje zhags pa'i mdun yo)song ste / /rdo rje rig pa mchog la zhus/ /dbang phyug chen pos bdag bcad de/ /drag po tshangs pa khorab tu bros/ /rdo rje rig pa mchog rgyal po/ /khro bo gtum po shin tu drag /de lta bu yi tshig gsan nas/ /thams cad du ni 'bar bar gyur11—/ /khro bo rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /drag po yis ni bka' bsgo ba/ /myur du song la lha chen po/ /rigs chen po dang bcas pa khug /khro bo'i rgyal po lu gu rgyud/ /84—662

gsan na ①dbang phyug che zhuganas song / /yan lag thams cad bcings nas su / /lha mo dang bcas kun du bkug /skad cig 'jigs pas ngu ①byed cing / /lha rnams thams cad shin tu 'jigs/ / 'jigs pa'i ༷sdug bsngal smre sngags 'don / /de ring 'dren pa (gelha chen min/ /stobs dang shugs ni thams cad kyis / /rdo rje kun dang 'thab par gyur(ye/ /mthu dang stobs dang shugs kyis ni / /bcag nas thams cad bros par gyur/ /lha chen la sogs thams cad ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du bros par gyur/ /mun pa yis ⑦ni kun du 'khrug /phyogs rnams kun du 'jigs par gyur(kye/ /khro bo lu gu rgyud 'ongs nas/ /rnam pa kun du smra bar byed/ /ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /bdag cag gnas po)ni bros par gyur/ /khro bo rdo rje rig pa mchog /slar yang shin tu khros par gyur/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas tsorab 'bar zhing / /rdo rje drag po nyid du gyur / /drag po ha ha zhes bzhad dgod/ /rang gi yan lag za bar byed/ /rang gi mgo la rdeg byed cing / /rdo rje gsor ba bskor bar 'bar/ /de lta bu yi khyad par dang / /bcas pas khro bo yang dag byung / /slar yang rang gi (nyebadag nyid dran/ /khro bo'i rgyal po brjod par gyur/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha tu)rtsu/ griṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa ()rgyu/ gro: 8pa ya griṇ+ḍa 8pa ya hūm̐/ ā tson ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa / khro bo'i rgyal po bcas nas ni/ /yi ge dzaḥ4)ni yongs su brjod/ /rdo rje lcags gyur rab tu bsngagasaXshe/ /stobs dang ldan pa khug la shog /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ag (7ni sa tri ṣa e ( )ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ(nya/ rdo rje 'bar ba lcags lu gyu ni/ /song nas phyogs kun bdag nyid che/ /skad cig gis ni 6)stobs chen rnams/ /lha rnams thams cad bkug par gyur/ /rgyal po dbang phyug lnga dang ni/ /lha rnams 84—663

thams cad grangs med par/ /rigs bcas dpung dang bcas pa nyid/ /gcig nyid du ni bsdus par gyur/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog rab tu mngags/ /chings shig ②stobs chen dang ldan pa/ /tshogs dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kun/ /bcing ba lnga yis bcings par gyural/ /nang gi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs/ /lha tshogs gnod sbyin srin po chadang / /lha min rlung dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /thams cad bcings par ④gyur nas ni / /rdo rje zhags pa rab tu mngags/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dang bcas par /song la dkyil 'khor dag khug cig /rdo rje zhags pas mngon chags pas⑤/ /yan lag kun las yongs su spro4)/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin zhags pa ste/ /brtan par gyur par the tshom med/ /bye ba dag ni grangs (7med bcu/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rab tu byung / /lha la sogs pa'i re re zhing / /spyi bo nas 'gugs yang dag sbyor / /lha chen dbang phyug chen po yi(3)/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu btab nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rgyal po yis/ /dbang phyug chen po 'gugs 6)par byed/ /lha sogs 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /phan tshun du ni ngu bar byed/ /shugs rings bokun du phyung nas ni/ /phan tshun du ni smra bar byed/ /kye ma'o sdug bsngal kye ma'o (7shi/ /tshogs ni (shegang du khyer bar gyur/ /rdo rje 'bar ba chen po des/ /skad cig de la bsregs (nyegyur nas/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo ru/ /lha la sogs pa thams cad bkug /gnas de ru cha)ni thams cad dag /yongs su bskor nas kun du gnas/ /rdo rje kha khyer phyi rol du/ /lha rnams de dag thams cad gnas/ /rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du/ /lha la sogs pa thams cad bkug /phyi rol rdo rje ra ba ni/ /lcags bsregs charang bzhin rdo rje mtshungs/ /rdo rje 84—664

can gyi rdor 'bar masanyu/ /nang nas shin tu gdungs par gyur②/ /lha tshogs sems can de dag kyang / /'jigs su rung ba'i 'o dod 'bod/ /stong gsum 'di dag thams cad ①kyang / /hūm̐ hūṃ sgra ni yongs su brjod/ /'o dod bos nas smra bar byed/ /ngan song dag ni ci zhig byed/ /sngon ma mthong ba 'di ci zhig /'dir ni rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas ④rgyal po de/ /slar yang thugs rje kun du skyes/ /thams cad bcings pa las bgrol te/ /rdo rje me yi nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin drag po che/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor nas phyung ste//lha la sogs pa kun bos te/ /nga yi tshig 'di rab tu nyon/ /de nas lha rgyal la sogs pa/ /khyod ni su yin smra bar byed/ /nged kyis khyod ni sngar ma mthong / /gnas mchog 'di yang sngar ma mthong / /rdo rje (snyeganod sbyin drag po che/ /ha ha zhes dgod bzhad pa yis/ /smras pa rdo rje gnod sbyin nga ⑥/ /thams cad za byed bzod dka' ⑦ba/ /de nas lha chen gyis smras pa/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin ngas mi shes/ /nga yis khyod ni sngar ma mthong / /bdag nyid kho na rang byung ba/ /rdo rje drag pos rab smras pa/ /nga yi bka' la (nyemyur gnas kyis/ /min na rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis/ /rang gi rigs ni sreg par byed/ /lha chen po yis tshig smras pa / /bstan pa la ni nga mi gnas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dbang phyug nga 5)/ /su yi bstan pa la gnas pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i stobs gang yin/ /de ring nga yis bstan par bya/ /khyod la stobs ni ci yod pa/ /stobs chen ldan pas 7bstan par gyis/ /dbang phyug chen po rgyal po che/ /'byung po'i tshogs bcas lhan cig tu/ /tshig dag smras par gyur pa ni/ /drag po nyid ni bstan par bya/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng bas 84—665

khyabaske/ /ha ha zhes bya shin tu drag /dbang phyug chen pos bstan par bya/ /oṃ shu la a tri 7shu la ma hā sa ha sra shu la ā yu dhe/ rtse gsum mngag gzhug rgyal po ni / /stong phrag gcig ni byung bar 'gyuraphyi/ /rtse bcas kun du 'bar ba yis/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab/ /na phyi'o ya nas smras pa/ oṃ ma hā sa ha ④su tsakra ā ⑤yu 0dhe/ khyab 'jug gis ni de dag (7smras/ /'khor lo gcig tu rnam pa (gyistong / /thams cad 'od zer 'bar bas khyab/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thabate/ /brgya byin gyis tsho)smras pa/ oṃ ma hā sa ha sra badz+ra ā kyiyu dhe/ rdo rje stong ni byung bar gyur/ /rdo rje 'bar ba tsha bas khyab/ /brgya byin gyis ⑩ni smras pa yin/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab/ /gzhon nus smras pa/ oṃ ma hā sa ha 7sra sha'i ā 7yu dhedhi/ gzhon nus de skad smras nas ni/ /mdung ni rtse gsum stong byung gyur/ /sgra ni drag po sgrogs byed cing / /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab / /tshangs pas smras pa/ oṃ ma hā sa ha sra daṇ+ḍa ā 7yu dhe/ tshangs pas de skad smras nas ni/ /dbyug to stong ni byung gyur nas/ /mtshon cha drag po 'jigs 7byed pas/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab/ /gzhan yang lhag ma ma lus pa/ /rnams kyis yang ni mtshon cha dag /re re stong phrag gcig gyur nas/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab/ /tha na sprul pa gang yin dang / /phyi rol gyi (meni dam ldan pa/ /de rnams nges par stong gyur nas/ /rdo rje can dang lhan cig 'thab / /me yang kun du 'bar gyur cing / /'jigs par byed pa'i rlung yang byung ske/ /'brug gi sgra dang glog 1)chen pos/ /khyad (7par srid gsum gnas par gyur / /ha la ha la'i sgra chen po/ /nam mkha' 6 )bar snang la ni grag( te /rdo rje drag po tshogs chen po/ /lha rnams thams cad 'thab par byed/ /de nas rgyal 84—666

po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtum po drag po 'jigs ①byed pas/ /lha yi lan ②gyi phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje yi ni snying po gsungs/ /oṃ ma hā sa ha sra ①ha ra badz+ra tsa kre/ oṃ ma hā ④badz+ra shu le/ oṃ dīp+ta dzā ⑤la ag ni badz+ra/ oṃ badz+ra shat+ta⑥/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra ni phyadhikhya/ de lta bu yi rnam pa ru/ /snying po dag ni stong phrag gcig /srid gsum zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang ni chen pos 6)phyung / /gtum po 'od zer 'bar bas khyab/ /rdo rje me dang yang dag ldan/ /drag po'i snying po las byung gyur/ /rdo rje 'chang ni dbus na bzhugs/ /lha tshogs phyag rgya de dag ni / /rnam par bshig cing dum bur byas/ /bcom zhing bsdams te bsres tsonas ni/ /phyogs rnams kun du thim par gyur/ /rdo rje me yis (nyarab bsdams pas / /lha yi rgyal po 'bar bar 'gyur8/ /'og nas (ges ni rab tu 'bar/ /steng nas me ni shin tu gdungs/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po ches/ /dbang phyug chen po la gsungs pa/ /lus srul po ni drag po che/ /nga yi bka' ni rab tu nyon/ /dur khrod gnas la rab tu dga'/ /lus la thal ba dag gis skyibyugs/ /mi yi sha ni bza' snyibar byed/ /nga yi bka' ni rab tu nyon/ /khrag rlon gyis ⑩ni rab tu bskus/ /pags yipa rlon pa gos su gyon/ /lha rnams thams cad khyod kyi 'khor/ /nga yi bka' ni rab tu nyon/ /gdug pa drag chen mtshan mo rgyu ba slong (nyamo ba/ /khrag la spangs pa'i pags 4)can lus la thal bas byugs/ /nga yis ( )bka' nyon drag po'i sems ldan lus srul po/ /min na bskal pa'i me yis rtswa (1bzhin khyod bsreg so bya/ / ro bsregs ( gyethal ba'i phung (9po bzhin du thal bar 'gyur/ /so rigs bcas dpung ldan dkyil 'khor dang bcas gnod sbyin drag /rdo rje drag po yi ( 9ni rab gzhom gzhig par bya/ /dbang phyug chen 84—667

pos smras pa/ nga ni ma lus dbang phyug chen po'i 'khor los sgyur①/ /'jig rten gsum gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa yi 'khor/ /shin tu drag cing rnam gtsigs 'jig rten khyod yin yang / /khyod kyis nga yi bka' ni mnyan ②par gyis/ /gdug dang sangs rgyas mang po'i 'khor ni sangs rgyas chos kyi 'byung gnas nga yis (misprul/ /zhi zhing de la rnam 'dul gsang ba dri med nyon mongs med pa'i pha rol phyin/ /de 'dra'i mgon po dga' ba dus gsum bzhugs pa thams cad nas dbang bskur④/ /slar yang nga yi ⑤'byung po'i tshig nyon zhes pa'i tshig ni 'di lta bu/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dul ba'i don la shin tu mkhas/ /khro bo gdug pa gtum chen po/ /rab 'bar khro ba'i 6)rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje'i byin brlabs (7phyag rgya las/ /bya ba de 'dra'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par zhugs nas sems dpa' ches/ /rang rigs (7khro bo las byung ba/ /gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i chos kyi tshul bzung nas/ /rkang pa nas brtsams yi)spyi bo'i bar/ /lus kun las ni rnam par phyung / /oṃ badz+ra kro dha usnri dhiṣa hūm̐/rdo rje'i gtsug tor khro bo che/ /'bar ba'i spyi bo nas phyung nas/ /sa rnams thams cad g.yo byed cing / /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad 'joms/ /oṃ badz+ra skṛ (meku ṭi kro dha (nyas/ khro bo'i rgyal po khro gnyer can/ /mdzod spu las /nyeni rab tu byung / /'jigs byed drag po yang dag ldan/ /lus rnams thams cad 'bar 'gyur ba/ /oṃ ni sum+bha badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje rig pa mchog rgyal po/ /kha las rab tu byung bar gyur/ /spyi bo nas brtsams rkang mthil bar/ /rdo rje 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥyi/ thugs kyi khro bo rgyal po che/ /thugs ka 7nas ni rab tu byung / /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa'i sku/ /'jigs su rung ba spu 84—668

langs byed/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku ①sha ā kur+sha ya hūṃ/ rdo rje lcags kyu khro bo che/ /phrag pa g.yas nas rab tu byung / /rdo rje lcags kyu gsor byed cing / /rdo rje 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /oṃ badz+ra pā sha kro dha ā kunu ②rgyu phaṭa/ rdo rje zhags pa khro bo che/ /phrag pa g.yon nas rab tu byung / /rdo rje 'bar bar ②yang dag ldan / /rdo rje zhags pas bskor ④bar byed/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li kro dha rtsu phaṭa/ khro bo'i rgyal po lcags kyu thogs/ /lte ba'i dbus gnas phyirab tu phyung / /kun nas 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /blo mchog rdo rje gnod sbyin mtshungs/ /oṃ badz+ra me kha lā yigro dha rgyu phaṭa④/ khro bo chen po ska nirags ni/ /rked pa'i rdo rje rab tu phyung glu/ /kun nas 'bar ba ⑨yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya dang ni lhan cig ldan/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ba la hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen po stobs/ /dpung pa g.yas nas cirab tu phyung / /rdo rje 'bar bas 'bar bar gyuratso/ /me yis shin tu nga rgyal gyur / /oṃ badz+ra ba lā yinyeya kro dha hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdu bu ni/ /dpung pa g.yon las yang dag byung / /gsang zhing rdo rje 'bar bas khyabatso/ /rdo rje khro bos ()rab tu khengs/ /oṃ sa ma ya tsobadz+ra kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig khro bo'i rgyal po ni/ /de bzhin khro bo'i gnod byed pa/ /khu tshur g.yas nas rab tu phyung ske/ /kun nas 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /oṃ badz+ra musbyi 7gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo khu tshur drag po che/ /khu tshur g.yon las rab tu byung / /rdo rje 'bar ba dag gis gsal/ /rdo rje me yis rab tu brgyan/ /oṃ badz+ra ban dha kro dha r+ghaṃ/ sa ma ya 47/ oṃ badz+ra añdza tsoyi ban dha kro dha hūṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ 5nyerdo rje 'ching ba rgyal po che/ /de bzhin rdo rje sor mo nyid/ /khro bo lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi/ /sor mo dag las yang dag byung / /oṃ badz+ra na kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha e 4)ku li ma 84—669

hā 0)kro dha rgyu/ rdo rje sder mo khro bo che/ /de bzhin rdo rje sder mo'i gdong / /phyag ni g.yon dang g.yas pa yi/ /sor mo dag las rab tu byung / /oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha ka ṭi rā ga hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha mudha nye ②ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i rgyal po rked pa dang / /de bzhin khro bo spyi gtsug (midag /rgyal po brla ④ni g.yon pa dang / /g.yas pa dag las rab tu byung ⑤/ oṃ shri kha li ⑥ma hā kro dha ban dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ā sha ni ⑦ban dha rtsu/ gnam lcags rdo rje lu gu rgyud / /khro bo'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /rgyal po 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab/ /pus mo'i lha nga dag las byung / /oṃ badz+ra ban dha kro dha ha na ni: phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha 5)e ku ⑩sha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo che/ /rdo rje yi ni yan lag drangasal/ /'bar ba dang bcas gnod sbyin gnyis/ /rje ngar dag las rab tu phyung / /oṃ nu pu ra tsho1gro dha hūm̐/ oṃ 8badz+ra kro dha tu)mo gha be ga ā yin ya hūm̐ phaṭa/de nas dka' 7thub khro bo che/ /de bzhin rdo rje don yod nyid/ /rgyal po shugs chen gnyis po ni/ / gdu bu'i rkang skyalas rab tu byung / /oṃ badz+ra ban dha ha la gro 7snya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā tā (nyal mā ra ya kro dha rtsu phaṭa/ rkang pa khro bo shugs chen po/ /de bzhin mthil gyi khro bo nyid/ /'bar ba 'phro ba lhur len pa / /gnyis po zhabs kyi mthil las byung / /de dag la sogs rgyal po ni/ /dpag tu med par rab tu byung 9/pe/ /gang gā'i bye snyed grangs med pa63 / /phra rab rdul gyi khams dag ni/ /ba spu'i gseb ni thams cad dang / /lus kyi gseb ni thams cad nas/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po che me/ /rang gi snying po las byung 'gyur snye / /rdo rje khro bo'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs rnams kun du yongs spros (stete / /slar yang gcig tu gyur nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni yang dag gnas/ /84—670

sangs rgyas kun gyi ①sbyan sngar 'dus/ /ched du brjod ②pa yang dag brjodadu/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thabs chen po/ /e ma'o ye shes shin tu bzang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /theg pa chen po zhes byar bshad/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dpag tu med pa zhes byar gyur/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo 'di / /thams cad rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /sems can kun gyi don bya'i phyir / /de nyid sangs rgyas rigs chen po/ /de nas de yi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /khro bo che las yang dag byung / /rdo rje khro bo'i dbang phyug bshad/ /rdo rje gtsug tor rdor mdzod gospu/ /gnod mdzes bdag cag stobs po che/ /thugs kyi khro bo rgyal po che/ /rgyal po ⑤'khor los sgyur ⑥ba dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu rdo rje zhags/ /rked pa'i khro bo stobs po che /ska ⑦rags stobs ldan ⑧nyid dang ni/ /lag gdub de bzhin dam tshig dang / /rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje bsdams/ /rdo rje sor mo shin tu drag /rdo rje sen mo rdo rje gdong / /de bzhin rked pa khro rgyal po/ /khro bo spyi gtsug rgyal po dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po lu gu rgyud/ /rdo rje gnam lcags rdo rje dbyig /rdo rje khro bo yan lag drag /rdo rje rkang gdub dzi)rdor don yod/ /rdo rje zhabs dang de bzhin mthil / /dam tshig rdo rje rgyal po 'di/ /rdo rje yi ni rigs su bshad/ /de dag la sogs rgyal po ni/ /rgyal po chen po rdzu 'phrul che/ /byang chub sems las yang dag byung / /rtag tu gzhan yang grangs 7med pa/ /khros pas rang gi sha za zhing / /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab par gnas/ / bskal pa (nyayi ni me ltar 'bar / /rdo rje khro bos dkyil 'khor ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni bskyed yinanas kyang / /rab tu drag 'dzin bka' bsgos yi pas/ /gdug 8pa rnams ni 'dul bar gyis/ /84—671

nga yi bka' yang mnyan par gyis/ /rdo rje can kun rang nyid kyi/ /bka' thob nas ni gzung ①bya ste/ /lha rnams kun gyi gsung gcig gis/ /rig pa 'di ni brjod ②par gyur/ /oṃ ni sum+bha ①badz+ra byas phaṭa/ rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ /gtsug tor la ⑤sogs kun gsungs pa/ /lha chen la sogs gdug ⑥pa rnams/ /'og tu kha bltas (pe'agyel bar gyur/ /rdo rje khro bo stobs po chesabya/ /lha rnams brgyal 6)bar gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'bar zhes pas/ /snying po dag ni yang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ⑩ra ṇa skye phaṭa/ khro bo chen po rdo rje'i me/ /skad cig de las byung nas ni/ /lha rnams de dag bsregs chanas kyang / /de bzhin 'og tu bsgyel tibar gyur8/ /rdo rje mes ni rab tu sreg /rdo rje 'bar bas 'bar bar gyur/ /tshig cing btsos 8par ⑩gyur nas ni/ /lha la sogs pa 'o dod 'bod/ /rdo rje khro chen de rnams de/ /de bzhin khro chen la sogs pas/ /thams cad gsung gcig byas nas ni/ /slar yang snying po gsungs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ā ⑩the sha a/ rdo rje dbab pa'i khro ba nye che/ /rdo rje can gyi thugs las byung / /lha rnams kun gyi gnas song nas / /de bzhin lha chen la sogs pa/ /lha rnams kun la yang dag babs/ /rdo rje dbab par rab sdug bsngal/ /byas 6)nas rang gi yan lag dgazho gye /gcig la gcig ni za bar byed/ /rdo rje can dang ( nyabacas pa kun/ /rdo rje zhags pa kho rteyang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la asnyi pra dīp+ta ( nyam hā badz+ra e ku sha ā kur+sha ya hūm̐/ rdo rje lcags kyu rgyal song nas/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag 'gugs9 mi / /lha rnams thams cad bkug nas ni/ /spyi bo ru ni ltung ( gebar byed//rdo rje lcags kyu yang dag 'gugs/ /rdo rje zhags sgo pas drangs par gyur/ /rdo 84—672

rje 'bar bas rab bsregs 6)nas/ /steng du rkang pa 'og tu mgo/ /ha ha zhes ni sgrogs ②byed cing / /'jigs pa'i skad chen ( rasdug bsngal gyuradu/ /rdo rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /stobs chen gzhom par ma mdzad cig /de bzhin lha la sogs pa kun/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dgug par gyur/ /rdo rje can dang bcas kun gyis/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ⑤yang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa ⑥ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha tshogs gdug ⑦pa de dag ni/ /'ching ba lnga yis bcings par gyur / /rdo rje lcags sgrog khro bo che/ /'ching ba brtan ⑧pa bcings par gyur/ /khro bo rdo rje rgyal po che/ /shin tu gtum po 6)stobs chen po7/ /slar yang snying po yang dag dran/ /rang gi snying po yang dag brjod/ /hūṃ/ snying po drag po brjod pa yis/ /gdug pa de rnams rab tu 'gyel(nye/ /g.yo med shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal nye bar 'thobatso/ /de nas rgyal po rnam snang mdzad / /chos kun dbang phyug dbang dang ldan/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'chang la bos par gyur/ /sems dpa' chen po mnyan par gyis/ /'di rnams sems can rab 'jigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di/ /srog ni gzhom par ma byed (nyecig /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje kun bdag dbang ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni thos nas su/ /rig pa 'di ni yang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra ustiṣ+ṭhatso/ rdo rje slong ba rdzu 'phrul che/ /de ni brjod pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha la sogs pa thams cad ni/ /slar yang gson pa nyid du gyur / /sdug bsngal kun dang rab tu phral8/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yizhi bar gyur / /rdo rje slong ba'i byams pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bskul bas / /de nas lha la sogs pa kun/ /sangs rgyas byams pas langs par gyur/ /84—673

thal mo sbyar nas tshig gcig gis/ /bcom ldan 'das la zhus gyur pa/ /bcom ldan nyes pa gang gis 6)ni/ /bdag cag 'di ltar 'dul bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can kun gyis/ /bdag cag yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②bka' stsal pa/ /khyed cag yongs su bskyab ①pa dang / /phan gdags par ni ngas mi nus/ /'di ni drag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ④bdag por ⑤bshad/ /de rnams kyis gsol pa/ khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi yidon/ /ji ltar rung lags mi 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas bdag por gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'phags pa ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑧byang chub gang / /de nas ①rdo rje can du gyur / /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /rdo rje gang yin drag po 'dzin/ /de rnams kyis chagasol pa(nya/ sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni byang chub de dang 8mtshungs/ /brtse dang byang chub sems las byung / /de 'dra'i drag po ga las byung / /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'baka' stsal pa/ /'di ni thabs kyis ⑫'dul ba ste/ /gdug pa thams cad rab 'dul byed/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di/ /byang chub sems las yang dag byung / /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin / /rdo rje khro bo bdag chen pos/ /lha tshogs kun la bos nas ni/ /dbang phyug chen po la gsungs pa/ /nga yi 7bstan pa'i bka' dag ni/ / kye gdug 7pa dag mnyan par gyis/ /min na rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /rigs dang bcas pa nga yis sreg⑩ /khyab 'jug la sogs lha rnams kyis(nya/ /tshig gcig tu ni 'di skad zhus0ste/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin bgyi/ /de nas lha chen gyis smras pa/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin ngas mi shes/ /84—674 byu

nga ni rang nyid rgyal po ste/ /nga yi ①bka' ni mnyan par gyis/ /lha chen po yi tshig gsan nas/ /rdo rje khro bo rab 'bar bas/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin 'joms zhes pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po yang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra ni sum+bha hūm̐/ shin tu gtum pa ②stobs chen po/ /khro bo 'di ni brjod pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po brgyal ③gyur nas/ /de bzhin sa la 'gyel bar gyur/ /g.yo med 'chi ba'i dbang du gyur/ /shing 'gyel bzhin du gnas par gyur/ /'gul ba med cing g.yo ba med/ /rdo rje khro bos gdungs par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dhibaka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje khro bo thams cad mkhyenadu/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di yis ni/ /srog gi rgyu ni zad pa dang / /de nyid nyams par ci phyir byed/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas thugs rjes bskul ⑥ba yin/ /rdo rje tshe zhes ④bya ba ste/ /rdo rje'i rig ⑧pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥl/ rig pa 'di ni brjod pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen pos ⑩yang dag langs/ /rdo rje tshe yis 6nyagason byas nas/ /bde ba chen po thob par gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub chen la/ /zhabs dag la ni btud nas gsol/ /mgon po bcom ldan skyabs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de gdug min/ /kun mkhyen bcom ldan bka' stsal pa/ /nga 8yis brtse yi bar bya mi nus/ /'di ni gdug pa shin tu drag /de nyid la ni skyabs su song / /rdo rje khro bos lha chen po/ /kun du bos nas 'di skad smras/ /nga yis yibastan pa'i bka' dag ni/ /gdug pa chen po mnyan par gyis/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bdag chen la/ /lha chen po yis 8slar smras pa/ /'chi ba chen po bzod nus kyiyi/ /khyod kyi bka' la gnas mi byed/ /rdo rje khro bo drag po che/ /khros pas gdug pa 'phel 'gyur na/lha/ /rgyu ni shin tu 84—675

'jigs byed pa/ /snying po drag po brjod par gyur/ //①/ yi ge hūm̐ ni brjod pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po slar yang 'gyel/ /rdo rje khro bo drag po che/ /rkang par dgug ②pa yang dag brjod/ /oṃ pā ta ā kur+sha ṇa ③badz+ra hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje dbang po 'di/ /brjod pas rdo rje khro bo phyung ④/ /tshig ni 'di skad brjod par gyur(5) / /bka' stsal 6)brjod cing ⑦'od chen po/ /rdo rje khro bos bka' stsal pa//oṃ pā ta ā (shwakar+ṣa ya sarba badz+ra dha yonyer ka tsa ra phaṭa badz+ra rtsu dzaḥkyi/ khro bo chen pos ⑪'di gsungs nas/ /dbang phyug chen po u mar bcas/ /rkang pas 'gugs ⑫pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje rkang pa dag gis bkug /rdo rje khro bos 8de dag bkugarnyi /steng du rkang pa 'og tu mgo/ /'jig rten thams cad dgod 'gyur ⑫cing / /rdo rje gdung bas gdungs par gyur/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbang phyug chen po u mar bcas/ /zhabs kyis yimanan nas rdo rje yis/ /dbang phyug chen po rdeg par byed/ /des yonani rkang pa g.yon pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po mnan byas nas/ /g.yas pas lha mo u ma yi/ /nu ma dag gi bar du btsir/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /dbang phyug chen po rab tu mnan / /oṃ badz+ra ā kra yonyam ho(7/ slar yang dbab pa'i rig pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bos yang dag brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra ā 9 gyebe sha ha na ha na tra ṭa/ dbang phyug chen po bcas ( nyagyur pas/ /rang gi lag pas lan stong du/ /rang gdong 'jigs su rang ni la brdeg ste /stong phrag gcig tu yang dag gyur/ /'jig rten gsum gnas thams cad ni/ /'o dod chen po 'bod par gyur/ /bdag cag gi ④ni rgyal po 'di/ /de da lta bu yi bdag nyid gyur/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /brtse dang snying rje skyes par 'gyur( dzī/ /snying rje steng du gzhug bya ste/ /sangs 84wa 676 ci

rgyas byams pa yang dag brjod/ /oṃ bud dha mi ༷tri rak+ṣa/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin gtso bos/ /de nas sngags ②'di gsungs pa yis/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sdug bsngal de/ /skad cig de la nye bar zhi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs dag gis / /reg dupas dbang phyug chen pos ④ni/ /sa chen po ni yang dag 'thob/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs ⑤de bzhin/ /tha mal pa yi lus bor nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phul bar gyur/ /lha chen 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ / shi zhing yilus ni bor nas su/ /gang gā gsum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing dang mnyam / /thal bas g.yogs pa'i gnas zhes pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni yid 'ong bske/ /de ru song nas lha chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang bstan ⑧par gyur/ /thal ba'i dbang phyug sgra 6)dbyangs can/ /de bzhin gshegs pa der gnas gyur//de nas shi ba'i lus de yis/ /ched du brjod pa yang dag brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu yis ni/ /tshigs bcad gcig ni mngon par brjod/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi0/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /bsad 7nas skad cig bdag tigis ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas dgod mdzad/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po ches/ /dbang phyug chen po yang dag phyung / /khyab 'jug la sogs lha rnams la/ /kun du bos nas 'di gsungs pa/ /rab mchog dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /gtso bo rab tu zhugs 8par gyis/ /gal te de bzhin mi byed na/ /dbang phyug chen po bzhin du bya/ /de nas lha kun 'jigs gyur te/ /skrag ⑫nas thams cad kyis zhus 8pa/ /de bzhin du ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag cag khyed ⑩kyi bran du gyur/ /rgyal po khyod 0kyi dam tshig ni/ /ji ltar bsgrub (nyepar mi bgyid lags/ /bdag cag rnams ni khyod kyi 'khor/ / bskal pa ⑪84—677
