sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas/ /ri rab tu ni kun du 'dus/ /rdo rje lcags kyus bkug nas ni/ /'bar ba dang bcas 'bar bar gyur①/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas rtsig② /smras pa rdo rje 'dzin pas skyobs②/ /skal chen rdo rje can gyis dugasungs / /kye gdug ①tshogs chen po 0myur ba ru/ /gsod pa spongs la bka' nyan gyis/ /de dag re re zhing smras pa/ /bdag cag 'di rnams sha za ste/ /gang zhig rtag tu gson gyur pa/ /bdag cag la ni thabs bstan gsol/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /de yis phyathabs ni 'di gsungs so/ /zla gcig lon nas shi ba gang / /de ni bza' ba blang bar gyis/ /byang chub sems la chags bral nas/ /gsang ba smod pa lhur len pa/ /khyod dang lhan cig yang dag sbyor/ /de bza' ba ni gnang bar gyis/ /phyag rgya yi ni snying po 'di/ /rtag tu bcang bar bya ba ste/ /phyi rol thams cad spangs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhu)bar gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra pra ti kṛ ṇ+ḍa skṛ ⑨da ya ā man+ta ya/ tsar+ya ⑩yaṃ me sa rnyo (1dhe na mi ni ya te tihā (nyes ri dha yiyi niṣ+ka ma du sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ/ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan/ /khro bo ⑩spyi gtsug rgyal po ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni de yis tshuspros/ /gal te dam tshig las 'das na/ /khro bo bdag nyid chen po yi/ tre/ /rtag tu mgo bo 'gas 'byed cing / /rigs dang bcas pa nges par sreg /bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal po zhes/ /bya ba de 'dra'i ting 'dzin la/ /sems dpa' chen po snyoms zhugs nas/ /nad kyi don du tshol bar gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tu)bka' stsal pa/ /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sems can thams cad 'jig ru )byed pas/ /nad rnams thams cad bkug nas ni/ /'gugs pa yi ni snying po brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra — 84—685

sa ma ya ā 6)na ya sarba duṣ+ṭa dzā ra ṇi ②gi nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas brjod pa tsam gyis kyang / /nad dang gdon gyi tshogs kun dang / /rims ①sogs kyis ni de thos ④nas/ /steng du rkang pa phyi'og tu mgo/ /'bar ba'i me dang yang dag ldan / /ha ha zhes sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /bdag cag rigs ni ma gzhom par / /khro bo chen po bka' stsol cig /rdo rje rnal 'byor chen pos gsungasayi/ / nga yi 9)bka' ni rab tu nyon/ /sems can nye bar 'joms pa spongs/ /mdangs kyang 'phrog par ma byed cig /de rnams kyis nismras pa/ kye dzi)rgyal po rdo rje bdag cag gis7/ /srog gi srung skyob mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag kun nas snyigazi brjid za/ /thabs ni cung 0zad brtsam du gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /de nas stobs chen gyis smras pa/ / nga yi 8sngags dang phyag rgya dag /gang zhig bsrung tshul gnod ma byed/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma bi sho dha ya sarba ā pa ⑩ra ṇa ni tshabud dha satwa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas phyag rgya chen po kun/ /theg pa chen por 3nyamangon bsdus pa/ /mdo sde gsang ba rgyal po las(7 yongs su bshad pa thams cad kun/ /sngags dang phyag rgya gnas gang na/ /rtag par rab tu sbyong byed pas/ /gnas de ru yang rtag pa ru/ /khyed sum̐ )rnams shin tu gnod ma byed/ /de skad gsungs pas gdon kun ni/ /hi hi zhes ni sgrogs par gyur/ /spyi bo'i rnal 'byor pa la ni/ /gnod pa byed pa thams cad gtad sto / /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /kun mchog gnas kyi dbang phyug gis / /sdig pa bral 32ba'i phyag rgya che/ /blo gros chen po snyoms par zhugs/ /ngan song bcing bar bya ba'i phyir/ /mgon po dag la bka' nod byed/ /mgon chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /kun nas snying po brjod par gyur/ /84—686

oṃ k+ṣe ①pa ya badz+ra swā srihā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thabs chen po/ /rdo rje las ni yang dag byung / /sems can rnams la brtse bya'i ①phyir/ /sdig pa thams cad bkug par dugyur/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ a pā ya na dubi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/de skad brjod nas rnal 'byor ches/ /skad 0cig gis ni ngan song bkug /ri yi rgyal po nye ba ru/ /ngu 'bod la sogs snang bar gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnal 'byor ches/ /ngan song sems can la smras pa/ /dkon mchog gsum dang nga bstan la/ /myur du bstan pa skyabs su song / /de dag thams cad kyis smras pa / /stobs chen bdag cag bskyab ⑦tu gsol/ /gtso bos ji skad bka' stsal pa / /de bzhin du ni bgyi bar 'tshal/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sdig pa dral ba nges 'ching ba/ /sdig pa thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /mchog tu gsang ba gsungs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra pā (nya'i bi sbo 6)( ya/ sarba a pā ⑩ya bhan dha nā ⑩ni pra mo k+ṣa ya sar+pā pā 8ya ga ta tunyebyaḥ/ sarba sa(8/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tā 8tha/ sems can ngan song rgyu can rnams/ /rig pa 'di yis dbang bskur ⑩bas/ /ngan song 'khor lo dral bar gyur/ /rgya mtsho ru ni rab tu ltung / /de bzhin ngan song shi 'phos nas/ /de kun rab tu grol bar gyur / /sdug bsngal ( 7kun las rab tu grol/ /rdo rje dbang po'i gnas thob gyur / /de bzhin thub pa rnam snang gi/ /zhabs drung du ni skyes par gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mthu yis ni/ /de bzhin mi khom zad par gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mthu yis ni/ /de nas skad cig des zhi thob/ /rmad byung (〈sna tshogs gsang chen po/ /cho 'phrul dag ni skyes par gyur(6/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /rdo rje rin chen rang bzhin gnas/ /rin chen bdun gyis rab tu 84—687

spras / /rdo rje rin chen gyis rab mdzes/ /de yi rigs kyi nang ①song kun/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ /sems can bde ba skyes par gyur/ /rdo rje bde ba yang dag ldan/ /mchog chen po yi zhing 'di ni/ /dag ②pa'i zhing du rab tu grags/ /sems can dag pa kun du khyab/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rdor rang bzhin/ /slar yang shing gi nags la ①sogs/ /rmad byung 0chen po snang ba med/ /rin chen sna bdun rang bzhin kun/ /nags dang rtswa las duskyes par gyur/ / mthon dman ⑥dag dang rnam par bral/ /lag mthil bzhin du mnyam par snang / /ka tsa li ltar reg na bde/ /stong gsum rab tu gnas par gyur/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug ⑦bsngal kun/ /dang por ningan song nye bar zhi/ /bkres 6)skom pa yi sdug bsngal dag /kun du 'gags par mnyam ⑩par gnas/ /rgya mtsho kun du thim par gyur/ /ri bo gzugs kyang kun du khyab//gzhan 'phrul gyi ni lha rnams dang / /mtshungs pa ru ni mi rnams gyur/ /slar yang mu khyud 'khor lo med6nye/ /ri rab man+da 8ra dag med/ /lha yi 'jig rten gnas kyang med/ /rgya mtsho med cing lha min med/ /klu yi gnas gzhi tsodag kyang med/ /mi yi khyim dang khang 7pa med/ /grong khyer ljongs dang yul 'khor dang —/ /phug dang bcas par rnam par bral/ /mi yi gnas kyange med pa nyid/ /chu bo phug dang lung pa med/ /mi dag gi ni lus kyang med/ /sems can 'ga' yang 'dir mi snang / /ngan song 'khor lo dag kyang med/ /mi khom med cing sdug bsngal med/ /bud med skyes pa la sogs med/ /rnga mo glang po lug kyang med / /dpag bsam shing dang spos kyi shing / /rin chen sna bdun rang bzhin mdzes / /spos kyi chu yi rgya mtsho dang / /rin chen sna tshogs rnams kyis snyimadzes/ /84—688

shing ni yid 'ong ①thams cad la/ /rol mo'i sgra ni mngon par phyung ②/ /rol mo'i ①chos kyi sgra dag kyang / /stong gsum du ni yongs su byung / /ji ltar rdo rje dbang po yiX/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo ltar/ /de bzhin stong gsum gyi ni gnas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'od 'bar gyuradu/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /gru bzhir rab tu gnas par gyur/ /kun nas phyi rol gnas rnams ni/ /kha khyer du yang snang bar gyur/ /slar yang nyi ma zla ba med/ /skar ma med cing dulha yang med / /rang gi ༷khang pa'i nang du yang / /lha rnams nyid kyang mthong mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyis (kyeyongs su gsal/ /'od zer sna tshogs yid 'phrog pa/ /gang gis zhing ni yang dag sbyangs/ /rdo rje rin chen yid 'ong ba6)/ /rdo rje dbang po'i gnas 0nyid kyang / /slar yang snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du gzhi ni gcig pa'i gnas/ /gang du sangs rgyas rnam yi'aphrul pa/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /lha yi pad+ma yongs su gsal/ /rin chen sna bdun rab tu mdzes/ /dri yi tshogs ni yid 'ong ldan/ /bskal pa chen po'i zhing gi dbus//dkyil 'khor shin tu sdug steng du/ /dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad ༷cu yi/ /rdo rje seng ge'i khri byung gyur/ /kun nas phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /dpag tshad stong phrag drug cu ldan/ /rdo rje rin chen rang bzhin mdzes/ /seng ge'i khri ni bzhi byung gyur/ /rdo rje bla re rnam par bresa'/ /dar gyi chun pos rnam par 'phyang / /dril bu'i dra ba rnam par 'phyang / /zhing ni kun nas yirab tu spras/ /me tog sna tshogs kun du bkram/ /sna tshogs sprin gyis rab tu g.yogs/ /sna tshogs dri yis tsokun du khyab/ /dpag bsam shing gis nye bar spras/ /dpag bsam shing ni yid 'ong ldan/ /rdo rje'i rol mo mdzes pa dag /sgra ni mngon 84—689

par 'byin par byed/ /'di nyid dang ni lhan cig zhing / /sgrib pa med pa'i rang bzhin du/ /phyogs rnams kun du snang bar gyur/ /slar yang 'jigs yonyepar 'gyur ba med/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten 'di/ /gang gā'i bye snyed grangs med pa/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su gsal/ /til gyi gang bu gang ba bzhin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su gsal / /phyogs rnams kun nas ma lus par/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dir gshegs 'gyur/ /dbus kyi seng ge'i gdan dag la/ /chos dbyings 'jigs pa med pa la/ /rnam par snang mdzad stobs chen po/ /ston pa bcom ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /shar du yang ni mi bskyod ②pa/ /lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /nub tu 'od dpag med pa yin/ /byang du don yod grub pa ste/ /mgon po chen po phyogs bzhi ru/ /rdo rje yi ni steng du bzhugs/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag tu ni/ /mnyam du dmigs nas rnam par gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings nas bstan ①par gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan par bzhugs/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas grangs med thams cad ni/ /rdo rje can ni lnga la bzhugs/ /phyogs ni re rer khyab gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas ④gcig gis yang dag bzhugs/ /mtshams dang steng dang 'og dag gi/ /rnam snang mdzad kyis brtan (gepar mdzad//chos kyi dbyings ni brtan gyur pa/ /dbus kyi 6)phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de nas sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul pa/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs snying po/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rang nyid kyi/ /seng ge'i khri ni lnga la bzhugs/ /grangs med tshad ni med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 84—690

chos nyid ma lus pa/ /ri mo gsal ba dang mtshungs par/ /stong gsum dag ni ma lus gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba che/ /pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs ①par gyur/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo ②yang dag ldan/ /bye ba dag ni grangs med lnga / /sangs rgyas rol pa dang ldan par/ /rdo rje can ni 0thams cad bzhugs//shar gyi cha las ⑤yang dag bzhugs/ /bye ba dag ni grangs med lnga/ /rdo rje rnam 'phrul ston byed pa/ /'khor lo dang ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /lho yi phyogs na thams cad gnas/ /bye ba dag ni grangs med lnga/ /rin chen rnam 'phrul yang dag ldan/ /'khor lo dang ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /bye ba dag ni grangs med lnga / /nub kyi phyogs na stiyang dag gnas/ /pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul ston byed pa/ /'khor lo dang ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /bye ba dag ni grangs med lngal/ /byang gi phyogs na rnam par gnas/ /las kyi rnam 'phrul ston byed pa/ /'khor lo dang ldan bzhugs par gyur/ /gsang dang mchod pa gang yin dang / /lha mo rdo rje lha mo ni/ /grangs med tshad ni med pa dag /bcu gnyis kyis ⑧ni dkyil 'khor gang / /sgo srung 5)dag ni grangs med pa/ /rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pa bzhidhi/ /rgyal po shar dang lho dag tu/ /nub dang byang ni 'o)yang dag gnas/ /chos kyi sku las yang dag byung / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa/ /sems dpa' chen po 'di 'dag kun/ /chos dang longs spyode rdzogs las (nyebyung / /gang zhig phyogs bcu dag gi yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i sa thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang 'dir 'ongs pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni gang gā yi/ /bye ma dang mnyam ji snyed pa/ /yongs su gang bar gyur pa'i tshogs/ /de dag thams cad yang dag gshegs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 84—691

mthu yis 6)ni/ /zhing dag rgya ni chen por gyur/ /yul rnams thams cad bya ba yang —/ /gnod pa med cing 'tshe ba'ang med/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten pa'i / /ji ltar sngon ni bar med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi③ / /bar med pa ni de bzhin gnas/ /gang nas sangs rgyas mi snang ba/ /phyogs ni rdul tsam yod ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor che/ /gang dag sa ni bzhi bcu dang / /yang na chos las byung ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas sras ni grags pa che/ /rigs lnga byung ba la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ston pa dang / /'dir gnas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /mchog rnams phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ②mthong / /sangs rgyas dag ni grangs ④med kun/ /lha rnams yang dag gnas 'di ru/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni mthong bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas dgra bcom ma gtogs (5)par/ /zhing 'dir 'ga' yang mthong ma gyur / /rdo rje rigs kyi 'khor lo min/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni tshogs kyang min/ /dbus dang phyogs 96)ni yang dag bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni mthong bar gyur/ /dbang phyug chen po gnod byed pa'i/ /rdo rje khro bo mthong bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas lnga dang de bzhin du/ /khro bo drug bdun rnam par gnas/ /tshangs sogs lha rnams de dag kyang / /ngo mtshar dag ni skyes par gyur/ /'jigs shing skrag nas lha de dag /gcig la gcig ni smra bar byed/ /gtso bo ji bzhin mthong 'gyur zhing / /shin tu ngo mtshar ci zhig snang / /slar yang lha yi 'jig rten dag /srid pa nang du mthong mi 'gyur(pe/ /'gro ba lnga yi sems can min/ /ri rab dang ni rgya mtsho min/ /zla ba nyi ma ma mthong zhing / /ri dang khang pa dag kyang min/ /ci bdag cag ni rmongs gyur tam/ /yang na mig ni long bar gyur//84wa 692

yang na bdag cag sems g.yengs pa/ /sgyu ma'i rnam ①'phrul 'di ci ②zhig /bdag cag gis ni sngar 'jigs mthong / /drag cing bkug nas thal bar byas/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo ru/ /sdug bsngal ②chen pos gzir bar gyur/ /slar yang ri rab yod ma yin/ /khro bo rdzu 'phrul chen po med/ /gzhan dang khro bo chen po gcig /dbang phyug chen po gnod par byed/ /gnas ni chung ngur gyur pa yang ske/ /rgya chen po ru 'di ru snang / /stong gsum 'di yang mi snang ste/ /bdag cag 'jig rten gzhan du phyin/ /de ltar brjod pa sna tshogs pa/ /gcig la gcig ni smra bar byed/ /mi smra bar ni gnas gyur nas/ /rdo rje can la lta bar byed/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po sha za sogs/ /gdug pa kun dang dugadon sogs kyisadu/ /mun par khyab pa bzhin du ni/ /stong gsum 'di ni dumathong bar gyur/ /gzhan ni cung zad ma mthong ste/ /gzhan du phyogs dag mun pas khyab/ /rdo rje khro bo 'khrul gyur cing / / sgyu ma yis ni rmongs gyur cing / /⑦kun du rmongs pa nyid gyur cing ⑧/ /gcig la gcig ni rmongs par gyur / /ha ha zhes bya'i sgra sgrogs shing / /bdag cag 'dir ni gang du phyin/ /tshig ni rab tu rjod 6)byed cing / /gcig la gcig ni smra bar byed/ /'di ni su zhig bdag cag gang / /'di ni su yi gam du phyin/ /bdag cag rang gi gnas na ltung / /bdag cag 'jig rten ⑩gzhan du phyin/ /rdo rje khro bos gsad par ⑪gyur / /'o na 'di ni ci zhig yin/ /lha yi gnas kyang ma mthong bzhin/ /rdo rje can yang mthong ma 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo min/ /bdag cag rnams ni mun par gyur/ /rang gi gnas kyang ma mthong zhing / /ri rab nyid kyang mthong ma gyur/ /mtsho dang rgya mtsho dag kyang min/ /skar ma zla ba nyi 84—693

ma min/ /bdag cag thams cad gang nas 'ongs/ /yul gang zhig tu 'gro bar bya/ /'gro ba lnga yang yod ma yin/ /'jig rten med cing ma mo med/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa dag /rnam pa kun du mthong ma gyur/ /sngon ①ni ji ltar de bzhin phyis/ /rmad du byung ba nyid ma gyur/ /gzhan du sa ni g.yos par gyur/ /rlung dag gis ni rnam par bskyod/ /'brug gi sgra dang glog chen po/ /sdug bsngal thams cad yang dag ldan/ /bkres skom la sogs sdug bsngal dang / /bral min kun du sdug bsngal gyur/ /der ni lha chen rdzu ②'phrul dag /cung zad kyang ni mthong ma gyur/ /dmyal ba yi dgas 6)dud 'gro dag /rnam par nyams shing bshig par gyur/ /sdig pa dral ba'i phyag rgya yis④/ /ngan song gsum ni nye bar zhi/ /lha gang 'du shes med pa dang / /gzugs med pa na spyod par gnas / /phung po lnga ru rang bdag nyid/ /ngo mtshar de bzhin mthong gyur nas/ /rang 957nyid la'ang rtog par byed/ /gcig la gcig kyang lta bar byed/ /de bzhin thams cad skrag cing 'jigs/ /ngo mtshar gyur pa 'di ci zhig /tshad med bskal pa chen po ru/ /bdag cag dag par gnas par gyur/ /bdag mchog las ni bdag cag grol/ /slar yang bdag tu 'dzin par gyur/ /sngon gyi bag chags mngon 'dod la/ /srid gsum gnas nas (5)mthong bar gyur/ /srid pa gsum yang mthong ma yin/ /de bzhin 'gro ba lnga yang med/ /gzhan du shin tu dag par 97gcig /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa (9sprul/ /sangs rgyas lnga nyid mthong bar gyur/ /srid gsum gnas ni gzhan dag min/ /tshogs la thams cad mnyes par gyur/ /gcig la gcig ni smra bar byed/ /'di ni su zhig bdag cag gang / /bdag cag 'jig rten gzhan du phyin/ /sngon nas 6nye84—694

bdag gis ①'jig rten 'di/ /'gro ba lnga bcas de bzhin du/ /ri rab dang ni rgya mtshor bcas/ /lha rnams drug ni 'khor bcas mthong / /srid pa gsum gyi lha rnams ni/ /gang zhig 'di ni mthong ma gyur/ /gzhal yas khang dang sems can ni/ /gtso bo ji bzhin mthong bar gyur/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar sna tshogs pa/ /gnas chen 'di ru mthong bar gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ②rol ba yin/ /gang zhig stong gsum 'di yi ③ni/ /rang rgyal thams cad ④mchog gyur pa/ /de yang kun du rmongs gyur nas / /rnam par 'phrul pa'ang mthong ma gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang mthong ma yin / /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyang min/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan zhi ba/ /gnas ni de ru mthong ma gyur/ /gzhan du stong ni gsum po 'di/ /rnam pa kun du ma mthong nyid/ /sa dang me dang chu khams min/ /gser gyi dkyil 'khor dag kyang (nyemin/ /'gro ba lnga yi sems can min/ /zla ba nyi ma dag kyang min/ /skar ma gza' (6)dang rgyu (7)skar min/ /sems can dag kyang khams gsum min/ /'di dag thams cad stong par gyur/ /gzhan du nam mkha' (kyidakyil 'khor min//de dag thams cad 'jigs skrag nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa nye bar thob/ /gang yang 6)phyogs rnams bcu po yi/ /nyan thos 'jigs pa med pa rnams/ /byang sems can ni chen po yis/ /de dag kun nas 'oskrag par gyur/ /rang rang gi ni zhing dag tu/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang mthong ma gyur/ /'dus pa chen po dag dang ni/ /chos rnams ston pa dag kyang min/ /zhing de yi ni sems can min/ /lha dang mi rnams dag kyang min/ /khang pa med cing zhing yang med/ /sa dang me yi ridang rlung yang med/ /rang gi zhing yang ma mthong zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' 84—695

'jigs par gyur/ /skad cig gis ①ni mi dgar gyur/ /thang cig tu ni rmongs par gyur/ /de lta bu yi rnam 'phrul du/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu snang / /sngon gyi bskal ba chen po la/ /'khor lo rnam par 'phrul pa bstan/ /bcom ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de lta bu ni byin gyis brlabasaphyi/ /sems can gang dag 'di na gnas/ /nyin dang mtshan mo mi shes gyur/ /de nas de nyid gsang ba che/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan ①pa'i tshogs/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de lta bu yi rnam 'phrul byung / /stong gsum yongs su bsdus pa yi/ /lha yi gnas ni bkod par gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas gcig pu/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /la lar sngon pos ④rab tu mdzes / /sa yi phyogs ni rab tu spras/ /rdo rje sngon pos rab tu brgyan⑤/ /la lar gser gyi mdog tu snang / /kha dog ser pos rnam par brgyan⑥/ /sa yi cha yang rab tu spras/ /rdo rje ser pos rab tu brgyan⑦/ /la lar kha dog dmar po ni / /byi garu lta bus rab tu mdzes/ /sa yi cha yang rab tu spras/ /rdo rje dmar pos rab tu brgyan6)/ /la lar btsag yigi mdog can gyi/ / be+e ḍūr+ya tunyematshungs rab tu mdzes/ /sa yi cha yang rnam par spras/ /rdo rje btsod kyis ⑩rnam par mdzes / /la lar shel gyi mdog can gyis(/sre/ /shin tu snang bas rab tu mdzes/ /sa yi cha 7yang rnam par spras/ /rdo rje shel gyis 7rnam par brgyanayi/ /shar du sngon po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste//byang ni btsod yodang yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha dag ni/ /shel gyi mdog can bla na med/ /rdo rje chen pos shin tu dag /tshon rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin bshad / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rab tu mdzes/ /cha 84—696 ri

mnyam legs par bgos pa ste/ /go rims ①dang ni yang dag ldan/ /kun nas phyi rol gnas dag na/ /rdo rje kha khyer yang dag ldan/ /kun nas kha khyer dang ldan zhing / /sgo yi kha khyer dag gis spras/ /ri mo rdo rje sngo rang bzhin/ /gzhan yang gser gyi mdog can dang / /kha dog dmar po mchog dang ni/ /gzhan yang shel ni bzang po dag /rin chen kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs mdzes gyur pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /rdo rje lha mo'i (mitshogs kyis mchod/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes/ /g.yer ku'i nidra bas kun du khebs/ /dril bu'i mchog ni kun du 'phyang / /sna tshogs shing ni yid 'ong ldan/ /dpag bsam shing ni yid 'ong ldan / /spos dang me tog de bzhin dri/ /snang ba'i shing mchog yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs bkod pa nye bar ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /mtsho mchog chu yis ligang bar gyur/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho rgya chen ldan/ /me tog sna tshogs kun du bkram / /sna tshogs bdug (5)pa dag gis bdugs6)/ /sna tshogs dri yi chu yis ⑦gtor / /sna tshogs dri yis (0kun du khyab/ /drag po chen po sras bcu dag /de nas nyams dga' ba dag byung / /shing dang pad sogs thams cad las/ /chos rnams 'byung ba kyi)thos par gyur/ /phyogs rnams kun du rnam phyung nas/ / dag pa'i yizhing du stong nyid bcas/ /rnam par sgra ni gang zhig grag /chos kyi bde ba 'byung skyobar 'gyuratso/ /yaṃ/ lo/ shaṃ/ boyin/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dhā skiya rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha yi.ā gar+sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha yirā ga 4)ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra duji kro dha ya sā dhu sā dhu nyu rtsu phaṭa/ khro bo rdo rje rin chen mchog /'bar ba'i phreng ba bkod dka' yi bas/ /khro bo rdo rje bla na med/ /mchog tu 84—697

gsang ba gsungs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra skṛ hu)ku ṭi (9gro dha ha na rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya ma hā dz+wa la mā la kro dha ②dzñā ④'a ⑤ya sarba rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu ma hā kro dha dhe na dus phaṭa/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa hā sa badz+ra mas hā sa gro dha ha ha ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po rdo rje chos/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab gyur pas/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rab bzod dka'/ /mchog tu 'jigs su rung ba smras/ /oṃ ⑦badz+ra dharma bi sho (midha ya rdzu phaṭa/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha 6) kro dha tshin+da ⑩/ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra te tu kro dha pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍa lo sarba rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bhā (nyaṣa ta pā ta rtsu phaṭa/ rdo rje las ni rgyal po che/ /gsang ba thams cad kun bsdus pas/ /'bar ba gsal 8bas khyab pa byung / /khro bo rgyal pos brjod par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kurma kro tsodha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā da khā da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha muṣ+ṭi sā dha ya sa ma ya 8rgyu phaṭa/ sems dpa' 'di rnams gsang ba che zhi ba'i gzugs las rnam par gyur/ /rdo rje khro bo drag po che/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs gyur/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che / /gsang ba 'di rnams yongs su brjod/ /mchod pa'i lha mos gsungs par gyur / /oṃ badz+ra lā phye spyon ga ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā le ⑩a bhi ṣiñtsa 7ya hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra gī h+ye gā tunyeta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ h+ye (7ba shi ( )ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra put+pa ( ཿpū dzā ( )spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan dha so)pu dz+dza (gespa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhi phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pa 'o snapu dzā ( s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa(nya/ oṃ badz+ra ā so)lo kai khri 7pū dzā (1sga ra ṇa sa ma ye rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo drag po shin tu gdug /rdo rje khro bo rab gtum pa/ /sgo sung snyedag ni kun du byung / /oṃ e ku sha ma hā kro dha ā kur+sha ya sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ(nya/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha ma hā kro dha 84wa 698

pra be sha ya sarba ①sa ma ya ②rgyu /①/ oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa ④ma hā kro dha ban dha ya sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā 0be sha ma hā gro dha ā ༷be sha ya sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaX /hoḥni / 'khor ṇilo yongs su zlum por ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur/ /khro bo chen po'i tshogs kyis ⑩khyab/ /dkyil 'khor chen po yang dag ldan/ /gnas chen po dang yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor chen por yonyakun bsdus pas/ /shin tu gsang ba chos chen po/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /de nyid snying po gsang ba che/ /thar pa chen po grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor rgyal po chen po ste/ /sems can don kun yang dag ldan/ /chos nyid rdzogs par byang chub pa/ /'di 'dra chos dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /rigs lnga'i gsang ba gang yin pa/ /gdon mi za bar byed pa yiX/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs zhi ba/ /gang phyir dag pa'i tshogs chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i rigs drag po4)/ /gang phyir lha chen rab 'dul byed/ /lha chen la sogs sprul byed pa/ /de bzhin pad+ma'igo rigs mchog ste/ /gang phyir gdul bya'i sems can rnams/ /sprul pa sna tshogs yang dag byung / /sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhi ba ste/ /drag po'i mchod pa rab bskor yib/ /sna tshogs rigs can 'khor lo ste/ /rigs bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs mchog ni/ /shar gyi 'khor lo yang dag byung / /de nas rdo rje'i rigs drag po/ /sems can don du yang dag 'jigs//rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po 'di/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs ni kun bsdus 7pa/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug rgyal po che/ /gang phyir gsang ba'i bdag por bshad/ /rdo rje thams cad kun bsdus pa/ /rang gi rigs mchog bshad nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po ches/ /dkyil 'khor chen po kun du sprul/ /lha la sogs pa 84—699

gdug 0)pa kun/ /skad cig de la yang dag bkug /slar ni bcug par byas nas kyang / /skad cig gis ni dam tshig phog /rdo rje mtshan ma'i dbang bskur ②bske/ /dam tshig ldan pa byin nas ni/ /bkug ste rab tu bcug nas kyang / /de bzhin bcings te dbang du byas/ /dam tshig la ni brtson byas te/ /dam tshig sdom pa de bzhin no/ /mi rnams la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni gsungs par gyur/ /'khor lo chen po grong khyer che/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po ste/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes bya ba/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /'jig rten gsum tshogs pham byas nas/ /lha la sogs pa rab bcug gyural/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gnas/ /'khor lo chen po grong khyer che/ /gang ming gzung ④ba tsam nyid kyis(zhe/ /sems can rab tu bcom nas ni/ /gdon la sogs pa 'bros par byed/ /rims dang gdon dang dug dag dang / /drag po gdug pa dam tshig dang / /mtshan bzang 6)ba yi mod nyid la/ /skrag pa dang ni g.yo bar gyur/ /sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchog /mi gang dag ni gdul bya min/ /de bas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sprul par gyur / /rdo rje slob dpon skal ba che/ /shin tu byang zhing rab tu mkhas/ /dgongs pa yi ni cho ga shes/ /gzhung (7rnams thos shing don la mkhas/ /rab tu dang zhing blo ldan brtan/ /rigs 957dang rigs min rab tu shes/ /byang chub sems la brtson par gyur/ /lha gzhan dag la 'dod ldan min/ /gsang ba'i snying po mchog mthong ba/ /snying rje bdag nyid brtser ldan pa/ /dag cing des la rnam par dul/ /rang gi ngang gis (9)rnam par gnas/ /zhen cing chags la gdug pa min/ /rmongs pa med cing le lo med/ / brtse ldan 7phan pa'i bsam 84—700

pa can/ /rtag ①tu rnam par dgod rgyal dga'/ /gzugs sogs ③'dod pa'i yon tan la/ /chags shing lhag par rgyal gyur nas/ /srid la sems ni skrag par byed/ /srid la mngon par chags pa ④med/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul la brtson / /theg pa gzhan la 'dod ldan min/ /sems can kun gyi ⑤don la brtson / /dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog byung ba/ /nyon mongs kun du chags pa spangs / /gnyen po dag ni rab tu bsgom/ /'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs che/ /mi sdug pa la sogs pa bsgom/ /rigs dang rigs min cho ga shes / /sngags dang phyag rgya shin tu mkhas/ /dgug dang gzhug yidang bcing ba dang / /dbang du bya dang gshegs gsol dang / /ji skad rdo rje dbyings bshad yinagaske/ /sngon du rig pa'i brtul zhugs ⑧bya/ /kha na ma tho rdul tsam la/ /kun du 'dzem ⑨par bya ba yin/ /tshad ⑩dang tshon rtsi srad bu dang / /yo ⑩byad cho ga yang dag ldan/ /bcing dang phur bus gdab pa nyid/ /sngar bshad rdo rje dbyings bzhin du/ /bza' ba dang ni mi bza' ba/ /rdo rje snyems 8tshul ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdo rje dbyings sogs dkyil 'khor du/ /sngar ni ji ltar de bzhin bya/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje dbyings dang rab tu mtshungs/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i mchog /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyanasnyi/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar gyi chun pos rnam par brgyanayi/ /rgya cher ji ltar rigs skepa ru/ /ji bzhin rdo rje grong khyer che/ /rdo rje dbyings dang rab tu mtshungs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i grong khyer bri/ /'khor lo lnga dang yang dag ldan / /ka ba brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /de dbus rang bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /84—701

dbus su sangs rgyas dgod par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad ston pa che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'od po che/ /hu)byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs dkyil 'khor/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar rdo rje ni/ /'bar ba'i dbus su dgod par bya/ /rdo rje me ltar 'bar nyid ni/ /phyag rgya 'jig rten gsum 'joms pa/ /g.yas su rin chen phyag rgya ni/ /'bar ba'i dbus su dgod ②par bya/ /g.yon du pad+ma'i phyag rgya bri/ /rgyab tu rdo rje rnon po ni/ /'bar ba'i dbus su dgod (kyepar bya/ /phyag rgya yi ni rgyal po bzhi/ /'bar ba'i me dang rab tu ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor che/ /chos dbyings grong khyer chen po la/ /'khor los sgyur ④ba bzhi po yi/ /phyag rgya dag kyang dgod par bya/ /gang dang gang gi thig gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor shes rab can thig gdab/ /rdo rje yi ni sngags 'di yis/ /rdo rje'i thig ni yongs su gzung 957/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru traṃ mā ti kra ma rtsu/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsdus ⑥pa yi/ /rdo rje shugs kyis 97song nas kyang / /rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs bsdus (7pa/ /rgyal po bri zhing dgod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā 99)kra ma hūm̐/ tshon rtsi thams cad yang dag ldan/ /'bar ba'i lta bas thams cad blta7/ /rdo rje tshon rtsi bkye (nyabya zhing / /rdo rje sngags ni rab tu bskul/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi ()tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ phyag rgya gang zhig dgod par du/ /snying po thams cad dgod par bya/ /sngar ni dgod pa gang yin pa/ /rdo rje gzugs ni skor 1 byed pa/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /rdo rje rig 7pa mchog rgyal po/ /mi bskyod 7shin tu mnyam bzhag pa/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /mche ⑫ba dag ni cung tshozad gtsigs/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'bar bas khyab/ /phyag na 84—702

phyag rgya dang bcas mtshon/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya ni/ /steng du phyag gnyis yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin kho nar phyag gnyis dag /lcags kyu 'phyar ①ba yang dag ldan/ /phyag gcig gis ni zhags pa bsnams②/ /gcig gis ③rdo rje yang dag bsnamasasti/ /mda' 'gengs pa yi phyag rgya dang / /phyag gnyis dag ni shin tu ldan/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya stergya/ /dbang phyug chen po kun du mnan/ /g.yas pas lha mo u 6)ma yi/ /nu ma'i bar du gnon par byed/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad dug/ /rdo rje khro bo dgod par bya/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab cing 'bar/ /khro bo 'jigs par byed pa mchog /mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /g.yas su rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje chags (kyepa ste/ /rgyab tu rdo rje legs pa'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /lho ru khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /khro bo'i rgyal po khro gnyer can/ /khro bos yongs su bskor bar po)bri/ /thams cad 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab/ /gdong ni khro bcas bzhad ldan pa/ /rdo rje dbang phyug phyag rgyar ldan/ /khro gnyer can ni yongs su brjod/ /de yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rdo rje khro bo bdag nyid che/ /sngags dang phyag rgya tsoyongs su bsdutunya/ /rang gi gnas su yang dag bri/ /mdun du rdo rje rin chen te//g.yas su khro bo gzi brjid do/ /g.yon du rgyal mtshan drag po ste/ /rgyab tu khro bo bzhad pa'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /nub kyi phyogs su dkyil 'khor ni/ /khro bo chen po rdo rje ste/ /khro bdag chen po rnams kyis bskora'i/ /rdo rje chos ni mdun du ste/ /rdo rje rnon po g.yas su'o/ /de bzhin g.yon dzinadu rdo rje rgyu/ /rgyab tu rdo rje smra ba'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor dag ni mchog bzhi pa/ /rdo rje dbab pa las chen po/ /khro bo chen pos 84wa 703

yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje las ni mdun du ste/ /g.yas su rdo rje bsrung ①ba'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje gnod sbyin te/ /rgyab tu rdo rje khu tshur ro/ /dbus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhi ru/ /lha mo bzhi ni yang dag bri/ /mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs bri/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor mtshams rnams su / /rdo rje me tog la sogs bri/ /rdo rje dbyings sogs dkyil 'khor du/ /ji skad sngar ②bshad cho ga bzhin/ /sgo bzhi dag ni thams cad du/ /sgo sung ①rnams ni dgod par bya/ /lcagal kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu dbab pa bla na med/ /rang gi phyag rgya snying gar ④bzhag /rang rang gi ni snying po yis/ /rdo rje dril bu yid 'ong ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnam par dgod//bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo ni/ /gtso bo rdo rje rig pa mchog /rdo rje rgyal po mchog byin brlabazho)/ /rang nyid rdo rje dkyil 'khor mchog /de yis khyadakyil 'khor de bris nas/ /rdo rje ti rin gti ri 'jug(kye /yang dag par ni brtag ⑨byas la/ /lan bdun du ni bskor ba bya/ /chad pa yigang yin yongs su dag /mkhas pas lhag par dbri (mebar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu rtogs par bya/ /grub par gyur ⑫te nyes pa med/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs kun/ /mnyam par bzhag pas las rnams bya/ /'khor lo'i (sridabus su zhugs nas ni/ /mkhas pas sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /yid kyis spyordo rje ri mo ni/ /bteg cing kun tu phye nas kyang / /rdo rje sgo ni bzhi po dag /yid kyis yidabye bar bya ba yin/ /de la snying po ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra dha 7ra ud gha ṭa (1ya pra be (nyasha ya sa ma ya hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor phyi rol gnas rnams su/ /phyi yi rdo rje rigs dag bri/ /khyab 'jug la sogs lha rnams ni/ /kha khyer gyi ni phyed la gnas/ /'khor lo dang bcas rigs bcas 84wa 704

te / /sems can gdug pa gdon la sogs/ /rims dang 'byung po sha za dang //mkha' 'gro 'byung po ma mo dang / /lha mo mtshon cha dang ldan kun/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bri/ /phyi rol kha khyer gnas su ni/ /rdo rje kha khyer mdzes pa rnams/ /de nas sngon ①la slob dpon ches/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung bcas te/ /ting nge 'dzin ②la snyoms 'jug bya/ /ji ltar rdo rje rigs byung ba/ /de bzhin bdag nyid rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje rig pa mchog rgyal po/ /bdag nyid yang dag byin gyis brlab/ /rdo rje khro bo rgyal po mchog /ces bya de 'dra'i ting ①'dzin la④/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis(ge/ /skal ba chen po snyoms zhugs nas/ /ji skad gong du grags pa bzhin/ /shes rab can gyis ⑥thams cad bsam/ /ji ltar rdo rje rigs 'byung ⑦ba/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ni/ /rgya chen gsang ba chen po dang ske/ /rdo rje slob dpon cho ga mchog /rgyud chen gsang ba zhes bya ba/ /rtog ⑧pa 'di las rab tu bshad/ /de nas dbus su 'dug byas nas/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches/ /khro bo'i phyag rgya bcings 6)nas ni/ /phyag rgya thams cad yongs su bcings/ /khro bo rdo rje lcags kyu bcings/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang 7bya/ /mtshan brgya yonam brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig tu ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje me tog sogs mchod pas/ /'dren pa thams cad mchod par bya/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa gang bya ba/ /phyag rgya thams cad yongs su bcing / /phyag rgya nye ba'i phyag rgya ldan/ /de bzhin du ni mchod pa nyid/ /phyag rgya'i lan la sogs pa kun/ /cho ga rab tu ldan pa 'bul7/ /rdo rje dril bu dgrol bya zhing / /gdug pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdigs par bya/ /gdug pa'i 84—705

rung / /bdag nyid dang ni mtshungs pa ru/ /lus ni yang dag sbyor ba ni/ /dbang po snyoms 'jug brjod par bya'o①/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'am / /②rdo rje khro bo'am sems dpa' gzhan/ /de'i lus gang yin pa dang /bdag gi lus gang yin pa mtshungs par shes pa (7nyid/ 'di ni dbang po gnyis snyoms par 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /yang na rnam par bsgom ④pa yis⑤/ /ji skad bshad bzhin yan lag 'khyud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /dpung pa dam por bsdam par bya/ /yan lag kun la yongs 'khyud pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab grub 'gyur/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags brtag (6)mi bya/ /'di yis mtshungs par bsgoms ⑦pa yis/ /mtshungs pa nyid ni dbang po yin/ /haṃ tram̐ hūm̐ gi sbyor ba'i so dag gis(nya/ /mchu bzung nas ni 'o bya zhing / /sems can gang zhig rnam bsgom pa/ /des ni bde ba don yod thob/ /ju dza'apho/ sems can thams cad bde byed pa/ /yi ge hūm̐ de rab sbyor zhing / /bdag nyid khro bor rnam 7sbyangs nas/ /de nas bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /hūm̐/ gang gis hūm̐ ni rab sbyor zhing / /sems can dag ni gang dag gis/ /yan lag thams cad bsdus byas na/ /de yi nyon mongs bsrabs par 37'gyur/ /hūm̐ phaṭa/ ye shes chen pos yo)thabs ldan pa/ /rdo rje'i rigs ni thams cad nyid/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i 'khor bcas pas/ /mkhas pa yis ni bslab 12par bya/ /sangs rgyas sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rtag tu bdag ni bsgom 〉par bya/ /rnam smin snyimachog rnams kun ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas sku tshani rnam par bsgom/ /bsgom pa'i sbyor ba de yis ni/ /skad cig sangs rgyas nyid thob 'gyur/ /a/ rdo rje'i rig yi 7pa mchog rgyal po/ /bdag 84—710

phyag rgya chen po yongs bsdu ①ba/ /theg pa chen po mngon bsdus ②las/ /rgyud chen gsang ba zhes bya ba/ /rgyud der charab tu bshad pa yin/ /gsang ba'i cho ga 'di yis ni/ /rnal 'byor bya ba bsgrub ④par bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yisaX / /skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'grub/ /'dir ni phan yon mang po dag /rang gi las la nges par sbyaraX/ /gang zhig btul gzhing mngon par sbyor / /skad cig gis ⑧ni sangs rgyas 'grub/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang ske/ /zhugs nas mngon par brtson 'gyur zhing / /rnal 'byor cho ga sgrub byed na/ /'grub par 'gyur bar the tsom ⑨med/ /tshe 'di la ni rnal 'byor pas / /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob 'gyur/ /gang gis yirdo rje can sbyor bas/ /gdon mi za bar sa thob 'gyur/ / bskal pa grangs 7med dka' chab ni/ /spyod pa'i bdag nyid med par min/ /rnal 'byor 'di la mngon par brtson/ /de bas sa ni rnyed dka' min/ /theg chen 'di ni gsang ba ste/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi tshul bstan pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub snying po che/ /de las sa ni thob dka' min / /g.yon brkyang tu cha lugs gnas nas ni/ /khro bo'i tshig ni rab tu brjod / /khro bo'i lta bas yang dag khros/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub ④par bya / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdo sde'i dbang po gsang ba'i rnal 'byor gsang ba de kho na nyid dam pa mchog tu gsang ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rdo rje rtse mo las khams bigasum rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba rnam par bshad pa ste le'u tsogasum pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje'i rigs las le'u dang po'o// //de nas gsang ba dag ni kun bsdus mchog /sems kyi dga' ba kun sbyor 84—712 ci

yang dag byung / /bya ba byas shing mchog tu rnam par mdzes/ /rdo rje dbang phyug thams cad rnam 'phrul tshogs/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi ni rigs chen mchog /rdo rje snying po'i thugs byung bde ldan pa/ /shin tu gsang ba'i yon tan mchog bsdus ①pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po bud med gzugs can gyur/ /e ma'o bud med dga' ba mchog ②spyod pa/ /gsang ba kun tu bsdus ③pa las byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu 'jigs mi mnga'/ /de yis ④gsungs nas cang mi gsung bzhugs sol/ /gzungs kyi dam tshig yang dag byung ba mchog /ting 'dzin gnas nas chos nyid gsang ba ⑥ni/ /spyi bo rkang mthil kun bsdus ⑦bstan pa las/ /de yi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs dag phyung (kye/ /hrīḥ/ de nas dga' ba'i ming can dag kyang phyung / /rdo rje bud med thugs las byung ba mchog /gzugs khams mchog gi lha las shin tu 'das/ /rdo rje'i mtshams rnams lha mo'i tshig dag grag6) /dga' bcas 'dzum pa dang ldan spyan mnga' ba//bzhad cing sgeg dang bcas pa'i zhal ldan pa/ /tshangs sogs rigs kyi lha yi lha mo ste/ /yid 'ong dga' ba chen pos rgyal 'gyur ba/ /lha mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de yang / /'khor lo'i dbus su gnas nas rtog 7byed pa/ /de yi rigs bsdus (nyamadzes shing yid du 'ong / /rdo rje chen mo rdo rje rmongs byed ma/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā rā ga mo ha na ya tu nyi/ snying po sangs rgyas rmongs par byed pas gsungs / /de bzhin gshegs pa mchog kyang rmongs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dga' ba rmongs byed dga'/ /sangs rgyas gzugs dag yongs su sgyur tu ba mchog /rnam snang thub pa'i dbang phyug mchog de niski/ /bud med gzugs kyi sprul pa nyid du 'gyuratso/ /dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul mchog mnga' gang 8de ni/ /84—713

astob ha stisi ni hā sa ma sdibaskyo ②ha ra ha ra dzi/ yi ge dzi ni shin tu brtan par gnas / /snying po mchog tu shin ②tu gyur pa gsungs/ /rin chen dbang phyug dam pa de yis ni/ /snying po bskul ④bar byed pa'i mchog dag gsungs/ /snying po mchog gsungs rmad byung dugasungs par gyur/ /'od dpag med de bud ⑥med gzugs gyur pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo dam pa 'byung ba'i mchog /snying po bzhi po dag ni gsungs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra shud dhi ha na dunyi dhi/ oṃ tīk+ṣa gro dha sbyin da ⑦na sarba dhi ri/ badz+ra he tu ma hā kro dha pra be sha ya sarba dhi/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hā ⑧ma hā gro dha bhā ṣi 6nyepa tsa uṅga ⑩ra ya dhiḥyi/ snying po rig (semachog brtan pa gsungs par gyur/ /pad+ma'i tshudakyil 'khor dbang dang ldan pa mchog /'od dpag med pa'i gsang mchog bstan pa ste/ /snying po bskul tsoba'i mchog ni gsungs par gyur/ /78/ dga' ba chen pos mtshan ma dag kyang phyung / /don yiyod grub pa bud med gzugs gyur pas/ /las tunyel shin tu bskul hunyeb dang ldan te/ /'khor gyi sring mo dag ni bzhi po gsungs/ /oṃ sarba mu khe kurma badz+re ṇi ma hā ()kro dha ku ru sarba ṇi4 )/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tsa 6nyagro dhi (nyerak+ṣa ma ṇi/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhe ma hā yak+ṣi ṇi badz+re hūṃ sherda'i ka rā li (9bi lā sa zhunasarba ṇizhu nya/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi badz+ra gro dha zhunani/ de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs dag /mchog tu gsang ba bsdus ( nyepa dga' chen po/ /dbus kyi gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor skul 9 shebyed pa/ /las kyi btsun mo'i snying po mchog 'di gsungs/ /hūm̐/ dbus kyi gsang ba sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur ba/ /gtso bo 'di dag rnam par snang mdzad gsungs/ /oṃ badz+re shwa rī )rgyu/ oṃ 6nya rasne shwa rī zhi rtsu/ oṃ pad+me shwa rī sa)rtsu/ oṃ game shwa rī zhunyes/rdo rje rgyal mo dang bcas bskul ba las byung gang yin pa/ /rdo rje btsun mo rnal 84wa 715

'byor bzhi yis dbus kyi dbang phyug nyid du gnas/ /rdo rje rin chen chos ldan btsun mo yan lag mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ /'di ni gsang ba'i tshogs las gzhan du rnal 'byor mchog ni 'ga' ①yang med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog tu 'jigs mi mnga'/ /de ni rang ②gi 'khor tshogs dbus na bzhugs/ / des ni brtse (gudang phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog gsungs gyur/ /de nas 'khor lo'i grong khyer bstan byas nas/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i bdag nyid des④/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug btsun mo yi / /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rnal 'byor yang dag bri/ /grong khyer rnam pa gnyis su yang dag bri/ /'khor lo rnam pa gnyis su sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin grong khyer 'di ru yang dag 'ong ba dang / /yang na ji ltar 'dod bzhin yang dag bri / /de yang phyag rgya dag gi tshogs dang bcas/ /bsgom par 'os pa rdo rje yang dag bri/ /yang na gsang ba'i chos kyis (snyemachod gyur pa/ /de yini gzugs dang ldan pa yang dag bri/ /dbus kyi rim par rdo rje sems dpa' ⑦bzhugs/ /zhags pa dang ldan 'khor gyi phyag rgya bcas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba nor bu pad+ma las/ /'bar ba'i 98)dang bcas me dang ldan par gzhag /shar gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo lnga yi bdag nyid che/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gang du mi bskyod (9)gtso/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya che dang rol par gyur/ /dbang phyug chen po rtse gsum ldan non mchog /de nas phyogs bzhi'i gnas dag dang bo/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang dga' ba dag /'bar ba'i me yi 'od zer yang dag ldan/ /'bar ba'i (nyadabus na gnas pa'i phyag rgya mnga'1snye/ /de ni yo rin chen rigs na 8yid 'ong ba//rdo rje'i dbus na rdo rje rin chen bzhugs/ /de nas phyogs bzhi'i gnas dag tu/ /84—716

rin chen gzi brjid rgyal mtshan bzhad ①phyag rgya/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i rigs ni yid 'ong ②la/ /rdo rje ①pad+ma'i phyag rgya ste/ /de nas phyogs bzhi'i mtshams dag tu / /pad+ma'i byaral gri 'khor lo de bzhin smra/ /de bzhin las kyis dubyas pa'i rigs rjode las/ /rdo rje rnon po me chen dang ldan pa/ /de yi phyogs bzhi'i mtshams ni brtan pa ru/ /las dang gnod sbyin bsrung ba tshukhu tshur rnams/ /de las rgya cher gzugs kyi tshogs dag la/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog drag mkha' 'gro ma/ /'bar ba'i mche ba chen po 'jigs nirung ma/ /dbus na rdo rje nyi ma 'bar ba ①ldan/ /sa yidag bsrung ⑩ba'i cho gar bcas/ /rgya cher gzhung mchog rtag tu blta ⑩bar bya/ /sbyang dang dbab pa'i las rnams thams cad ni/ /yan lag mchog ldan dam pa las gzung 0bya/ /de nas phyag rgya 8phyag rgya'i yan lag bslabatso/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgyas mchod pa'i phyag rgyar brjod/ /de nas sgo dang mtshams bcas dkyil 'khor du/ /btsun mo dag bos gnam 8lcags gnod sbyin mchog /de nas sgor ⑩'jug pa yi tshogs la ni/ /badz+ra dzaḥdzaḥ(she/dgug pa'i pheg rdob sprin ni rgya che ba/ /badz+ra hūṃ rgyu/ de bzhin 'ching ba'i chos ni ster byed pa/ /badz+ra baṃ bam̐/ de nas ye shes chos nyid sna tshogs pa/ /badz+ra aḥ.aḥyi / de nas gsang ba'i sgeg ( )pa dang bcas mchod/ /badz+ra hūm̐ kho( nya/de nas yan lag phreng ba sna tshogs ldan/ /badz+ra hūm̐ r+ghaṃ/ de nas glu ( 3blang ba dang rol mo dag /badz+ra hūṃ rta/ de bzhin gzhan dag dkyil 'khor dbang phyug mchog /badz+ra hūm̐ ste/ de nas phyi rol me tog rgya chen po/ /badz+ra ti te/ de bzhin rol cha stong phrag dag brdungs pa/ /badz+ra ṭaṃ ta/ spos dang dri ldan rol mo sosnyedag bri ba/ /badz+ra dhā tu/ de nas 'od zer snang ba rab tu spro/ /badz+ra gro khrin84—717
